122011.label: Other impact (e.g. award of patents or prizes, collaboration with other research institutions, technology transfer, etc.)
122011.value: There are many tall buildings in Hong Kong. Nearly all high-rises have lifts. All lifts have ropes for hoisting the lifts. Due to the humid and saline environment in Hong Kong, the lift ropes are suffering from rusting. The current rope inspection method is still depending on human visual inspection. On March 2, 2013, there was a lift accident occurred in a commercial building located at North Point. This accident caused seven people in hospital with three of them in critical health condition and four others injured. The concerned lift plunged to ground after all four hoisting ropes broken (Oriental Daily News and Apple Daily, head news, page A1, March 3, 2013). As mentioned in the newspapers, for the past five years, there were at least 10 similar lift incidents. It is because according to the lift regulations issued by the American Society of Mechanical Engineering (ASME), the core wire of a lift rope, which is subjected to the heaviest load, will fail first. However, using human visual inspection cannot detect the health condition of the internal core wire. Even for inspecting the external twisted wires, because they are often covered by oil and dirt, using visual inspection is difficult to identify rust and cracks on the rope. Hence, continuously using such ineffective human visual inspection method, more lift accidents will definitely occur. Today, 15 SCI indexed high-ranking journal papers, 3 book chapters and 9 peer-reviewed conference papers have been published. Three PhD students were supported and/or performing research work related to this project. Three undergraduate students were hired by using this research project fund for helping data analysis. Because of the success in generating useful research outcomes, it attracted 13 newspapers/bulletins and even TVB news to report the outcomes. The foundation research of guided wave developed in this project not only can benefit the quality inspection of ropes/cables, but also leads to the success of obtaining another GRF project which uses the improved guided wave to inspect building risers. The successive GRF has been granted for around $860,000. Moreover, because of the practical research outcomes that have been generated by this project, we have intended to commercialize the research outcomes and applied an Innovation and Technology Fund (ITF) platform project. The ITF project has been approved and successfully attracted $2.6 million dollars from the Hong Kong Government Innovation and Technology Council and sponsorship from the related industry. Without the foundation research work of guided wave developed and implemented from this GRF project, it is impossible to prepare the successive GRF and ITF projects and finally obtained the supports. By using our future products in the integrity and quality inspection of cables, ropes, pipes and building risers etc., less accident is expected and consequently more valuable human lives will be saved.

122511.label: Project Title(Chinese)
122511.value: 关于网状网络构建，蛋白质位点预测及蛋白质复合体预测的算法

122511.label: Project Objectives
122511.value: Reticulate Network construction: design efficient and effective algorithms for two models: (1) In-Degree-2 Phylogenetic Network Construction from Multiple Trees and (2) Irrelated Phylogenetic Network Construction from Multiple Trees. We will also attack a related problem, the HGT inference with given duplications problem. Protein Binding Site Prediction: design new algorithms for protein binding site prediction. Our new method will first identify surface substructures of proteins and then directly compute a 3D rigid transformation to match each candidate pair of binding sites (3D substructures). Protein Complex Prediction: design new algorithm for protein complex prediction. We will extend the single interaction assumption approach and consider joining a set of 3D structures of proteins in a complex in 3D space. The main issue is to compute rigid transformations simultaneously for a set (or subset) of proteins in a complex. This is the first time that 3D structure transformations are used for protein complex prediction. We will implement all those algoritms to form software packages needed in practice.

122511.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
122511.value: 计算生物学是一个在一些生物研究中起着至关重要的作用迅速发展的领域，。我们的项目目标是设计和分析 在计算的三个重要问题的有效的算法。 这三个重要的问题包括：网状网络的建设问题，蛋白结合位点预测和蛋白质复合体的预测。 构建一个物种的进化史是生物进化的研究的一个基本问题。网纹事件发生时，进化 历史应该被描述为一个网状网络。网状网络的建设问题吸引了大量的关注。我们将设计有效的算法。 确定蛋白质的结合位点的位置是一个 重要的问题。它有着广泛的应用，例如分子对接， 药物设计，结构鉴定和功能位点的比较。在这里，我们 提出了一种全新的方法来解决这个问题。我们的方法的主要思路 是通过考虑蛋白质分子的体积找出表面部分作为候选结合位点，然后通过计算蛋白质三维结构刚体变换来确定蛋白质子结构是否匹配。 蛋白质复合体是多种蛋白质群，他们往往是 基底细胞机制的重要组成部分。因此，用计算的方法来预测 蛋白质复合体变得越来越重要。在这个项目中，我们提出了一个新的 对蛋白质复合体的预测方法。我们将尝试用蛋白质对接的方法来进行预测。 该项目将为解决这三个问题提供一个坚实的理论基础。我们也将 实现这些算法并产生三个软件包。

122511.label: Realisation of objectives
122511.value: Protein Binding Site Prediction， We propose a method which enumerates “all” the configurations (or poses) between two proteins (3D coordinates of the two subunits in a complex) and evaluates each configuration by the interaction between its components using the Atomic Contact Energy function. The enumeration is achieved efficiently by exploring a set of rigid transformations. Our approach incorporates a surface identification technique and a method for avoiding clashes of two subunits when computing rigid transformations. When the optimal transformations according to the Atomic Contact Energy function are identified, the corresponding binding sites are given as predictions. Our results show that this approach consistently performs better than other methods in binding site identification. Our method achieved a success rate higher than other methods, with the prediction quality improved in terms of both accuracy and coverage. Moreover, our method is being able to predict the configurations of two binding proteins, where most of other methods predict only the binding sites. Protein Complex Prediction: we design a new protein complex prediction method by extending the idea of using domain–domain interaction information. Here we formulate the problem into a maximum matching problem (which can be solved in polynomial time) instead of the binary integer linear programming approach (which can be NP-hard in the worst case). We also add a step to predict domain–domain interactions which first searches the database Pfamusing the hidden Markov model and then predicts the domain–domain interactions based on the database DOMINE and Inter Dom which contain confirmed DDIs. By adding the domain–domain interaction prediction step, we have more edges in the DDI graph and the recall value is increased significantly (at least doubled) comparing with the method of Ozawa et al. (2010) [1] while the average precision value is slightly better. We also combine our method with three other existing methods, such as COACH, MCL and MCODE. Experiments show that the precision of the combined method is improved.

123411.label: Project Title(Chinese)
123411.value: 界面親和效應對潤滑接觸副內摩擦力的影響

123411.label: Project Objectives
123411.value: To develop an original optical sliding lubricated test rig that works with both wedge and parallel step bearing contacts, and can facilitate simultaneous measurements of film thickness and friction; To find an effective means to produce interfaces of different degrees of affinity for oil-based lubricant (from oleophilic to oleophobic); To experimentally investigate the influence of interface affinity on lubrication behaviour under different sliding conditions, in terms of speed, load and inclined angle; To build a theoretical model to describe the relation between interfacial (liquid/solid) properties (i.e., contact angle, surface energy) and boundary slip characteristic parameters (i.e., critical shear stress or slip velocity); To study the trade-off between friction and film formation capacity, and thus enable optimum lubrication design.

123411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
123411.value: 節能已成為當今世界關注的熱點問題。本課題致力於通過探索疏油塗層新技術及該塗層與潤滑油的界面親和機理來減小摩擦力。 現有的摩擦力模型大都基於潤滑油的粘性流動特性。公認的一個假設性邊界條件是：潤滑油與固體界面之間無相對滑動。該假設對於大多數工程界面適用的，因為潤滑油可以很好地粘附在固體界面上且該粘附力比粘性力大得多。在這樣的條件下，摩擦係數往往是潤滑油粘度的函數，即摩擦力的減小可以通過減小潤滑油的粘度來實現。但是，對大多數工程應用而言這種方法受到了限制，因為減小潤滑油粘度將直接導致潤滑油膜的減小，其結果是使固體表面承受更大的磨損。另外一種方法是通過潤滑油在固體界面的滑動（或被稱為“界面滑移”）來減小潤滑接觸副內的滑動摩擦力。這就要求潤滑油與固體界面間的粘附力非常低。而較低的介面親和力可以利用疏油塗層或採用特定的表面來獲得。 最近，被限于小縫隙內的潤滑油膜界面滑移已經被廣泛報導。實驗結果已經證明在動壓潤滑系統中，當接觸副中的一個表面採用疏油處理后將會使摩擦力減小。然而我們的實驗結果表明低界面親和性也會導致潤滑油膜厚度的減小。爲了更好的利用界面親和效應及增強潤滑系統的有效性，我們需要進一步更好地理解界面親和性、摩擦力和膜厚這三者之間的關係。我們的研究重點集中于將目前的實驗測量技術拓展至摩擦力測量，這樣測量得到的膜厚數據、摩擦力數據及潤滑油的界面親和效應可以同時獲取并評價。 本項目可交付的成果包括：（i）自主研發的光學滑塊潤滑實驗臺，該實驗臺可實現摩擦力和膜厚的同時測量；（ii）製備不同界面親和特性試樣的有效方法；（iii）通過大範圍的運動工況回歸理論模型，用以描述及預測潤滑油親和效應與界面滑移之間的關係；（iv）探尋和理解因界面親和性引起的摩擦力減小和油膜承載能力之間的權衡關係。 在本項目完成時，我們將能夠澄清如何選擇合適的界面親和特性來對潤滑系統產生正面的影響。

123411.label: Realisation of objectives
123411.value: (Objective 1) This study made use of an existing optical slider-on-disc test rig that can adopt both wedge and step bearing sliding contact. The test rig was successfully further developed to facilitate simultaneous measurements of film thickness and friction. The friction measurement was achieved by using a load cell of high sensitivity. The real challenge was to implement simultaneous measurements of friction and film thickness, particularly, under transient conditions. A new optical technique using dichromatic interferometry was developed for measuring lubricating film thickness. The new measuring technique enables the on-line measurement of lubricant film thickness. Lastly, even though the current design of friction measurement has fulfilled the objective, its sensitivity should be enhanced. For well lubricated contact, the magnitude of friction is expected to be very small. Due to this limitation, there were not too many friction data taken in the study. (Objective 2) The project successfully achieved liquid/solid interfaces of different degrees of affinity (from oleophilic to oleophobic). The combination of five very smooth slider surfaces of different materials (Cr, glass, steel, an anti-fingerprint coating and a proprietary oleophobic coating) and three lubricants (Glycerol, PAO and Silicon oils), polar and non-polar, provided contact angles ranging from 30 to 110 degrees. A more systematic variation of interfacial affinity was realized by adding different amounts of perfluorohepanoic acid into Silicon oil 201-500. (Objective 3) Upon successfully developed the major test rig, we have performed significant amount of tests with slider/oil combinations of different interfacial affinities under various operating conditions. Overall speaking, hydrodynamic film thickness or load carrying capacity can be reduced if the interface affinity is weakened. (Objective 4) Based on our experimental results, we successfully identified contact angle hysteresis, CAH, being the best interfacial parameter to correlate with hydrodynamic lubrication. This finding is significant to the hydrodynamic bearing design. We also dug up a theoretical model derived based on thermodynamic principles which relates the surface energy barrier to CAH. The relation of boundary yield stress and potential energy barrier was described. (Objective 5) We found that making the whole bearing surface oleophobic can only slightly reduce the frictional force but it also lower the bearing carrying load capacity. Recent findings from different researchers point out that the friction reduction as well as the load capacity enhancement can be achieved by implementing boundary slip only on part of the bearing surface instead of the whole surface.

123411.label: Major findings and research outcome
123411.value: 1. Update of the fixed-incline slider test rig We have made great improvement to the fixed-incline slider tester which was invented by my research team in 2010. The major drawback of the tester was the requirement of stopping the test and the slider falling through the lubricating film in order to measurement film thickness. More seriously, this practice hindered the installment of a load cell to get the friction. This project has successfully devised a new dichromatic interferometry technique, which enables the on-line measurement of lubricant film thickness. The new feature brings in a lot of conveniences. Measurements of film thickness and friction can be continuously taken even the operating conditions is changed. The new updates make the existing test rig to be used for other research projects. (The new optical technique presented in Journal Paper [3] and [4] in Part C) 2. Effect of interface affinity on hydrodynamic lubrication We found that the weak interfacial affinity could lead to substantial reduction in lubricating film thickness and thus low load carrying capacity (Journal Paper (1-2, 5-6) in Part C), but the expected advantage, friction reduction, is not significant (Conference Paper (1) in Part C). Recent findings from various researchers show that both friction reduction and load capacity enhancement can be achieved by implementing boundary slip only on part of the bearing surface instead of the whole surface. 3. Best interfacial parameter correlated with hydrodynamic lubrication We evaluated different facial and interfacial parameters and eventually we identified contact angle hysteresis, CAH, being the best interfacial parameter to correlate with hydrodynamic lubrication. This finding can advance the design of a hydrodynamic lubricated system from the perspective of interfacial properties. (Journal Paper (5) in Part C). 4. Relation of boundary yield shear stress and surface potential energy barrier The boundary yield stress which is the threshold for slip was derived from the experimental results by a two-dimensional hydrodynamic lubrication analysis using a simple boundary yield-stress slip model. The potential energy barrier was calculated using the measured contact angle and contact angle hysteresis. Results showed that the two parameters are monotonically related. (Journal Paper (6) in Part C)

123411.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
123411.value: Weak solid/liquid interfacial affinity leads to the reduction in bearing load carrying capacity. As pointed out by various researchers, the friction reduction and load capacity enhancement can only be achieved by facilitating only part of bearing surface slip but not the whole surface. Such hypothesis was raised mainly based on numerical and theoretical studies. To the best of my knowledge, there is no related experimental work. It is really worth to study the effect of patterned slip surface on lubrication. After the current updates, the existing fixed-incline slider test rig is all suitable for this proposed study.

123411.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
123411.value: This project studied the effect of the molecular adhesive strength at the solid/liquid interface on lubricated system. Conventional concept to reduce friction of a lubricated system is to use a lubricant of lower viscosity. However, there is a limitation to reduce lubricant viscosity in most engineering applications, because reducing viscosity would lead to a thinner lubricant film, which would induce more wear on the solid surface. This study explored a new concept to reduce friction, i.e. to save energy, by facilitating sliding of the lubricant on the solid surface (boundary slip). Effective means to prepare solid/liquid interfaces of various affinity through surface modification or/and using oil additives were obtained. A key interfacial parameter, contact angle hysteresis, which is closely related to the lubricating effect was identified. The relation of interfacial affinity to the condition at which boundary slip occurs was described. These findings have good practical value in engineering application. Furthermore, this project also made advancement of an optical slider test rig such that it can produce simultaneous measurements of friction and lubricating film thickness. The updated tester provides great conveniences for experimental lubrication studies.

123511.label: Project Objectives
123511.value: Security Against Malicious KGCs – reduce the trust level on the authorities in attribute-based cryptography, where the authorities include a centralized authority (CA) and multiple attribute authorities (AAs). This involves the investigation of accountable ABE (Attribute-Based Encryption), new security models for anonymous ABE against honest-but-curious KGCs (including the CA and/or multiple AAs), and new constructions of anonymous ABE and ABS (Attribute-Based Signature) against malicious KGCs. ABE with Delegation – support multiple levels of decryption delegation. Formalize and construct delegable ABE schemes which allow multiple levels of delegated parties to decrypt a ciphertext without the real-time involvement of a delegating party. ABE with Revocation – allow compromised attribute keys held by individual users to be revoked efficiently by formalizing revocation requirements in the context of ABE and proposing constructions of revocable ABE schemes which can be proven with full security against adaptive chosen key attacks. Multi-Authority ABE – eliminate non-standard number-theoretic assumption and construct schemes which are provable in the standard model with full security against adaptive chosen key attacks. Also support multiple AAs with large universe construction. Different AAs may manage different sets of attributes while malicious AAs cannot compromise a user’s encrypted messages even they collude. Oblivious Transfer with Access Control (AC-OT) using ABE – design an efficient and concrete AC-OT protocol based on CP-ABE and fully-simulatable oblivious transfer protocol that can be proven with full security in the standard model while improving the computational complexity of the protocol, especially at the user side.

123511.label: Realisation of objectives
123511.value: Under the support of this grant, we have accomplished all the project objectives, and have published 7 papers on reputable venues which include ACM CCS 2013 and IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security. We proposed both whitebox and blackbox traceable Attribute Based Encryption (ABE) schemes in both ciphertext-policy and key-policy settings. We successfully constructed and proven security an ABE scheme which support multiple centralized authorities and attribute authorities. Delegation of key issuance is also considered and an extension of our basic schemes has been proposed for supporting delegation. In other words, we have successfully attained positive results with respect to objects 1 to 4. On objective 5, we proposed an ABE based system which allows privacy-preserving data sharing in public clouds using our newly proposed cryptographic primitive called ciphertext-policy attribute-based proxy re-encryption scheme. This achieves oblivious transfer with fine-grained access control with high efficiency.

123511.label: Major findings and research outcome
123511.value: We successfully built a CP-ABE (Ciphertext-Policy ABE) scheme which supports multiple Attribute Authorities (AAs) and shows that it is secure even if malicious AAs collude without relying on the random oracle assumption. We considered the revocation issue of ABE and proposed an integration technique which enables several major ABE schemes to support revocation. The resulting schemes can still maintain the collusion resistance and high expressivity (i.e. the access policies can be in any monotonic access structure form). In particular, we have successfully defined and built a "white-box" traceable CP-ABE which is highly expressive (i.e. supporting any monotone access structures). The scheme is efficient and has been proven secure in the adaptive security model we defined in the standard model. Based on the "white-box" traceable CP-ABE, we proposed new techniques for achieving ABE with delegation and privacy-preserving access control using ABE. The resulting traceable ABE schemes can identify malicious users, so called traitors, from a decryption blackbox.

123511.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
123511.value: The CP-ABE and Key-Policy-based ABE (KP-ABE) schemes we proposed in this project support high expressivity (i.e. supporting any monotonic access structures) with security in standard model. Revocation can also be supported in the blacklist fashion. However, the number of attributes in the schemes is bounded polynomially with respect to the security parameter. One further development direction is to further enhance the ABE schemes, both on CP-ABE and KP-ABE, so that they can support large attribute universe which could have an exponential number of attributes with respect to the security parameter.

123511.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
123511.value: Attribute Based Encryption (ABE) is a natural extension of the conventional public key cryptography. It extends the identity-based cryptographic setting to attributes. This is significant in both theory and practice as it not only includes the conventional public key cryptography under identities in a one-to-one fashion, ABE supports one-to-many encryption in an efficient way. As a young and vibrant field in public key cryptography, we observe that attribute-based cryptography has promising applications and a wide range of interesting research problems. The research results produced in this project contribute to the development of ABE. They make the ABE schemes more practical and one step closer to real applications. With revocation and traceability, ABE schemes finally have the mechanisms to handle the real-world situation that people leave and join an organization dynamically, and it is the corporate's interest to control the issuance and revocation of employees' credentials on a secure corporate network. Furthermore, it is also the corporate's interest to be able to identify any insiders who violate the security policies of the corporate.

123711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
123711.value: The use of externally bonded fiber-reinforced polymer (EB-FRP) is currently one of the most popular methods for the rehabilitation of concrete structures. However, the efficacy of this method is limited by the relatively weak adhesive interface it provides, which often causes premature debonding of the FRP materials from the concrete substrate. This problem can be effectively overcome by a newly developed bond enhancement system – the hybrid bonded FRP system (HB-FRP) – in which small mechanical fasteners are used to augment the bond. Five years of investigations on the HB-FRP system have confirmed its effectiveness in enhancing EB-FRP bonds. Considering its high degree of effectiveness and the lack of better solutions for intermediate crack-induced debonding, the proposed Hong Kong Guideline for the Strengthening of Concrete Structures Using FRP Composites (referred to as the Hong Kong Guideline below) recommends the use of such bond enhancement systems for EB-FRP. However, due to the lack of design theory for the new bonding system, the Hong Kong Guideline imposes a limit on the bond strength, and furthermore, specifies experimental validation for a particular HB-FRP system. Such restrictions and requirements not only limit the efficacy of the technology, but may also hinder its use due to the difficulty involved in test verification. This proposed research project will develop a theory supporting design of the HB-FRP system through both experimental testing and analytical studies. The direct deliverables of the project will include identification of the bond-slip relationship, the effective bond length, and the bond capacity of the HB-FRP system, which will together form the basis for a comprehensive understanding and evaluation of its bond properties and for the development of design guidelines. 外贴纤维复合材料加固法是目前最流行的方法之一。然而对于混凝土结构的外贴加固，粘结面剥离问题一直困扰着工程和学术界，成为阻碍该方法进一步推广的一个主要瓶颈。这一问题目前有了一种较好的解决方法-混合粘贴技术。经过5年多不断的研究，该技术对解决剥离问题的有效性和实用性已经得到肯定，从而被写入香港FRP加固混凝土结构规程之中。然而，目前的研究仍然属于定性研究阶段，而实际工程应用需要定量计算和设计。因此本课题的目标是开发混合粘贴技术的定量计算公式和设计方法。研究的直接成果将是：界面粘结滑移关系，粘结强度和有效粘结长度，从而建立混合粘贴加固的设计方法。由于混合粘结法具有一般性，本课题的研究成果将同样适用于其它外贴体系，因此有助于进一步理解此类复合体系的机理和推动该技术的进步。

123711.label: Realisation of objectives
123711.value: All of the objectives of the project have been achieved 100% with additional outcomes. Four objectives were initially proposed and realization of them are summarized below: Objective 1-Identification of the bond-slip relationship for HB-FRP Extensive experimental tests have been completed. Based on the experimental results and mathematical, numerical, and analytical studies, the interfacial mechanism of this new system has been clearly identified, and the composite mechanics theory has been developed for this new system. In particular, the interfacial bond-slip relationship has been established both qualitatively and quantitatively. Objective 2 - Development of a theory for evaluating the bond strength of HB-FRP Based on the composite theory developed in this project, the theory or model for calculating the maximum bond strength of HB-FRP system has been derived, with coefficients experimentally identified and typical bond strength of the system evaluated. Objective 3 - Establish a standard test protocol to determine the parameters required for objective 2 Through analytical study and experimental validation, a standard test protocol has been successfully developed for engineering use. A graphical method has been developed for easy application and interpretation of test results obtained from bond tests. This outcome was not originally planned and is an additional result of the project. Objective 4 - Development of a design method and guidelines for HB-FRP Based on the above results, the design methodology and guidelines for calculation and construction of the HB-FRP system have been developed. The guidelines are convenient and easy for engineering applications.

123811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
123811.value: Power efficiency is becoming a critical issue across all types of computing domains, from mobile devices, PCs, to supercomputers. Studies have shown that memory and cache consume over 60% of the power in most of computing systems. As semi-conductor technology advance into sub-micro levels, static power is surpassing dynamic power and becoming the dominant factor in power consumption. While the processor technology has grown exponentially in the last quarter of century along with the semi-conductor advancement, memory technology has been lagging behind. In the last couple of years, exciting developments in memory technology aim to solve the power efficiency issue as well as bring memory technology leaping forward. New memory developments center on Non-volatile Memories (NVM), such as Phase Change Memory (PCM), Spin Torque Transfer RAM (STT-RAM), Flash Memory. These memories have the characteristics of non-volatility, shock-resistivity, high density and power-economy. At the same time, there are limitations on non-volatile memories. Write operations on non-volatile memories usually incur higher latency or energy, and non-volatile memories often have limited lifetimes bounded by the number of write operations. Cost is another factor that is limiting the wide adoption of large-scale non-volatile memories. It is observed that neither pure SRAM/DRAM nor pure NVM is the best solution for low power and high performance systems. With the goal of obtaining all the benefits of NVM while retaining the write efficiency and cost efficiency of SRAM/DRAM, in this project, we propose hybrid caches and memories based on NVM for practical low power and high performance systems. Memories and caches are often organized into hierarchical structures in a computing system. This project intends to build hybrid memory solutions on four levels: hybrid scratch-pad memory, hybrid last-level cache, hybrid main memory, and hybrid disk cache. There are common ideas and techniques that can be shared and applied to all four levels, for example, data allocation between different parts of the hybrid memory based on the read and write characteristics. At each level, armed with different information available and along with different settings, we have identified different perspectives to develop unique, effective, and efficient hybrid solutions. Synergies among these four levels will lead to the success of this project as a whole. The future of memory is NVM based hybrid cache and memories. This project will make significant contributions to memory and cache research and the results can be applied directly in several vital industries of Hong Kong. 功耗问题成为了所有类型计算领域里的一个关键问题，无论是移动设备，个人电脑，还是超级计算机。有研究表明，在大多数计算机系统中，内存和缓存消耗了超过60％的功耗。随着半导体技术进步到亚微米级别，静态功耗正在超过动态功耗并成为功耗的主要因素。虽然随着半导体在最后1/4世纪中的进步，处理器技术已经有了指数级的发展，但是内存技术一直发展滞后。然而在过去的几年中，内存技术有了令人振奋的发展，用以解决功耗问题并带来了内存技术的跳跃式前进。 新的内存发展集中于非易失性存储器（Non-volatile Memories,NVM），比如相变存储器（Phase Change Memory, PCM），自旋转移RAM（Spin Torque Transfer RAM, STT-RAM的），闪存(Flash Memory)。这些存储器具有非易失性，耐冲击，高密度和节省功耗等特性。与此同时，这些非易失性存储器也有一定的限制。非易失性存储器的写操作通常具有更高的延迟或能耗，并且这类写操作的数量限制也制约了非易失性存储器的寿命。成本是限制大规模非易失性存储器广泛采用的另一个因素。据观察，纯粹的SRAM / DRAM，或者纯粹的NVM，都不是低功耗和高性能系统的最佳解决方案。所以为了能利用NVM的所有优势，同时保留的SRAM / DRAM的写入效率和成本效率，在这个项目中，我们提出了基于NVM的混合式（hybrid）缓存和内存技术，用于实际的低功耗和高性能系统中。 内存和缓存通常是以存储层次结构的方式组织在计算系统中。该项目拟建立四个层次的混合存储解决方案：混合式高速暂时存储器（scratch-pad memory, SPM），混合式最后一级缓存，混合式主存储器，混合式磁盘缓存。在这四个层次中，有一些共通的想法和技术可以共享和应用，例如，基于读写特性的在混合式存储的不同部分上的数据分配。在每个层次上，借由已知的不同信息和不同设置，我们已经确定了不同的角度来发展独特的，有效的，高效的混合式解决方案。这四个层次之间的协同合作将引导这个项目作为一个整体的成功。 存储器的未来是基于非易失性存储器的混合式缓存和内存。该项目将在内存和缓存的研究上作出重大的贡献，同时结果可以直接得应用于香港的若干重要行业。

123811.label: Major findings and research outcome
123811.value: In this project, non-volatile memory (NVM) based hybrid scratch-pad memory, hybrid cache, hybrid main memory, hybrid disk cache are exploited. Based on NVM's read-write asymmetric property, optimization techniques in both compilation level and architecture level are proposed. It has been a fruitful journey for this project. A total of nine IEEE/ACM Transaction journals have been published as a result of this project.

123811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
123811.value: In the future, further improvement and optimization can be conducted for NVM. For example, we can relax the non-volatility requirement to get better write performance and energy cost. Careful designs are needed so that data will not be lost with relaxed non-volatility. Furthermore, redesign of the whole memory hierarchy can be considered, as now we have non-volatility in higher levels of the memory hierarchy. Re-design of the persistence scheme and backup strategies will be exploited.

123811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
123811.value: The results of this project is one big step forward in applying non-volatile memory in modern computer systems. The recent announcement by Intel of its X-point memory is one example of NVM is coming into commercial products soon. The software and system level solutions proposed by this project will be significant impact for the wide adoption of NVM in near future low power and high performance systems.

124411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
124411.value: Given an array, the Range Minimum Query (RMQ) asks for the minimum element within a contiguous subarray. The 1D version of the RMQ problem is a fundamental problem in string pattern matching, and the multidimensional version has an important application in database systems, i.e., it can be used to answer range MIN/MAX queries in OLAP (online analytical processing) data cubes. This proposal aims to do an extensive study of the RMQ problem in multidimensional arrays, and design efficient data structures to meet various requirements. The requirements considered are related to (but not limited to) external memory data structures, time-space trade-offs, dynamic updates, and probabilistic inputs. 給定一個數組，區域最小元素查詢 （RMQ） 從一個連續的子數組返回一個最小的元素。一維版本的 RMQ 問題在字符串模式匹配裏面有重要應用。多維版本的 RMQ 問題在數據庫系統裏面也有重要應用，比如在線上分析處理中查詢立方裏面的區域最小或最大元素。 這個項目旨在深入研究多維數組 RMQ 問題以及為不同的需求而設計數據結構。這些需求包括（但不限於）外部存儲數據結構，時間-空間平衡，動態更新，以及隨機輸入。

124411.label: Realisation of objectives
124411.value: 1. Design efficient external memory data structures for multidimensional RMQ. For this objective, we made some attempt to design external memory data structures and we found that there is a lower bound for the number of memory blocks to be read which makes a straightforward algorithm optimal in this sense. 2. Design cache-oblivious data structures for multidimensional RMQ. We explored the problem along this direction but other groups publish results earlier. One reference can be found in "I/O-Efficient Range Minima Queries" by Peyman Afshani, Nodari Sitchinava in 2014 3. Improve existing time-space trade-offs schemes. We investigated the problem and found that less number of comparisons can be achieved if more space is allowed. However, it is only a small result and not much appreciated by the community. 4. Design efficient data structures to handle different types of dynamic updates. This is achieved in the journal version of the COCOON 2015 paper which is invited to Algorithmica. 5. Design efficient data structures for reasonable probability distributions. This is achieved in the COCOON 2015 paper.

124411.label: Major findings and research outcome
124411.value: Given a d-dimensional array and an integer p, the max (or min) filter is the set of maximum (or minimum) elements within a d-dimensional sliding window of edge length p inside the array, which is extended version of RMQ. The current best algorithm for computing the 1D max (or min) filter, due to Yuan and Atallah [15], uses 1 + o(1) comparisons per sample in the worst case. As a direct consequence, the d-dimensional max (or min) filter can be computed in (1 + o(1))d comparisons per sample, and the d-dimensional max and min filters can be computed simultaneously using (2 + o(1))d comparisons per sample. Both bounds are the best known results for the corresponding problems, on both worst-case inputs and independently and identically distributed (i.i.d.) inputs. We present an algorithm for computing d-dimensional max and min filters simultaneously on i.i.d. inputs that uses 1:5+o(1) expected comparisons per sample. This is the first algorithm for d-dimensional max and min filters (on i.i.d. inputs) that gets rid of the dependence on d in the number of comparisons needed. It also achieves the optimal upper bound up to the lower order term. In particular, for the 1D case, our algorithm improves the previous best upper bound of 2 + o(1) to 1:5 + o(1). As a by-product of our algorithm, we can also compute the d-dimensional max (or min) filter on i.i.d. inputs using 1 + o(1) expected comparisons per sample, which matches the bound for the 1D case. We then obtained results for dynamic update where the probability of update in each location is the same. we made some attempt to design external memory data structures and we found that there is a lower bound for the number of memory blocks to be read which makes a straightforward algorithm optimal in this sense. Cartesian tree (which can be used to solve RMQ) is a fundamental data structure with many applications in the areas of data structures and string processing. We study the construction of a Cartesian tree on a parallel computation model. We present a CREW PRAM algorithm that runs in O(log n) parallel time and has linear work and space. This improves upon the best previous result of Blelloch and Shun which takes O(log^2 n) time and linear work/space.

124411.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
124411.value: One possible direction for further research is to study approximate range minimum query where an approximately good candidate will be returned on the query. This will be especially useful when the data size is too big (will usually be the case in the big data era) and cannot be stored as a whole in the data structure. Furthermore, if the data are stored in the cloud in the encrypted form, how to return the answer for the range minimum query without leaking the information of the data is also quite challenging.

124411.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
124411.value: Range Minimum Query (RMQ) is a fundamental algorithmic tool to design efficient data structures for string pattern matching. The 1D version of the problem has been studied extensively, but not many algorithmic results for the multidimensional RMQ were known until recently. In this research project, we extend our knowledge to the multidimensional cases, which have important applications. One typical application of the multidimensional cases is the range MIN/MAX queries in OLAP (online analytical processing) data cubes. The range MIN/MAX queries are basic query types in OLAP data cubes. Therefore, it is important to study the multidimensional RMQ problem. Our obtained results improve the performance of queries in high dimensional spaces and can also manage dynamic update of the data sets for data which are randomly distributed within a range.

140011.label: Project Objectives
140011.value: The first objective of this paper is to investigate how cross-country differences in laws regulating the relation between employer and employees affect the price (interest rate) of loans offered to firms in those countries. In theory, it is not clear whether regulations that grant stronger bargaining power to workers should increase or decrease the price of bank loans. As indicated, labor regulation can affect the workers’ relative influence on important corporate decisions, and, in particular, decisions that directly affect their job security or wages and benefits. On the one hand, because workers’ job security and wages are usually tied to firm performance and its survival, workers tend to oppose corporate decisions that may increase the probability of corporate bankruptcy. Consequently, more stringent employment protection laws or greater power of labor unions can reduce credit risk and, in turn, lower interest rates charged by banks. On the other hand, firms operating in countries with stronger employment protection may not be able to implement necessary value-enhancing restructuring activities that may result in job losses or lower wages. Consequently, stronger labor regulation can increase credit risk and, hence, raise loan interest rates charged by banks. Which effect dominates in reality is an empirical question. The second objective of this study is to examine the effects of labor regulation on the nonprice dimensions of loan contracts, such as loan size and loan maturity. It is often argued that banks adjust both the price and non-price terms of loans in response to higher credit risk. For example, Stiglitz and Weiss (1981) posit that rather than increasing the interest rate on loans, banks can ration credit to riskier borrowers. Consequently, I expect that labor market laws influences the size and maturity of loans offered to firms as well.

140011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
140011.value: In this proposed research project, I examine how differences in labor market regulation across 40 countries influence the price and nonprice terms of bank loans offered to firms. My paper contributes to a recent and growing literature on the role of firm-labor relations in shaping firms’ financing decisions. Specifically, Matsa (2010) and Bae, Kang and Wang (2010) show that labor union bargaining power and firms’ treatment of employees have an important effect on the firms’ use of debt financing. To date, however, there has not been a cross-country empirical study exploring the role of laws regulating the relation between employers and employees in determining corporate loan contract terms. This project intends to fill this gap. I plan to use cross-country data on different aspects of labor market regulation, such as employment protection laws, labor unionization rate, labor bargaining power, and other employee practices, along with several dimensions of bank loan contracts to analyze this issue. The advantage of using an international setting is that it allows me to exploit substantial cross-country differences in labor market regulation. My focus on bank loans is motivated by the fact that bank are the most important suppliers of capital to risky businesses in most countries. Therefore, banks should naturally be concerned about workers’ influence on key corporate decisions, such as necessary labor adjustments. I believe that the results of this project will advance our understanding of the costs of labor market regulation and therefore be useful for researchers, policy makers, investors, and managers. 论文摘要 在此研究项目中，我将考察40余国的劳动力市场的不同法规是如何影响银行商业贷款的利率及其他非价格成分。我的论文将对日渐庞大的研究用工关系对公司融资决策的影响的文献做出贡献。至今，文献中还没有关注劳动力法规如何影响公司贷款合同的多国经验比较研究。此项研究意欲填补此项空白。我计划使用集中了劳动力法规（如劳动保障，工会比例，劳动力议价能力）和商业贷款条款的多国数据来展开经验研究。 使用多国数据的优点是其中蕴含了丰富的各国间劳动力市场法规的差异。在大多数国家，银行借贷是风险型企业融资的主要渠道。因此，银行自然会将用工关系对公司重要决策的影响纳入考虑范围。我相信此项研究的结果将会加深我们对劳动力市场治理的理解，将会对其他研究人员、政策制定者、投资人和经理提供有用的参考。

140011.label: Realisation of objectives
140011.value: I completed all the project objectives. As the attached paper shows, I conducted a comprehensive analysis of the impact of labor regulations that restrict firms’ flexibility to adjust labor on the price and nonprice terms of corporate bank loans. To do so, I created a sample of 14,810 bank loan facilities made to publicly traded corporations located in 25 industrialized countries between 1991 to 2009. The source of bank loan contracts is the Dealscan database provided by the Loan Pricing Corporation and firm-level accounting data was obtained from the Worldscope database. Central to my analysis are the aspects of country legal institutions designed to protect the interests of workers that of relevance to suppliers of capital to corporate borrowers. In this paper, I focus on one such important legal mechanism: law and regulations governing the dismissal process of workers on regular (permanent) contracts. My main measure of labor regulations is the strictness of the Employment Protection Legislation (EPL) Indicators, constructed on a yearly basis by the OECD. Because the sample countries adopted changes in their employment protection laws in different years, I can employ the difference-in-difference approach to identify the effect of labor regulations on the price and nonprice terms of bank loan contracts. The price term of the loan contract is measured as loan spreads, computed as the amount the borrower pays over LIBORs or LIBOR equivalent. I also examine three major nonprice loan contract terms: the loan amount, loan maturity, and loan ownership structure. The regressions control for country, industry and year fixed effects, as well as for a rich set of firm, loan, and country-specific characteristics that could influence both dependent and independent variables. Therefore, the estimated results reflect the effect of average within-country changes in the cost of bank loans when a country increases or decreases the legal protection of workers. The results of this study have important implications for understanding the link between labor market frictions and firms’ cost of capital.

140011.label: Major findings and research outcome
140011.value: I find strong evidence that increases of the EPL (i.e. strengthening of employment protection) are associated with significantly higher spreads on bank loans. Depending on the specification, a one standard deviation increase in the EPL index, on average, increases loan spreads by 25 to 55 basis points. Thus, the results are both statistically and economically significant. I reaffirm the causal connection between changes in labor laws and bank loan pricing by employing the instrumental variables methodology and the country-industry interaction methodology of Rajan and Zingales (1998). The results from these two sets of tests thus strongly support the thesis that there is a causal link from labor regulations to bank loan contracting. Specifically, I find that increases in the stringency of labor protection have greater impact on the terms of bank credit for borrowers in industries where labor hiring and firing are relatively more important. Further investigations show that greater employment protection increases the cost of loans primarily for firms with higher default probability, which suggests that banks are indeed concerned that stricter labor laws significantly constrain the firms’ flexibility to adjust labor costs in times of financial distress.I also conduct a number of additional tests to confirm the robustness of the results. I further examine whether country-level changes in labor laws affect the nonprice terms of the loan contracts as well. I find that increases in employment protection result in bank loans that are significantly smaller, have shorter maturity, and have more diffuse ownership structure. These results are also statistically and economically significant. Because stricter nonprice loan contract terms may impose additional costs on the borrower, the economic effect of changes in labor laws in on the effective cost of bank debt is likely to be higher than that the estimated changes in the loan spreads. Taken together, the findings in this study suggest that when countries imposes additional restrictions on the firms’ flexibility to adjust labor force, banks respond by offering loans on more stringent price and nonprice terms thereby negatively affecting firms’ ability to raise debt financing. The results of this research have been presented at City University of Hong Kong and 2013 Asian Finance Association International Conference. The research paper entitled, “Labor Protection Laws and Bank Loan Contracting”, is currently under review at The Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis (JFQA).

140011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
140011.value: I have used insights from this research to develop a new study that examines the role of country-level laws that protect employment in cross-border merger and acquisition decisions and merger premiums. To do so, I create a sample of 53,583 completed cross-border majority deals announced between 1991 and 2009 involving firms from 28 countries. This new research is currently in progress.

140011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
140011.value: This research project presents novel evidence that labor regulations that restrict firms’ flexibility to adjust labor affect the cost of bank loans for corporations. The strictness of laws and regulations that govern firm’s labor adjustment policies has generated a vigorous debate about their economic consequences. Using within-country variation in employment protection legislation across 25 countries between 1991 and 2009, I find that when countries imposes additional restrictions on the firms’ flexibility to adjust labor force, banks respond by offering loans with higher interest rates, as well as stricter nonprice contract terms. I reaffirm the causal connection between changes in labor laws and bank loan pricing by employing alternative methodologies. Further analysis indicate that increases in the stringency of labor regulations lead to costlier bank loans because lenders are concerned about an increase in the borrowers’ default risk due to legal restrictions on the firms’ flexibility to adjust labor costs, especially in times of financial distress. Overall, the findings in this paper suggest that more rigid labor regulations inhibit the availability of private credit to corporations as bankers provide loans on relatively unfavorable terms. The results are also relevant for the ongoing debate on the economic consequences of rigid labor laws.

140511.label: Project Objectives
140511.value: 細緻研究章太炎與明治時期日本知識社群的交往，按年份整理他在日本期間與哪些學者交往、交往形式如何以及相互探討問題的內容為何等等。 觀察日本近代知識社群及其思想發展，並在此基礎上研究它們給予章太炎思想以哪種思想影響或治學方法啟發。 承上，章氏學術思想的日本因緣如何促進中國現代學術的轉型，他在著作中如果闡釋及評論日本學術思想，他關注的時代核心問題是甚麼，以及這些內容在中國知識群體的傳播情況，特別是「如何地」或「怎樣地」被接受。 除章氏外，日本近代思潮也廣泛影響了近代中國知識社群，與章氏在政治觀念、思想信仰方面相異的黃遵憲、梁啟超等均深受日本影響。他們所受自日本的不同的思想影響值得與章氏相互比較，由此見出章氏學思特色。 章氏在日本接受西方哲學家如叔本華、赫胥黎、斯賓塞、柏格森影響，他對西方學說的接受與運用、取捨或迎拒等情況如何？西學在中日雙方知識群體的影響與流傳差異情況又是如何？我們希望在章氏身上了解到中國現代學術的產生經過及其特質。

140511.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
140511.value: 章太炎被譽為民國元勛、國學泰斗，現代學者大都得其學術思想灌溉、浸潤。然而，他那影響深遠的學術思想，不少都是在滯留日本期間(前後逾六年)因廣泛接觸西學和日本學術觀念後形成。本計劃擬通過太炎的著作，整理其所吸收、運用或轉化的近代日本學術思想觀念和相關詞彙；此外，將仔細比較太炎留日期間接受的西方哲學家的學術觀念在中日雙方產生的影響、流傳經過，並特別觀察太炎與日本學者以及中國同代學者在接受態度上之異同。有關研究將有助我們認識：第一，太炎與明治時期日本學界的交往關係及其學術思想的日本因緣；第二，他在接受日本學術之餘又充滿大量批判言辭的背後複雜思想；第三，掌握其迎拒西學或現代性的思想脈絡；第四，釐清其於現代中國「學術轉型」課題上的位置與實質貢獻所在。要之，本研究將能讓我們認識到太炎以至於近代中國知識社群興起與日本近代思潮所存在的關係，深刻展示近世中日學術文化交流的圖景。 As a great scholar, Zhang Tai Yan's philosophy has inspired and enlightened numerous modern intellectuals. To understand his philosophy, the time he spent in Japan cannot be overlooked and should be studied in-depth. It is in those years that he had extensive contact with Western thoughts and Japanese ideas which had eventually shaped the formation of his philosophy. Therefore there is a strong need to collect and emendate all works of Zhang Tai Yan so as to understand how he absorbed, applied and transformed the Japanese intellectual thoughts and related terminologies of modern time and integrated them into his philosophy. How Western philosophical thoughts had exerted an impact on Chinese and Japanese intellectual communities which Zhang learned in Japan will be studied and how the thoughts were spread and the differences in attitudes of Zhang as well as the Japanese and Chinese scholars of Zhang's time when they first encountered the Western thoughts will also be probed into. The investigation will be conducive to obtain the following: 1) the acquaintanceship between Zhang and many Japanese scholars of Meiji Period and the Japanese factors of Zhang's intellectual thoughts 2) the complexities of Zhang's attitude. Zhang had promoted many Japanese thoughts but at the same time he made many criticisms on them. A study will be done on understanding how he dealt with the thoughts 3) the understanding of the vein of Zhang's acceptance and rejection of Western ideas and modernization 4) insights on Zhang's actual contribution on propelling "Intellectual Transformation" of modern China. In brief, this research aims at understanding the relationship between Zhang Tai Yan, the rise of the contemporary Chinese intellectual community and the trend of development of Japanese ideas in modern time so as to draw a clearer picture of the intellectuals of China and Japan had exchanged their thoughts in modern time.

140511.label: Realisation of objectives
140511.value: 1.本研究已釐清章太炎與明治時期日本知識社群的交往情況，並對他們探討的學術問題和所關注的時代問題有整全的了解。 2.本研究已深入探究日本近代知識社群及其學術發展的思想脈絡，同時也分析了章太炎對日本漢學家治學方法和思想關懷恉歸的觀感。 3.本研究細緻探討章氏及日本學術思想因素與中國現代學術轉型的關係，也深入研究章氏如何闡釋及評論日本學術思想，從而展現章氏所關注的時代核心問題。 4.本研究對章氏以外的近代中國知識社群，如何在學術觀念、思想信仰方面受到日本影響也已經作出恰切的分析和討論。並且從他們所受自日本的不同的思想影響與章氏的相互比較，由此見出章氏學思特色。 5.本研究已經對章氏在日本接受西方哲學家、史學家的內容有所探究，見出章太炎對域外之學的運用、取捨或迎拒的情況，從章氏身上反映中國現代學術產生經過的複雜思想面相。

除章氏外，日本近代思潮也廣泛影響了近代中國知識社群，與章氏在政治觀念、思想信仰方面相異的黃遵憲、梁啟超等均深受日本影響。他們所受自日本的不同的思想影響值得與章氏相互比較，由此見出章氏學思特色。
章氏在日本接受西方哲學家如叔本華、赫胥黎、斯賓塞、柏格森影響，他對西方學說的接受與運用、取捨或迎拒等情況如何？西學在中日雙方知識群體的影響與流傳差異情況又是如何？我們希望在章氏身上了解到中國現代學術的產生經過及其特質。

140511.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
140511.value: 本研究的成果顯示了章太炎與現代中國思想、社會及學術的發展有深刻的關係，從辛亥革命到疑古運動、從白話文運動到圍繞國學的諸種論爭，都可以看到章太炎的思想影響力。但當中不可忽視的是，我們發現現代中國學術與近代日本國學思想、疑古思想之間存在你中有我、我中有你的關係。但章太炎反對一些學者對日本學術的全盤接受，他在域外新學之基礎上着意建立自己的思想體系。在我們的研究中，說明了中日學者在學術上的緊密交往關係，展示了現代中國學術建立過程中接收了那些域外學術，同時也闡明了從章太炎乃至中國現代學術社群如何溝通中外學說、博採眾學的學術涵養。

141111.value: 主管對我和我的小組同事的攻擊性幽默對我的壓力及工作成果的影響

141111.label: Co - Investigator(s)
141111.value: Dr Lam, Wing Prof Xie, Jia Lin

141111.label: Project Objectives
141111.value: To examine the extent to which supervisors’ aggressive humor affects focal employees’ strain. To determine how supervisors’ aggressive humor toward the peers of focal employees influences the focal employees’ attribution of the cause of the humor. To explore the explanatory power of the joint effects of supervisors’ aggressive humor toward the focal employees and focal employees’ attribution of the cause of the aggressive humor on those focal employees’ strain and work outcomes.

141111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
141111.value: Abstract Literature on humor usually documents positive effects on employees’ attitudes and behaviors, though suggestions of aggressive humor reveal some conflicting viewpoints. With a basis in social identity and attribution theory, this project aims to examine the influence of supervisors’ aggressive humor on employees’ strain and subsequent work outcomes. The proposed model indicates that supervisors’ aggressive humor causes strain for employees, which ultimately influences their in-role and extra-role performance and counterproductive behaviors. Therefore, this research offers insights into a “dark side” of humor and extends both humor and leadership research. Aggressive humor toward focal employees and their peers might influence employees’ strain and work outcomes according to the attribution they develop regarding the cause of supervisors’ aggressive humor. Specifically, targeted employees might tend to make an actors’ (i.e., supervisors’) external attribution, such that supervisors’ aggressive humor appears due to their own mistakes, especially if supervisors do not exhibit aggressive humor toward peers. Targeted employees instead should adopt an actors’ (i.e., supervisors’) internal attribution, related to supervisors’ flaws, when their peers in the same team setting also frequently are targets of supervisors’ aggressive humor. This latter attribution of the cause to the supervisors could alleviate negative impacts of aggressive humor on focal employees’ strain, whereas the former, external attribution might reinforce the negative impact. Finally, employees’ strain should relate negatively to their in-role and extra-role performance but positively to counterproductive behaviors. A field experiment (Study 1) and a three-wave longitudinal field survey (Study 2), using samples of 300 and 600 (120 teams with five members each) employees, respectively, will constitute the experimental undertaking in this research. Data will be collected from two subsidiaries of Alcatel-Lucent China Investment Co., Ltd., both located in mainland China. The Study 1 data will come from employees, whereas Study 2 will rely on a round-robin design to collect data from multiple sources, including employees, immediate supervisors, and objective sources provided by the company. Multilevel analyses will support the data assessments. This study can contribute to both humor and leadership literature by exploring whether and how supervisors’ aggressive humor influences employees’ strain and work outcomes, as well as how social comparison influences employees’ attribution about the cause of supervisors’ aggressive humor and their subsequent psychological and behavioral responses. The findings also offer practical implications for managers. 文獻中通常認為幽默對員工的態度和行為有積極影響，但是有關攻擊性幽默的研究揭示了一些與此相反的觀點。以社會認同理論和歸因理論為基礎，本研究旨在檢驗主管的攻擊性幽默對下屬的壓力及工作結果的影響。根據我們提出的研究模型，主管的攻擊性幽默會給員工帶來壓力，並最終影響員工的工作績效、角色外表現和反生產行為。因此，本研究對幽默的“陰暗面”提出了一些看​​法，擴展了有關幽默和領導研究的理論。 主管對員工本人及其他小組成員的攻擊性幽默會影響員工對這種幽默的歸因，從而影響員工的壓力和工作成果。具體來說，如果主管的攻擊性幽默是針對員工本人的失誤，尤其是當主管沒有對其他成員表現出攻擊性幽默時，員工傾向於把這種幽默歸因於（主管的）外部原因，而不是主管本身的原因。反之，當小組的其他成員也經常成為主管的攻擊性幽默的目標時，員工就會進行（主管的）內部歸因，認為這是主管自身的問題。後面這種歸因能夠減輕主管的攻擊性幽默對目標員工的負面影響；而前一種則會加深這種負面影響。最後，員工的壓力會對他們的工作績效和角色外表現產生負面的影響，對他們的反生產行為產生正面影響。 本研究將通過現場實驗（研究1）和一個三波的縱向實地調研（研究2）進行，分別以300和600（120個小組，每組五名成員）名員工為樣本。數據將來自阿爾卡特朗訊（中國）投資有限公司位於中國大陸的兩個子公司。研究1的數據將來自員工，而研究2將用循環設計，從多個來源收集數據，包括員工、員工的直接上司、以及由該公司提供的客觀數據。我們將用多層次分析來處理數據。 通過探索主管的攻擊性幽默是否以及如何影響員工的壓力和工作成果，及社會比較怎樣影響員工對主管的攻擊性幽默的歸因和相應的心理、行為反應，本研究可以對幽默和領導行為研究領域做出貢獻。調查結果也會為管理人員提供實際建議。

141111.label: Major findings and research outcome
141111.value: This research proposes a model based on social comparison and attribution theories to examine the inﬂuence of supervisors’ aggressive humor on employees’ strain and addictive behaviors. The tests of the research model entailed a 2-wave study with 243 front line employees from 4 manufacturing companies of a group corporation in China. The results showed that supervisors’ aggressive humor with employees related positively to employees’ strain. This positive association became stronger when the supervisors did not use aggressive humor with the peers of the focal employees. Employees’ strain mediated the interactive effects of supervisors’ aggressive humor with the focal employees and those with their peers on employees’ addictive behaviors (e.g., problematic use of Internet, alcohol, and tobacco). As well as having practical implications, this study offers theoretical insights for research into humor, leadership, and addictive behaviors.

141111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
141111.value: Based on social identity and attribution theory, this project examines the influence of supervisors’ aggressive humor on employees’ strain and subsequent work outcomes. More specifically, we argue that supervisors’ aggressive humor is likely to cause strain of the focal employees, which ultimately influence focal employees’ in-role and extra-role performance and counterproductive behaviors. By doing so, our research offers insights into the “dark side” of both humor and leadership research. Additionally, we examine how supervisors’ aggressive humor toward focal employees and their peers influence their strain and work outcomes through the attribution of the cause of supervisors’ aggressive humor by the focal employees. Our study contributes to both humor and leadership literature by exploring whether and how supervisors’ aggressive humor influences employees’ strain and work outcomes and by investigating how social comparison influences employees’ attribution about the cause of supervisors’ aggressive humor and their subsequent psychological and behavioral responses. Practical implications to Chinese managers are also discussed.

142211.label: Project Title(Chinese)
142211.value: 用於工作的網絡2.0：工作空間中的社會網絡

142211.label: Co - Investigator(s)

142211.label: Project Objectives
142211.value: The first part of the research will involve the development and validation of a theoretical model to explain the use and value of Web 2.0 applications in organisations for work purposes. We propose that Web 2.0 technologies underpin social networks in the workspace and subsequently influence organizational performance. The interactive nature of Web 2.0 technologies can encourage employees to participate in projects and sharing ideas, thus deepening an organisation’s knowledge pool, reinforcing the ties among employees, customers and suppliers. The specific constructs of this “Web 2.0 in Organisations” model will draw on the international literature, as well as our own research experience in firms globally. In addition to the literature review, we will undertake detailed case studies of Web 2.0 use in selected firms in Hong Kong, China and the USA, with the specific intention of establishing how Web 2.0 applications may exert a positive impact on key dimensions of organisational performance such as customer and employee satisfaction, operational efficiency and personal productivity. In this latter part of the project, we expect to interview and observe selected employees, managers and customers so as to fine-tune the proposed model of Web 2.0 Organisations. In the third part of the research, we expect to collect sample data from a large population in Hong Kong and other countries so as to make global comparisons. Locations where we plan to collect data include: Hong Kong, China (multiple locations), USA (multiple locations), UK (multiple locations). The large-scale data will be used to validate the fine-tuned research model in part 2 of the research.

142211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
142211.value: The Web 2.0 revolution has taken social relationships by storm, with a wide variety of applications offering online interlocutors a myriad of opportunities to communicate. However, these same social applications have yet to become widely accepted in organisations for work. We suggest that Web 2.0 applications can enhance coordination and collaboration, knowledge sharing and problem solving, by strengthening social networks in the workspace. Based on prior research undertaken by ourselves and others, we aim firstly to develop and test a theoretical model that explains the salient factors determining successful application of Web 2.0 technologies in Chinese firms. We will then undertake a case study based investigation of Web 2.0 applications in a small number of selected firms with the intention of revealing how these applications exert an impact on key dimensions of organisational performance. Finally, we will undertake a large-scale survey of organisational employees to validate the theoretical model. We expect that this three-pronged approach will generate knowledge of significant value for both IS researchers and organisations, especially those yet to adopt Web 2.0 applications at work. 品種繁多的網絡2.0應用給予了對話者無數的溝通機會，網絡2.0的革命從而令人際關係風靡全球。但是，同樣的技術至今還有待企業廣泛採納(麥肯錫2008)。我們認為網絡2.0的應用能夠鞏固工作環境中的人際網絡，從而改善相互的協調和合作，知識分享和解決問題。基於其他學者和我們以往的研究，這個項目旨在首先建立和測試一個解析網絡2.0在中國企業成功應用之因素的理論模型,然後以案例分析的方法研究所選取的幾個企業，意圖揭示網絡2.0如何影響關鍵的企業表現，如客戶滿意度，運作效能，個人生產率和員工滿意度等。最後，我們會進行一個針對企業員工的大型問卷調查，以收集量化數據驗證理論模型。我們希望這種三管齊下的研究方法將提供對資訊系統的研究學者和企業，尤其是那些在工作中尚未採用網絡2.0應用的企業，有顯著價值的知識。

142211.label: Realisation of objectives
142211.value: The first objective has been met. We used the international literature as well as interviews to inform the development of our research models. Two such models were created. We were able, eventually, to collect data in various Chinese firms across multiple locations to validate this model. The amount of time spent collecting this data was far longer than anticipated. The China-based co-investigator proved not to be very helpful in this respect. We made a point of visiting the firms and introducing our research to senior managers in order to solicit their approval for our research. However, in some cases, a firm provided less data than was expected. Some of the data proved to be duplicated – i.e. multiple respondents submitted identical copies of the same response set. In other cases, a firm never provided data despite repeated reminders/requests. In still other cases, data was only forthcoming after extensive delays. In the last few months (April-June 2014) we have located a new source of data in China and are currently collecting more data that will help us overcome the inadequacies of the data collected previously. We expect to complete analysis by the end of the summer (2014) and to submit a new journal paper based on it shortly afterwards. Despite contacting several firms in Hong Kong, none were willing to allow us to study them in sufficient detail to write up a case study. At best, we were able to interview single managers. This was informative but is insufficient to permit either the writing of case studies or the validation of research models. Despite having a US-based co-investigator and visiting two US firms, we were not able to persuade US-based firms to engage in research with us. We did collect sufficient data in China to write up a case study that draws on material from several firms. One paper based on this material has been accepted for publication and a second is now in 3rd round review for a different journal.

142211.label: Major findings and research outcome
142211.value: The major findings of the research are represented in a pair of research models and the associated instrumentation. These models took a considerable amount of time to construct. Initial validation was performed to ensure face and content validity by presenting them at research seminars as well as in corporate offices. Early qualitative data based on interviews in four Chinese software firms has been written up into a paper that was presented at a conference in 2013 and is now accepted by a good journal. Once we were satisfied with the models, we developed the survey instruments that would later permit us to validate the models. These instruments, which run to 66 and 94 items, were then translated into Chinese and back-translated into English to ensure equivalence of meaning across the two language versions. We started to collect quantitative data data in Spring 2013 in order to validate the models. Data collection is still in progress (June 2014) but should be completed by summer 2014 for later analysis and journal submission.

142211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
142211.value: Validation of the research models is still in progress. When we checked the quality of the data collected earlier, we identified many problems that rendered much of it unusable. Consequently, we decided to collect more data. So far, data collection has proved a significant barrier. If the terms of the GRF research grant allowed us to pay respondents for their data, then the matter might be simplified, though one should still be concerned about the reliability of the data. Outsourcing data collection to a professional data collection agency is another option, but not one that we believe to be appropriate given the minimal level of control that the researchers have over that data collection process, i.e. if the agency wants to generate data randomly and without contacting real respondents, there is little that we can do to stop them. If we are able to locate an organisation willing to engage with us in a more detailed case and action research study, then there is the potential for influencing the future development of social media and their impact on organisational operations. However, our experience to date is that organisations are reluctant to engage with researchers in this respect.

142211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
142211.value: The research project is important because we know little about how social media, which are becoming increasingly widespread in organizations, create value for organisational employees. These social media are not necessarily restricted to the more popular applications like Facebook, but rather refer to communication applications like QQ, MSN, Weibo, Wechat, Twitter, Skype, Google + as well as wikis. Our initial findings suggest that social media create considerable value, especially with respect to horizontal communications between peers, at both junior and senior levels of a firm, as well as with external clients, partners and colleagues. So far, our results also suggest that social media appear to have less value for vertical communications between managers and lower level employees. Instead, more formal communication technologies such as broadcast or individual email are used for this purpose, though there are exceptions. In some hi-tech firms, senior executives use informal communication tools regularly for vertical communication.

142711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
142711.value: Terms are linguistic expressions of concepts specific to different subject domains. They are important to automatic language processing systems because they represent basic meaning units key to the machine understanding of human language. The proposed project, entitled "An Integrated System for Intelligent Term Management" (ITMS), is for the design and implementation of an automatic system to recognise terms from natural texts, to classify them according to subject domains, and to organise and store them in a database to enable easy access and cross reference with other terms or their source texts. Past research has typically made use of extensive domain knowledge to recognise terms. Such an approach means that a database of terms particular to a certain subject domain (such as medicine or bio-chemistry) has to be constructed first in order to identify these terms from natural texts. This approach is typically labour intensive and difficult to adapt to other domains. The proposed project has a different approach to identify terms, which is firmly based on linguistic analysis. Natural texts are first of all automatically analysed for their syntactic structures so that nominal groups can be extracted as term candidates. Syntactic constructions such as coordination, pre-modification and post-modification will be utilised to identify variant terms. Consider the example term candidate "heart and lung diseases". Proper syntactic analysis will show that it contains "heart and lung" as a coordinated pre-modifier of "diseases" and hence two variants can be recognised: "heart diseases" and "lung diseases". Similarly, proper syntactic analysis of "diseases of the heart" will identify "of the heart" as a post-modifier and hence "heart disease" can be generated as a new term candidate. To replace the labour-intensive construction of a domain knowledge base, the proposed project aims to implement automatic recognition of the subject domain of raw texts. This component of the project will make use of state-of-the-art technology to automatically predict the subject domain according to both linguistic analysis and machine learning techniques, a hybrid approach that can be easily adaptive to different subject domains. Another novel aspect of the project is the use of a voice-driven interface (via mobile phones or personal data assistants) to access the automatically generated term bank, in addition to the conventional computer keyboard. Project deliverables will comprise the ITMS which includes a term extraction and classification module, a generically designed repository for corpora and terminology databases (termbase) and a standalone, voice and Internet interface. 術語是表達各門學科領域中特定概念的用語。它們所代表的基本意義，是機器理解人類語言的關鍵，因此術語對自動語言處理系統十分重要。“整合式智慧術語管理系統”（ITMS）旨在設計和建立一項自動化系統：可自動識別自然文本中的術語，根據學科領域將其分類，組織並存儲到資料庫中，以便輕鬆訪問及對照參考其他術語或它們的源文本。 以往的研究通常利用廣博的領域知識進行術語識別。該方法意味著要首先建立某一學科領域（如醫藥或生物化學）的術語資料庫，方可將其從文本中識別出來。該方法既耗時耗力，又難以應用到不同的領域中去。異於以往的研究，該專案採用了基於語言分析的術語識別方法。首先將對自然文本進行自動語法分析，以便提取出名詞片語，稱之為“初始術語”（term candidates）。諸如“並列結構”、“前置修飾”及“後置修飾”之類的句法結構將用於識別術語變體。以“心臟和肺部疾病”（heart and lung diseases）為例，句法分析顯示，“心臟和肺部”為“疾病”的並列前置修飾語，因此可識別出兩個術語變體，即“心臟疾病”及“肺部疾病”。同樣，句法分析顯示“心臟疾病”（diseases of the heart）的後置修飾語為“心臟的”（of the heart），因此可產生一個新的“初始術語”—“心臟疾病”（heart disease）。 該專案試圖實施文本學科領域的自動識別，進而取代浩大的領域知識庫建設。使用尖端技術，依據語言分析及機器學習技術，該項目將自動預測出學科領域，這種複合式方法亦可很容易地應用到不同學科領域中。 “整合式智慧術語管理系統”（ITMS）的專案成果將包括一個術語提取及分類模組，分類設計的語料及術語資源庫。

142711.label: Realisation of objectives
142711.value: Objective 1 has been completely achieved through a linguistically oriented method that calculates the probabilities of terms based on their position in the syntactic tree. For this purpose, a syntactically annotated corpus was used and all the terms marked to help derive a probabilistic model of terms according to their syntactic roles. A computer software system has been implemented, publicly accessible at the following URL address: http://dsg.ctl.cityu.edu.hk:8080/tms-ui-web/. A users' manual describing the system is available at the URL address: http://dsg.ctl.cityu.edu.hk/tmp/TMS-EN.pdf. Objective 2 was completely achieved. The development of the system was targeted at biological texts archived centrally in the US (PubMed). They perform fairly standard term regulation and maintain an ontology (MeSH) which was used in this project to help classify the terms. The project researched term relations via the syntactic predicate and additionally focused on nominalized verbs as a major breakthrough point. Regarding this topic, the PI supervised a PhD research on nominalized verbs which has been completed. Two book chapters have been written and accepted for publication. Three conference presentations were given on this topic. Nominalised adjectives were also investigated since adjectives are treated as predicates and thus form term relations. A system for syntax-to-event structure has been implemented for public access. The URL is http://dsg.ctl.cityu.edu.hk:8080/et-ui-web.

142711.label: Major findings and research outcome
142711.value: The research has produced the major finding that syntactic information, although traditionally seen as belonging to a formal system without much reference to meaning, can offer significant input to the identification of terms. Within the terminology community, a lot of research has focused on the recognition of multi-word terms but a majority of the term recognition systems, if not all, perform poorly with single-word terms. This is because multi-word expressions tend to have a higher probability than single-word expressions to be a term. In our research, we folded in syntactic information whereby a single-word expression can be evaluated according to the term probability in that specific syntactic slot. This method turned out to be especially effective and our system outperformed all the other systems in the recognition of single-word terms. In all, one book, 7 journal articles and 13 conference proceedings were produced acknowledging support received from the grant. In addition, two computer software systems have been implemented: 1. Term recognition and management publicly accessible at the URL address: http://dsg.ctl.cityu.edu.hk:8080/tms-ui-web/, 2. Extraction of event structures of terms publicly accessible at the URL address: http://dsg.ctl.cityu.edu.hk:8080/et-ui-web A users' manual has been written up and publicly accessible at the URL address: http://dsg.ctl.cityu.edu.hk/tmp/TMS-EN.pdf.

142711.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
142711.value: The project has achieved the revised goals and has demonstrated the strengths of a linguistically oriented approach to term recognition and management. Given appropriate resources and further funding, the future development of the system can be achieved through enhancement of its The term classification system is expected to be capable of identifying the relationships of synonymy, antonymy, hyponomy and meronomy, and populating an ontology based on these relationships, whilst handling instances of polysemy. The system will also be domain-independent, such that different lexical-syntactic patterns will be applied and acquired depending on the domain. This capability will augment the online term suggestion system by providing information such as: frequently-used synonymous terms, more general/specific terms and potentially ambiguous polysemous terms.

142711.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
142711.value: This project proposed to construct a computer software system to perform the automatic recognition of specialist terms from free texts and to provide facilities whereby the terms can be edited and stored for future use. A major contribution of the project is the use of syntactic information to perform term recognition, which has resulted in increased accuracy to recognize terms. In particular, the system is superior when compared to the other similar systems in the recognition of single-word terms. The recognized terms are then stored in a database, which can be subsequently edited and changed according to the original context of use. In addition, the terms can be automatically translated into a specified language, edited and revised if necessary before being stored in the database for future use. The project has produced a software system to extract event structures containing terms, which can be further abstracted to represent term relations for precise semantic expressions. The project has now been successfully completed and all the promised software systems implemented. The research can be directly applied in real use. Potential user groups include terminology management teams in large international companies and translation service providers.

142911.label: Project Objectives
142911.value: To develop a unified analytical framework, based on dynamic games, to model legislative institutions that incorporate both majority rules and minority rights; To offer a positive theory that explains how the occurrence, frequency and duration of filibusters are determined by the specific institutional arrangements, preference polarization, heterogeneity of party members, congressional workload, patience of the legislators and other factors; To provide a theoretical foundation that guide rigorous empirical studies of filibusters and measurements of the related variables; To shed lights on constitutional reforms in old democracies as well as the constitutional design for countries/regions, such as Hong Kong, that are in transition to democracy.
