153711.label: Major findings and research outcome
153711.value: Our research provides insights regarding how people generate and consume the “virtual products” (e.g., photo and video) in online social networks. Using the photo-sharing website Flickr as a context, we first examined the influence of social ties on consumption of virtual content. We found that social ties make people more active in marking photos. After forming a social tie, people tended to adopt less similar photos, but such relationship is moderated by user status and the salience of photos. Low-status users tended to differentiate from their low-status peers while high-status users did not differentiate from their friends. Users selected the photos from less-famous people (vs. more famous people). Compared to the literature, our findings not only demonstrate the existence of social influence on consumption but also “why” that happened, thus greatly enriching the literature. We also found friend influence on generation of virtual content, which has received less attention in the literature. We focused on the types of content and examined whether or not online social relationships generate similar content. We found that users upload more dissimilar photographs to other users after they form social ties than before. We further explored the moderating effects of user difference in their popularity. We found that users enjoying different levels of popularity upload even less similar photos after establishing a social tie. The most divergent uploading behavior is found with user dyads where the subscriber is the one with higher popularity on Flickr. Our research makes important contribution to the literature. While most of the previous studies show that people behave more similarly after building connection, we show the opposite pattern that people seek differentiation, which is an important result to culture market (e.g., arts, books, photos) where people may value uniqueness. The contributions of our work are well acknowledged by peers in the field. We have been invited to present the work at the Marketing Science conference and workshop at the University of Maryland. Our work has been finally published in the first-tier journal in the business field, Information Systems Research, in 2013 (Details are provided in Part C)

153711.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
153711.value: One area that needs further development is how our results vary across different culture backgrounds. Our current data reflect the behavior of people mainly in North American market. It could be that people in this market emphasize individualism and thus they are more likely to seek uniqueness when creating and consuming virtual contents. In the Asia market where individualism is less emphasized, it is unclear whether the same pattern will be observed. In the current research, we were not able to examine this because we did not have any data from the Asian market. Once such data are available, it will be worthwhile to reexamine our questions.

153711.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
153711.value: Virtual content (e.g., photo, music and video) in knowledge-sharing social networking sites such as YouTube and Instagram has reached such high levels of quality and quantity that they constitute an important part of culture market. Understanding what types of content users consume and upload is vital to the success of the sites. For example, after two people become friends in the sites, will they adopt and upload more similar content than before they become friends? This research project explores this question using data from the photo-hosting website Flickr. We find that, under certain conditions, people in fact adopted and uploaded more dissimilar photos after becoming online friends. The underlying reason is that for culture products people may value more on maintaining distinct tastes and thus seek for uniqueness in creating and adopting the content. Our results contribute significantly to the literature. Most of the previous studies have focused on typical consumer products where conformity is usually found while this research focuses on the culture market and demonstrates a different pattern exists. Our findings generate important managerial implications to virtual culture market of photos, songs and movies.

154311.label: Project Title(Chinese)
154311.value: 普通話與粵語會話中的自我修補對比研究

154311.label: Project Objectives
154311.value: Identify possible self-repair operation types and their distribution in Mandarin and Cantonese for an overall description of self-repair in the two varieties of Chinese. Compare self-repair operation types between Mandarin and Cantonese. Study the impact of syntax on self-repair practices.
rows: Identify possible self-repair operation types and their distribution in Mandarin and Cantonese for an overall description of self-repair in the two varieties of Chinese.
Compare self-repair operation types between Mandarin and Cantonese.
Study the impact of syntax on self-repair practices.

154311.label: Realisation of objectives
154311.value: With the advancement in research on repair in spontaneous conversation, the description of repair now include both formal characterizations which focus on the structural features of repair, and interactional accounts which explores possible function of repair in situated social interaction. More focused studies on specific repair types have also looked at both structural and interactional aspects of that type. Based on the ten operations identified for same-turn repair in English, this project conducted an investigation of self-repair operations in two varieties of Chinese, namely, Mandarin and Cantonese. Dataset for each shows a similarity in the distribution of the more frequent repair operations. In both Mandarin and Cantonese, the highest frequency is recycling, which involves “a speaker’s resaying again some stretch of talk … that they have previously said, ordinarily just said”. This type accounts for 47.89% and 44.92% of the identified repair operations in Mandarin and Cantonese respectively. The next frequent type is replacing – substitution of a wholly or partially articulated element of a TCU-in-progress (20.69% and 30.15% respectively). Aborting – abandoning a self-interrupted TCU, ranks the third in both Mandarin and Cantonese (13.60% and 20.62% respectively). Inserting, i.e., adding one or more (modifying) element into the TCU-so-far, ranks the fourth (6.5% in Mandarin and 1.64 % in Cantonese). Although with different percentage, the distributions of the four types show a similar trend in both languages. Not all types identified in English were found in our data, and some are very infrequent. The findings should be useful in cross-linguistic comparisons when quantitative figures become available in other languages. . As two varieties of Chinese, Mandarin and Cantonese share similarities in repair practices, but the repair initiators (often called fillers) show difference in vowel quality. The syntactic pattern for recycling also show some difference regarding how much is being repeated in the resaying. Some preliminary observations regarding the structural/syntactic features of repair in the two languages were also made but not yet systematic. A full-time research assistant was recruited for processing the Mandarin dataset. However, some difficulties were encountered in recruiting a full-time research assistant with training in both conversation analysis and linguistics, and with experience in handling Cantonese conversational data, only a part-time research assistant was recruited to process the Cantonese dataset. This explains the unspent amount of the funding.

154311.label: Major findings and research outcome
154311.value: Zhang, Li & Shao (2014, see Part C) focuses on a self-repair operation with high frequency, namely, recycling. 100 mono-syllabic recycling cases across four tone groups are analyzed for five phonetic correlates. The findings suggest a possible compensating mechanism underlying the phonetic realization of recycling after cut-off in Mandarin spontaneous speech. Speakers employ different combinations of the correlates for word repetition in different tone groups. The shape of the lexical tones themselves seems to play a role in the compensating mechanism. The findings of the phonetic patterns across the tone groups help us better understand production, detection and management of repair in Chinese conversation. Zhang (2014, see Part C) examines another type of self-repair operation, namely, insertion repair at transition place. Past studies reported different prosodic packaging for further talk constructed as a new turn constructional unit (TCU) and that constructed as syntactic extension of the preceding TCU. Measurement of prosodic parameters such as speech rate, F0 and intensity for the repair-target unit, the repairing unit and the added part in the repairing unit shows that in general the repairing unit is prosodically marked as subordinate reflecting the speaker’s treatment of it as a non-independent unit. The repairing unit retrospectively works on a part in the preceding TCU. On the other hand, the added materials in the repairing unit is often produced with prominence in terms of higher intensity, reflecting the speaker’s treatment of it as something new that was introduced in the repairing unit. One article ready for submission (Zhang (in preparation), manuscript attached) examines two operations for same-turn repair, namely, reordering and parenthesizing, for their relevance in organizing multi-TCUs in extended turns such as telling sequences. Same-turn repair is often seen as dealing with ‘local’ trouble source within the TCU it is launched. On closer examination of the data, it is also found that they can target more ‘global’ trouble source, e.g., (potential) problems in arranging multi-TCUs in extended turns. Functionally, clauses added through re-ordering usually become an integral part of the linear arrangement of the TCUs in the turn. Clauses added through parenthesizing exhibit a hierarchical relation between multi-TCUs in the turn as they provide supplementary information to the main line of telling. The interactional import of these two types of repair operations are also discussed in the paper. Another manuscript being prepared examines how participants repair troubles of turn-taking and turn completion in conversation.

154311.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
154311.value: In this project we identified operation types for self-repair in Mandarin and Cantonese. We examined formal features (e.g. prosodic and syntactic aspects) of the major types, and built a small database. With a collection of repair cases and an understanding of their formal features, it is possible to move forward and examine in more careful manner possible interactional import of self-repair in both Mandarin and Cantonese, e.g. the actions being carried through self-repair. In fact, we moved in this direction towards the end of the project. Based on the video-recorded data, we were also able to incorporate in the analysis some preliminary examination of how non-verbal aspects (e.g. eye gaze, hand gesture, body movement, etc.) coordinate with the verbal delivery of talk with regard to doing self-repair. Interactional account and multi-modal analysis of repair practices are two promising directions in future research. Preliminary observations made in this project could help to formulate research questions for future grant applications.

154311.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
154311.value: Conversational repair is recognized as one of the basic infrastructures for organizing human social interaction. Repair provides a mechanism for dealing with recurrent problems in speaking, hearing and understanding talk in social interaction. This project examined the operations of the most frequent repair called same-turn self-repair, i.e. a speaker’s self-interruption of his/her own utterance in order to alter what has just been said, or to pre-empt potential problems for organizing his/her own utterance. The project identified operations for self-repair in Mandarin and Cantonese conversation, and conducted a number of in-depth analyses of selected repair operations. Our analysis examined both formal features (e.g. prosody and syntax) and possible interactional functions of a number of more frequent repair operations. Although same-turn self-repair is often understood as targeting ‘local’ problems such as word replacement in the utterance where repair is launched, our findings show that it can also target problems of a more ‘global’ nature, e.g. the linear arrangement or hierarchical structure of the utterances which form an extended speaking turn. This project is the first to study repair operations in Chinese conversation, thus it contributes to the advancement of conversation-analytic studies in Chinese as well as provides materials for cross-linguistic comparisons.

154811.label: Project Title(Chinese)
154811.value: 董事经理责任保险如何影响股东价值

154811.label: Project Objectives
154811.value: Is there a measurable effect of a company's purchase of D&O insurance on firm value and accounting firm performance? How does the quality of corporate governance moderate the effect of D&O insurance on firm value and performance? How do investors assess the marginal value of corporate cash holdings and capital expenditure in companies with substantial D&O insurance?
rows: Is there a measurable effect of a company's purchase of D&O insurance on firm value and accounting firm performance?
How does the quality of corporate governance moderate the effect of D&O insurance on firm value and performance?

154811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
154811.value: Directors’ and Officers’ liability insurance (D&O insurance) is an insurance policy paid by a company to cover its all directors and executives for legal liability arising from their activities on behalf of the company. D&O insurance purchase is prevalent in listed companies in common-law jurisdictions (e.g., North America and Hong Kong). Despite such popularity, to date there is no consensus as to whether D&O insurance benefits shareholders. Theoretically, there are two views. One view is that the purchase of D&O insurance represents managerial opportunism and the coverage insulates directors and executives from the threat of personal financial liability resulting from their corporate decisions, thereby lowering their incentives to act in the best interest of shareholders (i.e., the managerial opportunism hypothesis). In fact, most securities class action lawsuits in the US are brought by shareholders and are settled out of court within the D&O insurance coverage limit. The other view is that D&O insurance can be beneficial to shareholders because the scrutiny of a firm’s corporate governance and risk profile by the D&O insurer in underwriting provides a valuable monitoring function, because D&O insurance helps a company to attract high-caliber candidates serving as directors and officers, and/or D&O insurance encourages optimal risk taking (i.e., the benefit hypothesis). Empirically, evidence relating to D&O insurance (in particular, the incentive effects of D&O insurance) is sparse due largely to the difficulty in obtaining D&O insurance data at the firm level (only Canada requires companies disclose information on D&O insurance purchases that companies often deem to be sensitive and confidential). Taking advantage of the mandatory disclosure requirement in Canada, I plan to manually construct a unique and comprehensive dataset on D&O insurance for the period 1996-2008. The current study aims to examine 1) whether the prevalent usage of D&O insurance has a measurable effect on firm performance and valuation; 2) how corporate governance moderates the effect of D&O insurance on firm value; and 3) how do investors assess the marginal value of corporate cash holdings and capital expenditure in companies with substantial D&O insurance coverage. The project helps contribute to the longstanding and recently renewed debate regarding the merits of D&O insurance. The research output is of clear interest to scholars, millions of investors and securities regulators, and has strong local relevance. 董事经理责任保险由公司支付、但保障公司的董事和经理在行使职务中可能产生的股东诉讼风险。在普通法国家和地区（如北美和香港）的上市公司中，董事经理责任保险非常普遍。然而关于董事经理责任保险是否对股东有利存在争论。一种观点认为购买董事经理责任保险是董事和经理的一种自利行为、对股东并无好处，因为它的保障使得董事和经理们免于为其过错承担经济责任，这可能客观上降低董事和经理为股东谋取最大利益的动力。另一种观点认为董事经理责任保险于股东有利，因为公司购买董事经理责任保险可以帮助它们更容易地吸引到能干但厌恶风险的人士担任董事和经理，并使得他们在经营决策中避免过于保守。另外，保险公司的核保过程客观上也可以起到对公司风险的一种审视和监督。目前因为缺少实证研究证据，以致此类争论尚无定论。 本研究拟采用手工收集的加拿大上市公司的董事经理责任保险数据来回答董事经理责任保险如何影响股东价值这一论题。具体而言，本研究会探讨三个问题: 1) 公司所持有的董事经理责任保险是否会影响公司的业绩；2）董事经理责任保险与公司业绩之间的关系是否受公司治理的影响；3）投资者如何评价拥有大量董事经理责任保险的公司的持有的现金资产和大笔资本性支出(这两项很容易与董事经理的自利行为有关）。

154811.label: Realisation of objectives
154811.value: The three objectives of the research have been fully achieved. Specifically, (1) It is found that higher levels of D&O insurance coverage are associated with a lower firm value. There is also a negative relation between the level of D&O insurance coverage and one-year-ahead accounting performance measured by ROA albeit the result is weaker and less consistent compared with the results from using Tobin’s Q to proxy firm value. This difference is understandable because the market value measure (i.e., Tobin’s Q) captures all sources of risk and return information relevant to the firm ex ante, but the accounting performance measure is an ex-post indicator of performance, and only reflects the cash flow effect in the year ahead. (2) We find that the adverse effect of D&O insurance coverage on Q is less pronounced in the presence of a blockholder in a firm’s ownership structure (as an external monitoring mechanism) and more pronounced when a firm’s equity-based compensation (proxied by CEO’s vega) provides more risk-taking incentives. These results are consistent with the notion that the effect of D&O insurance on firm value is conditional on other governance mechanisms as predicted by theory. (3) We find moderate evidence that D&O insurance appears to improve the marginal value of investment in firms with good governance (i.e., when there is strong monitoring by internal independent directors or external product market competition), though the effect of D&O insurance on firm performance is negative on average. There is also weak evidence showing that in poor-governed firms, D&O insurance further lowers the marginal value of corporate cash holdings. These results add to our understanding of the beneficial role that D&O insurance might play in affecting corporate policies and outcomes under certain circumstances. It is worth noting that the interaction with corporate governance in the analysis on the marginal value of investment and cash holdings is not in the original Objective 3, and I have gone beyond Objective 3 to make the analysis richer.

154811.label: Major findings and research outcome
154811.value: We find that higher levels of D&O insurance coverage are associated with a lower firm value. There is also a negative relation between the level of D&O insurance coverage and one-year-ahead accounting performance measured by ROA albeit the result is weaker and less consistent compared with the results from using Tobin’s Q to proxy firm value. In addition, the adverse effect of D&O insurance coverage on Q is less pronounced in the presence of a blockholder in a firm’s ownership structure (as an external monitoring mechanism) and more pronounced when a firm’s equity-based compensation (proxied by CEO’s vega) provides more risk-taking incentives. These results are consistent with the notion that the effect of D&O insurance on firm value is conditional on other governance mechanisms as predicted by theory. Moreover, we find moderate evidence that D&O insurance appears to improve the marginal value of investment in firms with good governance (i.e., when there is strong monitoring by internal independent directors or external product market competition), though the effect of D&O insurance on firm performance is negative on average. There is also weak evidence showing that in poor-governed firms, D&O insurance further lowers the marginal value of corporate cash holdings. These results add to our understanding of the beneficial role that D&O insurance might play in affecting corporate policies and outcomes under certain circumstances and help resolve the longstanding debate on the merits of D&O insurance.

Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
154811.value: Directors’ and officers’ liability insurance (D&O insurance) is commonly purchased by companies to protect directors and officers against defense cost and potential damage award in litigation brought by shareholder and other stakeholders, but at the cost of companies. There is a longstanding debate over the merit of D&O insurance. Proponents argue that it is indispensable for companies to attract high-caliber risk-averse candidates to serve as directors and officers in the company and/or to provide incentives for directors and officers to take necessary risks in business decisions. Opponents contend that the protection of D&O insurance effectively shields D&Os from bearing personal financial liabilities and reduces the disciplining effect of shareholder litigation. Using a large hand collected data set on D&O insurance from Canada, we directly test whether D&O insurance increases or decreases firm value. We find that D&O insurance on average lowers firm value, but under certain circumstances (e.g., with good internal and external monitoring), D&O insurance may improve the marginal value of large corporate investment. Our evidence illustrates the difficulty in drawing a simple conclusion about the merit of D&O insurance.

The output was presented in seminars in Southwestern University of Finance and Economics and Renmin University. In addition, another output out of this project is a paper (co-authored with Zhihong Chen and Oliver Li) examining the effect of D&O insurance on firms’ cost of equity, which was recently accepted for publication in Journal of Accounting & Economics (a top tier journal in accounting). In the paper, we show that investors ask for a higher required rate of return in investing in a company with a high level of D&O insurance because high D&O insurance protection appears to reduce directors' and officers' vigilance in financial reporting and increases firms' exposure to market risk. The evidence is consistent with moral hazard as an unintended effect of D&O insurance, and provides a reason for the lower firm value observed in my project report. Overall, I think the project has achieved its planned aim and objectives, and the research further enhances our understanding of the merits/costs of D&O insurance.

160411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
160411.value: The ultimate goal of this project is to provide novel insights into the mechanistic role of leptin in endocrine disruption observed in hypoxic fish. Hypoxia (<2mg O2 L−1) arising as a result of euthrophication affects vast stretches of aquatic ecosystems worldwide and often leads to population decline and changes in community structure by eliminating oxygen-sensitive species. Endocrine disruption is one of the major causes of reproductive impairment observed in hypoxic fish. Our recent study demonstrated that hypoxia can alter both the levels and the balance of testosterone and estradiol, resulting in retarded gonadal development and altered phenotypic sex ratio in zebrafish. Reproductive impairments with concomitant perturbation of estrogens and androgens were similarly reported in several other fish species exposed to hypoxia. However, the mechanisms of such hypoxia-induced disruption of sex steroids are yet to be elucidated. One of the mechanisms of endocrine disruption is interference with steroidogenesis. In a previous study, we demonstrated that expression of cytochrome P450 cholesterol side chain cleavage enzyme (CYP11A) is down-regulated in hypoxic zebrafish embryos. Down-regulation of expression of CYP11A as well as the steroidogenic acute regulatory protein (StAR) gene has also been observed in human adrenocortical carcinoma H295R cells after short-term exposures to hypoxic conditions. Since both StAR and CYP11A represent the first and rate-determining steps of the steroidogenesis cascade, their suppression could contribute to the decreased sex steroid production observed in hypoxic fish. However, the regulatory mechanisms underlying hypoxia-mediated suppression of StAR and CYP11A remain elusive. The hormone leptin, apart from being a central regulator of food intake and metabolism, plays a role in modulating reproduction in mammals. This modulatory effect is likely due in part to the direct inhibitory effect of leptin on adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis, mostly through attenuation of StAR and CYP11A gene expression. The molecular mechanisms accounting for this attenuation is still unclear, although steroidogenic factor 1 (SF1), a transcription factor essential for activation of multiple steroidogenic genes, may be involved. Hypoxia has been shown to increase leptin expression and secretion in various in vivo and in vitro mammalian systems, and the involvement of hypoxia-inducible factor 1 (HIF-1) in these responses was suggested. Our team recently demonstrated that HIF1-α overexpression can also elevate leptin gene expression in zebrafish embryos. Based on these observations, we hypothesize that the suppressive effects of hypoxia on steroidogenic gene expression in early zebrafish development is at least in part due to HIF-1α-enhanced leptin expression. 本课题的最终目的是为瘦素在缺氧状态下的鱼的内分泌紊乱机制中的作用提供一个全新的见解。缺氧(<2毫克氧气/升)由富营养化产生，自然界的广大水域都受其影响。因缺氧而消亡的氧敏感种群常常导致水产总量的减少和种群构成的改变。内分泌紊乱是缺氧鱼类生殖损伤的最主要原因之一。我们最近的研究表明，缺氧会改变斑马鱼睾酮和雌二醇的水平和平衡，从而延迟性腺发育并改变表型的性别比。生殖损伤伴随着雌雄激素的紊乱同样见报于缺氧环境下的其它鱼类物种。然而，这种缺氧诱导对性激素的干扰机制尚未阐明。对类固醇激素合成的干扰是内分泌紊乱的机制之一。我们在以前的研究表明，在缺氧的斑马鱼胚胎中，细胞色素P450胆固醇侧链裂解酶（CYP11A）的表达是下调的。人类的肾上腺皮质癌细胞H295R短时间暴露在缺氧条件下也可以观察到CYP11A和类固醇合成快速调节蛋白（StAR）基因的表达下调。由于StAR和CYP11A这两个酶催化的是类固醇合成的第一步限速步骤，对他们的抑制可能有助于减少缺氧鱼类性激素的产生。然而，由缺氧介导的抑制StAR和CYP11A的调节机制仍不甚明了。在哺乳动物中，瘦素激素除了作为食物摄入和新陈代谢的主要调节器外，其对繁殖还起着调节作用。这种调节作用主要通过减少StAR和CYP11A基因的表达从而直接抑制瘦素激素在肾上腺及性腺类固醇类激素合成中的作用。尽管类固醇合成因子1(SF1)作为多个类固醇合成基因的重要转录因子可能与此有关，但是目前这个衰减的分子机理尚不清楚。缺氧已被证明能够增加瘦素在不同哺乳动物体内体外系统的表达和分泌，同时表明缺氧诱导因子1（HIF-1）也有参与这些应答。我们团队最近证明了HIF1-α的过度表达也可以提升瘦素基因在斑马鱼胚胎中的表达。根据这些观察资料，我们推测早期斑马鱼缺氧对类固醇基因表达的抑制作用至少部分是由于HIF -1α增强瘦素的表达而引起。

160411.label: Realisation of objectives
160411.value: We experienced two serious problems in the latter half of our project: (1) fungal contamination and (2) high mortality of zebrafish embryos. We used 0.01% methylene blue as a decontamination agent to prevent fungal growth in various batches of zebrafish embryos which yielded highly irreproducible results. In order to obtain sufficient zebrafish embryos for our study, we requested zebrafish embryos from the zebrafish facility of the Hong Kong Baptist University but the mortality rate of their zebrafish embryos were also very high, for some reason, over the same period of time. We attributed the problem to poor water quality. In any case, we kept a vigilant eye on the quality of the zebrafish embryos and selected only those that could be reliably used for our experiments. Despite the challenges, we have managed to achieve a reasonable degree of success with the project objectives. While tackling the above problems, we carried out a comparative study in the H295R human adrenocortical cell line to examine the role of HIF-1 in mediating hypoxia-induced disruption of steroidogenic gene expression and sex steroid production. The human H295R cell line expresses all of the genes in the steroidogenesis pathway, and produces both sex steroids (testosterone and estradiol) at appreciable levels under tissue culture conditions. Using data from that set of experiments, we published an article in 2015 in Environmental Science & Technology entitled “Evidence for microRNA-mediated regulation of steroidogenesis by hypoxia”. In addition, we have obtained sufficient data to write up a paper on “HIF-1 disrupts expression of steroidogenic enzyme genes and early embryonic development in zebrafish” which we has been submitted to Biogeosciences for review. We are in the process of finishing some final experiments for another paper on “Transcriptomic analysis of the effects of hypoxia and ectopic expression of the leptin gene (zlep-a) in zebrafish embryos”.

160411.label: Major findings and research outcome
160411.value: Using zebrafish as a model, we investigated (i) whether hypoxia disrupts reproductive functions through modulation of steroidogenic gene expression, and (ii) the role of leptin in hypoxia-induced disruption of steroidogenesis. Our results showed that zlep-a expression is upregulated under hypoxia, and that overexpression of zlep-a and exposure of fertilized zebrafish embryos to hypoxia both upregulated Cyp11a expression but not StAR expression. Similarly, testosterone (T) and estradiol (E2) concentrations in hypoxic and zlep-a overexpressing embryos were increased and reduced, respectively, relative to the normoxic control embryos. Overall, our gain- and loss-of function experiments demonstrated that hypoxia likely disrupts sex steroid (testosterone and estradiol) synthesis via the leptin gene (a HIF-1 target) which modulates steroidogenesis by acting directly on the expression of specific steroidogenic genes. Our experiments demonstrated that SF1 (Ff1b in fish) expression was significantly reduced under hypoxia, and that knockdown of HIF-1α resulted in upregulated expression of SF1. However, overexpression of leptin has no significant effect on SF1 expression in zebrafish embryos. Further gene transfection studies in HeLa and ZF1 cells also showed that leptin has no significant regulatory effect on expression of the SF1 promoter (2 kb) –luciferase reporter constructs or deletion constructs of the SF1 promoter. These results suggest that either leptin has no regulatory effect on SF1 or the effect of leptin on SF1 may be tissue- or cell-specific; further transfection experiments on endocrine-derived cell lines will have to be carried out to confirm this. Using EMSA, we observed no significant difference in the binding of SF1 to CYP11A in either hypoxic or zlepa-overexpressing zebrafish embryos, which suggest that hypoxia and/or leptin activation of CYP11A may not be mediated through SF1. We next investigated the effect of hypoxia and overexpression of zlep-a on the mRNA transcriptome in zebrafish embryos. RNA-seq libraries were generated for zebrafish embryos following: (1) normoxia and (2) hypoxia exposure, and (3) microinjection of in-vitro transcribed zlep-a mRNA. KEGG pathway analysis showed that a number of biological pathway genes were commonly affected in hypoxic and zlep-a microinjected embryos – 48 genes were co-upregulated and 96 were co-downregulated in hypoxic and zlepa-overexpressing embryos. As indicated in Part C, one manuscript has been published in “Environmental Science & Technology”, and another manuscript entitled “HIF-1 disrupts expression of steroidogenic enzyme genes and early embryonic development in zebrafish” has been submitted to Biogeosciences.

160411.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
160411.value: Using zebrafish as a model, the results from this study demonstrated that hypoxia-induced endocrine disruption that resulted in a significant decrease in estrogen production is mediated by the HIF-1 transcription factor through leptin repression of the cyp19a gene (which encodes for an aromatase enzyme that converts testosterone to estrogen). A comparative study using the H295R human adrenocortical cell line further indicated that hypoxic repression of the cyp19a gene may also be subject to epigenetic regulation of non-coding microRNA, miR-98. Despite numerous studies demonstrating that HIF-1 is a transcription factor with epigenetic functions, the epigenetic role of HIF-1 in hypoxia-induced endocrine disruption remains little known. Although the findings reported here provide a perspective on the functional relevance of leptin in regulating steroidogenesis in developing embryos of fish, whether this finding can be extrapolated to steroidogenesis in adult fish, in which gonadal steroidogenesis contributes to the major sources of sex steroids, is unknown. Detailed analysis of changes in the transcriptome profiles and associated epigenetic changes in the brain-pituitary-gonadal (HPG) axis of normoxic and hypoxic zebrafish should provide novel and valuable insights into the transcriptional responses that are specifically reprogrammed under hypoxia-induced endocrine disruption conditions.

160411.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
160411.value: Hypoxia arising as a result of eutrophication is presently one of the most pressing problems in aquatic ecosystems worldwide. Hypoxia has produced major changes in fish community structure and reductions in biodiversity resulting in serious population declines and the extinction of sensitive species in marine and freshwater systems. Recent studies have shown that hypoxia can cause reproductive impairments in fish by inhibiting testicular and ovarian development, affecting sperm and egg production and quality, reducing fertilization success, and affecting the health of juveniles. Findings from this study suggest that dysregulation of steroidogenesis may be a crucial cause of hypoxia-induced endocrine disruption in fish and that Hypoxia Inducible Factor-1 (HIF-1) has an important role in the process. HIF-1 is the principal regulator of various hypoxia-responsive genes that assist animals in adapting to and surviving hypoxia, but may also play a pathophysiological role in mediating endocrine disruption (at the genetic and epigenetic levels) under adverse conditions of acute hypoxia. The work here has laid the groundwork for further studies on how the epigenome in fish gametes could be reprogrammed through HIF and chromatin remodeling mechanisms such as DNA methylation and histone modification that may result in impairment of reproductive functions.

160811.value: 癌症化療藥例如順鉑經常會引致嘔吐。其作用機制被認為與腸嗜鉻細胞分泌五羥色胺（5-HT）並作用於迷走神經五羥色胺受體（5-HT3）上有關。 5-HT3 受體拮抗劑是急性期噁心嘔吐的有效的阻斷劑， 但在治療延遲嘔吐上卻沒有明顯作用。研究顯示當NK1受體拮抗劑與5-HT3受體拮抗劑同時使用時，延遲嘔吐的症狀可以得到改善，但其作用機制和作用位點卻尚不清楚。我們發表過的系列觀察顯示5-HT 負責檢測餐後腸內容物。腸腔是如何辨別攝入的有毒物質與食物的機制尚不清楚。 最近研究表明當受到炎症，損傷或食物的刺激時，迷走傳入神經元存在著特殊的可塑性以重新恢復功能。腸嗜鉻細胞同時富含5-HT和P物質（SP）。我們假設5-HT 和SP 可以協同刺激迷走傳入神經元。順鉑可導致NK1受體基因表達調控的上升和神經細胞的表型的轉換。增強的SP所引致的迷走傳入活動在引發大鼠的延遲性嘔吐上起著關鍵作用。 為了證明假設，電生理記錄將用來檢測迷走傳入神經對5-HT和SP的反應。我們將會描述這兩種分子在正常大鼠和用順鉑治療的大鼠上的相互作用。細胞內記錄以及隨後的免疫組化標記將用來提供對於5-HT/SP敏感的結狀神經節細胞的功能性的鑑別。更進一步，傳導速度將用來區分迷走A或C纖維。我們將證明順鉑會引致NK1受體上調和神經細胞表型的改變。我們將闡明新合成的NK1受體在順鉑非敏感神經元上的表達。而這種神經元連接著一般不會被SP所激活的快速傳導Aδ纖維。為了提供確鑿的證據證明迷走傳入NK1受體在調節化療引起的延遲性嘔吐上的關鍵作用， 我們將在大鼠上進行“食土實驗”，而這些大鼠的結狀神經節上導入了可抑制NK1表達的siRNA。 以上的研究將支持迷走傳入神經元為區分毒素-食品的主要調控者並同時參與到控制嘔吐這個新的概念。理解迷走神經可塑性所蘊含的機制可能對於我們對病因學的理解，以及在結狀神經節上尋找與化療相關的延遲性嘔吐的潛在治療靶點起至關重要的作用

160811.label: Major findings and research outcome
160811.value: We provide evidence about the critical role of vagal afferent NK1 receptors in the mediation of chemotherapy (cisplatin) induced delayed emesis. We performed a series of behavioral assessments in rats following chronic administration of cisplatin,. We showed that Cisplatin suppressed spontaneous exploratory activity. To confirm the anxiety-like behavior we performed elevated plus-maze test. The EPM tests showed that cisplatin-treated rats exhibited a reduced time in the open arms and a lower percentage of time spent in the open arms versus closed arms, further, rats with cisplatin also exhibited a higher level of freezing behavior during exposure to the elevated plus-maze. To investigate the learning acquisition processes and memory ability we conducted Morris water maze task. There was a significant effect on escape latencies suggest that cisplatin-treated rats spent more time trying to find the platform during 4-day acquisition over the course of several trials. Probe test in which rats searched the target quadrant that previously contained the escape platform. Control animals showed a significantly higher percentage of time spent in the target quadrant compared with cisplatin rats when tested in a probe trial 24-h after training and in 30- day after training suggesting suggesting cisplatin-disrupted memory retrieval in both the recent and remote memory retention. In particular the rat Iowa gambling task (RGT) was used to assess decision making functions in rats. Decision-making is the result of the integration of several executive brain areas and has emerged as a crucial theme in neurophysiological studies of cognition. Our RGT results show that good, delayed-good, undecided, and poor decision-makers could be identified in the RGT. In the cisplatin-treated group we observed decreases in the percentage of good decision makers, and increases in the percentage of maladaptive behavior (delayed-good decision-makers plus poor decision makers). These results suggest that chemotherapy agents could causally interrupt emotional and cognitive functions, learning and memory, and decision making. We studied the effects of cisplatin on induction of LTP in the basolateral amygdala (BLA)-anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) pathway, characterized the coordination of spike timing with local theta oscillation, and identified synchrony in the BLA-ACC network integrity. We provide the first direct evidence that the cisplatin interrupts theta-frequency phase-locking of ACC neurons. The block of LTP and disruption of synchronized theta oscillations in the BLA-ACC pathway are associated with emotional and cognitive deficits in rats, following cancer chemotherapy

160811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
160811.value: Go beyond previous animal work, in our study cognitive functions were examined up to two months post cancer chemotherapy and the animals were free of cancer and other diseases. Neural oscillations play a basic role in coordinated activity during normal functional brain processes. By characterizing the alteration of phase-locking of neural activity to the theta oscillation following chemotherapy our study allowed to identification of the disruption of the amygdala-ACC network synchrony associated with impairment of cognition and behavior after chemotherapy. These observations directly complement recent seminal findings showing that in human studies [Nature. 2014; 464; 903], the interruption of neuronal synchrony appears to impact cognition and behavior. These studies provided a basis for fundamental notions regarding neurophysiologic biomarkers in cognitive impairment induced by chemotherapy. We can take advantage of the electrophysiological techniques to understand the neurophysiology of behavior including risk-taking abilities, and decision-making in animal models, and also develop a stimulation therapy or medicine to reverse the neurophysiological changes due to induced by chronic chemotherapy.

160811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
160811.value: Patients following prolonged cancer chemotherapy are at high risk of emotional and cognitive deficits. In clinical studies, depression and cognitive impairment were found in 40 to 70 % of patients following cancer therapy. In previous animal research chemotherapy-related mood and cognitive deficits have not been investigated systematically. Our goal in the present study was to develop a animal model to examine the effect of chemotherapy agent Cisplatin on emotional and cognitive fuctions. We observed that cisplatin-treated rats development of anxiety-like behavior. In the spatial reference memory task, the cisplatin treated rats showed impaired learning acquisition processes. Furthermore, these rats showed impaired recent and remote memory. Animals are individuals that can exhibit human-like cognitive characteristics. Decision making is complex ; it can be impaired in psychiatric disorders, such as attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder. Our Rat Gambling Task showed that the cisplatin-treated group decreases in the percentage of good decision makers,and increases in the percentage of poor- and maladaptive behavior suggesting chematheray impairm decision making. The desults of this study, and the animal model can be used to develop a stimulation therapy or medicine to reverse the emotional and coginitive damages due to chronic chemotherapy in patients following prolonged cancer chemotherapy.

161011.label: Project Objectives
161011.value: Compare and evaluate the applicability of marine biotic and biological integrity indices for reflecting the state of subtropical benthic ecosystems from datasets collected in different environmental conditions and/or under different human disturbances. The questions that will be investigated include: • Sensitivity test: How well do the indices distinguish changes from expected conditions? • Precision test: How much within- or between-site variability is there for the index scores? Analyze the life-traits of subtropical macrobenthos to complement the evaluation of biological indices in different environmental conditions.

161011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
161011.value: A major problem in coastal areas is man-made disturbance of the marine environment. Therefore, there is an urgent need to develop methods which can help indicate the health of the ecosystem, at an early stage, using biological information, so that the integrity of the environment can be protected. The study of marine communities permits the assessment of ecological and environmental status. Various studies have demonstrated that bottom-dwelling (benthic) organisms are useful indicators of ecosystem health, as they respond predictably to various natural and man-induced changes. At present, the analysis of changes in benthic communities caused by human perturbations is based on statistical methods. However, the results obtained are generally difficult to interpret by non-scientists. This is especially true in environmental impact studies or marine quality monitoring, which are often addressed to policymakers, stakeholders and the general public. To this end, biological indices have been developed to estimate benthic community disturbance levels and to measure the ecological quality of a marine environment. However, these indices largely focus on the changes in community structure pattern and do not reflect the importance of the function and life-traits of the organisms within the community. The development of these indices is also primarily derived from European waters. There are very few studies using biological indices and life-trait analysis in tropical/subtropical marine benthic communities, in which more diverse structure and dynamic changes in species composition are often noted. The aim of this research is to test the applicability of biological indices and life-trait analysis on data obtained at latitudes and within environments which differ from those in which such approaches were developed originally. Results of this research will form the basis of extending the use of such methods to other areas, i.e., subtropical Asian regions, where such coastal areas are subjected to intense and unplanned anthropogenic activities, because they are under the influence of multiple environmental stresses. By investigating the biological indices and life-traits of marine benthic communities, we can better identify the ecological effects of human impact and contribute to future assessment of ecological consequences. This will also offer more insight into ecosystem monitoring, management and conservation in subtropical marine ecosystems.

161011.label: Realisation of objectives
161011.value: Both research objectives were 100% achieved according to the study plan through field collection of data in four contrasting marine environments in Hong Kong and the compilation and analysis of the species and life-trait data on benthic organisms using two biotic indices for comparison purposes. However, since much time and effort during the study period were focused on the research on life-trait information for the species in Hong Kong, principally because of the lack of such data in the literature in subtropical ecosystems as compared to well-studied temperate waters in higher latitudes. To circumvent such a delay, reference has made to use species under the same genus as a proxy of similar life-trait history in the subsequent analyses and to follow expert advice on biology and ecology of some species found. This has caused delay in the final preparation of manuscripts for publication. One manuscript on "Sediment characteristics and benthic ecological status in contrasting marine environments of subtropical Hong Kong" has just been accepted for publication with minor revision only, and one more manuscript on "Analysis of life-trait composition in macrobenthic communities in subtropical Hong Kong" is still under preparation for submission to Marine Pollution Bulletin.

161011.label: Major findings and research outcome
161011.value: The ATZI Marine Biotic Index (AMBI), which is widely applied in European waters, was shown to be sensitive to indicate the ecological benthic condition at the four contrasting marine environments in subtropical Hong Kong. For the protected marine reserve area (Cape D'Aguilar), most index values reflected the relatively undisturbed to slightly disturbed condition, depending on sediment characteristics at the sampling locations. For the offshore sediments on the east coast (Mirs Bay), the index values also revealed slightly disturbed condition. Mirs Bay has been subjected to bottom trawling (before 2013, when data were collected). Both Victoria Harbour and Tolo Harbour Channel areas, however, showed slightly to extremely disturbed condition, indicating that both harbours are under ecological stress with the former being suffered from past sewage pollution and the latter from poor circulation within a semi-land-locked topography. The AMBI was also proven sensitive to differentiate summer and winter benthic condition especially in Tolo Harbour and Channel areas, in which the occurrence of hypoxia resulted in moderately to extremely disturbed condition within the inner harbour sediments while increased water mixing in winter improved the condition to slightly disturbed. The analysis of life-trait composition of the benthic communities in the study areas further supported the findings from the use of AMBI. The major outcomes from this research are that (1) to accurately reflect the ecological health of marine benthic environment, effort should be given to collect life-trait data of the species rather than species composition alone, and (2) AMBI developed in European waters can be applicable to reflect benthic ecosystem health in other water regimes. While such research in subtropical or tropical waters is relatively less available, the compilation of life-trait databases can make reference to that available in temperate waters. In the longer term, there is a need to establish such a comprehensive database for local use so as to further refine the applicability of such index to reflect ecosystem health of the marine benthic environment.

161011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
161011.value: The performance of such marine biotic index as an indicator of benthic ecological condition can be further refined, in terms of its ecological group classification based on local expert knowledge. To this end, future research on the biology and ecology as well as the functioning of key, dominant benthic species in the study areas will need to be conducted.

161011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
161011.value: Ecological indicators can summarize and present the complex ecology of an environment for laymen’s information. Previous studies only focused on the changes in biological community structure pattern to reflect disturbances caused by human activities. Such changes, however, are often difficult to analyze and require much statistical techniques to reveal the actual status particularly in the marine seabed habitats which can be under different forms of perturbations, such as bottom trawling, disposal of wastewater and wastes, dredging and re-filling. This research investigated the application of marine biotic indices generated from the function and life-traits of bottom-dwelling (benthic) organisms, to reflect ecosystem health. Whilst most of such indices are derived from European waters, the present findings, using data from subtropical Hong Kong, showed the applicability of one of these indices be sensitive to reflect the benthic condition in seabed areas which are under different degrees of disturbances. By investigating such biological indices and life-traits of marine benthic communities, we can better identify the ecological effects of human impact and contribute to future assessment of ecological consequences. This will also offer more insight into ecosystem monitoring, management and conservation in subtropical marine ecosystems.

200211.label: Project Objectives
200211.value: Provide a comprehensive analysis of the effect a highly oscillatory kernel in a Volterra integral equation (of the first or second kind) has on the solution of the equation. In particular: when is the solution of such a Volterra integral equation also highly oscillatory? This theory will form the basis for 4 and 5 below. Study the application of direct quadrature methods based on composite Filon-type quadrature (e.g. Clenshaw-Curtis-Filon) to highly oscillatory integral equations of the first kind. Are these methods convergent? If so, establish realistic error estimates. If the kernel and the oscillator in a first-kind or second-kind Volterra integral equation are of convolution type, establish the analogue of Lubich's (et al.) convolution quadrature theory for such highly oscillatory Volterra equations. Establish optimal convergence results and realistic error estimates (uniform in the oscillation parameter) for collocation and discontinuous Galerkin methods for highly oscillatory Volterra integral equations whose solutions are not highly oscillatory. Design and analyze feasible numerical schemes for highly oscillatory Volterra integral equations whose solutions are highly oscillatory. Apply the results obtained in 4 and 5 to singularly perturbed Volterra equations with highly oscillatory kernels.

200211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
200211.value: Integral equations arising in the mathematical modelling of retarded potentials or elastodynamic models in fracture interaction often contain kernels that are highly oscillatory. The efficient and accurate computational solution of the resulting Volterra-type integral equations (reflecting memory effects in the model) is very difficult, and so far both the theory and the design of suitable numerical schemes are essentially open. In this proposal we address these challenges, exploiting recent advances in the approximation of highly oscillatory integrals and in discontinuous Galerkin methods for Volterra integral equations of the first and second kind. The derivation of numerical schemes hinges on new results on the nature of solutions to such highly oscillatory Volterra integral equations, since highly oscillatory kernels may or may not lead to highly oscillatory solutions. We also use the above insight and results to study the computational solution of singularly perturbed Volterra equations, and (ill-posed) first-kind Volterra integral equations with noisy data.

200211.value: The focus of future work will be on the the convergence analysis of collocation and (continuous and discontinuous) Galerkin methods for linear Volterra integral equations (of the first and second kind) with highly oscillatory solutions.

200211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
200211.value: Fredholm and Volterra integral equations with highly oscillatory kernels and highly oscillatory solutions arise as mathematical models in many physical applications (for example in laser theory). Due to the usually very large oscillation parameters w (order of 10^4 or 10^5) classical numerical methods (e.g. collocation methods based on piecewise polynomials) are no longer feasible since the resulting errors behave like some power p of w with p geq 2. Hence there is an important need to design discretisation methods for such integral equations whose errors either do not depend on $omega$, or which behave like the power r of 1/w for some positive integer r.

201611.label: Project Objectives
201611.value: Based on the interior point algorithms and the general framework for the continuous method, we will first establish some interior point based continuous method models for linear programming problems. For the continuous method models established above, we will fully investigate various theoretical properties, in particular the strong convergence, of these models. On the computational aspect, we will conduct extensive numerical simulations on our continuous method models. Comparison with the iterative interior point algorithms and various neural network models for linear programming will be implemented and documented.

201611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
201611.value: In this research project, we have fully investigated the interior point based continuous method model for linear programming. Our research has led to some neurodynamic models for linear programming problems (both primal and dual forms). Our theoretical study has ensured the strong convergence of our neurodynamic models. In addition, we have also proved that the limit points are indeed the optimal solutions of the original problems. These neurodynamic models can be easily extended to solve convex quadratic programming with general linear constraints.

201811.label: Project Objectives
201811.value: The synthesis of novel platinum(II), iridium(III) and rhodium(III) transition metal complexes as luminescent probes for changes in oligonucleotide conformations. Characterization of the physical, photophysical properties and selectivity towards different oligonucleotide conformations of the novel transition metal complexes using physical (mass spectrometery), spectroscopic (nuclear magnetic resonance, photoluminescence and UV/visible spectroscopy) and other biological and biophysical assays. Based on these results, the physical, photophysical and selectivity will be further refined by tuning the organic ligands around the metal center. To fabricate DNA logic gates based on the synthesized luminescent transition metal complexes and oligonucleotides with polymorphic conformations based on chemical stimuli (i.e. pH and metal ions). The oligonucleotide sequence will be optimized in an iterative manner to provide the optimal response. To develop methods for the simultaneous detection and removal of metal ions using luminescent transition metal complexes and immobilized oligonucleotide-based systems.

201811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
201811.value: 最近，將化學和分子技術結合來對以矽為基礎的處理和計算進行模仿，已在科學界發展成為很具有吸引力的研究領域。化學工作者對該項研究的前沿領域起到了推動作用。他們應用諸如小分子或DNA等分子物質來設計分子水準的邏輯閘以類比布耳函數，而後者正是現代數位資訊集成的基礎。這些布耳函數， 例如“AND”，“OR”及“NOT”等邏輯閘，根據“輸入”的不同組合可生成截然不同的二進位（0或1）“輸出”。 由於金屬在生物及環境中的重要性，金屬離子的分子邏輯閘受到廣泛關注。該項提案，我們致力於探索DNA的金屬-鹼基對形成能力以生成新的金屬離子邏輯閘，並且應用固載的寡核苷系統開發同時能夠檢測和去除金屬離子的方法。核苷酸形態多變，金屬離子如汞、銀、鉀等能夠誘導DNA在不同結構間進行轉換。我們將通過過渡金屬複合物來監測這種結構轉換過程，即通過加入或者移除金屬離子產生螢光的方法來監測這種結構的轉換過程。 我們初期的結果表明，某些鉑(II）複合物與一個DNA寡核苷酸一起可對汞和銀離子發揮“OR”邏輯閘的作用。我們將根據這些結果合成一系列新的鉑（II）、銥（III）、銠（III）複合物作為DNA選擇性探針。以精心設計的DNA寡核苷酸和一個DNA雙鏈(DNA duplex) 或G-四聯體(G-quadruplex)選擇性過渡金屬複合物之間的組合為基礎，我們預計，一系列新的邏輯閘例如“AND”，“OR”，“NAND”及“INHIBIT”等可以被開發出來。同時我們預料，這些方法可被應用于高流量的固載DNA邏輯閘系統，從而有了高靈敏度和重複應用的優點。由於DNA邏輯閘在構建分子水準電腦方面具有潛在應用前景，而分子電腦可能成為現代計算的基礎，該提案就是在該方面的一大進步。我們提出的方法很簡單，與之前報導的利用複雜和/或昂貴的樣品製備方法和程式所得到的DNA邏輯閘相比有一定的優越性。

201811.label: Realisation of objectives
201811.value: In this funding period, we have successfully achieved all of the project objectives and completed several projects on the development of label-free DNA logic gates through interactions of polymorphic oligonucleotides with metal ions. Firstly, we have designed and synthesized a series of novel platinum(II), iridium(III) and rhodium(III) transition metal complexes with different scaffold as luminescent probes for distinguishing changes in oligonucleotide conformations. According to our experiment result, most of the rhodium(III) complexes showed very weak luminescence even in organic solvent. Few of them have luminescent emissions, but they do not show any selectivity towards the G-quadrulplex DNA or dsDNA compared with other oligonucleotide conformations. Encouragingly, most of the iridium(III) complexes show very good luminescent properties and we obtained a series of novel Ir(III) complexes with G-quadruplex-selective properties through performing the experiments, such as G4-FID, FRET melting, UV/Vis titration. The luminescent intensity was significantly enhanced in the presence of various G-quadruplex DNA sequences (such as PS2.M, Pu27 and Pu22). In contrast, no significant change in the luminescence of complexes was observed upon the addition of ssDNA, dsDNA or DNA/RNA hybrid duplex. The experiment results indicated that these iridium(III) complexes could be used as G-quadruplex selective probes in the G-quadruplex-based sensing assay for the detection of metal ions. And then we utilized the G-quadruplex-selective metal complexes to monitor the metal ion-induced structural switching of nucleic acids for several logic gate applications, including AND, OR and INHIBIT logic gates. The oligonucleotide sequences are optimized in an iterative manner to provide the optimal response. The input of these logic gates include K+, H+, Ag+, Hg2+, Ca2+ ions and silver nanoparticles and all of these works have been published in peer-reviewed journals, such as Analyst, Analytica Chimica Acta, Journal of Materials Chemistry B, Methods, RSC Advances and so on. Meanwhile, our expertise in DNA-based logic gates has been recognized by recent review articles in high impact factor journal such as Chemical Society Reviews, Nucleic Acids Research, Chemical Science. We have also developed methods for the simultaneous detection and removal of Hg2+ ions using luminescent transition metal complexes and immobilized oligonucleotide-based systems. Furthermore, this assay could also be potentially applied for monitoring Hg2+ ions and decreasing its concentration in a real water sample.

201811.label: Major findings and research outcome
201811.value: In this funding period, we have synthesized a series of luminescent transition metal complexes with co-ligand bearing functional groups. Some of them show great selectivity towards G-quadruplex DNA and can be utilized as G-quadruplex-selective probes. Therefore, we utilize these iridium(III) complexes as G-quadruplex selective probes in the G-quadruplex-based sensing assay to monitor the metal ion-induced structural switching of nucleic acids for logic gate applications. Firstly, we have reported the development of a label-free oligonucleotide-based ‘‘OR’’ logic gate for H+ and K+ ions exploiting the target-induced structural transitions of polymorphic cytosine- or guanine-rich oligonucleotides. Crystal violet was used to monitor the formation of i-motif and G-quadruplex in the presence of H+ and K+ ions as the inputs, respectively. We have demonstrated the first application of CV as a selective probe for the i-motif over single-stranded and duplex DNA. (Analyst, 2011, 136, 2692) Afterwards, we also developed an “OR” DNA logic gate based on a luminescent platinum(II) switch-on probe for silver nanoparticles and pH. The modulation of metal complex/double-stranded DNA complex phosphorescence by Ag+ and H+ was used to construct a simple, rapid and label-free method for the label-free detection of pH and nanomolar Ag+ ions and nanoparticles in aqueous solutions with high selectivity. And with the addition of cysteine, this assay would also be changed into an INHIBIT gate, which is also known as the NOTIF gate. (Anal. Chim. Acta, 2012, 733, 78) And recently we constructed the AND, OR and INHIBIT logic gates for the detection of Hg2+ and Ag+ ions by using iridium(III) complexes as luminescent G-quadruplex-selective probes. To our knowledge, this study is the first time that the C–Ag+–T mismatched base pair has been used for the construction of luminescent assays or logic gates. (submitted) Furthermore, we have also developed a luminescent platform for the simultaneous detection and removal of of Hg2+ ions based on immobilized DNA that is adaptable to a high-throughput 96-well plate format (RSC Adv., 2014, 4, 54826) And two more sensing platforms were developed for the selective detection of Ag+ ions (J. Mater. Chem. B, 2014, 2, 6467) and Ca2+ ions (Methods, 2013, 64, 212). Meanwhile, Our expertise in DNA-based logic gates has been recognized by recent review articles in high impact factor journal (Chem. Soc. Rev., 2013, 42, 3427; Nucleic Acids Res., 2013, 41, 4345; Chem. Sci., 2013, 4, 3366).

201811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
201811.value: Previously, our logic gate studies are all conducted in the sample solutions, however, encouraged by the success of Hg2+ ion measurement and removal in well plate, we anticipate that our other sensing platforms can also be applied in this system by immobilizing DNA onto the surface of the well. We hope that by changing the sensing system from solutions to well plate, the sensitivity of the assay could be further improved and make it more convenient for in-field detection.

201811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
201811.value: In this project, we have synthesized some novel transition metal complexes as luminescent probes and utilize them in the detection of metal ions as well as development of oligonucleotide-based logic gates. Among these complexes, we selected out some complexes with specific selectivity towards G-quadruplex DNA over ssDNA or dsDNA. And then we utilized the selected metal complexes to generate new logic gates for metal ions, and to develop methods for the simultaneous detection and removal of metal ions using immobilized oligonucleotide-based systems. Metal ions are ubiquitous in biology and in the environment. For example, intracellular hydrogen and sodium ions can be significantly higher in the tumor tissues compared to normal tissues. Our DNA logic gates could form the basis of “smart” detection technologies that give single distinct outputs depending on the concentration of various metal ion inputs. This has potential applications in molecular computing, but also nanotechnology-based medicine. This study will also bring attention to the most significant advantages of luminescent metallointercalators over traditional intercalating organic dyes, which includes the long phosphorescence emission lifetime that can enhance signal stability and reduced background from fluorescence.

201911.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
201911.value: This research will examine sediments between about 1.2 million and 64,000 years old below the Oltepesi Plain in southern Kenya. Several techniques will be used in the study including the use of microfossils (diatoms), a variety of geochemistry studies (e.g., bulk sediment chemistry, isotopes) and XRD mineral analyses, together with observation of the characteristics of the sediments in the field and from samples returned to Hong Kong. Detailed environments have previously been determined for other locations to the west of the study site, but these earlier studies have not made extensive use of geochemistry as proposed here. The principal aim is to reconstruct past environments in the research area, to determine their spatial distribution, and to relate these environmental reconstructions to past settings for other nearby rift locations. During the period when these sediments were forming there was a distinctive episode of intense faulting that resulted in erosion, a change in the nature of sedimentation and the kinds of environments that developed. This "breakup" of the basin occurred at a time when humans were changing anatomically and their cultural use of stone tools was evolving. The investigation will focus on this period and will attempt to establish the environmental background against which these changes were occurring. The study will also examine the possible relative roles of climate verses faulting in causing this major regional environmental switch in conditions. 題目：肯尼亞南部峽谷歐堤佩斯 (the Oltepesi) 區域第四紀晚期的環境再造：多 功能代理方法 摘要：該研究主要用於確定位於肯尼亞南部歐堤佩斯平原的沉積物，其沉積年代 大約為64,000 至120 萬年之間。主要的研究方法將包括：微生物化石(硅藻)，不 同的地質化學分析 (例如：大體積沉降化學，同位素)，XRD 礦物分析，沉積物 特徵的實地觀察和實驗室樣品分析。此前，對歐堤佩斯西部的一些地方已經作過 詳細的環境研究。然而，這些早期的研究結果沒有廣泛地應用於該地區的地質化 學研究。該研究的主要目的是：再造該區域的古環境；測定它們在空間的分布； 和與峽谷附近區域位置古老結構的關係。 在這些沉積物形成期間經歷了一個強斷裂的特殊過程，它導致侵蝕，沉積物特徵 的改變和現在環境的形成。該盆地斷裂大約發生在人類構造產生變化以及開始使 用石器的年代。這項研究將側重於這一時期並試圖建立這一時期的環境背景。該 研究還將探討氣候在斷層生成過程中引發區域環境條件改變的作用。

201911.label: Realisation of objectives
201911.value: The major objectives have all been fully achieved. The diatoms, geochemistry and sedimentology of sediments in the Oltepesi basin have been described and analysed, producing several significant detailed records for Quaternary environmental change in the southern Kenya Rift (Objective 1). This involved investigation of several Pleistocene and Holocene sequences of diatomites, diatomaceous and / or zeolitic silts and volcaniclastic deposits, as well as a detailed analysis of Late Pleistocene carbonate deposits. This work has also been compared with other neighbouring basins (Munya wa Gicheru, Magadi, Koora; Objective 2) with a summary of the regional changes presented in one paper published in Palaeogeography, Palaeoecology, Palaeoclimatology and as part of a co-authored book (with Prof. Robin Renaut) on the rift valley lakes to be published by "Springer" in 2016. The research has also resulted in the development of a model for the evolution of the southern Kenya Rift Valley that accounts for the formation of several types of biochemical and geochemical sediments (e.g., diatomite, chert, trona, nahcolite). Groundwater changes that led to the formation of tufas and calcretes have been reported by Lee et al., (2014) with broader scale comparisons having been made with other parts of the East Arican Rift System (Tugen Hills and West Turkana, Kenya; Chew Bahir and Afar, Ethiopia) as set out in in Cohen et al. (in review).

201911.label: Major findings and research outcome
201911.value: The research has been based on multiple geochemical, sedimentological and micropalaeontological approaches that have been used to reconstruct Quaternary palaeoenvironments in the Oltepesi region and neighbouring southern Kenya Rift Basin. Lacustrine, wetland and fluvial deposition took place between about 1.9 and 0.72 Ma at Munyu wa Gicheru in the northern part of the study area. Sedimentation continued about 40 km further south to produce the lake, wetland, fluvial and pedogenic deposits of the Oltepesi region (Olorgesailie Formation -1.2 and 0.5 Ma). Faulting subsequently led to basin breakup at and the development of Middle to Late Pleistocene cut-and-fill fluvial deposits (Oltululei Formation 0.5–0 Ma), as well as pond, wetland and terrestrial sediments that were locally altered by pedogenesis. Tufas and calcretes also accumulated during this latter time interval. Sedimentation south of Oltepsei (Koora graben) includes a late Quaternary sequence of diatomites, ashes and pedogenic profiles recording expansion and contraction of a saline to freshwater lake. Sedimentation in these different depositional sequences reflects several long-term trends, including: 1) an increase in calcium carbonate deposition; 2) a decrease in biogenic silica; and 3) decreased chemical weathering indices (Chemical Index of Alteration, Vogt ratios), which imply increasing Quaternary aridity and/or erosion of catchment soils. Elements such as Br and S also increase upwards, suggesting pulses of erosion of organic soils. Plants permineralized by silica became widespread after about 0.5 Ma, providing evidence that groundwater bodies were becoming silica-enriched, possibly as a result of deeper water circulation along active faults. Fossil hot spring deposits include siliceous vent, pedogenic and swamp cherts at Emerit. Tectonism also provided pathways for meteoric water that led to the formation of carbonate springs in the Oltepesi area. REE patterns in clastic sediments are stable throughout the Quaternary, reflecting the dominant trachytic source rocks, but these patterns become variable in later Pleistocene calcretes and tufas documenting changing hydrochemical conditions. The geochemical evolution of the area partly reflects climate change through time. However, it also documents the influence of Quaternary rifting processes. Rift faulting affected the geochemistry of the basin sediments by 1) causing changes in the depth of fracture systems that guide fluids, 2) changing basin accommodation space in which sediments could accumulate, and 3) altering relief and thus rainfall and evaporation patterns across the rift system, as well as erosion and weathering rates.

201911.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
201911.value: The work has established a broad understanding of the long-term changes in the southern Kenya rift and models that can help to explain the occurrence of a variety of geochemical sediments that will help to guide ongoing studies of outcrops in the Magadi-Natron and Nasikie Engida Basins to the southwest of the Oltepesi region. The now well-established environmental records from Oltepesi, Olorgesailie and Munya wa Gicheru have provided a firm basis for understanding the environmental background for ongoing archaeological studies of hominin cultural changes in the Oltepesi-Olorgesailie region. This research will also provide a basis for comparison with the even more detailed lacustrine records being examined in other projects to the south, in the Koora and Magadi Basins, which have now yielded long core records for further study.

201911.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
201911.value: The Oltepesi region lies in the southern Kenya Rift and includes a variety of sediment types that have allowed a detailed reconstruction of the environmental context for a period when Homo sapiens (our species) emerged and during which there was considerable cultural change in our ancestors ways of life. The record generated by this research has also allowed the reconstruction of past climate change in the study region with implications for understanding patterns of human cultural evolution. The sediments analysed include chemically deposited materials that can be explained in terms hot waters and gases that have followed faults from great depth to the surface. These latter aspects of the study shed light on the manner in which rift valleys evolve with implications for understanding ancient rift deposits elsewhere.

202611.label: Project Title(Chinese)
202611.value: 具有不確性的雙曲型問題的計算方法

202611.label: Project Objectives
202611.value: We will begin by considering uncertainty quantification for shock wave physics. Solution error models, confidence intervals and Gaussian error statistics based on simulation studies will be investigated. The Burgers' equation with uncertain initial and boundary conditions will be investigated using a polynomial chaos (PC) expansion approach where the solution is represented as a truncated series of stochastic, orthogonal polynomials. The analysis of well-posedness for the system resulting after Galerkin projection will be carried out, and a characteristic analysis of the truncated PC system will be presented. There have been many research activities in areas of mathematics that are relevant to uncertainty quantification. However, several fundamental and challenging mathematical problems remain unsolved, in particular the so-called `curse of dimensionality' in solving problems in high dimensions. The proposed project will also be partially relevant to this challenging problem.

202611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
202611.value: The ultimate objective of numerical simulations is to predict physical events or the behaviors of engineering systems. In the past few decades, extensive efforts have been devoted to the development of accurate numerical algorithms. The goal is to make simulation predictions reliable in the sense that numerical errors are well under control and understood. Although this remains an active research area, there have been growing interests in understanding the impacts of uncertainty in data. The uncertainty may happen for parameter values, initial and boundary conditions. The study of uncertainty quantification is to provide more reliable predictions for real-life problems. In this project, we will investigate uncertainty quantification for problems governed by partial differential equations, in particular for nonlinear conservation laws that have many important applications in practice. The random effect and the fact that nonlinear conservation laws admit discontinuous solutions yield great challenges for designing numerical algorithms and for the relevant numerical analysis. 目前存在的主要的科學計算方法多基于偏微分方程的數值模擬，並且假設給定的初值和邊界值都是精確給定的。但在自然科學和工程問題中，很多問題都具有不確定的來源和不確定的因素。如何實現不確定的量化是一個非常有意義的研究課題。 本研究課題主要是考察非綫性雙曲型方程問題相關的不確定的量化。隨機性以及方程本身的非綫性使得問題變得非常複雜, 也使得這一研究特別具有理論和程序設計上的挑戰性。

202611.label: Major findings and research outcome
202611.value: Our first work is concerned with initial-boundary value problems of scalar transport equations with uncertain transport velocities. We demonstrated in our earlier works that regularity of exact solutions in the random spaces (or the parametric spaces) can be determined by the given data. In turn, these regularity results are crucial to convergence analysis for high order numerical methods. It is shown that the stochastic Galerkin and collocation methods can achieve spectral convergence under some regularity results or assumptions. As our primary goal is to investigate the errors introduced by discretizations in the random space, the errors for solving the corresponding deterministic problems are neglected at this stage. Our main contribution of this work is to investigate approximating multivariate functions in an unbounded domain by using a discrete least-squares projection with random point evaluations. Particular attention is given to functions with random Gaussian or gamma parameters. We first demonstrate that the traditional Hermite (Laguerre) polynomials chaos expansion suffers from the instability in the sense that an unfeasible number of points, which is relevant to the dimension of the approximation space, is needed to guarantee the stability in the least-squares framework. We then propose to use the Hermite/Laguerre functions (rather than polynomials) as bases in the expansion. The corresponding design points are obtained by mapping the uniformly distributed random points in bounded intervals to the unbounded domain, which involved a mapping parameter L. By using the Hermite/Laguerre functions and a proper mapping parameter, the stability can be significantly improved even if the number of design points scales linearly (up to a logarithmic factor) with the dimension of the approximation space. Apart from the stability, another important issue is the rate of convergence. To speed up the convergence, an effective scaling factor is introduced, and a principle for choosing quasi-optimal scaling factor is discussed. Our third contribution is the application of the deferred correction (DC) method which is a classical method for solving ordinary differential equations; one of its key features is to iteratively use lower order numerical methods so that high order numerical scheme can be obtained. The main advantage of the DC approach is its simplicity and robustness. In this work, the DC idea will be adopted to solve forward backward stochastic differential equations (FBSDEs) which have practical importance in many applications. It is noted that it is difficult to design high order and relatively 'clean' numerical schemes for FBSDEs due to the involvement of randomness and fully coupling of the FSDEs and BSDEs. We describe how to use the simplest Euler method in each DC step -- leading to very simple computational complexity -- to achieve very high order rate of convergence (say, up to order 12). The first two works have been published, and the third one will be submitted for publication within a month.

202611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
202611.value: The methods developed in this project, in particular the discrete least-squares projection with random point evaluations for the unbounded domain problems with uncertainty, may be further developed for solving more applied problems with uncertainty. It is expected that the methods developed in this project can be further used to solve uncertainty quantification involving stochastic differential equations (such as shock dynamics, nonlinear controls etc).

202611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
202611.value: This project is to investigate numerical methods for problems with uncertainty. One typical case is that many random evaluations will produce large size observed data. How can we obtain meaningful approximation polynomials with lower polynomial degree using the large set data? Once a good polynomial is obtained, many useful information like expectation and variance can be easily obtained. Among several possible approaches, the discrete least-squares projection with random point evaluations may be a good choice. However, to design an effective least-squares projection algorithm requires the understanding of several important issues such as the choice of the sample points and curse of dimensionality. It is useful and difficult to fully understand these challenging issues.

202711.label: Project Objectives
202711.value: The first project is to develop bias-corrected methods for the shrinkage-based diagonal discriminant rules (SDLDA/SDQDA). To advance our research goals, we propose to study the followings objectives: (1) to investigate the asymptotic properties of the bias-corrected discriminant score under the squared loss function; (2) to evaluate the performance of the bias-corrected SDLDA/SDQDA via both simulation study and real data analysis; and (3) to conduct a prediction accuracy analysis to validate the optimality of the proposed decision boundary as in Huang et al.
