202711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
202711.value: With the advent of technologies, learning high-throughput complex models is becoming critical in many disciplines. It is known that such high-dimensional data pose challenges to traditional statistics methods and motivate more accurate and powerful statistical methods. In this proposal, the investigators propose to use shrinkage techniques that aim to improve the performance of class prediction in high-dimensional data analysis. Specifically, in this research plan, the following two related projects are going to be investigated: (i) Bias Correction for Shrinkage-based Discriminant Rules; and (ii) Optimal Nearest Shrunken Centroids Method. The proposed research in this proposal is an essential step in the development of shrinkage theory and methods in high-dimensional data analysis. The preliminary studies by the investigators indicate that the proposed methods are both statistically efficient and computationally inexpensive. Finally, we reiterate that the proposed methods have extensive applications and can be applied to data sets from various areas including statistical genetics, epidemiology, ecology, brain imaging, and engineering sciences. 随着新技术的开发，學習複雜的高通量模型在许多學科里已经变得越来越重要。众所周知，用传统统计方法去分析高通量数据将面临着一系列的挑战。在这个研究项目里，研究人员提议使用收縮技術去提高高維數據分析中預測的准确性。具體地說，這項研究計劃将包括以下兩個相关的研究课题：(i) 基於压缩估计分类方法的偏差修正；以及 (ii) 最优化Nearest Shrunken Centroids方法。 這个项目所提出的研究计划是发展和完善高維數據分析中压缩估计理论和方法之不可或缺的一步。初步的研究表明，我们所提出的方法不仅是統計有效的，而且计算也很简洁。最后我們重申，在本研究中所提出的方法将具有非常廣泛的應用。它们可以應用於從統計遺傳學，流行病學，生態學，腦成像技術，以及工程學等各領域搜集来的各种高維數據。

202711.label: Realisation of objectives
202711.value: For the first objective, the investigators have proposed multiple approaches to improve the discriminant analysis for high-dimensional small sample size data. Some major contributions are listed as follows. In Tong, Chen and Zhao (2012), we first proposed a family of shrinkage estimators for the mean value under the quadratic loss function. We then construct a shrinkage-based diagonal discriminant rule using the proposed shrinkage mean. In Pang, Tong and Ng (2013), we proposed a bias correction method for a gene-module-based linear discriminant analysis by utilizing the correlation among genes in discriminant analysis. In Wang, Pan, Tong and Zhu (2014), we first considered the ridge-type shrinkage estimation of the large dimensional precision matrix. The asymptotic optimal shrinkage coefficients and the theoretical loss are derived. Data-driven estimators for the shrinkage coefficients are also conducted based on the asymptotic results from random matrix theory. Finally, we have applied the proposed shrinkage estimator to the linear discriminant analysis (LDA) and investigated its practical performance. In Kai and Tong (2014), we proposed a geometric diagonalization method for regularized discriminant analysis. We also considered the bias correction for our proposed method. In Wan, Liu, Cheung and Tong (2014), we proposed a new learning method, named RankCost, to classify imbalanced medical data without using a priori cost. Instead of focusing on improving the class-prediction accuracy, RankCost is to maximize the difference between the minority class and the majority class by using a scoring function, which translates the imbalanced classification problem into a partial ranking problem. The scoring function is learned via a nonparametric boosting algorithm. For the second objective, to develop an optimal Nearest Shrunken Centroids (NSC) method for class prediction, in Wang, Tong, Zhu and Pang (2014), we proposed a new criterion for shrinkage parameter selection to better evaluate the performance of the NSC method. Using several public microarray data, we illustrated the instability of the cross-validated NSC method and the favorable performance of the proposed NSC method. In particular, it was shown that the new method can be as competitive as other classifiers, and that the ad hoc cross-validated NSC method, which in case of several solutions chooses the one with the smallest number of features, is not always a good choice for classification.

202811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
202811.value: 光動力治療（PDT）是一項新型的治療腫瘤的有效方法， 近年來受到人們越來越多的關注。這種療法的基本要素是光敏劑、可見光和單分子氧。首先，腫瘤細胞組織選擇性攝取光敏劑，然後在適當波長光線局部照射後，光敏劑從基態轉化為激發態，處於激發態的光敏劑分子可以以發射螢光的途徑回到基態，也可以將能量以三重態形式傳遞給氧，生成活性很高的單線態氧，從而導致細胞以及組織的破壞。 在過去的二十年中，卟啉類光敏劑，譬如血卟啉衍生物已經被廣泛應用於光動力臨床治療。最近我們研究組開發出一種能被腫瘤細胞有效吸收的雙功能卟啉-多吡啶釕配合物，在近紅外波長光線照射後，利用藥物的雙光子可見螢光光譜實現分子成像，同時產生單線態氧以達到治療效果。但這類雙功能光動力治療藥物，在被腫瘤細胞攝取後，光線照射所產生的激發能量被引導到兩種不同的途徑:其一用來螢光發射成像，使我們能夠監測藥物在腫瘤細胞中的吸收；其二用來產生單線態氧，導致腫瘤細胞死亡。很明顯，這兩種功能的實現都只能是此消彼長。因此分區激發能量是當前雙功能光動力療法药物設計中的一項重大挑戰。為了解決此問題，我們建議通過設計將各个單獨功能元素融合到同一個卟啉類有機金屬絡合物中，在一個波長照射時， 其中一個元素會發出螢光成像；當另一個波長照射時，另一個元素生成有毒單線態氧。此策略有希望提供我們一個真正雙功能分子腫瘤成像和抗癌光動力療法。 初步研究證實了此設計策略的可行性。第一，我們合成了新的卟啉-釕配合物并證明在兩種不同波長的近紅外鐳射照射下，該藥物的螢光發射和產生單線態氧能相互獨立發生。第二， 釕配合物發光信號沒有造成任何重大的細胞死亡，說明雙功能光動力療法藥物在發光成像時，不會產生任何細胞的殺傷作用。這些初步結果鼓舞我們進一步研究這些分子內部能量轉移途徑，以改善他們的成像和光動力治療作用。光動力治療的靶向特性也是這类雙重功能光動力治療藥物研究重点，以實現最優藥物療效。

202811.label: Major findings and research outcome
202811.value: 1. An amphiphilic water-soluble ytterbium complex which is photo-selective, functional and Golgi apparatus specific has been designed as a responsive dual probe capable of sensitizing emission within the biological window (660 and 750 nm), generating the singlet oxygen (ΦΔ = 0.45) and triggering local cell damage only upon exposure to visible and near-infrared laser excitation. (Chemical Communications, 2012, 48, 9646-9648) 2. A water-soluble, mitochondria-permeable erbium(III) complex has been designed as a responsive bi-functional probe. This may be used to induce the mild formation of singlet oxygen (ΦΔ = 0.10) and causes local damage in cellulo when exposed to UV and near-infrared laser excitation. (RSC Advances, 2013, 3, 382-385) 3. Based on a donor-acceptor framework, several conjugates have been designed and prepared in which an electron-donor moiety, ytterbium(III) porphyrinate (YbPor), was linked through an ethynyl bridge to an electron-acceptor moiety, boron dipyrromethene (BODIPY). Photoluminescence studies demonstrated efficient energy transfer from the BODIPY moiety to the YbPor counterpart. When conjugated with the YbPor moiety, the BODIPY moiety served as an antenna to harvest the lower-energy visible light, subsequently transferring its energy to the YbPor counterpart, and, consequently, sensitizing the Yb-III emission in the near-infrared (NIR) region with a quantum efficiency of up to 0.73% and a lifetime of around 40 mu s. Moreover, these conjugates exhibited large two-photon-absorption cross-sections that ranged from 1048-2226 GM and strong two-photon-induced NIR emission . (Chemistry-A European Journal, 2013, 19, 738-747) 4. The new amphiphilic BODPY-porphyrin conjugate BZnPP and its precursor BZnPH were synthesised, and their linear and two-photon photophysical properties, together with their cellular uptake and photo-cytotoxicity, were studied. This amphiphilic conjugate consists of a hydrophobic BODIPY moiety and a hydrophilic tetra(ethylene glycol) chain bridging a cationic triphenylphosphonium group to an amphiphilic porphyrin ZnP through acetylide linkers at its meso positions. A large two-photon absorption cross-section (σ=1725 GM) and a high singlet oxygen quantum yield (0.52) were recorded. Intense linear- and two-photon-induced red emissions were also observed for both BZnPP and BZnPH. Further in vitro studies showed that BZnPP exhibited very efficient cellular uptake and strong photocytotoxic but weak dark cytotoxic properties towards human breast carcinoma MCF-7 cells. In summary, the two-photon-induced emission and the potent photo-cytotoxicity of BZnPP make it an efficacious dual-purpose tumour-imaging and photodynamic therapeutic agent in the tissue-transparent spectral windows. (ChemBioChem, 2015, DOI: 10.1002/cbic.201500349)

202811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
202811.value: The work in this proposal provided a concrete platform for the further development of organometallic lanthanide compounds in photodynamic therapy for anti-cancer treatment by designing and synthesizing various functional group on porphyrin with specific in vitro subcellular localization and also with the 1O2 generation. It is hoped that the results could aid in advancing these compounds from research use into practical use, such as preclinical trails. Nonetheless, our results showed that there is still room for improvement, such as enhancing the cancer selectivity, water solubility and singlet oxygen generation quantum efficiency to expand the photodynamic therapy practically to new fronts, which could be achieved by chemical syntheses and knowledge in chemical biology, before springing to next step - multi-modal lanthanide complexes for cancer specific photodynamic therapy and molecular imaging, such as PET and Magnetic resonance imaging.

202811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
202811.value: The major drawback of conventional photodynamic therapy (PDT) arises from adverse in-vitro/in-vivo reactions engendered by the variation in physiological conditions and notched distribution of singlet oxygen (1O2), a species well-known to be the major cytotoxic agent responsible for photobiological activities. Porphyrin is one of the most promising PDT agents with high 1O2 yield but its non-specific function may harm the normal cells during the treatment. In this project, we have been developed multi-modal lanthanide-porphyrin PDT agents that are capable of killing the tumor cells via 1O2 from porphyrin moiety and affording the fluorescence imaging by deep penetration excitation source simultaneously. In the long term, we envision the use of these synthesized in-vitro imaging PDT drugs incorporated with different vectors to enhance their target specificity in clinical practice. We purpose to systematically develop several lanthanide complexes as fast responsive biomedical probes for targeting and monitoring the disease and in addition, delivering the drug in-vitro, in-situ and in-vivo with a combination of biochemical, molecular and structural approaches.

203011.label: Project Objectives
203011.value: To design, synthesize and characterize novel series of thiocyanate-free metal-organic complexes consisting of different transition metals that can effectively function as assembling components in molecular arrays for the conversion of solar energy into electricity; To study their spectroscopic, redox, thermal, structural, photochemical, photophysical (including excited-state chemistry, photoinduced energy and electron transfer processes, time-resolved luminescence and transient absorption spectroscopy) and photoelectrical properties; To scrutinize the correlation between the molecular structure and physical properties of these metal complexes to their photovoltaic performance; To evaluate their photosensitization and light-harvesting abilities as well as energy-generating applications in various nanostructured (i.e. nanocrystalline and nanowire) dye-sensitized solar cell (DSSC) settings.
rows: To design, synthesize and characterize novel series of thiocyanate-free metal-organic complexes consisting of different transition metals that can effectively function as assembling components in molecular arrays for the conversion of solar energy into electricity;

To study their spectroscopic, redox, thermal, structural, photochemical, photophysical (including excited-state chemistry, photoinduced energy and electron transfer processes, time-resolved luminescence and transient absorption spectroscopy) and photoelectrical properties;
To scrutinize the correlation between the molecular structure and physical properties of these metal complexes to their photovoltaic performance;

To evaluate their photosensitization and light-harvesting abilities as well as energy-generating applications in various nanostructured (i.e. nanocrystalline and nanowire) dye-sensitized solar cell (DSSC) settings.

203011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
203011.value: The area of sustainable energy is a hot topic in the 21st century. As the most abundant, renewable and clean energy source on the Earth, solar energy is one of the best candidates for solving the worldwide energy crisis. Owing to their versatility, low cost and ease of fabrication of foldable and flexible large-area solar-energy conversion devices, dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs) have received surging academic and industrial attention as potential candidates for the future photovoltaic market. Since the seminal breakthrough by Grätzel and co-workers, ruthenium(II)-based photosensitizers become the benchmark for DSSCs. However, the thiocyanate ligands incorporated in most of these Ru(II) photosensitizers tend to render the sensitizers unstable under excessive thermal stress and/or light soaking. To commercialize DSSCs, both long term stability and efficiency should be further improved. Herein, we propose to design and develop a new suite of thiocyanate-free Ru(II) photosensitizers together with some non-classical organometallic dye molecules of Ir(III) and Pt(II) that would offer a good avenue towards fabricating high-efficiency and durable DSSCs. These metal-organic dyes will be studied in the appropriate nanostructured (nanocrystalline and nanowire) DSSC settings with both liquid-electrolyte and solid-state cells. With our strengths in synthetic chemistry, optimization of the dye component of the solar cell will be garnered through systematic variation of the ligands, metal, and other substituent groups in these metal complexes. The present work will fill in an innovative area of energy science and also provide a new impetus to the production of some robust metal-based photosensitizers with higher molar extinction coefficients and more red-shifted absorption bands relative to the benchmark compounds. While the development of DSSC dyes that can harvest solar radiation over a broad spectral range has yet proven difficult, molecular cosensitization approach using multiple dyes with complementary absorption properties is an emerging method to obtain panchromatic absorption, and should lead to higher energy-conversion efficiencies. Furthermore, high-efficiency DSSCs typically operate as dye-sensitized photoanodes (n-DSSCs), where photocurrents result from dye-sensitized electron injection into n-type semiconductors. Dye-sensitized photocathodes (p-DSSCs) perform the function in an inverse mode, where excitation of dye is followed by rapid electron transfer from a p-type semiconductor to the dye. It is therefore desirable to develop highly efficient p-n tandem DSSCs based on some of our good n-type metal-organic dyes. This new combination of both photoactive electrodes in a tandem cell will significantly improve the overall device performance.

203011.label: Realisation of objectives
203011.value: Owing to their versatility, low cost and ease of fabrication of flexible large-area solar-energy conversion devices, dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs) have received surging academic and industrial attention as potential candidates for the future photovoltaic market. Most of the good DSSC chromophores in the literature are Ru-polypyridyl complexes. However, the thiocyanate ligands incorporated in most of these Ru(II) photosensitizers tend to render the photosensitizers unstable under excessive thermal stress and/or light soaking. To commercialize DSSCs, both long term stability and efficiency should be further improved. To our knowledge, the use of thiocyanate-free metal complexes for high-performance DSSCs is yet very scarce in the literature. A new suite of thiocyanate-free Ru(II) photosensitizers together with some non-classical metal-organic dye molecules of Pt(II) and Zn(II) were designed and developed in this project that would offer a good avenue towards fabricating high-efficiency and durable DSSCs. Some relevant organic dyes were also studied in order to extend the systems to other metal-organic systems in the further studies. The spectroscopic, photophysical, redox, thermal and structural properties of the new molecular dyes were studied in details and the results were also compared with those obtained by the computational method. The structure-activity relationships of these molecules have also been investigated. These metal-organic dyes were studied in the appropriate nanostructured DSSC settings and the device performances were correlated to those of the Ru(II)-thiocyanate dyes and purely organic counterparts. With our strengths in synthetic chemistry, optimization of the dye component of the solar cell were garnered through systematic variation of the ligands, metal, and other substituent groups in these metal complexes. The present work will fill in an innovative area of energy science and also provide a new impetus to the production of some robust metal-based photosensitizers with higher molar extinction coefficients and more red-shifted absorption bands relative to the benchmark dyes. While the development of DSSC dyes that can harvest solar radiation over a broad spectral range has yet proven difficult, molecular co-sensitization approach using multiple dyes with complementary absorption properties was also used to obtain panchromatic absorption, leading to higher energy-conversion efficiencies of up to 8.89% for efficient panchromatic light harvesting. As far as the GRF proposal is concerned, the PI considers that we have addressed in full all the issues relevant to the revised objectives, even though the budget funded is less than that in the original proposal.

203011.label: Major findings and research outcome
203011.value: New unsymmetric platinum(II) bis(aryleneethynylene) derivatives were synthesized which showed good light-harvesting capabilities for application as photosensitizers in dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs). The absorption spectra, electrochemistry, time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT), impedance spectroscopy and photovoltaic properties of these platinum(II)-based sensitizers have been fully characterized. The incorporation of a strongly electron-donating group significantly enhances the absorption abilities of the complexes. The best PCE up to 5.78% was achieved (papers 1, 8). These findings suggest that platinum-acetylide small molecules have great potential for use as effective photosensitizers in DSSC applications. We also report efficient panchromatic light harvesting by co-adsorption of a metalloporphyrin molecule and N719 in DSSCs. The co-sensitized device shows a considerably enhanced PCE of 8.89%. The porphyrin-sensitized device shows strong photocurrent generation in the Soret and Q bands, while N719 shows efficient spectral response in the 500-600 nm range, thus displaying a full-color response (paper 9). Some organic dyes containing different electron donor moieties were synthesized, characterized and applied in DSSCs. The effects of electron-donating moieties of the organic dyes on their photophysical, electrochemical, and photovoltaic properties were investigated in details (papers 2-6) The best PCE of 8.18%, which exceeds the reference N719 (7.73%) under identical fabrication conditions, can be achieved (Paper 5). New di-anchoring organic dyes were prepared and characterized. This molecular design can significantly enhance the PCE significantly (up to 6.11%) due to inhibition of the undesirable charge recombination and prolonged electron lifetime. These findings open up a new avenue to developing organic dyes for highly efficient DSSCs (paper 11). New thiocyanate-free ruthenium(II) complexes based on various cyclometalating ligands were synthesized and applied in DSSCs. Their photophysical, electrochemical, thermal and photovoltaic properties have been investigated and the experimental results can be correlated well with the computational results obtained by TD-DFT calculations (Papers 7, 10). Another series of electron-rich Ru(II)-based photosensitizers have also been synthesized. With careful chemical tuning, maximum IPCE of 93.6% and PCE of 5.95% were obtained with a co-sensitized DSSC setting. It is only about 12% lower in efficiency than N719. A stability test of the devices was also conducted (paper 12). We have also developed a new cyclometalated iridium(III) complex for time-resolved luminescent spectroscopy and the approach can be introduced to design other related iridium(III) dyes for DSSCs in the future (paper 13). The PI was invited to contribute a review article in J. Organomet. Chem. (50th anniversary issue) on organometallics dyes for optoelectronic applications (paper 14).

203011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
203011.value: The following areas of research work can be further developed in the future: (1) There is room for performance improvement by extending the system to other transition metals. (2) The work can be further extended to other metalated systems by coordination of bithiazole ring or other organic chromophores to transition metals. (3) Further improvement in the device efficiency can be achieved by tuning the intramolecular charge-transfer absorption and energy levels of this type of small-molecule metal-organic materials.

203011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
203011.value: Dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs) have emerged as a promising alternative to silicon solar cells for harnessing the solar energy because of their high light-to-electricity conversion efficiencies, ease of processing and fabrication, and low costs. They represent a safe bet for the future in solving the impending worldwide energy crisis. One of the key elements of DSSCs is the dye sensitizer, which engages in both the light absorption process and the charge separation process. Transition-metal photosensitizers has received much attention, although organic dyes are catching up in conversion efficiency. While Ru(II)-polypyridyls are still at the forefront of this research, the thiocyanate ligands present are believed to provide the weakest dative bonding, making the photosensitizers unstable under excessive thermal stress and/or light soaking. To commercialize DSSCs, both long-term stability and efficiency should be improved. To address this key issue, we have developed a series of thiocyanate-free metal-organic dyes. Optimization of the dye was garnered through variation of the ligands, metal and substituent groups. This work provides new robust metal-based photosensitizers with higher molar extinction coefficients and red-shifted absorption bands relative to benchmark dyes. It also enables the elucidation of structure-property relationships desirable for the new design and improved performance of future materials.

203311.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
203311.value: Many applications arising in various fields can be modeled into such a separable convex programming problem whose objective function is formed as a sum of m individual functions without crossed variables. The special case with m=2 has been well studied in the literature, while the research for the general case with m>=3 is in complete infancy. The classical augmented Lagrangian method (ALM) is obviously applicable for this separable convex programming problem. But, the direct application of ALM treats such a well-structured model as a generic convex programming without any consideration of the particular separable structure, and thus ignores completely the nice separable structure which might be very beneficial for algorithmic design. Realizing the fact that each function component might be simple for many concrete applications of this model, the idea stimulating this project is to decompose the iterative subroutine generated by ALM into finitely many easier and smaller subproblems, with the purpose of exploring the favorable structure of the involved function components individually. Some augmented-Lagrangian-based splitting methods for separable convex programming are thus proposed. The principles of designing these new algorithms are fully structure-exploiting, easily implementable and numerically efficient. 很多应用问题都可以归结为这样一个可分离凸规划模型，即其目标函数是m个没有交叉变量的函数分量之和。现有文献对于m=2的情形有诸多讨论，但是对于m>3的情况研究结果并不多。经典的增广拉格朗日方法显然可以用来求解这样的模型。如果我们直接使用增广拉格朗日方法，那么我们关心的可分离模型将被当成一个一般的凸规划模型，其本身可以为算法设计带来诸多益处的可分离结构将被完全忽略。具体的应用问题当中，目标函数里出现的函数分量常常具有一些简单的结构。受此启发，本项目在算法设计中，将把增广拉格朗日方法产生的子问题进行分裂，使得这些函数分量具有的简单结构可以得到充分利用。由此，我们提出一系列基于增广拉格朗日方法的分裂算法来求解可分离凸规划。我们设计算法的原则是问题本身的结构要得到充分利用、算法实现要简单、以及数值效果要好。

203311.label: Major findings and research outcome
203311.value: As expected, we have designed a series of splitting methods for solving separable convex programming models. These algorithms are based on the technique of splitting the classical augmented Lagrangian method, in which the subproblems could be splitted either sequentially or in parallel. A major finding is that we have understood the basic philosophy of algorithmic design for developing such a splitting algorithm in the context of separable convex programming with linear constraints. Another finding is the fundamental theoretical framework for analyzing the convergence for this series of algorithms. The outcome of this project includes 21 research papers, most of which are on flagship journals, and some very interesting ideas to carry on deeper research in the future.

203311.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
203311.value: The results obtained in this project give us a comprehensive understanding on the mechanism of how to design an efficient splitting method with provable convergence, by using the very classical augmented Lagrangian method in the context of separable convex programming problems with linear constraints. To some extent, these results are the foundation of a pretty new research topic and they have inspired us to think some deeper topics such as how to extend the analysis in this project to more challenging settings like stochastic or nonconvex scenarios, which will be potentially our research topics in the future.

203311.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
203311.value: This project has been intensively focused on developing splitting algorithms for linearly constrained separable convex programming problems whose objective functions may have more than two functions, which indeed becomes a very hot topic in optimization. The core technique is further splitting the subproblems of the classical augmented Lagrangian method and thus obtaining easier subproblems which can take full advantages of the objective functions' properties. The results obtained in this project are indeed the first comprehensive study on how to design an efficient algorithm based on the augmented Lagrangian method for a separable convex programming model. The new algorithms have been widely used for a wide range of applications in various areas such image processing, statistical learning, computer vision and so on. Our philosophy in algorithmic design is widely used by some peers. Our theoretical analysis tools developed in this project turn out to be valuable for analyzing convergence for some other methods of the same or similar kind. We believe the results obtained in this project will continue to find more applications in the community.

210811.label: Project Title(Chinese)
210811.value: 隱私意識下的外包和雲數據庫查詢認證

210811.label: Co - Investigator(s)
210811.value: Prof Choi, Byron Koon-kau Prof Xu, Jianliang

210811.label: Project Objectives
210811.value: To formalize the privacy-conscious query authentication problem, and propose a general solution paradigm. To design authentication building blocks, data structures, and protocols for both relational and multi-dimensional spatial datasets. 210811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
210811.value: Data outsourcing and database-as-a-service (DaaS) have been gaining tremendous popularity over the recent years, and are forecasted to experience another boom with emerging cloud database solutions from Amazon SimpleDB, Google BigTable, Oracle via AWS, Microsoft SQL Azure. However, delegating data and service to a third party always inherits security harassment. Besides losing data security, the compromised server also puts the querying client in jeopardy – the compromised server may tamper the answer and mislead the client. To address this, the research community proposed a stream of solutions, collectively called query authentication. In these solutions, the data owner publishes not only the data, but also signed endorsements of all data being published. Given a query, the querying client should receive both the query results and a verification proof that can be used to reconstruct the endorsements and thus verify the correctness of results. All existing works in the literature assume that during the verification process, the client can always be trusted and entitled to receive data values on the querying attribute(s). However, this severely jeopardizes the privacy of the data owner. For example, an Employees table contains a sensitive field “salary” whose values should be hidden from the client. The data owner grants the “selection”, but not the “projection” privilege of this field. Thus, the client can query the relationship between age and salary as in “SELECT age FROM Employees WHERE salary > $40000 and salary < $80000” without knowing the salary of any employee. However, with query authentication in effect, this privacy no longer holds as existing methods require the server to disclose to the client some “salary” values. In this project, we study the new authentication problem arising in the above privacy-conscious query model where the querying attribute(s) are unavailable to the client. This model reflects the reality of business where data are either private assets of the owner or concern third-party privacy as in the above example. While this model invalidates existing authentication methods, it brings us opportunities to explore query authentication from a whole new angle. We will comprehensively design new data structures and protocols for a variety of data types and query types. For real-time and interactive queries, we will also seek new mechanism that trades authenticity for efficiency. We believe this project will benefit the research community, the outsourcing database industry, and Hong Kong society who shows strong concerns in recent privacy incidents. 數據庫外包和"數據即服務"在近年得到廣泛的應用。隨著各大雲服務商如亞馬遜，谷歌，甲骨文和微軟加入競爭行列，該領域將有望進入新一輪快速增長期。然而，將數據和服務授權給第三方會面臨安全上的困擾——除了數據隱私之外，被攻破的服務商甚至會給查詢客戶提供錯誤結果，以致造成危險。在數據庫研究領域，學者們提出了查詢認證的機制——數據擁有者不僅將數據發布給外包服務商，也同時將保證數據正確性的背書通過數字簽名的方式一同發布。對於每一個查詢，查詢客戶可以得到用以核實該查詢結果的信息來驗證結果的正確性。 然而目前的認證技術要求在認證過程中永遠信任查詢客戶，以提供足夠多的信息供其驗證。這樣在很多場合會侵犯數據擁有者的隱私。例如，一張職員數據表包含敏感數據項"薪金"，查詢結果中本不應顯示該項目。查詢客戶可以在不侵犯隱私的情況下做這樣的查詢——"查找所有薪金在40000到80000間的職員名"。然而，如果需要認證該結果，目前的技術要求向查詢客戶提供薪金數據，因而這樣的查詢便無法實現。 在這個研究項目中，我們將研究這一課題，即如何在隱私意識下的外包和雲數據庫中進行查詢認證。我們認為這個查詢服務模型值得研究，因為它將會成為主流的外包數據庫服務應用模型。我們將全面地研究可以應用於這個新模型的查詢認證機制和數據結構，設計並實現針對不同數據和查詢類型的協議。我們希望這一研究能為學術界，數據庫外包業界和香港社會帶來啟示和貢獻。

To design authentication building blocks, data structures, and protocols for both relational and multi-dimensional spatial datasets.

210811.label: Major findings and research outcome
210811.value: Our first finding is a well-formed definition of privacy-preserving query authentication. We have shown in our papers that providing integrity and confidentiality for both the data owner and query client are not only feasible but also indispensable in many real-life applications. As part of the rigorous definition, we also present a formal security model that is compatible to this authentication problem. Our second finding is some cryptography building blocks and data structures that can be reused for authentication for various query types. These building blocks include our custom-designed g() function, private distance/binary comparison protocols, and oblivious transfer-based secret exchange protocols. Our third finding is a comprehensive set of authentication protocols for a variety of classic query types. The query types include range, kNN, top-k, skyline, and aggregation queries in both relational and multi-dimensional settings. These protocols, based on a hybrid of standard cryptography techniques and database tools, can be used for large-scale heterogeneous outsourced databases that are frequently used in practice. Our last finding is a set of heuristics that are orthogonal to authentication protocols and can trade authenticity for efficiency. By aiming at different levels of authenticity, we can fine tune the efficiency settings so that real-time and interactive authentication schemes become possible.

210811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
210811.value: As for further development, we plan to further enhance our prototype system for demonstration and knowledge transfer. We believe that the promotion of this prototype system will further make an impact in both research and industry community regarding our privacy-preserving authentication on outsourced database.

210811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
210811.value: With the increasing popularity of data outsourcing and database-as-a-service (DaaS), we will witness emerging security issues arising from data owners delegating their data and service to a third party. In particular, malicious or compromised outsourced server can tamper the data or query answer and thus mislead or even jeopardize the querying client. In this research project, we have studied how to authenticate that the outsourced database faithfully stores and executes all query services, without compromising the privacy of data owners. This work of art gives both research and industry community the fundamental understanding of problems of this kind. Furthermore, it offers comprehensive solutions that integrate both cryptography and database techniques for classic query types in data outsourcing. We believe our work will relieve the data owner from being reluctant to outsourcing it's private data assets and therefore pave the way of next generation computing paradigm.

211911.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
211911.value: Poisson noise removal is a very challenging problem since this kind of noise may contaminate images in a totally different way from additive noise. This research proposal is focused on the development of image restoration models for Poisson noise removal and deblurring. The importance of Poisson noise mainly comes from the fact that this kind noise can be commonly found in many real word image processing applications such as microscope images and medical images. Unlike additive noises, these noises are much more difficult to be removed from the corrupted image due to the fact that their statistical distributions are signal dependant. In this proposal, we devote to variational approaches based on the theory of image restoration, optimization and statistics. Indeed, We will first examine a fast method for a classical variational model revoked by Poisson noise and blurring. And then we derive a new variational method for Poisson noise removal and blurring. The main contribution here is that the variation principle and sparse representation for image processing are seamlessly combined together for possion noise removal and blurring. In addition, efficient method is also devised to effectively solve the proposed model. We then turn to extending the previous results to other types of noise such as impulse noise and multiplicative noise. Finally, we study the non-blind deconvultion problem under Poisson noise. 泊松噪音泊松噪音的去除非常具有挑戰性，因為該噪音以完全不同於加性噪音的形式損壞圖像。本研究計劃集中於泊松噪音環境下的去噪和去模糊。泊松噪音的重要性在於它廣泛的存在於生物醫學等現實的圖像處理應用中。和加性噪音不同，該噪音號性質信號依賴，非常難以去除。本計劃致力於基於圖像恢復，最優化和統計等方法的變分法研究。我們首先考泊松噪音下的經典模型的快速算法。接下來我們引導出一個新的去泊松噪音和模糊的變分模型。這裡我們的主要貢獻將是變分模型和圖像處理稀釋表示的無縫結合。我們進一步考慮此模型的快速算法。然後，我們當前計劃將前述結果推廣到沖量和乘性等其他類型噪音。最後，我們考慮盲去模糊問題。

We will first examine fast method to deal with the varitional model revoked by Poission noise. In particular, we are interested in Arrow-Hurwitz scheme.
We then derive a new variatonal model with dictionary for blurred image with Poisson noise and study how to effectively solve it.
The above works are then extended to other noises.
Finally, we study the blind deconvultion problem under Poisson noise.

211911.label: Major findings and research outcome
211911.value: 1. A Two-stage Image Segmentation Method using a Convex Variant of the Mumford-Shah Model and Thresholding. Experimental results show that our method performs better than many standard two-phase or multiphase segmentation methods. 2. A Dictionary learning approach for Poisson image deblurring. Extensive experimental results suggest that the proposed algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art methods. 3. A Convex Variational Model for Restoring Blurred Images with Multiplicative Noise. Based on the statistical property of the noise, a quadratic penalty function technique is utilized to obtain a strictly convex model under a mild condition. 4. A Sparse Representation Prior and Total Variation--Based Image Deblurring Under Impulse Noise. The numerical experiments clearly demonstrate the super performance of the proposed methods 5. A Total Variation Structured Total Least Squares Method for Image Restoration Numerical examples are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model and the efficiency of the numerical scheme. 6. A Two-Step Approach for the Restoration of Images Corrupted by Multiplicative. Experimental results show that the proposed two-step approach performs better than the existing methods for restoring images with multiplicative noise and blurring. 7. A Two-Stage Image Segmentation Method for Blurry Images with Poisson or Multiplicative Gamma Noise. Experimental results show that our two-stage method performs better than many standard methods. 8. Method of Reducing Artifact in JPEG Decompression via a Learned Dictionary. Numerical experiments are performed to demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the total variation and weighted total variation decompression methods. 9. A Single Image Dehazing and Denoising: A Fast Variational Approach. A numerical procedure based on the Chambolle-Pock algorithm is given, and the convergence of the algorithm is ensured. Extensive experimental results on real scenes demonstrate that our method can restore vivid and contrastive haze and noise-free images effectively. 10. A Universal Variational Framework for Sparsity Based Image Inpainting. The numerical experiments on various image inpainting tasks, such as scratch and text removal, randomly missing pixel filling, and block completion, clearly demonstrate the super performance of the proposed methods. Furthermore, the theoretical convergence of the proposed algorithms is proved. 11. A Convex Variational Model for Restoring Blurred Images with Large Rician Noise. Numerical results are presented to demonstrate that our model outperforms the state-of-the-art models in both medical and natural images. 12. A Weighted Difference of Anisotropic and Isotropic Total Variation Model for Image Processing. In numerical experiments on image denoising, deblurring and reconstruction, our method improves on the classical TV model consistently and is on par with representative state-of-the-art methods.

211911.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
211911.value: Poisson noise removal is extremely important in the domain of applied mathematics as it contaminates images in a different way from additive noise. Our research project has been centered on the development of image recovery models under Poisson noise. Indeed it is commonly found in many real word image processing applications, such as laser images, microscope images, medical ultrasonic images. In this project, we have considered variational approaches based on the theory of image restoration, optimization and statistics to handle the Poisson noise removal problems. Many important issues have been carefully studied for Poisson and other noise removal problems. Beside the academic value, our research project also has an important impact on real life applications such as remote sensing, medical imaging and so on.

212111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
212111.value: 基因調控網絡方法（GRN）是生物系統的轉錄調控進行建模的有效方法，是當前計算生物學和系統生物學的一個研究重點。 根據問題的性質和數據的可用性，GRN建模可以採用靜態或者動態方法。 靜態方法通常基於使用相關性或者互信息來建立一個基因調控的平均模型。靜態方法的計算複雜度比較低，因此在大數據情況下比較高效，而且該方法對於小量數據仍然可以得到有意義的結果。但是靜態方法的缺點在於它無法描述動態機制。而動態方法，是基於時間序列（時變）數據對動態基因調控進行建模的方法。然而目前的動態方法卻無法對大多數人類疾病（比如癌症）的發展過程進行建模。主要是因為動態方法必須使用多點密集的時變數據，然而基於醫療上的原因密集地採集病人樣本是不現實的。 因此我們提出一種新的分期動態的方法，旨在突破時變數據的限制，從而重構癌發展過程的動態基因調控關係。我們的方法建立在這樣一個事實的基礎之上：當前幾乎所有的公開數據庫中的癌症樣本都包含癌症分期的信息，而癌症分期可以看作癌症發展程度的一個標準而又穩定的指標。根據癌症分期信息，我們可以將不同數據庫中的癌症樣本組合成描述癌症發展過程的樣本集。進而據此建立癌症發展過程的基因調控網絡模型。 我們的分期動態調控模型方法基於三個基本假設：1）期內定速假設：每個分期內的基因表達變化速率固定；2）連續性假設：期內期間的基因表達是連續的；3）獨立等分佈假設：假定癌症樣本在每個分期內為獨立等間隔採樣（i.i.d）。據此推出的分期動態模型將由多個分期相連的調控網絡組成。與其他的調控網絡類似，網絡節點表示調控子或者目標基因，鏈接表示調控方向，鏈接權重表示調控強度。 本項目中，建模的過程包括確定一組調控子以及優化網絡鏈接。調控子（包括轉錄因子和局部調控迴路）初步根據相關性或者互信息來確定，並在網絡優化過程中作適當調整。模型優化採用重複取樣的自舉擬合（Bootstrapping）策略選取樣本組合，使用最小絕對縮減和變量選擇算子（LASSO）進行建模以控制網絡複雜度和稀疏性，從而防止過學習問題。 本項目中的創新點主要包括以下幾個方面：1）首次提出分期動態網絡方法，對癌發展過程中的基因調控進行建模，從而突破了傳統動態（時變）網絡必須使用時變數據的限制；2）採用期內定速假設而不是傳統的穩定態假設。實際上定速假設是比穩定態假設更一般的假設：當速率為零時兩者等價。採用期內定速假設使更為靈活的模型形式成為可能；3）採用連續性假設，從而可以將多個網絡相鄰連接而成一個整體模型。而一般的（期內）平均模型只能得到多個相互沒有聯繫的模型。

212111.label: Realisation of objectives
212111.value: To achieve the first objective, we have collected datasets from the publically available platform Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO). So far we have managed to collect and organize 12 datasets. We organized the data and corresponding information into a home-made database. Currently our database includes gene profiling data on 2285 human lung tissues samples including normal and NSCLC samples. To realize the second objective, we have conduct research works on following aspects: Theoretical improvement and reformulation on the proposed theory; Algorithm for network reconstruction based on our theory; Performance assessment with a simulation platform; And validation with a real-world example. To realize the third objective, we have evaluated the performance of different algorithms of dataset normalization, and performance of network reconstruction. For data normalization, we have compared Quantile normalization (QN) and distance weighted discrimination (DWD) based on four existing datasets acquired from different centers. We found the mixing effect of DWD and QN are close, while QN is a bit better. In addition to the mixing effect, we also measure the distortion level using the indicator of inconsistency correction. Larger negative value of inconsistency correction (IC) stands for smaller distortion. Again we found DWD and QN perform quite close, and QN is slightly better. To validate the performance of network reconstruction, we constructed four in silico networks to simulate the regulatory behaviors of six genes during four consecutive stages of a continuous process. Simulation results show that the overall AUC is 0.75, suggesting a good predictive ability of our method. The p value of Z-test is 0.0065, meaning the network inference was significantly different from random guesses. Also the overall MCC value is much greater than 0, which also suggest the network prediction is significant. To realize the fourth objective, we have developed and validated the stage-varying gene regulatory networks for the progression process of NSCLC. The reconstructed networks showed significant enrichments for all five stages of disease progression. The highest enrichment ratio was accomplished at network connectivity of 0.01, in which around half of the network connections were known existing interactions.

212111.label: Major findings and research outcome
212111.value: In this project we developed a linear-dynamic cascaded (LDC) method to reconstruct dynamic gene networks from the sample-based transcriptional data. Simulation study shows that our method can significantly improve the performance of network inference comparing to static approaches. We applied our method to reconstruct dynamic gene networks of hepatocellular carcinoma progression (HCC). The derived networks can clearly characterize the dynamical patterns of HCC progression, which were verified by the functional analysis and network enrichment analysis. According to the derived networks, we have following findings: In the normal stage of disease, the hub genes and key modules are mostly related to regular activities of cell cycle regulation. In the cirrhotic stage of cancer, a new hub gene TGFB1 became active. The upregulation of TGFB1 can inhibit the secretin and activity of many cytokines and various interleukins and decrease the expression levels of cytokine receptors to down-regulate the activity of immune cell. Moreover, the reconstructed connection from ABL1 to TGFB1 is consistent with previous report that virus-induced Abl kinase permit the coxsackievirus entry through epithelial tight junctions. In the dysplastic stage, cell cycle modules remain to be active. Besides, new modules of CDK2 and CDK4 become active. It was reported that the activation of CDK2 and CDK4 can only happen in cells expressing full-length HCV (HCR6-Rz) RNA passaged after 44 days. We found the pathways of CDKN1A-CDK2-E2F4-RBL1 and CDKN2A-CDK2-E2F5 become active. In early cancer stage, the module of EP300, HDAC1, HDAC2, TFDP2 and E2F3 become active. It was recently reported that HDAC inhibitors and EP300 are directly responsible for the up-regulation of microRNA-24 (miR-224), which is one of the most commonly up-regulated microRNAs in HCC. Meanwhile, the up-regulations of TDDP2 and E2F3 in HCC have also been confirmed. Besides, in the module of PCNA, CDC6 and CDKN2A, connections are mostly known molecular interactions. In the advanced stage, the dominant gene is CDKN1A, by which the induced protein p21 is a potent Cyclin-dependent kinase (cdk) inhibitor. The expression of CKDN1A is tightly controlled by the tumor suppressor protein p53, through which p21 mediates the p53-dependent cell cycle G1 phase arrest in response to a variety of stress stimuli. It can be found in the network that CDKN1A/p21 inhibits EP300, HDAC1 and HDAC2, thereby down-regulates the expression of microRNA-24. Meanwhile, CDKN1A/p21 also inhibits CCNE and CCNA.

212111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
212111.value: The current scheme of reconstructing gene regulatory networks is facing a dilemma situation when studying the bio-medical problems. On the one hand, static approaches cannot exploit and describe the dynamical patterns of an evolving process. On the other hand, dynamical approaches can describe the dynamical behaviours while requiring the time-course data, which is normally not available in many bio-medical studies. In this project, we introduced a linear-dynamic cascaded (LDC) method to reconstruct dynamic gene networks from the sample-based transcriptional data. Our method is based on the intra-stage steady-rate assumption and the continuity assumption, which can properly characterize the dynamical and continuous nature of gene transcription in a biological process. Simulation and real-world applications showed that our method can significantly improve the performance of network inference comparing to static approaches. Our approach can be potentially applied to various types of cancer to identify significant gene regulatory pathways during cancer progression process. Recently, massive biological data that can reflect various aspects of the biological processes have been obtained, such as Chip-seq, RNA-seq, DNA methylation, 3D structure data, etc. One thing can be done based our method is to integrate multiple sources of data to identify more interesting gene regulatory pathways.

212111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
212111.value: We developed a stage-varying approach in order to reconstruct the dynamic gene regulatory networks using sample-based gene expression data. Our approach is motivated by the fact that most of gene profiles of cancer are associated with cancer stages, according to which it is possible to align the data from different centers to form a stage-course data. Our stage-varying model is composed of a series of cascaded networks of different cancer stages. Similar to other GRNs, the node denotes the regulator or target, the edge represents the regulatory direction, and the connection parameter stands for the regulatory strength. Development of the model includes identification of regulators and optimization of network connections. The regulators are initially identified by using correlation or mutual information. The optimization of the model employs LASSO (least absolute shrinkage and selection operator) together with bootstrapping strategy in order to control the flexibility and sparseness of the model and to prevent overfitting during the training process. Simulation showed that our method can significantly improve the performance of network inference comparing to static approaches. Real-world application of our method on cancer progression identified many known regulatory pathways and novel pathways, which can be used as hypothesis for further experimental studies.

240111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
240111.value: Following the outbreak of the Second World War two official film units: the Crown and Colonial Film Units, were established within the United Kingdom. Following this, official film units were then set up within the various British colonies, beginning with the New Zealand Film Unit in 1940, and ending with the inauguration of the Hong Kong Film Unit, as late as 1958. Up to 1953-5, when they were both closed down, the Crown and Colonial Film Units directly influenced the development of official film-making throughout the British colonies; and, after 1955, that influence still continued more obliquely, as film-makers moved from these British-based film units in order to find work, and make films, in the colonies. The principal remit of the colonial film units was of course to reinforce colonial jusrisdiction. However, because they were often staffed by personnel from outside of the traditional British civil service: in other words, by ‘film-makers’; their eventual output often went beyond such remit, in a variety of significant, and, so far, often under-researched ways. The period between 1940 and 1970 was, therefore the period of the British colonial film units. These units first emerged against the context of world war in 1940, and expired one by one up to 1970, when the introduction of television into colonies such as Hong Kong made them largely redundant. The research project proposed here will focus on official film-making in the regionally and administratively contiguous British colonies of Hong Kong, Singapore and Malaya, and will cover the period from 1946, when the Malayan Film Unit was established, to 1969, when the Hong Kong Film Unit was abolished. The project will explore both the way in which important British official film-making traditions spread into the then colonies of Hong Kong, Singapore and Malaya; and how official film-making then developed in those colonies. The PI of this proposed project is also the PI of two previous GRF projects on Hong Kong documentary film, and this project can be considered an extension of these previous projects outwards, from a study solely of Hong Kong documentary film, to one which explores official documentary film-making in Hong Kong, Singapore and Malaya/Malaysia over the period in question. The intention, is, therefore, to build on this previous research, in order to understand the larger picture of the then relations which existed between colonial, official documentary film-making in the region.

240111.label: Realisation of objectives
240111.value: The project identified how British official film-making spread from the UK in the post-war period into the British South-East Asia area. The project was able to discover who was involved in this, what the significant films were, and how the film units related to each other. During the course of the project a significant amount of primary documents were collected from national museums in the UK, HK, Singapore and Malaysia. This material had been previously unresearched. The material shows how the development of the official British film in the region was influenced by tensions between what I call a 'Foreign Office/Colonial Office tradition of official film-making and a Griersonian tradition emanating from the British documentary film movement of the 1930s and 1940s. Whilst the Griersonian tradition developed in the Dominions in the post-war period, it did not do so in British South East Asia, including Hong Kong, apart from the early years of the Malayan Film Unit. Instead it was the tradition of film-making associated with the colonial Office Colonial Film Unit that took root in Malaya from 1952 to 1957, Singapore from 1950 to 1963, and HK from 1950 to 1973. The project has been successful in discovering this previously unknown history, particularly as it relates to HK and the development of the official film in HK from 1950 to 1973. Virtually all the objectives of the project have been achieved 100 per cent, though some films were not traceable, and the full extent of the British influence on official film-making in the region turned out to be too considerable to be contained entirely within this project. The project was principally concerned with understanding the use of the official film in the area through the analysis of written primary documents, and over 4,000 pages of such documents have been collected, many of which are not available for scrutiny online on the project website. Evidence as to how British official film-making impacted upon the historical development of these colonies was however sparse, and therefore objective 2 (below) could not be realized 100 per cent. a number of publications have resulted from the project, two international conferences have been held, in 2012 and 2013, at which a large number of international scholars presented papers, and a comprehensive interactive website containing over 3,000 pages of primary documents has been placed on line.

240111.label: Major findings and research outcome
240111.value: As mentioned, the project discovered that the development of the official film in the region was significantly influenced by tensions between what I call a 'Foreign Office/Colonial Office tradition of official film-making and a Griersonian tradition emanating from the British documentary film movement of the 1930s and 1940s. Whilst the Griersonian tradition developed in the Dominions in the post-war period, it did not do so in British South East Asia, including Hong Kong, apart from the early years of the Malayan Film Unit. Instead it was the tradition of film-making associated with the colonial Office Colonial Film Unit that took root. The outcome of all this was that the official film in the region was a much more conservative affair than was the case with the Dominions, with film units looking towards the British metropole and the Colonial/Foreign Offices rather than to the region. This was also particularly the case with Hong Kong, which was not faced with the prospect of decolonization in the postwar period, unlike Malaya and Singapore. The official film in HK was particularly cut off from the region, and developed strong links to the Colonial and Foreign Offices in London. Opposition to the Griersonian tradition was also particularly strong in Hong Kong, though also in Malaya and Singapore from 1950 to 1963, that is, from just after the start of the Malayan Emergency in 1948 to the granting of self-governance to Singapore in 1963. In Hong Kong that opposition emerged from the founding of the Hong Kong Government Information Services in 1950 to 1973, when the Hong Kong Film Unit closed down. The project also identified the key individuals involved in the development of the official film in the area. In Hong Kong that person was John Murray, the director of GIS from 1950 to 1963. Murray was strongly anti-Griersonian, and formed a strong link with the director of the Colonial Film Unit, William Crawford. In Malaya and Singapore the key figure was Tom Hodge, who was head of the Malayan Film Unit and of Cathay Film Services, the leading documentary film making institution in the region. Hodge was also strongly anti-Griersonian. These two figures, in accord with Crawford, and senior officials within the British Colonial Office, shaped the development of British official film in the region over this period. These and other findings are set out in the publications which have stemmed from the project.

240111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
240111.value: The potential for further development identified here relates to the use of the official film in the region against the context of the Cold War, and, in particular the role of semi-autonomous government agencises such as UK Information Services and the British Council during the 196s0 and early 1970s. A GRF application to research this was later submitted to RGC but was not awarded. Despite this a research monograph has been contracted with Palgrave Macmillan to carry out this further research and achieve publication of it. Other areas requiring further research and publication include the early (Griersonian) years of the Malayan Film Unit, from 1946 to 1950. Few of the publications on the MFU over this period are based on primary research, and this awaits to be done. Similarly, the role of the Regional Information Office in Singapore over the Cold War, and its use of the official film, requires further research. Important film series such as the Singaporean Berita Singapura and Hong Kong Film Unit's Hong Kong Today series require further research. Some people have also drifted out of the records, and need to be traced, including the last director of the Hong Kong Film Unit, Albert Young.

240111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
240111.value: In the post-war period from 1945 up to the growth of television in the late 1960s, film was the most important means of mass communication in British South-East Asia, particularly against the context of the Cold War, which was also a 'hot' war in the region. British and colonial government use of the official film to promote policy and manage populations was, therefore, also very important. This research has uncovered how that happened in the region over the period, who the people and institutions involved were, and what films were made. The research also illuminates significant distinctions between Malaya and Singapore - two territories moving towards late-colonialism and post-colonialism - and Hong Kong, which was not. The research shows how this fundamental difference shaped the use of the official film in these territories. The research also illuminates the process by which local people gradually took control of the official film services, in Malaya (1957), Singapore (1965-8) and Hong Kong, with Hong Kong the last territory for this to occur, in 1973. The research has also examined important films, which have been analysed and brought to critical attention for the first time in the outputs which have emerged from this research.

240911.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
240911.value: 本計劃擬研究金文與詩經中的習用語詞，分析這些語詞在先秦語言文化中的來源、發展，以及二者之間的關係。並從金文研究來考察其商周音樂詩歌發展之關係。本計劃基於本人於國際學術界首次提出的觀點：即從西周金文來看，銘文的入韻和四言化是在西周中期，而《詩經》之〈雅〉〈頌〉部分的詩歌語詞與西周中晚期金文多相重合，故中國四言詩體的發展成熟時期是在西周中期。舉例來說，詩經中常見的「萬壽無疆」一詞，在西周晚期金文亦頗為常見，但以金文來看，此詞本源自西周早期金文中「亡疆」一詞，在西周中期金文語言四言化和韻律化過程中，乃逐漸演變為「萬壽無疆」、「萬年無期」、「萬年壽考」等語詞，而這些成語和詩句的變化形式，也是原於叶韻（陽、之、幽）的需要。或有學者認為《詩經》文本是漢代才形成的文獻，但以近年來出土的戰國時期竹簡文字來看，《詩經》文本在戰國時代已經成形。如上海博物舘楚竹書〈孔子詩論〉〈緇衣〉、郭店簡〈緇衣〉之引詩、2009年出土的清華簡〈耆夜〉引詩來看，這些出土文獻所引之《詩經》文句，雖有異文，而顯然是基於一個共同的文本。本計劃擬全面地考察西周金文，在斷代為基礎的研究中考察其與詩經語言之關係。同時亦考察戰國時期的《詩經》文本。筆者相信這項跨學科的研究不僅對於詩經與詩學研究將有影響，對於金文、音韻學、上古漢語的研究也都將具有重大意義。

240911.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
240911.value: An examination across these two different types of texts, transmitted and excavated, demonstrates that the shaping of the poetic form, i.e. tetra-syllabic meter and rhyme structure of the bronze inscriptions can be dated to mid-Western Zhou, especially to the reigns of Kings Gong (r. 917/15-900/898 B.C.) and Yi (r. 899/97-873 B.C.), and the early rhyme poems in the “Ya” and “Song” sections can be dated no earlier than these periods. These language features of the Zhou texts, based on the reform of mid-Western Zhou, developed concurrently with the development of the musical instruments, especially the two-tone chimed bells, of the Zhou dynasty. A careful and thorough study of this relationship could help the deciphering of the bronze inscriptions on one hand and rectify the interpretation of the poems in the Book of Odes by predecessors on the other. Ultimately, this will offer a new picture of how the ancient four-character poetic style took shape and evolved.

241011.label: Project Title(Chinese)
241011.value: 從文化威脅角度探討排斥外資企業的消費者行為

241011.label: Co - Investigator(s)
241011.value: Prof Chao, Man Chi Prof Kwong, Jessica Yuk-yee

241011.label: Project Objectives
241011.value: To introduce cultural threat perspective as a theoretical framework in understanding consumer exclusionary reactions toward foreign companies. To delineate the underlying psychological mechanism and contextual triggers of consumer exclusionary reactions toward foreign companies.
rows: To introduce cultural threat perspective as a theoretical framework in understanding consumer exclusionary reactions toward foreign companies.
To delineate the underlying psychological mechanism and contextual triggers of consumer exclusionary reactions toward foreign companies.

241011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
241011.value: 全球化，國家之間經濟和政治相互依賴的加劇，為企業充分提供了超越地理疆界的機會。由於頻繁的國際貿易，在很多發展中的社會，即使足不出戶，人們也可體驗其他文化。與此同時，這些外國企業也會把它們原有文化的價值觀，做法，和理念引進本地市場。雖然外國企業往往是受歡迎的，偶爾他們也會挑起消費者的排斥行為，這些行為旨在抵制外國企業對當地的文化的影響（例如，麥當勞在法國遭破壞，以及中國網民抗議在中國故宮博物院開設星巴克）。 這項研究試圖解釋排斥外資企業的消費者行為。就此課題，過往的研究主要集中在消費者排外行為的個別差異，將排斥行為歸咎於個人傾向。而本研究則從文化威脅的角度來探討消費者面對外資企業的心理反應。文化心理學的文獻指出人們倚靠文化去滿足重要的心理需要，它幫助個人維持理想的自我狀態。由於個人和文化息息相關，人們因此會致力保護自身文化的延續性，獨特性和意義免受外來的威脅。因此，我們認為消費者排斥外資企業的反應會較容易在他們感到自身文化受到威脅時出現。 本研究角度的價值有三。首先，我們從文化威脅的角度去理解排斥外資行為背後的心理歷程。這角度提倡，排斥外資企業的行為是基於消費者認為外國公司可能會削弱本地文化。二，這個研究角度加入了外在情境因素來預測排斥行為。例如，當前的文化環境和當地文化的發展軌跡，這些因素也會影響外國公司有多大程度會被視為對當地文化的威脅。這項研究有助了解這些背景因素對排斥行為的影響。三, 這個研究角度為探討消費者排斥外的行為開拓了一個廣闊的研究方向。這個研究將有助研究人員了解文化威脅這概念的價值，並有可能引發多方面對此課題的進深探討。 除了其理論貢獻，此研究對全球營銷手法可能有重要的實際啟示。通過識別特定觸發消費者抵制外國企業和當地文化影響的條件，這研究結果可能會對須要制定全球定位策略的企業管理有重要的影響。

To delineate the underlying psychological mechanism and contextual triggers of consumer exclusionary reactions toward foreign companies.

241011.label: Major findings and research outcome
241011.value: Regarding objective 1: First, we showed that perceiving that a foreign company is intended to spread a foreign culture is a key driver of anger and resistant behaviors toward the company. Second, we showed that heightening the concerns over local cultural development increases exclusionary reactions. Findings illuminate that exclusionary reactions toward foreign companies can be driven by concerns for cultural threat, which have not been examined in prior research. Regarding objective 2: First, we examined the effects of psychological essentialism on the process of exclusionary reactions. We found that people who tend to essentialize social group (i.e., perceiving social group to have defining, unchangeable characteristics) were more likely to be affected by international conflict events, which drives their reactions to foreign companies. In other words, not all individuals react to international conflicts events and resist foreign companies, but those who think that cultural groups are essentially different. Second, we examined the effect of bicultural priming (i.e., co-presentation of local and foreign cultural symbols) in comparison of single culture priming (i.e., priming of either local or foreign culture). We found that bicultural priming sensitizes individuals toward the possible cultural effect of a foreign company. Exclusionary reactions will be resulted only for those who believe the foreign company will potentially weaken the local culture. All the effects were replicated among Chinese and U.S. samples. This replication adds value to the cultural-threat perspective we seek to substantiate.

241011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
241011.value: The cultural threat perspective proposed in this project opens up a broad research agenda in studying exclusionary reactions. We examine cultural continuity threat as a launching pad. Future research can extend to other type of threat such as distinctiveness threat and meaning threat. The contextual factors that lead to the perception of different types of cultural threats and their respective behavioral consequences also warrant future research efforts. Research efforts organized under the proposed theoretical framework will reveal a more holistic understanding of exclusionary consumer reactions. As a result of globalization, symbols of different cultures can often be found in the same space at the same time. This kind of cultural exposure represents a phenomenon with high ecological validity but its psychological effects remain largely unexplored. This set of findings highlighted bicultural priming (i.e., priming of two cultures simultaneously) as a unique priming phenomenon that contrasts with the extant literature that focuses primarily on one culture. Future development could be on further delineating bicultural priming effect, its boundary and underlying mechanism. From a practical perspective, future studies could examine how and to what extent a company's marketing strategies could reduce perception of cultural threat and thus the likelihood of consumers' resistance.

241011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
241011.value: This research seeks to explain exclusionary consumer reactions toward foreign companies. Prior research approached this question by identifying stable individual differences. We add to the literature by proposing a cultural threat perspective of exclusionary reactions. According to the psychological literature, individuals are motivated to protect their culture from potential threats because culture offers important psychological benefits such as sense of continuity, belongingness, and meaning. Individuals exhibit exclusionary behaviors that aim at alleviating any threat to their culture. Findings of this project illustrate under which conditions, this motivation can drive consumers to reject foreign companies. The value of this perspective is threefold. First, it delineate the psychological process and contextual triggers of exclusionary consumer reactions, which fill an important void in a literature that primarily focus on analysis individual difference. Second, the cultural threat perspective opens a broad research agenda in studying exclusionary reactions. Cultural threats can be further categorized into continuity threat, distinctiveness threat, and meaning threat. Future research could examine the contextual factors, perception, and behavioral consequences of different types of cultural threats respectively. Third, from a practical perspective, this research helps marketers to formulate their marketing strategies when a company enters into a foreign market.

242111.label: Project Title(Chinese)
242111.value: 中國的國家管治，空間策略與地區規劃

242111.label: Project Objectives
242111.value: To examine the governing reasons that lying behind China's spatial strategy To investigate the relationships between regional planning and urban planning in the pursuit of a spatial strategy To examine how land has been used as a new spatial technique for central regulation
rows: To examine the governing reasons that lying behind China's spatial strategy
To investigate the relationships between regional planning and urban planning in the pursuit of a spatial strategy
To examine how land has been used as a new spatial technique for central regulation

242111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
242111.value: This research will investigate a new form of state governance in China and its implication on the country’s central-local relationships. Unlike conventional discussions which concentrate on fiscal matters, personnel arrangement and institutional frameworks, this study seeks to examine how spaces – spatial planning and land – have been used for central regulation. Regional development strategies have been used as a tool to distribute resources and balance local powers since the first Five Year Plan. During the pre-reform period, it was a powerful technique as the central state was the only channel for resources. Economic reform since 1978 has increased new channels for resources and hence decreased the effectiveness of those strategies. In addition to the growing of local discretion and the formation of a fragmented governance landscape as a result of power decentralization, the need to develop a new spatial strategy is raised. In 2009, the introduction of eight regional plans by the State Council is a respond to such need. Focusing on the current practice of regional and urban planning in the Pearl River Delta, this research will investigate the central state’s new spatial strategy and its associated techniques. Specifically, this research investigates the Guangzhou-Foshan integration plan. It seeks: (a) to examine the governing reasons that lying behind the spatial strategy; (b) to investigate the relationships between regional planning and urban planning in the pursuit of spatial strategy; and (c) to examine the role of land in the process. It is expected that the spatial perspective will provide new understandings on China’s state governance and central-local relationships, an arena which has been dominated by political scientists. 本研究項目主要調查中國的新國家管治方法及其對中央地方關係的影響。本項目嘗試超越目前只集中於財政分配、人事調動和機關組織三方面的討論，探討空間（即規劃與土地）作為中央政府管治地方的一種新手段。早於第一個五年計劃時，中央政府已編制區域規劃作為分配資源和平衡地方權力的工具。然而，改革開放以及隨之而來的權力下放卻大大地削弱了傳統區域規劃的重要性。針對因權力下放而產生的管治問題，以及地方勢力的抬頭，中央政府於是重新推出新的地區規劃，制定新的空間策略。2009年中央國務院推出了針對8個不同區域的規劃，可以說是對上述情況的一個回應。本研究透過目前珠三角洲的地區及城市規劃，調查國家的新地區規劃及其相關的措施／手段。本研究特別著眼於廣（州）佛（山）同城的規劃，嘗試了解：(一)國家在空間策略背後的管治邏輯；(二)國家空間策略下地區規劃與城市規劃的關係；以及(三)土地在當中的重要性。透過這些問題，本研究希望超越政治學的觀點，為中國的中央地方關係提供新的詮釋及新的看法。

242111.label: Realisation of objectives
242111.value: The project has completed, with most of the objectives being met. In fact, this research has encountered a few unexpected problems because some of the inquiries are politically sensitive in China. This has made the investigation a difficult one; a lot of efforts were made but to no avail. I reported some of these difficulties in the annual-progress report. In 2013, the project suffered a major setback when the country’s Ministry of Railway was dissolved as a result of serious financial problems and corruption. While this research has identified a multi-billion dollar railway station development project as a case study to investigate the negotiations among the government at the central, provincial and city levels during the implementation of regional planning, the dissolution of the ministry has affected all its development projects, big and small, from the central to the local level. Owing to the sensitivity of the dissolution, planners and officials who involved in the multi-billion dollar project are reluctant to talk about it. Conservations were stopped abruptly. Such an unexpected development has significantly hampered the investigation and the pursuit of the set objectives. Among the three lines of inquiry that proposed, the first line was fully achieved. A more sophisticate framework which aligns the concept of ‘space’, ‘governmentality’ and China’s central-local politics has developed to understand the governing reasons that lying behind China’s spatial strategy. Unlike conventional studies which rest on European experience and conceptual framework, this study reasserts the importance of domestic politics in China’s regional planning, in particular the central-local dynamics – a very important domain but often considered as a background in existing research. As a result of the dissolution of the Ministry of Railway as noted, my plan to investigate the details between regional and urban planning through a large-scale railway infrastructure project was futile. This is the biggest defect in this research; and led to the under-achievement of the second objective. The missing of a detailed case study has affected the third line of inquiry – the importance of land. I responded to this by adopting a historical approach. Major events in China’s economic reform were reviewed; in conjunction with territorial adjustment and institutionalisation of spatial planning, I am able to show how land has been used to respond to political and economic challenges since 1980s. This approach has not only showed how space has been used for central regulation, a spatial strategy has also revealed.

242111.label: Major findings and research outcome
242111.value: Major findings of this research have cut across the empirical and theoretical aspects. For the former: (a) Domestic politics, especially the politics between the central and the local states, play a very important role in the formulation of regional planning in China. (b) Regional planning in China is not facilitated by either top-down (i.e. central planning) or bottom-up forces (i.e. local initiatives), but through negotiations between the central and the local state. (c) Space, including territory adjustment and spatial planning, has been used as a tool for central regulation since China initiated its economic reform. The various ways to use space to tackle different political and economic challenges has revealed the country’s spatial strategy. (d) The importance of city in both regional and urban plannings has demonstrated a new dimension to investigate China’s central-local relationship. At the theoretical aspect: (a) A new analytical framework which aligns the concept of ‘space’, ‘governmentality’ and China’s central-local politics has been built to understand China’s regional planning. (b) Such a new framework has moved beyond the conventional view which considered the revival of region is a result of global economic competition. (c) Negotiations between central and local states in regional planning have provided excellent instance to understanding China’s central-local relationships after three decades of economic reform. It is worth mentioning that this research has touched on some issues that receive little, if not completely overlooked, scholarly attention. This is demonstrated by the exceptionally long reviewing process of my submissions to academic journals for consideration of publication. More than one journal editors told me that they have difficulties to identify reviewers for my papers; and this is a very unusual situation. Certainly, such a lengthy reviewing process has delayed the publication of research outcome. At the time when I am writing this report, I am still waiting patiently for the responds of two journals. Research outcome includes conference papers, a book chapter and journal articles, please refer to Part C for details.

242111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
242111.value: This research has spanned across geography and political science, a potential area for further elaboration is to collaborate with political scientists who are familiar with Chinese politics. Their insights on the relationship between the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese state, the country’s institutional reform and the changing way of governance would provide useful insight to consolidate the analytical framework that developed in this research. Another area for potential elaboration is the empirical investigation on spatial planning. Are there are differences in the formulation and implementation of spatial planning in different geographical regions? This spatial variation would provide useful insight to explore if there is an unequal power relation between the central state and different localities. This would further shed light on the investigation of the country’s unequal development.

242111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
242111.value: This research has filled in a gap in current research on China’s regional planning by putting domestic politics, especially central-local relations, into consideration. Considering central-local dynamics as a major force for regional planning, this research has investigated the negotiations among governments at different levels during the formulation and implementation of regional planning schemes. Such an approach has moved beyond the conventional view which considers the flourish of regional planning as a response to global economic competition. Investigating spatial planning and territorial adjustment in China, this research has also revealed the country’s spatial strategy since the 1980s, articulating the important role of land and space in central regulation. Taking the central-local dynamics into consideration has generated a more accurate and in-depth understanding about China’s regional planning in the era of economic reform. Moreover, from the perspective of China studies, the emphasis on space and its planning has extended beyond the conventional discussion over central-local relationships which dominated by non-spatial, institutional, matters such as personnel arrangement and fiscal relationship.
