246311.label: Major findings and research outcome
246311.value: Major findings: It is often said that Ancient Greece, the Classical Period in particular (roughly the 5th and 4th century BCE), was the cradle of Western civilization. The same thing can be said of the Warring States Period (475–221 BCE) for Chinese civilization. Though both periods were marked by incessant warfare, the intellectual responses were different. Ancient Greeks produced narratives of war: either poems or prose accounts commemorating particular battles, but both were intended to record and glorify events. Philosophical discussions of war were remarkably rare in spite of the achievements of classical Greek philosophy. Plato wrote surprisingly little about war. Aristotle did discuss war in his Politics, but his views were notoriously confused. In contrast, most major thinkers in the Warring States Period in China urgently engaged the topic of war. Hence there were heated and extensive debates on the need to distinguish justified from unjustified wars in ancient China, as there were not in ancient Greece. With all due respect to the brilliance of the ancient Greek intellectual traditions, it is the ancient Chinese traditions that we should turn to in order to have access to nuanced and rich discussions on warfare in the so-called Axial Age. We have more to learn from them on this subject than from Plato and Aristotle. Output: One journal article (2012), one book chapter commissioned by the editor (2015), and one book co-edited by me (2015) which includes two brand new book chapters and two chapters of revised journal articles authored by me. (Please see Part C for details.)

246311.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
246311.value: This research focused on the Military Strategy School with some attention to the Confucian, Daoist, and Legalist Schools in Pre-Qin China. More can be done on the latter. Besides, further research should also include the Eclectic School (za jia; e.g., the Guanzi, The Annuals of Lü Buwei), historical narratives such as the Zhuozhuan (Commentary of Mr. Zuo [on the Spring and Autumn Annals]), the Zhanguoce (Strategies of the Warring States). Much more work needs to be done so that this enormous intellectual heritage can be transmitted to our world today. I will apply for another GRF project to complete this investigation.

246311.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
246311.value: Among ancient civilizations, Early China (Pre-Qin) was the only civilization that developed a web of sustained ethical discourses on warfare. It covered both the legitimate/illegitimate reasons for going to war and right conduct during warfare. The just war ethics, embodied in particular in the The Seven Military Classics, predated that of Europe by at least five hundred years. This research analyzed the just war ethics in this set of writings and compared it with contemporary Western just war tradition. Analogues of both "ius ad bellum" and of "ius in bello" can be found in them. However, this ancient Chinese just war ethics have not been developed and refined subsequently. Hence both China and the West can learn from one another on this topic and there is an excellent prospect for developing a cross-cultural consensus on ethics of war and peace.

247511.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
247511.value: Despite a huge academic literature on corruption, there is little direct evidence on the types of firms that pay bribes, and on the factors that influence the magnitude of these bribes and the benefits that firms derive from them. This is not surprising since this kind of activity is usually undisclosed. Most of the empirical literature has attempted to measure bribery indirectly, by relying on questionnaires and survey evidence or by conducting small-scale field experiments. Moreover, the current literature seldom examines firm-level data, and when such evidence is examined it is also derived from surveys. However, recent research highlights a very long list potential problems and biases with this survey evidence on corruption. In response to this problem, we plan to analyze a hand-collected sample of prominent bribery cases, involving publicly listed firms from different stock markets that have committed bribery of government officials worldwide, with particular emphasis on Asia. We expect that more than half of the sample will involve firms or government officials from Asia (mostly China, Japan, Korea, and to a lesser extent Taiwan, Singapore, Hong Kong, and the Philippines). We will focus on the initial date of award of the contract for which the bribe was paid (rather than on the revelation of the bribery). We plan to measure the benefits that firms receive from paying bribes as the increase in firm market value around the dates of the award of the contract for which the bribe was paid net of the bribe payment. In addition, we will compare the bribing firms with a matched sample of competitors that have not been involved in bribery incidents. Our data will enable us to describe in detail the mechanisms through which bribes affect firm value. We aim to answer three questions. Do firms that win government contracts by paying bribes differ in their performance characteristics from firms that do not pay bribes? Which firm performance, government official, bribe-paying country and bribe-taking country characteristics affect the magnitude of the bribes that firms pay? What benefits do firms receive by paying bribes and which of the above factors affect these benefits? Our study will differ from the majority of the academic literature on bribery, which uses data derived from surveys. To the extent that our results differ from previous survey-based studies, our findings may support moves away from surveys and towards the analysis of real world corruption cases. 尽管有大量的学术文献探讨贿赂行为，但在公司行贿的类型、贿赂金额的影响因素以及公司从中获得的收益方面，还是缺乏直接的证据。我们计划分析主要贿赂案例，包括世界范围内行贿政府官员的上市公司。我们侧重于行贿所得契约的初始日期（而不是揭露这种行为）；另外，对于行贿的公司，我们建立一组对比样本——没有参与行贿行为的竞争者。我们的研究旨在于详尽的描述贿赂影响公司价值的内在机制。我们计划回答下述3个问题： 问题1：通过贿赂行为得到政府契约的公司，其绩效是否不同于哪些没有贿赂的公司？ 问题2：在公司绩效、政府官员、及行贿与受贿区域特征这些因素中，哪些影响公司行贿的金额？ 问题3：行贿公司得到了怎样的收益？上述哪些因素影响这些收益？

247511.label: Realisation of objectives
247511.value: We obtain our sample from official documents that report corruption cases detected during 1975-2010, (Transparency International’s OECD Anti-Corruption Convention Progress Reports, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission releases, U.S. Department of Justice documents for violations of the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), and the UK’s Serious Fraud Office website). Our final sample consists of 155 observations, involving 107 publicly listed firms from 20 stock markets that have been reported to have bribed government officials in 52 countries worldwide. In our analysis, we match specific bribe payments with specific contracts awarded to the firm at a time the bribery was not public knowledge. To estimate the benefits that firms receive we compute the cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) relative to the initial contract announcement (that was won by paying the bribe) using event study methodology. We estimate the net benefits as the gross benefit minus the amount of the bribe. Our analysis of the division of rents between government officials and bribing firms is based on the share of the rents received by the government official, which we estimate as the ratio of the bribe payment divided by the sum of the bribe payment plus the firm’s gross benefits. Financial statement data, stock returns, exchange rates and GDP deflator are obtained from CRSP, Compustat, Datastream, the PACAP database, Factset, and International Financial Statistics (IFS). Country-level data are obtained from Djankov, La Porta, Lopez de Silanes, and Shleifer (2010), Freedom House, the Polity IV project, the World Bank, Transparency International, issues of the Doing Business Report (World Bank), and the Global Competitiveness Report (World Economic Forum). We have performed tests that analyze all five objectives. For objectives 2-3-4 we first examine each of the categories of theoretical determinants of the size of bribes and magnitude of benefits separately. We conduct univariate analysis of means and medians, univariate regressions, where the dependent variable is regressed on one explanatory variable, and multivariate regressions with all explanatory variables. We report p-values based on standard errors corrected for heteroskedasticity that cluster at the country level and estimate country fixed effects whenever feasible. For objectives 1-5, we compare raw performance for bribing firms to a control sample of firms that have not been reported to have paid bribes and are matched to our bribing firms by country, industry, size, and market-to-book ratio 4 years before payment of the bribe.

247511.label: Major findings and research outcome
247511.value: How much do firms bribe and what benefits do they receive in return? The mean bribe in our sample is $20 million, representing 4.7% of the size of the project, and a transfer of 48.9% of the rents from the contract to the government official. We find that many firms indeed earn significant net benefits from paying bribes, although these benefits are not overwhelmingly large for all firms. The median benefit that firms receive in our sample is $1.73 per dollar of bribe they pay. An alternative estimate using cross-sectional regressions indicates that a $1 increase in the size of the bribe is associated with a $10-11 increase in the value of the firm (a marginal effect). We test theoretical predictions for the size of bribes and benefits and find the most robust support for three of the six main determinants identified by the theoretical and survey-based literature. First, we find that the firm’s ability to pay (proxied by current and expected future profitability) explains a large part of the variation in the size of the bribes. Second, we find that politicians with greater hold-up power (higher ranking) receive larger bribes compared to lower-ranking officials. Firms that pay bribes to high ranking government officials do not receive significant benefits from these bribes, because most of the rents are expropriated by the government official. Third, we find that variables related to the ease of detection of the bribery appear negatively associated with the benefits that firms receive from bribes. Although we find some support for the remaining three factors that have been hypothesized to affect the magnitude of bribes and the benefits that firms receive (competition for the contract, political environment, size of available rents), the results appear less robust than the previous three factors. Finally, when we compare the performance of bribing firms with their peers before and after the bribery, few of the variables are statistically significant, and they do not appear to follow any pattern. There is no difference in performance following the payment of the bribe. Furthermore, there is no difference in performance between bribing and control firms during the year that the bribe was detected. Overall, there is little to distinguish bribing from control firms.

247511.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
247511.value: One interesting question that arises from these results is that if several bribing firms do not appear to receive sizable benefits from the bribes, and if they do not outperform their peers following the bribe, then why do they bribe? One potential explanation is that these firms are subject to weaker corporate governance mechanisms. Examining these mechanisms (CEO, Chairman, board of directors, blockholders) and whether they improve following the detection of the bribery is the research question for a new proposal submitted after the completion of the current project.

247511.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
247511.value: Most of the academic literature has focused on measuring the extent or frequency of bribery at the country level, its determinants, and its impact on the country’s economic development, and typically rely on evidence derived from questionnaires and surveys, which are better at capturing corruption perceptions at an aggregate level. Instead, we analyze a hand-collected sample of 155 prominent bribery cases, involving 107 publicly listed firms from 20 stock markets that have been reported to have bribed government officials in 52 countries worldwide during 1975-2010. We focus on the initial date of award of the contract for which the bribe was paid and estimate the benefits that firms receive in terms of increases in market value. Our data enable us to describe in detail the mechanisms through which bribes affect firm value. Our most robust findings include (i) a positive relationship between bribing firm profitability and the size of bribes or benefits, (ii) that high-ranking politicians appropriate a larger share of the rents from the contract without leaving the firms with larger benefits, and (iii) that variables associated with better detection are negatively related to the benefits that firms receive.

248311.label: Project Title(Chinese)
248311.value: 評估及測試法國汽車保險市場中的道德危機

248311.label: Project Objectives
248311.value: To test for asymmetric information in French automobile insurance market under experience rating system under which premium depends on the claims record of an insured individual in a dynamic framework. To solve the long-standing empirical puzzle – no asymmetric information, be it adverse selection or moral hazard, exists in insurance markets – that contradicts existing theory predictions. To be the first one adopting a new econometric methodology of estimating and testing moral hazard that bypass the two major problems in estimating dynamic binary choice model by relaxing those unreasonable and unverifiable assumptions on the unobserved heterogeneity making the results more robust. To provide insights to insurance companies and governments who are planning to run universal insurance programs about the merits of the experience rating system and trigger another analysis on the choice of a pricing function that can induce optimal effort of the insured individuals.

248311.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
248311.value: Asymmetric information is well exemplified in every insurance market in the form of moral hazard and adverse selection. The former is manifested when agents buying more insurance become more risky since more coverage discourages cautious behavior. In contrast, adverse selection occurs when agents deliberately hide their unfavorable characteristics from insurance companies. Theoretical literature has already shown the existence of these two phenomena. However, empirical literature often shows the opposite. To avoid agents’ dishonest reports, French government introduced experience rating system in early 90s - premium increases if an accident claim is filed and decreases if there is none. Moral hazard is present when he becomes more cautious for avoiding further premium increase after an accident had occurred. Thus, it imposes a negative dependence structure on the claim intensity. In contrast, adverse selection, captured by agents’ hidden characteristics, say, bad driving behavior, generates a positive dependence structure. If it is not carefully controlled, these two phenomena will be confounded together. This observation, which is also implied by standard utility maximization model, suggests that claim intensity can be modeled in a dynamic binary choice framework. If moral hazard exists, the coefficient of the lagged dependent variable, claim intensity, will be negative. Traditionally, dynamic binary choice model is estimated by either fixed or random effect model. The former treats the unobserved individual characteristics as fixed. However, when number of individuals is large, estimating the heterogeneity involves incidental parameter problem. If it is treated as random, consistency of parameters hinges on the correctness of its conditional distribution specification and the treatment of the initial value of the dependent variable - initial condition problem. This project is the first one to apply estimation and inference procedure for parameter sets to test for moral hazard in the presence of heterogeneity. This methodology avoids both incidental parameter and initial condition problem. The sacrifice of this relaxation is that we can only partially identify the parameters. Since our goal is to test whether there is moral hazard in the data by adequately controlling heterogeneity, that is, the sign of the coefficient of the lagged dependent variable, absence of point identification does not impose any problem in this analysis. To test for its significance, a subsampling test proposed by Chernochukov, Hong and Tamer (2007) will be adopted.

248811.label: Project Objectives
248811.value: Discuss the development of major diseases and epidemics in Hong Kong from 1841 to 2003. 248811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
248811.value: Based upon the recently completed project on the documentary history of public health in Hong Kong by the same team of researchers, this newly proposed project will investigate the history of diseases and epidemics in Hong Kong. It will aim at discovering the dynamic interactions during the processes of negotiation over the question of how to identify the causes and consequences of diseases and epidemics and their corresponding cures. Parties involved in such negotiations include the following: a) practitioners of Western and Chinese medicines in Hong Kong and Britain, b) colonial administrators in Hong Kong and within the British Empire, c) Chinese government officials in South China, and d) social leaders in Hong Kong whose views were represented in both organized and unorganized manners, ranging from initiatives to offering medical services for the needy ones within the institutional framework of hospital care to newspaper coverage by journalists or spontaneous contributions from the community. Evidently, there were external dimensions of diseases and epidemics that connected Hong Kong with China, Asia and the world. Attention will also be given to comparable cases for discussion where comparative perspectives are required. This project will attempt to identify the patterns behind the occurrence of major diseases and epidemics in Hong Kong. In particular, the scope of investigation will focus on the changing notions of the following factors: a) the cultural assumptions of diseases in the British and Chinese minds, b) the emergence of medical professionalism, c) the impact of health and diseases in the power structure and Chinese leadership, d) local voluntarism and its patron of indigenous medicine and biomedicine, e) features of demography and urban and rural landscapes, f) gender factor, g) socio-economic conditions of different classes in Hong Kong, and h) the port of Hong Kong as a major nodal point in the network of global communications and movement of people and commodities. The inception of British colonial rule serves as a relevant starting point for this project because it marks the beginning of a conscious effort of documenting information concerning morbidity and mortality in Hong Kong, while the SARS in 2003 the other end of time-frame for this proposed investigation as it signifies as a recent example of an epidemic that illuminates Hong Kong's role in the broader view of medical history. 本研究建基於較早前完成的「香港公眾衛生歷史資料研究計劃」，現擬探究香港歷史發展之中出現的疾病與疫病。究竟如何定義「病」、斷定其成因、尋找適當的治療方法等問題，如此種種有其繁複的歷史進程，涉及其中的不同人士有其不同的觀點卻又各不相讓。這些人士包括：a)本地和英國的醫師（包括中醫）、b)本地及英國的殖民地官員、c)華南地區的中國官員，及d)本地社區領袖經由各渠道表達的見解及其推動各式各樣的治療方法。顯然，某些「病」之所以在香港出現是因為與外地聯繫而產生的，故本研究亦注意有關的比較研究。 本研究旨在探討「病」的成因、其模式和型態。具體而言，本研究聚焦於下列不同因素及其轉變中的時代意義：a)英人與華人對「生病」的文化預設、b)醫學專業化的發展、c)疫病與本地華人社會的權力結構、d)慈善與醫藥的發展、e)人口結構、f)性別因素、g)不同階層人士的社會經濟條件、h)香港的港口在地區及全球海運交通的角色。本研究以英國在1841年建立殖民管治為開端，以2003年出現非典型肺炎研究時限的結束。前者標誌本地開始記錄主要的疾病，後者是表明香港在全球疫病史的意義。

248811.label: Realisation of objectives
248811.value: Objective 1: Discuss the development of major diseases and epidemics in Hong Kong from 1841 to 2003. This objective is achieved to a large extent. The monograph, in particular, is constructed with a chronological framework of seven periods, namely, 1841-1894, early 20th century, 1920s-1945, 1945-1960s, 1960s-1980s, 1980s-1997, and 1997-2003. Under each period, the developments of major diseases and epidemics are addressed with a theme that defines and qualifies such periodization. The period of 1841-1894 shows the foundation of the public health policy in Hong Kong that addressed the colonial priorities and local realities. The period of early 20th century captures how such a foundation was redefined by the shock of the plague that cost Hong Kong dearly. The period of 1920s-1945 addresses the unprecedented scale of immigration into Hong Kong and the emergence of industrialization on the one hand and the damages brought by the Japanese aggression in China and subsequently in Hong Kong on the other hand, and how such changes upset the public health system and demanded new solutions. The period of 1945-1960s is a period of post-war reconstruction and challenges because of the big leap in both population growth and industrial developments. The period of 1960s-1980s sees a paradigm shift of the social policy in public housing and public health whereby resources and initiatives were made available to address the control and prevention of communicable diseases. The period of 1980s-1997 is characterized by the issue of the future of Hong Kong as well as the accelerated socio-economic interactions between China and Hong Kong that were made possible by the Chinese open door policy and reform. While drafting the Basic Law, medicine issues, including the future of the Chinese medicine, were included in its agenda. The alarming spread of AIDS captured the public attention of that period. Finally, the period of 1997-2003 sees the beginning of postcolonial development that gives public health a newly defined position in social development, addressing such issues as chronic diseases, environmental health, reforming the health care system, and the potentials. The SARS and its impact also defined this period. Objective 2: Assess the impact of demographic and spatial factors, (including the differences in urban and rural settings) and socio-economic conditions of various social groups in the cause and spread of diseases. This objective is achieved to a large extent. The monograph gives due attention to these issues. Demographic and spatial factors are one of the core concerns in chapters 2, 4, 5, and 6. The fact that the population of Hong Kong was a story of migration and mobility of people and its impact upon the development of public health in Hong Kong is thoroughly discussed. In particular, the first wave of migration between 1860s and 1890s, the second wave of migration caused by political turmoil in China between 1910s and 1930s, and the third wave of migration between 1946 and 1965 together with the post-war baby boom are adequately covered and their impact on the spatial distribution of the population and socio-economic conditions of various social groups. Specifically, the changing housing condition, an important aspect of Hong Kong society that was attributed to the evolving socioeconomic conditions in different historical periods and their causes to the spread of the diseases are addressed. Objective 3: Examine the role of major players that shaped the historical development of diseases and epidemics, including practitioners of Western and Chinese medicines in Hong Kong, colonial administrators in Britain and Hong Kong, officials in China, and social leaders in Hong Kong. This objective is achieved to a large extent. While writing this monograph, the role of major players is given sufficient attention. The chapters discuss the roles played by the practitioners of medicine. In particular, the book covers both the internationally well-known names (e.g. Patrick Manson and James Cantlie) and locally significant names (e.g. William Hunter and G H Choa). The chapters also discuss the roles played by administrators and social leaders in Hong Kong. For example, this is probably the first piece of research literature that discusses the role played by Governor Henry Blake in the promotion of scientific medicine and Ho Kai’s part in the investigation in the origins of Beriberi. The role of the Tung Wah Hospital is likewise thoroughly examined; for example its contributions in the anti-smallpox vaccination in pre-War and the BCG vaccination in post-War are adequately discussed. Object 4: Discuss the changes in cultural assumptions regarding diseases among the European and Chinese populations as well as their respective responses to illness and healing modalities. This objective is achieved to a large extent. This monograph pays due attention to a number of cultural assumptions. Some believed that diseases were results of such external factors as miasma, fifth, odour, and such internal factors as certain philosophies about different forces in human bodies. These assumptions were not easy to overcome, partly due to ignorance and prejudice as well as partly administrative arrogance and cultural pride. This happened in the nineteenth century while combating the Malaria and the Plague. It took a long time to find out the true cause and accept the suitable healing modality. The same was true in the twentieth century while combating the HIV/AIDS. The social and cultural stigma against homosexuality makes it more challenging in identifying in full accuracy about the prevalence of HIV/AIDS. Objective 5: Evaluate the global nature of diseases and epidemics in Hong Kong. This objective is achieved to a large extent. This monograph gives an account of two major global epidemics that Hong Kong had played a significant part, namely the plague of 1894 and the SARS in 2003. Attempts are also made to address the spread of some diseases that are of global impact in different periods, such as the spread and the global collaboration in the control of tuberculosis. In regard to the global nature of diseases in comparative perspectives, the principal investigator also presented some tentative thoughts in a specialist panel of an international conference on East Asia Studies. The paper was about the use of the Hong Kong case for some comparative views in the history of diseases within the East Asian historical contexts. The discussion went very well in the panel and it was full of inspiration. It is indeed a new direction for further study. To begin with, one might consider using a particular disease as a case study.

248811.label: Major findings and research outcome
248811.value: The major research output of this project is a monograph entitled "Health Policy and Disease Colonial and Postcolonial Hong Kong, 1841-2003," to be published by Routledge and would be available on 21 July 2016. Attached in this report is a proofreading version of the book. Publisher's note about the book can be accessed: https://www.routledge.com/Health-Policy-and-Disease-in-Colonial-and-Post-Colonial-Hong-Kong-1841-2003/Yip-Leung-Wong/p/book/9781138943575 Prior to this monograph, this project produces two pieces that give a general outline of the historical development of health and disease in Hong Kong from the 19th century up to 1985. The monograph shows how the governments—both colonial and postcolonial—dealt with the multitude of health problems associated with such diseases as malaria, smallpox, tuberculosis, plague, venereal diseases, avian influenza, and SARS (severe acute respiratory syndrome). It illuminates how various diseases and epidemics shaped the emergence of strategies as well as machineries of government designed to control health problems. It also examines the changing perceptions of diseases among the Chinese and non-Chinese populations as well as the impact on, and responses to, diseases among different social groups and organizations. It reveals how the formulation and implementation of policies were often results of negotiation among various groups, vested interests, and the state. Finally, it looks at how Hong Kong’s health status had been, and continues to be affected by the spatial spread of diseases and epidemics from other areas, especially those adjacent to the city. No other studies have investigated and compared the history of diseases and epidemics over the broad sweep of time covered in this monograph. Studies on diseases and epidemics in Hong Kong have been either episodic narratives or records of specific diseases. With the recent outbreaks of avian influenza, SARS and other emerging diseases, scholarship has become present-minded and often treats 1997 as the “great divide” in Hong Kong history. This monograph is unique in its comprehensiveness and analysis, and is solidly grounded in the context of historical developments in Hong Kong. Moreover, globalization has enhanced the potential for the outbreak of pandemics of emergent diseases or diseases previously under control, and this research offers lessons and insights into ways to understand and combat these potential health threats.

248811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
248811.value: This research is a necessary corrective to mono-causation explanations in the field of medical history where some might over-emphasize scientific breakthroughs that made it possible to target the causes of specific diseases, or some might attribute health policy formulation and implementation mainly to the power of the state in imposing control through bio-governance. This project shows the complexity of the intersections of factors (such as state power and priorities, social dynamics and customs, cultural perceptions, an economic approach to health, science and bio-governance, regional and international health developments etc). Taking a rather holistic perspective, this project showcases the possibility of further development of research projects of similar nature yet of entirely different scope and contents. For this reason, the principal investigator has initiated a new research project entitled "A Social History of Obesity in Twentieth Century Hong Kong: A Pilot Project." This new project has been submitted to the research committee of the Hong Kong Baptist University for the application for funding to do groundwork research.

248811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
248811.value: Besides looking at major outbreaks of diseases and how they were coped with -- diseases such as malaria, smallpox, tuberculosis, plague, venereal disease, avian flu, and SARS -- this project also examines how the successive government regimes in Hong Kong took action to prevent diseases and control potential threats to health. It shows how policies impacted the various Chinese and non-Chinese groups, and how policies were often formulated as a result of negotiations between these different groups. By considering developments over a long historical period, this project contrasts the different approaches in the periods of colonial rule, Japanese occupation, postwar reconstruction, transition to decolonization, and Hong Kong as a Special Administrative Region within the People's Republic of China.

248911.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
248911.value: 香港教育局推行的融合教育政策實行至今已近十年。這政策的目的是讓有特殊教育需要的學生能夠在主流學校接受教育。融合教育在香港仍然是一個較新的概念，至今只有少量與香港融合教育相關的學術研究。本研究計劃運用兩階段的混合研究方法，探討香港小學音樂教師對實行融合教育的音樂課堂所關心的事項。根據西方國家的經驗，大部份教師在敎導有特殊教育需要的學生時都感到困難，因此需要接受相關的培訓才能處理這些學生的學習需要。雖然有西方學者曾發表過一些有關教師對融合教育的意見的量表，但卻沒有一個與音樂教育相關。現今有關音樂科融合教育的研究之中，亦只有Darrow (1999) 所作的一項調查美國音樂教師在實行融合教育的音樂課堂教導嚴重殘障學生的質性研究。然而，該研究所報導的只集中於教師所關注的普遍教學情況，而非針對音樂科教學相關的事項。因此有需要為音樂教師發展出一套有效的研究工具，用作調查他們在音樂科的融合教育方面所關心的事項及教導有特殊教育需要的學生時所面對的問題。本研究將會以質性研究方法探討香港小學音樂教師在實行融合教育的音樂課堂上所關注的事項，然後以量性研究方法發展一套用以調查音樂教師對實行融合教育的音樂課堂所關注的事項的量表。本研究亦會分析及探討這量表的可靠度及有效度。

248911.label: Realisation of objectives
248911.value: All three objectives had been fully achieved through mixed research method. The qualitative research method used was face-to-face individual interview, while the quantitative research tool was a set of survey questionnaires with teachers' self-rating questionnaires. There were 10 primary music school teachers participated in the qualitative study, and then 317 primary school music teachers participated in the quantitative study. They expressed their concerns of teaching music to students with special educational needs in inclusive music classrooms and their responses contributed to the development of the music teachers' "Concern of Inclusive Music Teaching" (CIMT) Scale.

248911.label: Major findings and research outcome
248911.value: According to the qualitative data collected, the findings addressing the first two objectives are: 1. Primary school music teachers found it difficult to teach SEN students due to the lack of music-subject specific professional knowledge and skills to support SEN students' music learning, and to assess their musical abilities (Research output no. 1). Their music-subject specific concerns include the opportunities (1) to learn music-subject specific professional knowledge and skills for teaching SEN students, and (2) to know about successful SEN music teaching practices (Research output no. 3) 2. The generic teaching concerns of primary music teachers about teaching students with SEN in music classrooms include (1) lack of time to modify the music curriculum for SEN students, (2) lack of support from school administrators about modifying music curriculum and assessment to help SEN students, and (3) the lack of extra manpower, such as teaching assistant to help SEN in inclusive music classroom (Research output no. 2) According to quantitative data, results of the third objective are: 1. A 25-item music teachers' Concern of Inclusive Music Teaching [CIMT] scale was constructed and administered to 317 primary schools music teachers in Hong Kong. The CIMT scale comprises six concern factors: (1) learning support, (2) learning difficulties, (3) learning needs, (4) resource, (5) training and (6) curriculum design and assessment (Research output no. 4).

248911.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
248911.value: Further research on validation of The Music Teachers’ Concern of Inclusive Music Teaching Scale in Hong Kong and other cities could be done in future. A HKBU Faculty Research Grant has been secured in March 2015 to conduct the validation of the scale in Hong Kong.

248911.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
248911.value: The purpose of this study was to investigate Hong Kong primary schools music teachers' concerns about inclusive music education. With the use of mixed methodology, an instrument for measuring primary schools music teachers' concerns about inclusive music education was developed. A 25-item music teachers' Concern of Inclusive Music Teaching [CIMT] scale was constructed and administered to 317 primary schools music teachers in Hong Kong. Results of the study indicate that the CIMT scale involved six factors, and primary music teachers were concerned about: (1) learning support, (2) learning difficulties, (3) learning needs, (4) resources, (5) training and (6) curriculum design and assessment, when implementing inclusive music teaching in primary schools music classes.

249211.label: Project Title(Chinese)
249211.value: 修辭建構的中西二分法：一個歷史和語藝的視角

249211.label: Project Objectives
249211.value: To reach an understanding of the nature and historical and rhetorical functioning of cross-cultural dichotomies. To demonstrate the active role played by rhetoric, particularly the art of topical invention, in history making. To reveal the dynamics of modern and contemporary Chinese intellectual history.
rows: To reach an understanding of the nature and historical and rhetorical functioning of cross-cultural dichotomies.
To demonstrate the active role played by rhetoric, particularly the art of topical invention, in history making.
To reveal the dynamics of modern and contemporary Chinese intellectual history.

249211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
249211.value: The use of such cultural dichotomies as Chinese collectivism versus Western individualism to describe cross-cultural differences has recently incurred significant criticism for being overly simplistic. This criticism, however, becomes less relevant when these dichotomies are seen as rhetorical practices. The objective of this project is to demonstrate that the China-West dichotomies prevalent in China after the humiliating Opium Wars were rhetorically constructed to place China in an awkward position, one in which it had to learn from the rich and powerful West to survive modern challenges. The study will explain the popular appeal of these rhetorical constructions as the creative exploitation by modern Chinese reformers of the categories and commonplaces of Confucian discourse and their topical implications. The topical invention of the series of modern Chinese dichotomies of China and the West that ultimately led to the Chinese collectivism-Western individualism polarity will thus be closely examined. The study will look to a dynamic period of history to account for the most profound ideological changes that took place in modern China by furthering our understanding of how the modern Western themes of democracy, liberty, and individualism came to interact with the Chinese topical tradition. 中西文化二分法，例如“中國集體主義和西方個人主義”，常被批評為過份簡單地看待文化間的異同。但若果把文化二分法看作是一種有意識的修辭舉措，以上批評便不再是有的放矢。本研究旨在論證屈辱的鴉片戰爭之後，在中國流行的種種中西二分法是基於民族改革的需要建構起來的。這些二分法刻意將中國置於困窘的位置上，它必須從富強的西方那裏學習如何應對近代和現代的挑戰。從修辭的角度看，這一建構能夠成功，關鍵在於近代和當代的改革者們巧妙地利用了傳統的哲學、倫理和政治範疇（如“體與用”、“道與器”、“心與物”、“公與私”、“群與己” 等）的辯證關係來確立其文化二分表述的合法性。本研究將系統分析鴉片戰爭以來各個重要時期流行的中西二分法的修辭建構過程，它將讓我們看到近代民主、自由、個人獨立的觀點如何可以與傳統的修辭手法結合成為一種巨大的思想改革力量。

249211.label: Realisation of objectives
249211.value: The goal of this case study is to demonstrate that the China–West distinctions that have prevailed in China since the Second Opium War (1857-1860), such as the “Chinese Way versus Western implementation,” “Chinese substance versus Western function,” and “Chinese monarchy versus Western democracy,” are rhetorical constructions. These distinctions were formulated, and to a certain extent carried over into present day, in response to a national crisis that largely resulted from the West’s intrusion, and in coordination with the steady reform of China into a modern state. This study explains the popular appeal of these rhetorical constructions as the creative exploitation by modern Chinese reformers of the categories and pairings of Confucian discourse and their topical implications. It pays particular attention to the topical invention of the series of modern China–West dichotomies that ultimately led to the Chinese collectivism–Western individualism polarity that is seen today. The overall goals outlined above have been achieved. As a result, I have finished writing an essay that is aimed at publication in the Quarterly Journal of Speech. Throughout the course of writing this essay, I have made two changes to its framework to sharpen its overall focus. Originally, the project was presented as part of the current discussion on the limitations of cross-cultural dichotomies (e.g., Chinese collectivism versus Western individualism). This will remain a significant, albeit subtler, framework for my next essay. However, based on what I have found thus far, it is more appropriate to showcase this project as a case study of Occidentalist discourse, in view of the fact that the Chinese invention and reinvention of “the West” have been found to be driven by an emergent domestic agenda. To enhance the appeal of the essay to rhetoricians, a specific readership of the journal, I have tried to be more conscious about its own rhetoricity. To achieve this, I have addressed the angst that drives it, the cultural exigency or national identity crisis it responds to, the invention and intervention it seeks to make, the speaking position it takes, its intended audience, and the “equipment for living” it proffers. These two adjustments explain the current title (“China–West Distinctions as Exigency-Driven In(ter)ventions: A Topical Analysis”) that I am using for the essay, instead of the originally proposed title (“China–West Dichotomies as Topical Inventions: A Historical and Rhetorical Perspective”).

249211.label: Major findings and research outcome
249211.value: This project provides a significant case for the study of Occidentalist discourse. As such, it necessarily supplements Said’s critique of Orientalism. Whereas cross-cultural comparison always involves the ideological and rhetorical inventions of another culture, this case study shows that this “other” does not have to be someone conceived as inferior to us. It could be someone that we want to identify with in the near future, in which case the creation of a superior other justifies the need for self-transformation. Although scholars often criticize cross-cultural dichotomies for impairing intra-cultural diversity, this project provides strong evidence for the alternative view that such dichotomies arise in response to emerging national or cultural urgencies. We can thus fairly assess their historical and rhetorical functions. This project further demonstrates that cross-cultural dichotomies are not only rhetorical inventions, but also rhetorical interventions designed to address national identity crises. We can therefore invoke Burke’s notion of rhetoric as identification rather than merely as persuasion. I also find that the dichotomies addressed in this project (e.g., Way-implementation, substance-function, and mind-matter) are discourses that have outlived their warranted historical course and have even trapped Communist China in their powerful assumptions and fallacies. The rhetorical invention of these China–West dichotomies, by means of exploiting the topical implications of Confucian categories and pairings, is the main concern of my analysis. Contrary to the popular view of the Confucian system of categories and pairings as essentially conservative and rigid, the analysis reveals that the system is actually very dynamic, which allows for arguments in favor of differing points of view. It is this dynamism that made the reformist and revolutionary creation of these cross-cultural dichotomies possible in China after the Opium Wars. The foregoing are only the most significant findings of this research, which have been reported in the associated essay. It is difficult to report the outcomes of this project, as I have only finished writing one essay. As indicated in Subsection 6.2, four additional, related essays are in the works. I have spent a great deal of time developing the first essay, as it is aimed at publication in the Quarterly Journal of Speech, the most prestigious journal in the field of rhetoric and communication. I have struggled to decide how to frame my study, however, this struggle has revealed the potential for developing this project along four additional lines of research.

249211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
249211.value: The essay, an immediate outcome of this project, fulfills only a part of the project’s overall potential. However, it presents several opportunities for further research development. I anticipate at least four different, yet related and significant, projects—in fact, I have already started working on each of them. The first focuses on generating an argument about the significance of applying Confucian categories—categorical binaries, in particular—in Chinese rhetoric. The second concentrates on developing a more comprehensive rhetorical history of China–West dichotomies. The third takes theoretical account of China–West dichotomies as a living discourse that is better viewed as normative, performative, generative, and constitutive, in the sense of constituting a new national identity. Based on the findings of this project, we can also develop a fourth piece: a critique of the current view of cultural dichotomies as incorrect or simplistic. Insofar as cultural dichotomies are considered to be rhetorical constructions, whether they really manifest cross-cultural differences is not a valid point of concern here. These four themes have yet to be developed beyond this project.

249211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
249211.value: As many studies have eloquently shown, how we see people of another nation depends not on what they are but how we want to see the world and ourselves. Currently, most of these studies focus on the dominant Western way (i.e., the Eurocentric or imperialist way of conceiving Eastern developing nations as an inferior “other”). This study focuses on the rhetorical creation of the series of China–West dichotomies that prevailed in China from the 1860s to 1920s, such as the “Chinese Way versus Western implementation,” “Chinese substance versus Western function,” “Chinese monarchy versus Western democracy,” and “Chinese collectivism versus Western individualism.” These cultural distinctions were constructed in correspondence with the three Western-oriented reform movements of this period. This Chinese case study can shed light on both a non-Western nation’s discourse of the West and the world, and on this kind of national discourse as a rhetorical in(ter)vention. As these dichotomies continue to drive the international dialogue between China and the West, this study may facilitate an understanding of contemporary China as it relates to the West. These cases are not only important to communication studies, but also to international politics, history, and several other social sciences.

250011.label: Project Objectives
250011.value: 從文學史的宏觀角度，梳理豔情書寫的源流，特別討論這一書寫在詩歌如宮體詩一類作品中的發展，以及從楚辭發展到漢魏六朝賦中的詠美人傳統，还有与词学传统中艳词的异同，進而揭示明清詞學中的宮體詠物詞對文學傳統的繼承和補充。 從時代特徵和社會心理，看宮體詠物詞產生的背景及其對特定階層心理的反映,以及宮體詠物詞發展過程中體現的文化特色。 從雅文學與俗文學的交叉中，看宮體詠物詞與其他類型的文體（如小說、戲曲）中的某些現象的關係。 从美感的层面，探討明清宮體詠物詞在用语和典故等方面的特色，特别关注其发展的阶段性。 从性别的角度，分析比較男女作家的同類作品在書寫方式及表現心態等方面的異同。 本課題的最終成果為一部學術專著或五至六篇專題論文。專著擬由上海古籍出版社或人民文學出版社等高規格出版社出版，論文則將發表於高規格的核心期刊上。 由於宮體詠物詞分佈零散，查找不易，因此，擬將所有此類作品彙編成冊，為研究中國文學、歷史、文化、社會、性別等領域的相關學者提供參考。

250011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
250011.value: 本研究計畫對明清兩代宮體詠物詞進行研究，包括以下幾方面的內容：1、唐宋詞的傳統與宮體詠物詞的出現；2、在明代尤其是晚明注重感官享受的文化背景中，宮體詠物詞所得到的發展；3、在清代詞學復興的背景中，宮體詠物詞得到怎樣的更大關注，以至於形成一種寫作風氣；4、明清兩代都有不少女性詞人也加入這一行列，她們是怎樣以女性的身份來寫女性的身體的。本課題將把這一現象放在中國文化史和文學史的大背景中，以對詞的探討為主線，結合詩歌發展中的豔詩傳統和辭賦發展中的詠美人賦傳統，結合特定的社會文化風氣，探討這一類作品的文化意義和文學意義。 This project aims to study the ci poetry focusing on objects (wu 物) in the palace style (gong ti yong wu ci宮體詠物詞 ) in the Ming and Qing Dynasties. I have identified four areas of focus for this project: 1.The relationship between the tradition of ci poetry in the Tang and Song Dynasties and the emergence of gong ti yong wu ci; 2. In the Ming Dynasty, especially in the late Ming, the gong ti yong wu ci quickly developed in a cultural background where people were very fond of sensory experience; 3. Due to the revival of ci poetry in the Qing dynasty, gong ti yong wu ci began to gain more attention. In turn it became one type of popular writing style. 4. Because of the increase in the number of women ci writers using this writing style, this project will explore how the women writers wrote about the feminine body. This project will discuss the writing of gong ti yong wu ci in the context of Chinese cultural history and Chinese literary history. I will focus on the Ci poetry, and compare it to the writing of yan style poetry (豔詩) as well as the writing about beauties in fu (賦). Meanwhile, I will explore the cultural and literary meaning of this kind of writing by looking at the specific social and cultural environment. 本研究計畫對明清兩代宮體詠物詞進行研究，包括以下幾方面的內容：1、唐宋詞的傳統與宮體詠物詞的出現；2、在明代尤其是晚明注重感官享受的文化背景中，宮體詠物詞所得到的發展；3、在清代詞學復興的背景中，宮體詠物詞得到怎樣的更大關注，以至於形成一種寫作風氣；4、明清兩代都有不少女性詞人也加入這一行列，她們是怎樣以女性的身份來寫女性的身體的。本課題將把這一現象放在中國文化史和文學史的大背景中，以對詞的探討為主線，結合詩歌發展中的豔詩傳統和辭賦發展中的詠美人賦傳統，結合特定的社會文化風氣，探討這一類作品的文化意義和文學意義。

250011.label: Realisation of objectives
250011.value: 本硏究計劃，按照原來的思路，順利展開，基本上達到了原來的設想。一方面梳理了大量的文獻，使得理論硏究建立在堅實的文獻基礎上，另一方面，從歷史、美學等各個不同的角度對這個課題加以分析，特別突出其在詞體發展中的意義和價値，對這一個過去基本上沒有得到文學史的硏究者關注的有意義的課題，給予了充分的解釋。

250011.label: Major findings and research outcome
250011.value: 本課題從文學史的宏觀角度，梳理了豔情書寫的源流，集中討論明清詞體創作中的宮體詠物之作。這種創作從楚辭以及漢魏六朝賦中的詠美人傳統發展而來，而又帶有鮮明的文體特色。同時，就其文體本身看，它也是词学传统中艳词的一個演進，體現了對這一傳統的繼承和補充。宮體詠物詞發展過程有鮮明的文化特色，與聲色追求的時代特徵和市民社會的心理狀態有著密切關係。詞原是結合雅俗的一種文體，宮體詠物詞將這一傾向進一步發展，雅的方面對於遣詞造句更為精心，俗的方面則將俗文學中的一些感官描寫借用過來，從而在詞與其他類型的文體（如小說、戲曲）之間搭起了橋樑。宮體詠物詞追求特定的美感，集中表現在用语和典故等方面，有著才學化的思路，和整體詞學發展的趨勢大致相同。另外，从性别的角度，也分析比較了男女作家的同類作品在書寫方式及表現心態等方面的異同，相對男作家來說，女詞人更為含蓄，但同時帶有比較具體的體驗，這體現了二者面對這一較為香艷題材的微妙不同。至於個案上，則對劉過、朱彝尊、纳兰性德、李漁、茹敦和等人作了具體硏究，而在展開硏究的過程中，也發展出其他的一些面向。還有，對宋代以迄清代的宮體詠物詞，就目前所見，加以蒐集整理，可以為學界提供參考。

250011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
250011.value: 這一硏究還可以進一步深入發展，例如，詞史的發展中，人們不斷要對艷情之作加以重新認識，以便建構新的理論。目前的硏究中，自唐代以迄清代乾隆年間的此類創作的面目已經比較清楚了，但嘉道之後，尤其是張惠言創建常州詞派之後，此類作品的生態發生了什麽變化，還有待於細緻探討。與此相關，從整個文學史的角度來看，艷詞的邊界可以劃在什麽地方，也是一個有趣的問題。

250011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
250011.value: 詞有自己的特點，人們常說，「詩莊詞媚」，詞從剛剛產生的時候，就是以寫美人愛情為重要題材的。本課題從這一點出發，主要探討詞在寫美人的過程中所發生的變化，即從寫情態轉向寫身體，以及從歷史、社會、性別、美學等方面，對此做出闡釋。

250111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
250111.value: Social capital and technological capital are firm strategic resources that are critical to firm innovation. Extant studies are inconclusive regarding the impact of their interaction on firm innovation outcomes. Some studies have found complementary evidence of the two in improving innovation outcomes, while others have suggested substituting effect of the two. This proposed research project aims to shed light on this research gap by proposing three alternative explanations. We suggest that the diverging findings, in the relationship between the joint effect of firm’s two key strategic capitals and innovation performance, can be better explained by examining the intermediate role of knowledge sharing with its partners, distinguishing the effects of internal and external social capital, and identifying potential managerial level contingencies, such as transformational leadership, in the relationships. The project extends the investigators’ current research programs on product innovation and on social capital and aims at filling up a significant research gap in innovation literature. This study will contribute to our understanding of how the interactions between social capital and technological capital of a firm influence its innovation performance as well as the potential contingencies in the process. More importantly, the study will provide insights for companies in how to leverage its social capital and technological capital for a better innovation performance. 社會資本和技術資本是企業創新至關重要的戰略資源。現存的研究仍未對其相互作用對企業的創新成果的影響有定論。一些研究發現兩者在提高創新成果方面起相互補充的作用，而另一些研究則發現兩者有替代作用。這項擬議的研究項目旨在提出三種可能的解釋。我們認為，兩個重要的戰略資本對創新績效的影響，可以通過研究與合作夥伴共享知識的中介的作用，區分內部和外部社會資本的影響，和識別潛在的制約因素如變革型領導，得到更好地解釋。 該項目擴展了研究提請人目前對產品創新和對社會資本方面的研究，旨在填補一個前期研究的顯著不足。這項研究將有助於我們了解社會資本與技術資本的相互作用如何影響的企業的創新表現，以及在此過程中可能的制約因素。更重要的是，研究將對企業提供關於如何利用社會資本和技術資本獲得更好的創新表現的見解。

250111.label: Realisation of objectives
250111.value: To achieve our objectives, we first conducted a broader literature review based on reviewers’ comments. After that, we collected some data using a sample of high-tech firms in which we believe our proposed relationships were most likely found. Although we used these preliminary data to write up two manuscripts, one with a simple model (quickly published) and one with the main model (not yet published), overall, we think we have achieved only about 80% of our objectives mainly because the manuscript containing the main model that directly addresses the two objectives is not yet published, after targeting A journals for about two years. One of the comments we repeatedly obtained from reviewers of A journals is that our cross-sectional survey design is not acceptable for testing a mediation model. So, after several tries, we eventually submitted the manuscript to a B level journal early this year and we received an R&R. However, we were unable to get the manuscript accepted before the due date of this report because the PI's pregnancy slowed the revision process. Meanwhile, we have made some additional attempts to overcome the design problems and further expanded our research ideas. On the one hand, we stopped the process of data collection after we first received such a comment and re-designed a questionnaire for a data collection using a two-wave survey design. However, we were unable to complete the second-wave data collection within the project time frame and the design was still not a true longitudinal design. On the other hand, we had been searching potential panel data that allow us to address related research questions using a true longitudinal design. Though we recently identified one such data set, we were unable achieve visible outcomes within the project time frame.

250111.label: Major findings and research outcome
250111.value: Two manuscripts were prepared and submitted to journals. One manuscript (a side model) was quickly accepted by Journal of World Business. The paper examines the effects of social capital on new product development outcomes and a potential underlying mechanism in the link in an emerging market. Findings suggest that both trust and power in a firm’s social network are significantly associated with its new products development speed and innovativeness through its sensing capability which fully mediates the relationships. The second manuscript (the main model) was eventually submitted to Industrial Marketing Management after a two-year attempt to get into an A journal. This paper intends to answer a research question: how can firms best exploit resource interplay between internal resources such as technological capital and NPD human capital and external business networks for their dynamic capabilities and how such capabilities may promote new product success? Drawing on the dynamic capabilities perspective, the study tested a moderated mediation model. Findings reveal that power in its business network (one aspect of external social capital) limits a firm’s effective use of its internal resources for a firm’s sensing and seizing capability, a dynamic capability in its new product development, which in turn transforms the benefits of resource interplay into new product success.

Thus, we plan to test a revised model of this project as a further development of the research using the newly collected sample. In addition, we will also take advantage of the newly identified panel data set and test some potential models further developed from this project.

250111.value: The research project intends to advance our understanding of the interaction between social capital and technological capital of a firm and its subsequent impact on its innovation performance and potential contingencies in the process. This helps address research gaps in product innovation literature and shed new light into the black box of how a firm leverage both internal and external resources into innovation outcomes. Several hypotheses were proposed and tested using a sample collected through a cross-sectional survey design.

260111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
260111.value: Inflammation is a common human disease that seriously degrades the quality of life of patients. The existing anti-inflammatory drugs, both steroidal and non-steroidal (NSAIDs), have unavoidable adverse reactions. Given recent successes in finding remedies from herbs for other conditions, herbs are a potential source of new drugs for inflammation as well. “Xuelianhua (雪蓮花)” is highly regarded in China for its potency in treating various diseases related to chronic inflammation, such as rheumatism, impotence and menoxenia. Saussurea involucrata, S. medusa and S. laniceps are the three main species used in Uighur and Tibetan folk medicine. In our previous study, the chemical composition and pharmacological activities of the three species of “Xuelianhua” were compared. S. laniceps, one of the Tibetan “Xuelianhua”, was found to be most effective against the inflammatory and nociceptive models. However, the active components and treatment mechanism of Tibetan “Xuelianhua” (S. laniceps) are still unknown. Previous work suggests that further study will be productive; thus, and the current work aims to screen active ingredients from the original constituents or the new metabolites by bioassay-guided fractionation and metabolism study. Active compounds and metabolites from the plant will be investigated to confirm their anti-inflammatory and anti-nociceptive effects on animal models. In addition, the pharmacological mechanism of Tibetan “Xuelianhua” (S. laniceps) will be elucidated. This investigation will provide a scientific basis for the clinical use of “Xuelianhua”, and is expected to lead, ultimately, to the development of new, safe and effective anti-inflammatory drugs from “Xuelianhua”. 炎症是一種常見的人類疾病，其嚴重降低患病者的生活質量。現有的甾體類和非甾體類抗炎藥都不可避免地有不同副作用。最近以來，不斷有從中草藥中成功尋找治療其他疾病藥物的報導，由此啟發我們也可以從中草藥中尋找新的抗炎藥物。 “雪蓮花”是中國著名中草藥之一，主要用於治療各種與慢性炎症相關的疾病，包括風濕、陽痿和月經不調。“雪蓮花”主要在維吾爾族和藏族民間醫藥中使用，其植物來源眾多，天山雪蓮、水母雪蓮和綿頭雪蓮是最常見的三個種。在前期的研究中，我們比較了三種“雪蓮花”的化學成分和藥理活性，發現西藏“雪蓮花”之一的綿頭雪蓮是其中具有最強抗炎和鎮痛活性的品種。 然而，綿頭雪蓮的活性成分和治療機理至今還不清楚。前期的工作表明，有關雪蓮花的研究值得進一步深入。因此，本課題選擇綿頭雪蓮為研究對象，擬應用活性追蹤技術從綿頭雪蓮藥用部位或代謝產物中篩選抗炎和鎮痛的活性成分，並對活性成分進行代謝研究。活性成分的功效將在動物模型上進一步驗證，並進而闡述其作用機制。本課題將為“雪蓮花”的臨床使用提供科學依據，為從“雪蓮花”開發安全和有效的抗炎新藥打下基礎。

260111.label: Realisation of objectives
260111.value: All five objectives have been realised. Objective 1: A lipopolysaccharides (LPS)-stimulated RAW 264.7 cells model for anti-inflammatory agents screening was established. RAW 264.7 cells were plated in 96-well plates for a pre-incubation. Xuelianhua fractions and lipopolysaccharides (LPS) were added and the samples were incubated. The nitrite accumulated in culture medium was measured as an indicator of NO production by Griess reagent. Twenty-two compounds have been isolated and identified from the active fractions. Objective 2: We compared the chemical constituents of aqueous and ethanolic Xuelianhua extracts using chromatographic analysis. Chemical comparison demonstrated that the types of chemicals in the two extracts were identical, but the contents of the main constituents in the aqueous extract were lower than those of the ethanolic extract. A transesterification of dicaffeoylquinic acids took place in the aqueous extract during boiling. In metabolism study, umbelliferone and scopoletin were evaluated to be the key bioactive components. Glucuronidation and sulfation are the main phase II metabolism of umbelliferone and scopoletin after their absorption into the blood stream. Their pharmacokinetic parameters were measured and biotransformation pathways were elucidated. Objective 3: The results indicate that umbelliferone and scopoletin are absorbed by animals after Xuelianhua oral administration. Umbelliferone and scopoletin showed cyclooxygenase-2 and 5-lipoxygenase dual inhibitory activity, which suggests that the two compounds produce anti-inflammatory activity in part via the inhibition of the generation of eicosanoids. The metabolites of umbelliferone and scopoletin are also involved in the pharmacological effect of Xuelianhua. Objective 4: We provided a scientific basis for clinical use of the Tibetan “Xuelianhua”. The results clearly demonstrated that Tibetan “Xuelianhua was most effective for the treatment of inflammation and pain compared the other two species. This study also supported discrimination among the three herbs when using them in folk medicine. Ethanolic extract and nonpolar fraction may be responsible for its pharmacological activities. Objective 5: “Xuelianhua” is highly regarded in China for its potency in treating various diseases related to chronic inflammation, such as rheumatism, impotence and menoxenia. Through our study, the plant source has been explored and clarified. Tibetan “Xuelianhua has been proven to be effective for the treatment of inflammation and pain, which will lead to the further research and development of new drugs from “Xuelianhua”.

260111.label: Major findings and research outcome
260111.value: 1, Exploring the plant resource of Xuelianhua herbs and differentiating the easily-confused species; To differentiate three representative easily-confused Xuelianhua herbs, namely, Saussurea involucrata, Saussurea laniceps, and Saussurea medusa, macroscopic features of the three herbs were systemically observed, and microscopic features were compared by using ordinary light microscopy, polarized light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The results indicate that, as for macroscopic identification, capitula situation and arrangement, and as for microscopic identification, pollen grains, nonglandular hairs, glandular hairs, and cells of inner surface of the microdiodange can be used to authenticate the three Xuelianhua herbs. 2, Clarifying the chemical changes of Xuelianhua in decoction and metabolism process; A transesterification of dicaffeoylquinic acids took place in the aqueous extract during boiling of Xuelianhua. In metabolism study, umbelliferone and scopoletin were evaluated to be the key bioactive components. Glucuronidation and sulfation are the main phase II metabolism of umbelliferone and scopoletin after their absorption into the blood stream. 3, Establishing an integrated strategy based on UPLC–MS for metabolism and pharmacokinetic studies of herbal medicines; We established a strategy to integrate the metabolism and pharmacokinetics study of multi-component herbal medicines, based on UPLC–MS technique. The strategy consists of three steps: (1) Firstly, characterize the absorbed constituents and their metabolites in plasma, urine and feces by UPLC–MS after herb administration; (2) secondly, the marker components for pharmacokinetic study are generated based on global metabolic profiles and combine with the abundance and biological activities of the candidate constituents; and (3) thirdly, the corresponding markers were quantified in plasma for pharmacokinetic study by UPLC–MS, and also the biotransformation pathway was provided to clarify the potential bioactive mechanisms of herb. This strategy was applied by using Tibetan “Snow Lotus” herb (Saussurea laniceps) as a model herb.

260111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
260111.value: Our completed research focused on the constituents and metabolism study of Saussurea laniceps, one of the species of “Xuelianhua”. Through our investigation, however, there are other two species, S. involucrata and S. medusa, have also been used under the name “Xuelianhua” for the treatment of similar diseases besides SL. To achieve a comprehensive research conclusion on the “Xuelianhua” herbs, further study on the active components and therapeutic mechanism of S. involucrata and S. medusa is necessary in the future.

260111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
260111.value: Inflammation is a common human disease that seriously degrades the quality of life of patients. The existing anti-inflammatory drugs have unavoidable adverse reactions. “Xuelianhua” is highly regarded in China for its potency in treating various diseases related to chronic inflammation. To provide a scientific basis for the clinical use of Xuelianhua in this study, firstly, we clarified the plant resource of Tibetan Xuelianhua herb by using light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy. Macroscopic and microscopic features can be used to authenticate the easily-confused Xuelianhua herbs. Secondly, an anti-inflammatory agents screening cells model was established, and potential active compounds have been isolated from the “Xuelianhua” extracts. The anti-inflammatory and anti-nociceptive effects of Xuelianhua have been confirmed on animal models. Thirdly, the chemical changes of Tibetan Xuelianhua in decoction and metabolism process have been clarified, and transesterification, glucuronidation and sulfation of the constituents are found. Fourthly, we established a strategy to use for integrated metabolism and pharmacokinetic studies of Xuelianhua, and the metabolism process of Xuelianhua is involved in its pharmacological mechanism. This project provided a scientific basis for the clinical use of Xuelianhua, which was expected to the development of new, safe and effective anti-inflammatory drug in the future study.

262111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
262111.value: The life cycle of plants alternates between the diploid sporophyte generation and the haploid gametophyte generation. Upon switching from the vegetative stage to the reproductive stage, the shoot apical meristem of an Arabidopsis plant turns into an inflorescence meristem which gives rise to floral meristem. The stem cells in each floral meristem undergo a limited number of cell division and then terminate their activity to give rise to a defined number of floral organs. An Arabidopsis flower contains anthers where pollen grains (male gametophytes) develop and carpels which are the female reproductive organs. A carpel contains ovules in which female gametophytes are produced. Ovules later develop into seeds following fertilization. The production of viable gametophytes and seeds are essential for plant sexual reproduction. Recently, we identified an Arabidopsis E3 ubiquitin ligase (PUB4) as a new component that regulates pollen development and floral meristem determinacy. E3 ligases regulate biological pathways by modulating protein stability and activity by catalyzing attachment of ubiquitin units to their specific substrate proteins. This protein ubiquitination targets the substrate proteins for degradation or changes the protein activity. The pub4 loss-of-function causes developmental defects in the tapetal cells. The tapetum is a somatic cell layer in anthers that surrounds developing pollen and undergoes timely programmed cell death at a later stage during male gametogenesis. Proper functioning of the tapetum is essential for pollen development. The pub4 mutation causes unusual enlargement of the tapetal cells and blocks their normal cell death process, leading to male sterility. The pub4 mutation also causes aberrations in floral organogenesis. In the pub4 mutant, ectopic floral organs are formed interior to carpels, indicating that PUB4 also regulates floral meristem determinacy. The main focus of this proposal is to understand how PUB4 controls the developmental and physiological processes related to pollen development and floral organogenesis. We will use a combination of biochemical, physiological, molecular, and genetic approaches to elucidate specific pathways regulated by PUB4. We aim to identify the targets of PUB4 and additional elements that function in the pathways where PUB4 is involved. Understanding the definitive function of PUB4 will offer novel insights into the genetic networks and the molecular mechanism that regulate these important biological processes. 高等植物的生活周期經曆著二倍體孢子體世代和單倍體配子體世代的交替循環過程。當擬南芥從營養生長期向生殖生長期轉變時，莖分生組織轉變爲産生花分生組織的花序分生組織。花分生組織中的幹細胞在經過有限的細胞分裂之後，細胞分裂活性停止，繼而分化出壹定數目的花器官。擬南芥的花包括雌、雄配子體兩部分，雄配子體（花藥）是花粉粒産生的地方，雌配子體（心皮）是胚珠發生的地方。花粉進入胚珠完成雙受精産生合子，合子進而發育成種子。因此，具有活力的雌雄配子體和種子的産生是植物有性生殖過程中必不可少的部分。 最近，我們发现擬南芥一个E3-泛素連接酶（PUB4）調控雄配子體發生和花分生組織決定。E3-泛素連接酶負責結合特異性底物蛋白質，並將泛素轉移到底物蛋白質上，促使蛋白質降解或者改變蛋白質活性，從而調控生物學途徑。PUB4功能缺失造成突變體中的絨氈層細胞發育缺陷。絨氈層細胞是花藥中圍繞著花粉粒的一層體細胞，該細胞在雄配子體發育晚期適時地出現細胞程序化死亡。功能正常的絨氈層細胞是花粉發育所必需的。在pub4突變體中，絨氈層細胞異常肥大並且細胞程序化死亡受阻，從而導致雄性不育。此外，在pub4突變體中，花器官形成也出現異常現象。異位的花器官在形成在心皮的內側，這表明PUB4蛋白質在調控花分生組織決定中起著重要的作用。 該課題主要研究目的是來探索PUB4蛋白質怎麽樣調控與花粉發育和花器官形成相關的發育及生理過程。我們將用生物化學、植物生理學、分子生物學、遺傳學等多種手段來闡明PUB4蛋白質參與調控的生理及生化機制。我們也將致力于鑒定PUB4蛋白質所參與生物學途徑中的底物和參與同一途徑的其他蛋白質。 對PUB4蛋白質確切功能的研究，將爲闡明花粉發育和花器官形成的遺傳網絡和分子調控機制開拓新的視野。

262111.label: Realisation of objectives
262111.value: Objective 1. Through measurement of the auxin levels in leaf tissues and floral buds of both wildtype and pub4 mutant and using the DR5::GUS reporter transgene assay, it was found that the pub4 mutation does not lead to obvious change in the auxin levels. Objective 2. Digital gene expression analysis (DGE) and RNA-seq, followed by q-PCR analysis, were carried out to compare transcriptome profiles of the pub4 mutant and wt plants. Although it is not easy to pinpoint a particular pathway that is affected by the pub4 mutation based on the profiling data, expression of some genes related to meristem functions and floral development were found to be altered by the mutation and have been further analyzed. Objective 3. We made a construct in which PUB4 is under the control of a tapetum-specific promoter. The construct was introduced into the pub4 mutant. The transgene was found to be able to complement the pub mutant phenotype (enlarged tapetal cells and male sterility). The result reveals that the defect in the tapetal cells caused by pub4 is solely responsible for the male sterility phenotype. Objective 4. We initially expressed PUB4 in E. coli and purified it from E. coli cells. However, PUB4 protein expressed in E. coli was not found to possess an E3 ligase activity. We then generated transgenic Arabidopsis that expresses an epitope (FLAG)-tagged PUB4. PUB4-FLAG purified from plant tissues was used in enzymatic assay and was found to have an E3 ligase activity. The assay indicates that PUB4 might catalyze mono-ubiquitination. Objective 5. Through yeast two-hybrid system, BiFC, and co-IP assay, we have identified three XLG proteins and NIT1 as PUB4-interacting proteins. Through a genetic approach (suppressor screen), three suppressor mutants have been isolated and two of the suppressor mutations are apparently caused by mutation in the same gene that encodes for a receptor-like protein kinase.

262111.label: Major findings and research outcome
262111.value: 1. The pub4 mutation leads to abnormal enlargement and incomplete degeneration of the tapetal cells. As a result, pollen grains could not be released, although they are still viable, leading to conditional male sterilty. Exine formation on the pub4 pollen wall is also abnormal, which however apparently does not affect pollen viability as pub4 pollen are viable. 2. We expressed epitope-tagged PUB4 in Arabidopsis and purified it from the plants. In vitro enzymatic assay revealed that PUB4 could undergo self-ubiquititation. The ubiquitination pattern suggests that it was a mono-ubiquitination. 3. Yeast two hybrid screen and BiFC assay revealed that XLG1, XLG2, and XLG3 interact with PUB4. Interaction between XLG2 and PUB4 occurs in both plasma membrane and nuclei. An in vivo co-IP assay identified NIT1 (Nitrilase 1) as its putative interacting protein. NIT1 is known to catalyze formation of auxin IAA from IAN. Excessive IAN, like IAA, is known to cause suppression of seedling growth. However, the pub4 mutant is insensitive to IAN-caused suppression of seedling growth, suggesting that PUB4 is needed for NIT1 activity. 4. A genetic suppressor screen led to isolation of three suppressor mutants (sup1, sup2, ad sup3). Candidate genes for these three suppressor mutations have been isolated and are under further verification through genetic complementation. sup1 and sup2 are apparently caused by mutations in the same gene that encodes for a receptor-like kinase. 5. The pub4 mutant was found to have reduced sensitivity to inhibition of seedling growth by excessive cytokinin, suggesting that PUB4 is involved in the cytokinin signaling pathway. 6. The pub4 mutation was also found to cause indeterminacy of floral meristem, as evidenced by formation of extra floral organs in the mutant. The pub4 floral organs exhibited ectopic expression of WUS, a key regulator of meristem activity. 7. The original pub4-1 line was found to contain another T-DNA insertion in a gene encoding for a PPR protein (AtPPR2). The ppr2 mutation was found to cause arrest of mitotic division during gametogenesis and embryonic lethality. We further showed that PPR2 is an rRNA-binding protein. 8. Some of the findings have been included in two papers published in Plant Journal.

262111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
262111.value: Biological and molecular functions of PUB4 have been characterized in depth in this study through a multi-disciplinary approach. The study reveals that PUB4, which possesses an E3 ligase activity, plays an important role in multiple developmental and physiological pathways, including cell expansion and division, programmed cell death of the tapetum, the response to cytokinin, and conversion of IAA from IAN. Several potential physiological substrates of PUB4 have been identified through molecular and genetic approaches. These findings provide basis for additional study to further define the roles of ubiquitination, mediated by PUB4 as a newly identified player, in these important biological processes. A new proposal has been submitted for further understanding the molecular mode of action of PUB4 and the pathways mediated by PUB4 and its interacting proteins.

262111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
262111.value: In this study, PUB4 has been found to be an E3 ubiqiotin ligase, an enzyme that is involved in modifying and regulating other proteins through ubiquitination. Disruption of the PUB4 gene causes abnormal expansion and incomplete degeneration of the tapetal cells. The tapetum is the maternal tissue that surrounds developing male gametophytes (pollen). The pub4 mutation causes male sterility. The pub4 mutation also causes formation of extra floral organs. Those findings indicate that PUB4 is a newly discovered player in controlling cell growth, division, differentiation, and programmed cell death. PUB4 is apparently involved in the response to cytokinin, an important hormone in plants involved in control cell division and differentiation, as the pub4 mutant showed a compromise to the response to cytokinin. PUB4 might also be important for formation of auxin IAA (another important hormone for cell growth and division) from its precursor IAN. Several proteins have been identified as putative physiological substrates of PUB4 in this study through molecular and genetic approaches, including three unique G proteins (XLGs) in plants, NIT1 (Nitrilase 1 that converts IAN to auxin IAA), and a protein kinase. PUB4 might modify those proteins by mono-ubiquitination.

310111.value: 基於文法及依存關係學習的適應性遺傳編程法

310111.label: Project Objectives
310111.value: Grammar-based approaches are hot topics in GP (Miller and Poli 2010). The problem of learning and adapting grammars is very important and challenging in the fields of GBGP and GP. However, there are very few studies in investigating why the problem is so difficult. This project proposes performing comprehensive and systematic experiments in identifying the causes of it. Thus, this project establishes the foundation for further development in these fields. A new formalism for representing dependences among different components of programs will be developed and evaluated. Methods for learning these dependences will be studied. The formalism and methods improve the performance of GBGP in learning grammars. This research is our first attempt to detect and exploit dependences of program trees without fixed structure. A number of techniques and EDAs/EDP approaches that can tackle the problems of learning complicated and imprecise grammars and modifying grammars inappropriately will be studied. The formalism, learning methods, and techniques developed in (2) and (3) above will be implemented in a new GP system. The new system will be used to solve practical problems in direct marketing and bioinformatics domains. The solutions obtained by the proposed system will be compared with those found by other existing methods. The knowledge represented in the grammars adapted during the process will be discussed with domain experts and practitioners to determine if interesting and novel knowledge can be discovered. The formalism and learning methods developed in (2) can also be used in EDAs and EDP to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of these algorithms. Thus, the project will have a significant impact on GP, EDAs, evolutionary algorithms as well as their applications. In summary, the project will place Hong Kong in a strong position of basic and applied research in this area.
