444611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
444611.value: The project for which I seek GRF funding is a book I have been contemplating for several years on the influence of Reformation ideas on Shakespeare. I have published some peer-reviewed essays on this topic and look forward to writing this book over the next three years. The study is structured as individual chapters focusing on key Reformation concepts such as predestination, conversion, free will, and Puritanism. Each chapter will examine the context of the relevant idea in Reformation thought and then discuss the ways that Shakespeare deployed the idea in selected plays. This is a topic I know well, and which has been the focus of my scholarly research while at The Chinese University of Hong Kong. There are, of course, many studies of Shakespeare and religion, in both essay and book form and dating back even further than the publication of Roland Frye's Shakespeare and Christian Doctrine in 1963. However, much of this work involves historical research that attempts to determine William Shakespeare's personal religious background, or politically-focused work that explores Shakespeare's reactions to hotly contested religious issues of the day. My approach is somewhat different, focusing on what I consider to be the revolutionary psychology of Reformation thought and the ways in which people crafted a sense of personal and social identity within it. Unlike other scholars who explore such issues in relation to a wider range of authors, I plan to concentrate on Shakespeare in this study, with the aim of explaining how Reformation ideas provided inspirational subject matter to a great artist. The project I am proposing is especially pertinent in the light of an upsurge, over the past decade, in book-length studies of the English Reformation that aim to integrate highly detailed awareness of sixteenth- and seventeenth- century theological matters with close readings of canonical literary texts written during this epoch. Nonetheless, while a wide range of English Renaissances authors are addressed in these works, there is as yet no full-length study detailing the influence of the Protestant Reformation on Shakespeare. Indeed, the most recent full-length studies of Shakespeare and religion all focus on the influence of pre-Reformation, Catholic, thought in his work. Focusing on the Reformation context of Shakespeare can provide a useful supplement to such studies as well as a foundation for other scholars to study Shakespeare, and his contemporaries, in the light of Reformation thought. 我申請優配研究金(GRF)的撥款來用作於我的研究項目: 出版一本書關於｢基督教的宗教改革對莎士比亞的影響｣｡ 我將會以個別章節續一地、集中地探研那些重要的改革概念上，例如: 宿命论、宗教轉換、自由意志、清教｡ 每章節只會探討一個主題，例如，第一章會探討｢宿命论｣，形式會先探討宗教改革內相關的思想背景，繼而討論這些宗教改革對莎士比亞在已選的劇本上部署思想的方法有何影響｡ 現今，己有許多關於莎士比亞與宗教的文章和書本｡ 有些著作，比一九六三年出版的 “Roland Frye’s Shakespeare and Christian Doctrine” 著作還要早｡ 不過，大部份的著作都涉及歷史研究來試圖定奪威廉 • 莎士比亞本人的宗教、或是專注於政治的著作來探討莎士比亞對於激烈地爭辯的宗教事議上的反應｡ 在某程度上，我的探討方法與之有別，第一，我將研究焦點放在基督教的宗教改革如何創新了人們對個人和社會的認同; 第二，其他的學者多於在其作品上廣泛地研究多於一位作家，而我的著作將會全神貫注於莎士比亞這位劇作家身上，目的在闡明基督教的宗教改革有何影響、如何為這位偉大的藝術家在其作品上帶來靈感和鼓舞性的題材｡ 我所建議的研究項目是有急切性需要的｡ 在過去的十年裡，那些詳盡而有關於英國宗教改革的著作都旨在高度詳細地綜合對十六及十七世紀的神學與文藝的認知｡ 很多學者探研英國文藝復興作家，但並沒有詳盡地研究基督教的宗教改革對莎士比亞的影響｡ 其實，在近其詳盡的莎士比亞與宗教的研究中，都是集中於改革前和天主教的思想對莎士比亞寫作的影響｡ 我的研究項目將焦點放在基督教的宗教改革對莎士比亞的影響能提供一個有用的補充資料給此類的著作，而且，也可成為一個基礎有助其他學者研究莎士比亞及与其當代有關的宗教改革｡

444611.label: Major findings and research outcome
444611.value: Major findings, as conveyed in the published essays and forthcoming monograph, aim to produce an impact both on the current state of understanding of two significant fields: Reformation theology and Shakespearean drama. Specifically, this research refines current understanding of Reformation psychology by emphasizing such ideas as the minimal differences between ‘elect’ and ‘reprobate’ in terms of their (almost equivalent) degree of sinfulness and highlighting the tension, generally not resolvable by the Reformers, between a ‘double predestination’ theology and the insistence, on the part of Reformers, that God not be considered ‘the author of sin.’ In terms of Shakespearean drama, this research aims to provide evidence for its major claims relating to the influence of early Reformation theological ideas on Shakespeare’s work. In some cases, particularly in terms of Shakespeare’s suggestion that powerful erotic desire is the primary sign of ‘election,’ Shakespeare takes the Protestant theology of his day in surprising new directions.

444611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
444611.value: There are numerous points of departure for future research. I will be looking next at the ways in which Shakespeare uses pre-Christian settings in his works to work out his ideas of how Christian (specifically Protestant) theological principles took form in the eras before the advent of Christianity.

444611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
444611.value: This research aims to cover new ground both in terms of the history of theology (refining the nature of formulations of Protestant Reformation conceptions of human psychology that developed in the sixteenth century) and literary study (showing how Shakespeare uses the revolutionary new ideas of the Protestant Reformation) to generate his own unprecedented conceptions of human nature and its interactions with the divine. Shakespeare’s power as a dramatist emerges largely from his sustained effort to deal with the most fundamental early Protestant paradox: how people can attain spiritual goals, given their infinite capacity for sin.

444711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
444711.value: Architectural education in China has a unique position in the world because of its intricate historical development. The formal professional education of architects has been practiced in China for almost 90 years now. In the mid 1920s, the Paris-based Beaux-Arts education was transplanted into China by the first generation of Chinese overseas students. Up to the Liberation in 1949, some new programmes were established, which were based on the pedagogy of Modern Architecture, or the Bauhaus model. However, the transition from the Beaux-Arts to the Bauhaus did not happen due to the inclination toward Soviet Union in the 1950s. A unified system was implemented based on the Beaux-Arts model for the whole nation, which pushed China away from the main stream of architectural education until the 1980s. A formal professional education system was eventually introduced in the beginning of 1990s. The dramatic expansion of student enrollment and the opening of new schools have turned the previous elite education into a mass production of professional architects. This, together with other factors such as new interest in space and tectonics, globalization, the commercialization of design market, and the redesign of educational system, signify that architectural education in China is right at a turning point of its historical development. The today’s overwhelmed economy makes China a hottest spot in the world for architecture. Architects and scholars from all of the world come to China to sell their designs and theories. Accordingly, there is a growing curiosity on architectural education in China—the type of education behind those who have designed our cities and buildings today. However, there seems not a single work we can really refer to. The study on architectural education in China so far is mainly treated as a historical subject concentrated on the first half of the 20th century unfolded around a few personalities and schools. In contrast, the proposed study is a comprehensive and thorough investigation on architectural education in China with an intention to establish a holistic view on its historical origins, characteristics, and evolution. It will address particularly on the development in the last 30 years to identify its achievements, problems, and challenges, and to project its future directions. This will be the first formal investigation on the subject, and will fill in a knowledge gap in the understanding of architectural education in China. 中國建築教育由於它的曲折發展而在世界建築教育中據有獨特的地位。建築學正規教育已經在中國實施了近90年。在上個世紀20年代，中國的第一代留學生將巴黎美術學院的建築教育模式移植到中國，到1949年前開始出現一些以包豪斯和現代建築為理念的建築學校，但是這一轉變的趨勢因解放後舉國學習蘇聯而受到壓制。相反，巴黎美術學院成為全國唯一的建築教育模式，這使得中國的建築教育脫離了國際建築教育發展的主流。文化大革命以後，中國建築教育發生了一系列的巨大變化，1990年代初開始建立建築師的職業教育體系，而學生人數和新辦學校的急速增長使得原先的精英式教育轉化為職業建築師的大批量生產。以上因素，再連帶全球化、設計市場的商業化、設計觀念的轉變、以及重新設計職業教育制度等，使得中國建築教育正處在一個歷史的轉折點。 當今的中國受經濟因素的催谷而成為全球最受關注的建築設計市場，外國建築師和學者紛紛來到中國推銷他們的設計和理念，伴隨其來的是對中國建築教育的關注——對導致我們今天的城市和建築的獨特教育制度的認識。然而，我們發現在這方面完全沒有可以參考的文獻。目前的中國建築教育研究基本上是一個以上個世紀的上半葉為重點、圍繞幾個關鍵人物和學校來展開的歷史學研究。而本研究計畫將是一個對中國建築教育的全面檢視，探究其源源、把握其歷史演變的脈絡、以及描述其基本的特點。本項研究將特別關注中國建築教育最近30年的發展，其所取得的成就、存在的問題、面臨的挑戰，以及將來的發展方向。這項研究將填補關於中國建築教育的知識空白。

444711.label: Realisation of objectives
444711.value: Chinese architectural education as a research field is rather new, about 30 years history since the mid of 1980s and only attracting more attentions in recent years. The current state of research in this field reveals three major issues. First, it is mainly treated as a historic study by historians. Second, it focuses only on singular topics such as the Beaux-Arts or biographies of pioneer educators. Third, it does not address contemporary issues. With this background, the primary task of this project is to build up a theoretic model to describe the unique and complex development of Chinese architectural education. To a great extent, the project has accomplished this task. In view of project objectives as per original application, all the points have been addressed with various degrees. For the first point, “the holistic view” was built upon a broad survey of the historical development of Chinese architectural education from its origin to the present, with a special focus on the development after 1949. For the second point, the complexity of Chinese architectural education has been presented as an interwoven of four identical forces as the Beaux-Arts, Polytechnique, Modernism, and university. For the third point, the current state of architectural education in China has been described as a consequence of these four forces. For the fourth point, the study has also addressed the current challenges in Chinese architectural education such as the monotony of design teaching, the influence of academic research, etc. For the fifth point, the good practice of architectural education has been promoted through case studies of programmes. For the last point, the future possible directions has been dealt as the conclusion of the whole study. Research activities involved in this study were mainly literature review, school visits, interviews, analysis and synthesis. To highlight, the PI has visited 15 schools covering almost all the important architectural schools in China and conducted 25 interviews mainly at Southeast University. The research findings were disseminated through guest lectures, conferences, paper publications, book writing, and guest editor of journal special issue on architectural education. The only under-achieved item is the book writing, which has been contracted with China Architecture and Building Press, but still work in progress with expected publication in early or mid 2016. The main reason of delay is due to the progress of three Ph.D students’ works.

444711.label: Major findings and research outcome
444711.value: The research outcomes have been achieved: 3 journal papers (1 published, 2 accepted), 1 book chapter (publication in process), 4 international and national conference presentations, 3 invited public lectures at prestigious schools , 5 research students trained (completed and in progress), 1 journal special issue as the guest editor, and 1 book contracted. The collaboration with Prof. Shan Yong of SEU has made a big step in the study of history of this oldest and most influential architectural school in China, also the key case study of the project. We have conducted extensive archive researches and interviews. Research findings from this study is mainly reflected in two master theses from SEU, Wang Yanze’s work (2014) focuses on the history of the school from 1949 to 1966 and Liu Xuechao’s work (2014) focuses on the whole nation in the same period. Wu Jiawei’s thesis topic is about SEU-ETH exchange program and its impact on China. All these research findings also provided materials for other writings. During this period, the PI also joined SEU’s research project about Prof. Zhong Xunzheng’s academic achievement (2015, not listed in this report). The PI’s previous knowledge on Chinese architectural education is limited to the Beaux-Arts model. To overcome this single sided view, the model of four forces is conceived to describe the complex development of Chinese architectural education in four key words: Beaux-Arts, Polytechnique, modernism and university. The PI’s understanding about the Beaux-Arts has been further deepened, which is reflected in book chapter “Do we have chances to become T.P.Yang?” (2013), conference presentations “Style versus Method” (2012) and “The Studio Timetable” (2012), and lecture “The Beaux-Arts and beyond” (2013). We are the first in China to point out the importance of the Polytechnic model and the transformation from the Beaux-Arts to Modern Architecture. Two Ph.D students, Han Ruyi and Zhang Yiwei have been involved in the study of these two issues as their dissertation topics. The PI also realised the impact of “university” on the development of Chinese architectural education, turning a professional training into a university subject. The interwoven relationship of these four forces in shaping the current state of Chinese architectural education has been explored through journal articles “The Essence of Architectural Education” (2012), “Beaux-Arts, Polytechnique and University” (2015), and “Beaux-Arts — Modern” (2015), and lecture “Chinese Architectural Education—Its origin, evolution and challenge” (2014).

444711.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
444711.value: Architectural education in China has a unique position in the world because of its intricate historical development. It was imported from the western countries in the early 20th century, developed following a particular trajectory in its 90 years history and is reaching a turning point in the new century. What are the origins of Chinese architectural education? What are the major driving forces in shaping the current state of Chinese architectural education? What are the challenges we are facing today? And how to describe the complex development of Chinese architectural education? All these questions are explored through a proposed theoretic model of four forces: the Beaux-Arts model, the Polytechnique model, the transformation from Beaux-Arts to Modern Architecture, and the impact of University to turn architectural education into an academic subject. Each aspect is dealt in great depth and all together form a complex picture of Chinese architectural education.

445411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
445411.value: Several recent studies of historical local society in China have drawn attention to the wealth of documentation available on Ji’an prefecture in Jiangxi province. Much of that relates to the Yuan and Ming dynasties. The abundance of documents on that period in Ji’an can help to fill an important gap in the history of local society in China. Studies conducted in the Pearl River delta in Guangdong have demonstrated that a shift in village structure occurred in the middle years of the Ming dynasty, during which time lineage sacrifice in an ancestral hall came to be the focus of much village organisation. In contrast, in Putian, Fujian province, it was the territorial temple which remained the dominant village establishment. It is unlikely that the Pearl River delta Ming dynasty pattern had evolved from the Putian model of territorial temples. Current research, and my own brief experience in Ji’an, indicates that the Ji’an pattern was closer to the Pearl River delta’s, but lineages had evolved there from much earlier. In other words, not only did local institutions change over time, but they did according to identifiable patterns. In order to trace the successive patterns of village organisation, this project proposes to (1) locate villages in Ji’an in which during the Ming significant changes had been brought about in village organization; (2) to collect available data on all major institutions in the village (including but not necessarily restricted to schools, shrines, temples, and ancestral halls); (3) to collate documents available on the village institutions to compile chronologies of their development for individual villages; and (4) to compare the chronologies prepared for individual villages to reach generalisations that might apply to the entire Ji’an region. Previous research on the Ji’an region has concentrated on studying local institutions in isolation. This project is rooted firmly in the study of social institutions as they evolved, and will seek to explain how, through the Yuan and Ming periods, local society as a whole had changed. I hypothesize that the Ji’an documentation will demonstrate how the Pearl River delta’s emphasis on the lineage goes back to the Southern Song and Yuan, that the neo-Confucian efforts in building academies was more closely tied to ancestral sacrifice in designated halls in this area, unlike Putian, where state recognition of local temple cults gave the temples more prominence than the lineages. 近年來研究中國地方社會的學者都注意到吉安府留存了豐富的歷史材料，其中不少材料都涉及元明時期。這些豐富的元明時期的材料可以填補中國社會史研究的一項重要的缺失。 珠江三角洲的研究顯示明中葉的禮儀改革徹底改變了珠江三角洲的社會，因為家廟作為一種制度得以普及，家廟形式的祠堂逐漸發展為鄉村社會的核心。與珠江三角洲相比較，不論在祠堂建構，或是在地方管理層面，福建莆田社會都更加突出神明祭祀的形式。可以說，在莆田，神明的拜祭系統是核心，宗族為次。科大衛、劉志偉、蕭鳳霞把珠江三角洲與莆田江口平原在地區社會結構與形態上的分歧，歸咎於兩個區域與王朝整合的時間和過程有所不同：莆田于南宋開始整合進入王朝的禮儀，而在珠江三角洲，宋王朝的影響非常有限，因為珠江三角洲的大部分地區是明代才整合在國家體系之內的。莆田的社會形態體現南宋朝廷以敕封地方神明作為歸化地方的重要手段，而到了明代，莆田的宗族制度是建立在這個基礎之上。明朝廷推行的戶籍登記以及明中後期敬宗收族的風氣則成功地奠定了珠江三角洲宗族形態的基礎。兩者之別，源于地方與王朝建立關係的時間不同，以及關係建立時，王朝歸納邊緣地區的政策。從現有的研究以及我對於吉安的初步田野可見，吉安的模式更接近與珠江三角洲，但是在吉安當地人建構宗族的時間比珠江三角洲早得多。 誠然，地方制度在不同的時空會會呈現出不同的樣態，但是，地方制度也是在一個可以確定的維度上的演變。為了追溯地方中各種機制的發展脈絡，本專案希望開展以下幾項工作：首先，在吉安確定一些仍保留著明代或者更早期的禮儀痕跡的鄉村；第二，收集這些鄉村中所有地方制度的材料，其中當然包括學校、神壇、廟宇以及祠堂等等；第三，整理與比堪收集到的材料，編輯出各個鄉村地方制度演變的年表；第四，將不同鄉村的年表進行比較，在此基礎上建立對於吉安鄉村社會整體性的解釋。 以往對於吉安社會得研究主要集中於個別制度的孤立研究，本項目則著重探討在演變中的社會制度，試圖解釋元明之際地方社會的整體轉變。我假設，吉安的材料將展現出類似於珠江三角洲的以宗族作為鄉村核心的社會如何發展；與珠江三角洲不同的是，這裏的歷史可以追溯到宋元時期，此時新一代的儒家正開始建立以讀書人的禮儀與生活方式為正統的嘗試。

445411.label: Realisation of objectives
445411.value: I think I achieved the objectives I set out for this project. (1) I identified quite a number of villages in Jiangxi that dated from and even before the early Ming. (2) I collected quite a lot of local documentation from those villages, including many genealogies and stele inscriptions from the temples. Some of those were copied directly by myself in the field, and some of them, thanks to the funding made available in this project, were copied for me by my associates in Jiangxi. There were also genealogies available on the web, but copying from them would have taken an undue amount of time if not for the help of assistants hired through this project. I also built up good connections with Nanchang University, Jiangxi Normal University and the county museums. Thanks to them, I not only succeeded in contacting village people, but also had access to the increasing number of publications they are now producing out of their collections of texts and inscriptions. (3) I did, indeed, produce chronologies of institutional changes in individual villages. Some of those, connected with the Ouyang surname, I am publishing in an article that has been accepted by Xin shixue. I was fortunate also to locate some very important texts on the Tiandihui secret society in Jiangxi pertaining to the Qing dynasty and they contributed to another paper which is being published in Frontiers of History in China. (4) Objectives listed out as (1) to (3) in the proposal were preliminary to this paragraph. They were all meant to contribute to generalisations applicable to the Ji’an region. I shall elaborate on what they might be under “research outcome”, but I can say that, again, thanks to funding made available, it has been possible for me to generate ideas towards this objective through conference papers and participation in scholarly discussions. The Tiandihui paper came out of participation in a conference on secret societies in the University of Macau, and, there, exchanging ideas and learning from established scholars on the history of Chinese secret societies, I realized that this work is leading to a view of Chinese society that they had not yet exploited. Chinese historians still take institutions to be real, but the secret society, like the lineage, belonged more to the “imagined” community. Out of the “imagined” communities, real consequences followed (people found guilty of being members of secret societies were executed, whether or not those societies were real). I also found very valuable participation in a conference at the Osaka Muesum of Ethnology, where I met not only Japanese scholars on the Chinese lineage but also Chinese anthropologists and ethnographers working on similar themes. I contritued a co-written paper that drew on the Ouyang lineage research and that is being published. I found particularly useful participation in the Eurasia Trajeco Conferences organized by the Ecole des Hautes Etudes en Sciences Sociales in Paris and Florence. I have attended their annual meetings for three consecutive years and found it very beneficial to have to present my work not with a Jiangxi focus, but in a way to bring the Jiangxi lineage history results to bear on the history of the sixteenth and then the eighteenth century in China. The conference is attended not only by China historians, but also by historians of Europe and the Middle East who have an interest in comparative business history. It is quite expensive to attend conferences in Europe and I don’t think I would be able to do that without the grant.

445411.label: Major findings and research outcome
445411.value: I think my major findings in this research falls into two groups. (1) I learnt how important the written genealogy became in the Song dynasty and that made an impact on local society. My paper now to appear in Xin shixue traces that history. In that paper, I show that the accident of Ouyang Xiu’s burial of his mother back in his home village led to his writing a genealogy which became famous as a style of genealogy writing. It also became a tool for local descent groups to build linkages among themselves. Linkages among descent groups so established came to be integrated with common rituals out of which came the ancestral hall and the holding of common property. In other words, the process described by Maurice Freedman, whereby local lineages linked up to form intermediate lineages and then clans is reversed in the longer term from the Song dynasty to the early Qing. The idea of a common ancestry that might be established through a written genealogy was in place before the institutions for common sacrifice were prevalent. (2) I also learnt that the common acceptance of bonds and networks beyond the local community could only be made possible with the connivance, or even collusion, of the officialdom. While working on this project, I came across documents related to the Tiandi hui in Jiangxi province and with the collaboration of Professor David Faure produced a paper to demonstrate that institutions that were commonly thought to span local communities could be presumed by local people even when they knew that the institutional claims were dubious. The presumption of lineage unity that was founded on written genealogies belonged very much to a similar framework of presumptive reality. Lineage members who subscribe to written genealogies have to, at least, accept that the written records were, in parts, authentic, in order to build on them the emotional and ritual bonds that might lead to common activities, including the holding of property. This discovery is central to the book that I am writing on my Jiangxi research, as I shall explain in the next paragraph.

445411.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
445411.value: I had always wanted to write a book out of the research that went into this project. I am well into the fourth chapter and intend to complete the book next year. The book addresses issued raised by three established scholars in the field: Robert Hymes, John Dardess and Anne Gerritsen. In answer to their work, I am showing that it was only by the Song that a local written geography was coming into place. Family groups adopting the written genealogy found that the written convention intervened in their on-going practice of naming. It was this particular problem that Ouyang Xiu’s genealogy provided a solution for, but the solution also increased the chances of finding famous ancestors in history. By the Yuan, writing genealogies and finding famous ancestors became an industry: some writers became very good at it. Those were the practices that transformed the Ming dynasty lijia registration households into lineages. Those ideas and practices were applied in the building of local society. The temple emerged as a focal point of local society in the Song, and the Confucian attack which led to the late Ming radical He Xinyin idealistic rendition of the lineage local society.

445411.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
445411.value: It is often thought that Chinese people have practiced ancestral sacrifice and maintained genealogies from time immemorial. In recent years, historians of the lineage have discovered that the involvement of common people (as different from aristocrats) in tracing ancestors to many generations back was relatively recent. In most parts of China, that practice did not precede the Ming dynasty, although in some parts of China, from the Song. The work that comes out of this project shows that the Song origin of the practice of writing genealogies was crucial in this history. The written genealogy transformed the naming of members of the lineage and ritual practices. It made it possible for local groups tracking descent to build genealogical linkages so that they might appear to be parts of bigger lineages. Ideas of such lineages, which spanned across different local groups, provided blue prints for social action, some of them leading to consequences that were considered to be contributive to social instability, such as He Xinyin’s version of the local lineage in the late Ming, or the Tiandihui’s version of the secret society in the nineteenth century.

445811.label: Project Objectives
445811.value: This project aims to examine the usage of Japanese compound verbs in contemporary Japanese. This project aims to find out the characteristics of the frequently-used CV and provide suggestions on the selection of CV for Japanese language education.

445811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
445811.value: Aim The aim of this project is to conduct research into Japanese compound verbs (CV), one of the most difficult items in Japanese language acquisition for many learners, from the perspective of linguistics and to examine how they are used in Japanese society. Project Background Japanese CV consist of two single verbs (V1 and V2) and there are about 2,500 CV combinations. The study of CV is very important because about 40% of Japanese verbs are CV. The variations of these combinations are confusing for Japanese language learners and are difficult to master. There is still no effective pedagogy to teach CV because there is no research on what kinds of CV are frequently used and thus should be accorded a high priority in teaching. This project aims to fill this gap by investigating how CV are used by Japanese native speakers. By analyzing the findings, this study will summarize the characteristics of frequently-used CV. Also this project will recommend a list of CV which should be introduced into Japanese language teaching. Brief Project Description This project will be divided into two stages. In the first stage (the first 12 months), the usage of CV in written materials will be examined. These include Japanese newspapers, magazines, Japanese language textbooks and the Japanese language corpus. A list of CV will be created and their frequency of usage will be calculated. In the second stage (13th–24th months), a questionnaire survey on the usage of CV by Japanese native speakers will be conducted. By summarizing the results, we will be able to know the current usage of CV in contemporary Japanese. Then, by analyzing these frequently-used CV, we will identify their characteristics and hence provide suggestions on how to teach them to non-native learners. Significance of Project The findings of this project will provide much-needed information and suggestions which will facilitate feasible planning of the future development of teaching of Japanese CV. Teaching materials of CV will be developed based on the project findings. Furthermore, Japanese teachers will benefit by using the project findings to design their own CV teaching plans. The findings will provide important information on the current trends of CV usage. This is a timely project, the findings of which will not only find immediate practical application for all Japanese language learners, but will also have important implications both for Japanese language teaching and Japanese linguistic research. 研究目的 本研究的目的是從語言學的角度探討日語複合動詞在日本社會的運用。對廣大日語學習者而言，複合動詞是日語學習過程中一個最困難的項目。 研究背景 日語複合動詞由兩個獨立動詞 (V1及V2) 組成，其數量達二千五百個左右，佔日語動詞整體的約四成，可見複合動詞的研究極具重要性。對日語學習者而言，複合動詞的組合之多令他們感到困惑而且難以掌握，所以複合動詞系統性的教學顯得特別重要，應受到日語教育界的高度重視。但關於甚麼性質的複合動詞才是常用的研究一直欠缺，至今仍無教授複合動詞的有效方法。本研究以填補這個缺口為目的，從調查入手，看母語為日語的人士使用複合動詞的情況。通過數據分析，歸納出常用複合動詞的特性，然後就日語教育課程中應該編入的一系列複合動詞提出建議。 研究概要 本研究分成兩個階段。第一階段 (頭十二個月) 會調查複合動詞在書面材料中的使用情況，根據調查結果製作一個複合動詞列表，並計算這些複合動詞的使用率。書面材料包括日語的報章、雜誌、教科書以及日語語言資料庫。第二階段 (第十三至第廿四個月) 會對母語為日語的人士進行問卷調查。總結數據後，就能得知複合動詞在現代日語中的使用情況。然後梳理出常用的複合動詞並對其進行分析，找出其特性，最後就如何向母語為非日語的學習者教授複合動詞這個問題提出有效的建議。 研究的重要性 本研究在日語教學與研究兩方面均具重要性。一，為日語教學者和學習者提供極爲實用而又方便的資料，幫助促進日語複合動詞教學在未來的發展。日語教學者可根據本研究的結果設計有效的教案，在教學上因而受惠。此外，在研發複合動詞方面的教材亦可得其助一臂之力。二，就現今複合動詞的使用趨勢提供重要的資訊，為日語語言學研究領域帶來前無先行者的研究專題，在研究領域有不可忽視的重要意義。

445811.label: Realisation of objectives
445811.value: For the first objective, this project has examined the usage of Japanese compound verbs by studying various contemporary written Japanese language materials, namely, large-scale written Japanese language corpus BCCWJ "Chûnagon", 141 copies of primary, secondary and high school Japanese language "Kokugo" textbooks, and 140 copies of current-affairs magazine "AERA". By examining the above materials in details, we have successfully identified the usage of Japanese compound verbs according to their frequency of usage. We have created lists showing their ranking (Top 200) of frequency of usage for language corpus BCCWJ "Chûnagon", "Kokugo" textbook and "AERA" respectively. These ranking cover a wide range of Japanese compound verbs which are used by native speakers of Japanese in their daily life. In addition, it is also significant to know how these compound verbs are actually used in various contexts before the discussion of pedagogy and teaching material development, this project also examined the lexical collocation of compound verbs in sentences. We have examined the lexical collocation for each compound verb in the top 200 included in corpus BCCWJ "Chûnagon". The lexical collocation information collected provide information on how compound verbs combine with other lexicon like particles, adverbs, onomatopoeia to form sentence. For the second objective, in order to find out the characteristics of the frequently-used Japanese compound verbs, this project has further examined the lists showing the top 200 compound verbs included in language corpus BCCWJ "Chûnagon" and "Kokugo" textbook respectively. As a result, 84 compound verbs are identified as common members which appeared in both set of materials and they should be considered as the most commonly used compound verbs by native speakers of Japanese. By examining these compound verbs, we have summarized the V1 - V2 characteristics of these compound verbs. Since it is impossible to teach all compound verbs in class due to limitation of time, we suggest that the most commonly used compound verbs, namely the 84 compound verbs identified in this project can be considered as those should be taught with high priority. In conclusion, the two objectives stated have been achieved based on the above report.

445811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
445811.value: The potential for further development of this project and the proposed course of action are summarized as below. 1. Usage of Japanese compound verbs in spoken Japanese language Since only written Japanese language materials have been examined in this project, all the findings in this project refer to written language. However, spoken language also play an important role in the real world. In other words, it is necessary for us to examine the usage of compound verbs in Japanese spoken language. With the advancement of technology, there is large-scale language corpus for spoken Japanese language developed by National Institute for Japanese Language and Linguistics, which is available recently. By using this kind of corpus, we can examine the usage and frequency of usage of those compound verbs in contemporary spoken Japanese language. 2. Development of teaching materials Since the findings of this project has provided many significant data and information on the usage of compound verbs, we can move forward to develop new teaching materials which is appropriate for the teaching of compound verb. The main focus should be on introducing the most commonly used compound verbs and their structure to students.

445811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
445811.value: This project has successfully identified those most commonly used compound verbs in Japanese language by using various written Japanese language materials such as corpus, Japanese language textbook used by primary, secondary and high school students in Japan. Compound verbs are widely used in contemporary Japanese language and they have a large group of members. However, Japanese compound verbs are very difficult for most of the Japanese learners to acquire. Therefore they have been receiving less attention in the Japanese language education due to limited amount of teaching hour. Teachers are not willing to study and find out what kinds of compound verbs should be taught in class. As a result, many learners gradually fail to acquire compound verbs and they are not able to use them even though they have attained a high level of Japanese language ability. The findings of this project show that what those most commonly used compound verbs are. On the other hand, findings of this project also reveal the characteristics of these compound verbs and how they are used in different context. Teachers can apply the findings to develop appropriate teaching materials according to their own teaching plan.

446111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
446111.value: When a multinational firm (MNF) designs and operates its global supply chains across multiple countries, the tariff and tax systems of these countries often affect the global firm’s supply chain decisions strategically and in highly complex ways. Yet, the supply chain management literature has traditionally focused on factors such as market demands and production/distribution costs; rarely has international taxation been treated as a strategic issue in the global supply chain management research. This project will attempt to fill this gap by studying an MNF’s supply chain decisions under a so-called “territorial tax system”. The territorial tax system is adopted by some countries and regions in the world such as Hong Kong, France and Malaysia. Under such a tax system, all of the global firm’s foreign incomes are not subject to additional tax in its home country. Thus, the MNF’s worldwide after-tax profits are the aggregate of the after-tax profits from the firm’s individual subsidiaries located in different countries. The proposed project is motivated by our observations at many Hong Kong-based MNFs with subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Mainland China. For these firms, tax issues have become one of the most important factors when they make supply chain decisions across the border. We will consider a global firm with two subsidiaries, one in its home country and another located in a different tax jurisdiction (or a foreign country). Both subsidiaries produce a single product to meet stochastic demands in both countries. The objective of the global firm is to maximize its expected annual worldwide after-tax profits through supply chain decisions at both subsidiaries over a multi-period planning horizon. The proposed research will characterize the optimal supply chain decisions under a number of global supply chain structures. These optimal supply chain policies will then be compared with those under the traditional cost-minimization or (before-tax) profit-maximization objectives. The expected outcomes of the proposed project are expected to enrich the existing supply chain management literature. For example, the models we propose will be the first among the multi-period inventory management problems under uncertainties to consider the impacts of tax. In addition, we expect to derive fresh managerial insights on how tax will impact a global firm’s supply chain decisions across different divisions and under what business environments such impacts will be the greatest. These expected managerial insights will be especially beneficial to Hong Kong-based MNFs who are operating under a territorial tax regime. 当跨国公司在设计和运作其全球供应链时，各国的关税及税收系统经常会对公司的供应链决策产生非常复杂的战略性影响。然而，传统供应链文献集中于对诸如市场需求，制造、分销成本的讨论，很少将国际税收作为全球供应链管理研究中的一个战略决策进行讨论。本项目旨在通过研究区域(territorial)税收系统下的跨国公司供应链决策来填补该项空白。区域税收系统被世界上的一些国家和地区，如香港，法国和马来西亚所采纳。在该系统下，跨国公司的海外收入不需要在其母国承担额外的税负。因此，跨国公司的全球税后总利润等于其各国子公司的税后利润的加和。本研究项目是通过观察在香港和中国大陆拥有子公司的香港跨国公司而提出的。对于这些公司来说，税收已经成为其在进行跨境供应链决策时考虑的重要因素之一。我们考虑一家拥有两家子公司的跨国公司，一子公司在其母国，另一子公司处于另一个不同的税收管辖区域（或者国外）。两家子公司均通过生产单一产品来满足两国市场的随机需求。跨国公司通过分公司多期供应链的决策来最大化其全球年度税后期望利润。本研究将描述一系列全球供应链接构下的最优供应链决策。并将这些最优决策与传统的以成本最小化或者（税前）利润最大化为目标的最优决策进行比较。本项目研究成果将能丰富现有的供应链管理文献。我们提出的模型是不确定性下多期库存管理问题中首个考虑税收影响的。另外，我们期望在税收怎样对跨国公司各个部门的供应链决策产生影响，在何种环境下这种影响达到最大这些问题上得到全新的管理上的见解。这些见解将对在区域税收系统下运作的香港跨国公司大有裨益。

446111.label: Major findings and research outcome
446111.value: The project supported the research efforts leading to 3 research papers. The research outcomes of this project confirm the significance of tax-effective supply chain strategy, which integrates international tax planning and global supply chain decisions. Specifically, the project helped gaining the following major findings: (1) Under single-sourcing, single-market, multi-period setting, it finds that after-tax profit objective impacts a firm’s optimal inventory decisions in ways that are quite different from that of the traditional before-tax profit setting. For example, as profitability of a firm in a period increases, the firm may actually decide to keep less inventory—a behavior that is counter-intuitive in a traditional inventory management setting. (2) Under single-sourcing, dual-market, single-period setting, the sourcing strategies of a multinational firm can be significantly affected by a tax-refund scheme in China.

446111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
446111.value: The research completed in this project suggests that there is a high potential of research in the area of tax-effective supply chain management which connects operations and taxation issues.

446111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
446111.value: The research outcomes of this project suggest that tax-effective supply chain strategy, which integrates international tax planning and global supply chain decisions, can play a significant role in a multinational company’s global business strategy. Specifically, the project finds that with consideration of tax-savings, a multinational firm’s global operations decisions can be significantly different from that of the traditional before-tax profit maximization setting.

446211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
446211.value: We ask three questions in this proposal: (1) To what extent does trade contribute to the economic growth of a developing economy? (2) To what extent does urbanization contribute to the economic growth of a developing economy? (3) How does the openness of a developing economy affect regional inequality and economic growth? The first two questions are popular topics in economics. However, the literature largely employs the reduced-form approach, and most structural studies focus on developed economies. In this proposal, we aim to develop a structural model that incorporates trade and rural-urban migration in a dynamic setting, and to quantify the model to answer the three research questions. In principle, one can answer the first two questions separately. However, in answering the third question, the simultaneous consideration of both trade and urbanization, including their interactions, is necessary. For a developing economy like China, the widening regional inequality against a backdrop of rapid growth raises concerns on how to achieve the optimal balance between regional inequality and economic growth. Trade and openness are important factors affecting both economic growth and regional inequality. As such, how will changes in the relative openness of the country’s different regions potentially affect regional inequality and economic growth? In particular, China’s coastal regions grow much faster than its inland regions. Will the increased openness of the inland regions hurt economic growth while reducing regional inequality? If yes, to what extent? The policy implications are largely different under two possible cases: a small decrease in growth rate coupled with a large decrease in regional inequality, and a large decrease in growth rate coupled with a small decrease in regional inequality. We develop a model that considers two views on trade and urbanization: (1) trade promotes economic growth by increasing access to large foreign markets, and (2) urbanization promotes growth by human capital spillover. The novelty of this proposal lies in the development of a dynamic Eaton–Kortum model which allows us to answer the three quantitative questions simultaneously using a structural approach. The models of trade and geography developed by Eaton and Kortum (2002) and Bernard, Eaton, Jenson, and Kortum (2003), hereafter BEJK, are extremely influential in the field of international trade. They are trade models that incorporate comparative advantages (a.k.a. Ricardian models), and their structures are highly flexible and tractable, making them suitable for quantitative analysis. N/A

446411.label: Project Title(Chinese)
446411.value: 注意力选择的实施算法

446411.label: Project Objectives
446411.value: The Appropriate Method for Studying the Algorithms of Attentional Selection The prime-test alternation method used in the pilot test will be refined to balance the frequencies of all of the items by adjusting their contrasts or exposure durations. Another irrelevant-region method will also be developed: Some items will appear in “irrelevant regions” and the “distracting effect” of these items will be used to assess the priority given to them based on the assumption that a item that is given higher priority will be more difficult to ignore and will thus produce a greater distracting effect (i.e., cost on response time). The Algorithm of Attention in Various Dimensions I will test several other features (color, orientation, shape, etc) in addition to size: (1) lightness—another clear one-dimensional organized feature; (2) colors—specifically, whether the algorithm of selecting colors is implemented upon selecting either one of the three components (i.e., red, green, or blue) or one of the primary categories (i.e., red, green, yellow, blue, purple, or cyan); (3) colors—specifically, whether selection of color can be implemented as a “direction” on the wheel of saturated colors; (4) orientation—specifically, whether the selection of orientation relies on two components (i.e., vertical vs. horizontal) or on one continuous wheel; (5) within-object configuration—specifically, whether the selection mechanism relies on the relation between the parts or only on matching to a template; and (6) digits (and other highly familiar simple patterns)—specifically, whether semantic analysis contributes significantly to the selection of such items. The Algorithm of Attention in Various Types of “Attentional Mode” Even if the observers attempt to select the same target in two physically identical displays, they could be primed (by previous trials) into different modes of attentional selection; for example, the distinction between (1) a singleton-detection mode and a feature-detection mode, (2) a “single-target search” mode and a “pattern selection” mode, and (3) a “parallel search for a large difference” mode and a “serial search for a fine difference” mode. I will test whether different algorithms are used to implement attentional selection in these different modes. The Algorithm of Attention in Spatial Selection I will test the algorithm of attention in relation to two specific questions. First, I will regard “location” as a feature, instructing the observers to attend to one of two locations and to ignore the other, and measure how the locations further along both directions are prioritized. Second, I will test how flexibly visual attention can be allocated to two isolated regions or to a holed region. The Algorithm of Attention in Across-Dimension Selection Previous studies have provided two theories on how multiple features can be used to jointly make a selection: (1) addition into one single salience map and (2) subset selections from dimension to dimension. This question will be studied by measuring the priority given to some items that share feature with the distractor in one dimension, but exaggerate the target feature in another dimension. How Long-term Practice affects the Algorithm of Attention The potential changes that can occur in relation to the algorithm of attentional selection after extended practice will be studied: (1) whether extended practice of selecting one feature and ignoring another feature makes the selection more specific to these features; (2) whether or not observers who are extensively trained on a few simple patterns rely more on template matching; and (3) whether the algorithm used for a conjunction task changes after extended practice.

446411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
446411.value: In the last three decades, visual attention has been one of the most active research areas in cognitive psychology and neuroscience. One important issue is the algorithm of its implementation; specifically, how the mechanism of attentional selection gives priority to different feature (or location) values to accomplish a selection. Naturally, to successfully accomplish a selection, the visual system has to give a higher priority to the to-be-selected feature than to the to-be-ignored feature. However, what remains unanswered is how the selection mechanism treats the other values beyond these explicitly defined features. For example, when selecting a 2-cm target and ignoring other 1-cm items, the selection mechanism will naturally give a higher priority to the value of 2 cm than to the value of 1 cm, but it is not clear what priority will be given to other feature values (e.g., 0.5 and 4 cm). There are several potential ways in which the visual system can implement a selection: (a) Distractor exclusion: specifically giving low priority to the ignored value (1 cm) and higher priority to all of the other three values (0.5, 2, and 4 cm); (b) Target inclusion: specifically giving high priority to the selected value (2 cm) and lower priority to all of the other three values (0.5, 1, and 4 cm); (c) Relation coding: giving priority to items in the order of the direction of selection (4, 2, 1, and 0.5 cm); and (d) Boolean mapping: using a cutoff point to divide the feature dimension into two sides, equally giving all values greater than this cutoff point (i.e., 2 and 4 cm) high priority and all values less than this cutoff point (i.e., 1 and 0.5 cm) low priority. In the present project, I will study which of these four algorithms is used to implement attentional selection in various situations. Pilot data suggest that attentional selection is implemented using the algorithm of Boolean mapping in a size-based selection task. I propose to adopt a six-objective approach to study this question systematically by exploring (1) the appropriate method to use for studying the algorithms of attentional selection, (2) the algorithm of attention in various dimensions, (3) the algorithm of attention in various types of “attentional mode”, (4) the algorithm of attention in spatial selection, (5) the algorithm of attention in across-dimension selection, and (6) how long-term practice affects the algorithm of attention. 过去30年，视觉注意是认知心理学和神经学中最活跃的领域之一。一个重要的问题是其实施的算法。具体来说，注意力选择的机制怎样给不同特征（或位置）优先度以完成选择。自然，为了成功完成选择，视觉系统必须给应被选择的特征比应被忽略的特征以更高的优先度。但是，选择机制怎样对待这些明确定义的特征之外的其他值则仍然有待回答。比如，当选择一个2厘米的目标而忽略其他1厘米的项目时，选择机制会自然的给2厘米这个值以比1厘米更高的优先度，但是尚不清楚其他特征值（比如0.5厘米和4厘米）会被给予什么优先度。视觉系统有几种潜在的方法来实施一个选择: （a） 排除干扰项：特别给应忽略的值（1厘米）以低优先级而所有其他三个值以高优先级（0.5，2，和4厘米）；（b）目标包含: 特别给应选择的值（2厘米）以高优先级而所有其他三个值以低优先级（0.5，1，和4厘米）；（c）关系编码: 按照选择的方向的顺序给优先级（4，2，1，0.5厘米）；以及（d）布尔映射：用一个切断点来将特征维度划分成两边，给所有高于切断点的值（也即，2和4厘米）高优先级而所有低于切断点的值（也即，1和0.5厘米）低优先级。在当前的项目中，我会研究在各种情形下这四种算法中的哪种被用来实施注意选择。预数据表明在尺寸为基础的一个选择任务中注意选择用布尔映射的算法实施。我提出系统的探索这个问题，具体完成以下六个目标：（1）用来研究注意选择算法的合适方法，（2）在各种维度中注意的算法，（3）在各种“注意状态”中注意的算法。（4）空间选择中注意的算法。（5）跨维度选择中注意的算法。（6）长期练习怎样改变注意的算法。

446411.label: Realisation of objectives
446411.value: All the experiments described in the original objectives have been successfully completed. Some of them have produced clear and publishable results. And some of them have led to new experiments and new findings. For the first objective, I have tested beyond the original plan to find out what is the best way of studying the algorithms of attentional selection. It turned out that the threshold measures gives much higher reliability than response time (and RT slope) does, even if the latter has actually become more popular than the former in the more recent literature of visual attention. Therefore, I have adopted the latter and try to give a very systematic study of the various aspects of the algorithm of attentional selection. This sets up foundation for the follow-up tests. For the objective 2-6, I have tested the algorithm of attention in various dimensions, in various types of attentional mode, in spatial vs. featural selection, in across-dimension selection, and how it is affected by long-term practice. I have also studied the interaction between some of them, depending on the results of pilot test. What turns out to be the most interesting is a line of study studying the interaction between featural dimensions (i.e., original objective 2) and task (i.e., part of the original objective 3). As part of objective 3, I conducted one set of experiments comparing the attentional mode when selecting a heterogeneous set and when selecting a single object, and found that, despite the popular beliefs in the field, their attentional demands are similar to each other. As part of objective 4, I conducted one set of experiments comparing spatial vs. featural selection in the case of perceptual grouping and the results revealed some fundamental difference between them. The experiments on objective 5 (across-dimension selection) and objective 6 (long-term practice) did not reveal anything that are substantial and new. Please see the section 6.1 for details of the new findings.

446411.label: Major findings and research outcome
446411.value: First, the most interesting finding is a line of experiments studying the interaction between featural dimensions (i.e., original objective 2) and task (i.e., part of the original objective 3). This leads to 3 published papers. Here, I tried to ask whether featural dimensions (e.g., color, orientation, shape, and size) the general building blocks across various tasks? In other words, are performances affected by the same “featural difference” in the same way in various tasks? For example, is it true that if the difference between one set of features is difficult to perceive (i.e., a subtle difference), then it will be difficult to find in a visual search task, and difficult to remember in a working memory task? The scientific report paper showed the distinction between featural strength (i.e., how well a certain type of signal is picked up by the feature detectors in the visual system) and visual strength (i.e., how strong the signal is. Next, the psychological science paper demonstrated that the role of spatial structure of the stimulus (i.e., Spatial strength) is another factor that is separable from the general “featural strength”. Finally, the cognition paper adopted an individual-item analysis approach and showed that these 3 factors (i.e., featural, visual, and spatial strengths) explained 96.4% of all the variances. As part of objective 3, I conducted one set of experiments comparing the attentional mode when selecting a heterogeneous set and when selecting a single object. In the present study, observers performed a color task and an orientation task, and the attention effect was measured as the advantage of pre-cueing one of the two tasks. The color and orientation tasks required participants to report either an object feature or the mean of a 4×4 array (i.e., statistical property). The precueing advantages were approximately equal regardless of the nature of the tasks (object features vs. statistical properties), providing evidence that statistical properties are not perceived with zero cost, but demand as much attention as object features. These results have been published in the PLOS one paper. As part of objective 4, I conducted one set of experiments comparing spatial vs. featural selection in the case of perceptual grouping. The results showed that for grouping by similarity, but not for low-level groupings (e.g., connectedness, common region), when two conflicting grouping cues are present, the grouping structure tended to be driven either by one type of cue or by the other type of cue and will usually not lead to the impression of “no grouping”. These results have been published in the Psychonomic Bulletin and Review paper.

446411.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
446411.value: Mostly, these projects have been conducted fairly completely and I do not intend to conduct a follow-up study in the immediate future. In the long run, it would worth testing how the 3 factors that have been identified (i.e., featural, visual and spatial strengths, see the cognition paper) can be applied to real-world situation. In the real world, the objects are not clearly defined and it would be important to re-define the features and the factors to capture the variances across all tasks.

446411.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
446411.value: Visual attention has been one of the most active research areas in cognitive psychology and cognitive neuroscience in the last three decades. One important issue is the algorithm of its implementation. I have tested various aspects of the algorithm of attention, and have made a few interesting findings. First, I studied the interaction between featural dimensions and task and tried to ask whether featural dimensions are the general building blocks across various tasks? The results revealed 3 factors: featural strength (i.e., how well a certain type of signal is picked up by the feature detectors in the visual system), visual strength (i.e., how strong the signal is) and spatial strength (the role of spatial structure of the stimulus) and showed that these 3 factors explained 96.4% of all the variances. Second, I compared the attentional mode when selecting a heterogeneous set and when selecting a single object, and showed that statistical properties demand as much attention as object features. Third, I compared spatial vs. featural selection in the case of perceptual grouping. The results showed that for grouping by similarity, but not for low-level groupings, two conflicting grouping cues lead to the dominance of one of them.

446611.label: Project Objectives
446611.value: To correct the omission of linguistics from postcolonial studies. To challenge the political desires of postcolonial studies. To challenge the philosophical presuppositions of postcolonial studies. To put postcolonial studies and the discourse of World Englishes in dialogue. 446611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
446611.value: English studies may seem in crisis, like the humanities generally, and yet more and more people from different cultures are adapting the English language to their own needs, and using it as a communicative and creative medium. This project situates postcolonial literary studies, seen as a cultural political project, in the context of the linguistic study of World Englishes. World Englishes could be understood as a kind of postcolonial linguistics, and its pronouncements on the dispersal of 'ownership' of English (and the 'death of the native speaker') have tended towards a political idealism for which postcolonial theory is itself often criticized. However, World Englishes as a discipline is increasingly moving away from political pronouncements towards macro- or micrological descriptive accounts of actual usage, as analyzed for example in corpus-based approaches or ethnographic cultural studies. While the shift in linguistics may seem to challenge the confidence of the literary postcolonial project, this project argues that an expansion in scope drawing in, and being transformed by, work from World Englishes offers a source of potential renewal for postcolonial studies. This is true in particular for postcolonial literary studies, but also for postcolonial studies in general. World Englishes as a term captures the sense in which the ownership of English has been widened by centuries of colonialism and postcolonialism. It also provides a powerful conceptual framework for the study of all facets of linguistic behaviour. Its underlying assumption is political, despite the fact that some in the field have attacked its politicization. Instead of making interdisciplinary gestures, this project actively embraces the assumptions and methods of linguistics, which can seem so alien to postcolonial critics more familiar with the paradigms of literary and cultural studies. The project will argue that despite superficial differences, the fields have much to offer each other, and share a political and philosophical paradigm premised on the desirability of difference as such. The work will further argue, however, for a balancing stress on sameness, which is, despite appearances, equally as political and philosophical as the valorization of difference. In making these arguments, the project does not side with one field or the other, instead exploring sites of productive similarity, difference, disagreement, and potential future development. Further, it argues that the study of postcolonial literature, which remains so pivotal to postcolonial studies, must progress through engagement with the empirical studies of language characteristic of World Englishes.

446611.label: Realisation of objectives
446611.value: To the extent that these objectives are achievable by any individual, they have all been addressed in the major research outcome (see below). Objective 5 has been perhaps the most problematic, in that writing a research monograph frequently takes the writer away from the practical implications of what is being discussed in order to focus most fully on the abstract or at least theoretical questions. Nonetheless, by focusing on particular case studies (such as Hong Kong and Singapore), the published research has made connections between the broad issues and practical realities for agents in the city, region, and beyond.

446611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
446611.value: Most directly, the research has been developed into work on a collection entitled 'The Future of English in Asia', co-edited by the PI, and to be published by Routledge in 2015. This collection will explore many implications of World Englishes throughout Asia. Meanwhile, and less directly, the research can be developed into discussion of literary studies generally, and World Literature in particular. For example, the circulation of translated fiction through the English language seems to be part of a problematic Anglophone cultural and political domination. There are many ways in which the demand for a kind of literary and cultural transparency, as well as consensus, is resisted, and the PI is already working on related issues through co-editing a collection on the Mozambican novelist Mia Couto.

446611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
446611.value: The most simple statement about the research is to say that we need to cease relying on a consensus-based concept of communication, if that is we are to recognise what is most interesting in the spread of the English language. The development of English into World Englishes requires us to think more about the vital role of dissensus in globalised communication. English's spread has not led to the forced consensus that many commentators fear, but instead enables a more forceful dissensus to develop.

447111.label: Project Objectives
447111.value: Understand the motivation for participation in Roscas and the interaction between Roscas and formal financial markets. Construct a theoretical model to analyze the economic agent’s optimal bidding behavior in a Rosca auction and Rosca’s performance. Test several representative theoretical predictions and analyze the performance of Roscas (by comparing different type of Roscas as well). Propose an optimal Rosca mechanism in a general setup where economic agents require mutual insurance against their privately known shock.

447111.label: Realisation of objectives
447111.value: The main challenging of the project at the first place is how to build a neat and reasonably simple model to deliver some important economic message, without involving too many mathematical derivations. It took about 1.5 years in for me to think through the theoretical properties of the Rocas when there is financial market. The bidding behavior in Rosca is non-trivial, which is not a standard auction that I can immediately recall the literature from auction. In fact, the Rosca bidding is much more than a standard auction in sevaral aspects. First, in Rosca bidding there is no ex ante "buyers" and "sellers," the roles of "sellers" (or "lenders") and "buyers" (or "borrowers") are determined endogenously. Second, in standard private value auctions a bidder cares about the bids of others only to the extent that the opponents' bids affect her probability of winning. By contrast, in Rosca bidding, the opponents' bid will affect the size of the pot in the subsequent periods and thus directly affect the bidder's continuation value even if she loses in the current period bidding. Third, because Rosca participants can access the formal credit market every period, in this model bidders' valuations are endogenously derived from the value function of an optimal consumption/saving problem. I tried very hard to investigate the possibility of having a model incorporate these features., by extending the model step by step. First, I consider a benchmark case without credit market. Second, I move to the other benchmark where credit market is perfect. Then, I consider the general case in the between. Finally, I consider the case where some social norm may help, even if credit market is perfect. This goal has been finally achieved. The second challenging is how to test the model using real data. I had countered difficulties in data collecting. It is very costly and time consuming. But finally, I have collected a considerable number of observations (not a big sample, but it is sufficient for our analysis). Then I need to simply the model even further to do some structural analysis. This process is also time-consuming and I had made substantial progress. The estimation and econometric analysis has not been fully completed yet (I already have a suitable model), but it can be finished in this year.

447111.label: Major findings and research outcome
447111.value: In this project, I develop a model under which risk-averse participants pool their privately known income shocks to investigate the interesting interactions between Roscas and the formal credit market. First I consider two benchmark cases, without access to the formal financial market or with a perfect credit market (no interest rate gap between borrowing and lending). In the first benchmark, it is shown that a bidding Rosca is ex ante welfare improving (but may not be interim individually rational) when the size is optimally chosen. In the second benchmark, we show that Rosca is not even ex ante beneficial. However, in the between, if there is an imperfect credit market with interest rate gap, a bidding Rosca is welfare improving (in a stronger sense, interim individually rational) because Rosca participants use both financial market and Rosca to smooth the shock. Therefore, the social welfare may not monotonically increase in terms of the perfectness of credit market. Finally, it is shown that a Rosca with some social norm could still be ex ante beneficial even if the interest rate gap disappears. The research uncovers two competing forces regarding the interaction between a Rosca and a formal financial market. On the one hand, the formal credit market may facilitate (rather than substitute) the participation of Rosca through smoothing the risk of losing a Rosca auction. On the other hand, the incentive compatibility constraint becomes more difficult to meet because it is harder to prevent the arbitrage incentives. We provide a comprehensive analysis of these two effects. Without access to any financial market, the benefit of Rosca is actually limited, because Rosca participants cannot smooth the risk of losing or winning a Rosca auction. With access to a perfect financial market, it becomes impossible to preserve the incentive compatibility to prevent the bidder from achieving arbitrage between Rosca and the formal financial market. However, in the case of an imperfect financial market, the interest rate gap serves as a natural self-discipline device to motivate the saver to bid a lower price. Because of this effect, the social welfare may be non-monotonic in the "perfectness" of the credit market. The complementarity between the Rosca and the credit market can be further enhanced if there is social norm that limits the no-shock bidder's opportunistic behavior. Under such social norm, Rocas can improve the social welfare, even if financial market is perfect.

447111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
447111.value: The main result has been wrapped up in a working paper "Rosca Meets Financial Market" which will be submitted to an esteemed journal soon. And there are several further research directions. The first is on the issue of default that has not been considered in the current research. The second is the portafolio of the Rosca, if we allow agents to participate more than one Rosca, then what is the optimal combination of them? Third, is it possible for a model financial sector/bank to organize Rosca, and improve the effeciency of the Rosca? In the next step, I will take some effort to investigate these questions.

447111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
447111.value: This research helps people to understand how human being can help with each other in an uncertain world with asymmetric information. On the one hand, people need help to smooth the risk, even if the loss of shock is only privately known. On the other hand, they are rational and may want to ask for more help (than what they should). A good mechanism should first provides the incentive for them to tell the truth. A bidding Rosca is one of such mechanism. More than that, Rosca may encounter the shock from the emergence of formal credit market, where people can alternatively save or lend money though a bank or other financial institutions. Are these new emerging financial opportunities always helpful? The answer is NO. This research shows that getting rid of some friction of financial market may inviates more opportunistic behavior and wape out the advantage of some local mutual-insurance arrangement like Rosca. And people may be worse off. It is more desirable to combine the formal credit market with Rosca, so that people can take advantage of both to improve their welfare.

447211.label: Project Objectives
447211.value: To examine whether corporate executives’ stock repurchase decisions are affected by their personal compensation contracts that are contingent on EPS performance.
rows: To examine whether corporate executives’ stock repurchase decisions are affected by their personal compensation contracts that are contingent on EPS performance.

447211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
447211.value: There is an obvious gap between theory and anecdotal evidence regarding the motivation for stock repurchases. Previous academic studies assert that signalling, mitigation of agency costs, and adjusting leverage are the primary motivations for stock repurchase decisions. However, anecdotal evidence shows that earnings per share (EPS) is one of the most important determinant of repurchase decisions. The reason executives attach such importance to EPS in their repurchase decisions is not well understood. We seek to address this gap in the literature by focusing on executive compensation packages. The aim of the proposed project is to examine whether corporate executives’ stock repurchase decisions are affected by their EPS performance-contingent personal compensation contracts. EPS is one of the most widely used measures of executive performance and stock buybacks can affect the denominator in the EPS calculation. We therefore argue that incentive compensation contracts in which EPS is one of the performance metrics provide executives with strong incentives to manage EPS via stock repurchases. We plan to test this conjecture by hand-collecting information on compensation contracts from the proxy statements of S&P500 firms from 2006 to 2010. The new executive compensation disclosure rule introduced in 2006 will allow us to avoid the selection bias problem encountered in most previous studies, which rely on voluntary disclosure of compensation information. The proposed project will provide new insight into the impact of EPS-contingent compensation contracts on stock repurchase decisions, and will yield evidence on whether executives opportunistically use repurchases to maximize their compensation at the expense of shareholders. 对于股票回购动机的理解，理论界和实务界存在着明显的差异。以前的学术研究表明，信号、减少代理成本以及调整财务杠杆都是股票回购的主要动机。然而，调查和实例研究表明，每股盈余才是股票回购决策中最重要的决定因素。虽然存在着差异，但每股盈余在回购决策中的作用却很少受到学术界的关注，同时管理层在回购决策中为何会给予每股盈余如此高的重视的原因也没有得到很好的解释。我们试图通过关注管理层的薪酬方案在股票回购决策中的作用来填补这个空缺。 这个项目的目的是要检验公司高管的股票回购决策是否会受到他们个人的与每股盈余息息相关的薪酬契约的影响。股票回购可以同时影响到每股盈余计算过程中的分子和分母。同时，每股盈余还是使用最广泛的用于评估高管业绩表现的指标之一。因此，我们认为，采用每股盈余作为业绩度量指标的激励薪酬契约，为管理层通过股票回购来实现对每股盈余的操纵，提供了强有力的激励。 为了检验这一猜想，我们计划从股东委托书中手工搜集标准普尔500公司从2006年到2010年的薪酬契约信息。而2006年出台的新的管理层薪酬披露规定也使我们得以避免在以往基于公司自愿披露薪酬信息的研究中出现的选择偏差问题。 这个项目将为我们理解基于每股盈余的薪酬契约对股票回购决策的影响提供了新的见解，同时也将为管理层是否通过投机性的股票回购以股东利益为代价来实现个人薪酬的最大化，提供了证据。

447411.value: To investigate Dai Wangshu’s poetic ideas based on neglected primary source material. To examine Dai’s view on war literature in relation to his literary perspective. To examine Dai’s perspective on Russian literature under the influence of French leftist intellectuals and his reflection on the dilemma between art and politics during wartime. To examine Dai’s view on war literature in relation to his literary perspective.

447411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
447411.value: Influenced by the latest aesthetic trends from the West, Chinese modernist literature, however, found itself nurtured in the Sino-Japanese War. The works of Dai Wangshu, a prominent modernist poet and translator of the time, provide us with an opportunity to look into the complexities of modernist practice in China. Most scholars prefer to emphasize Dai’s attachment to Western modernism and therefore confine their attention to his publications in Shanghai. This proposed project aims at carrying out extensive research into the body of work published during his exile in Hong Kong (1938-1949). Based on hitherto-neglected source materials, it will examine central issues concerning his views on poetry, his foreign influences and his reflection on the role literature in wartime politics. More specifically, the project will address the following key questions: 1. How did Dai Wangshu perceive “war literature” during the Sino-Japanese War? With reference to the European war literature he introduced to Hong Kong, how did he deal with the contradiction between pure aesthetics and ideological commitment in his writing and translation of war literature? 2. Why did Dai emphasize the poetic qualities of fiction he translated during wartime? How does this help us better understand his theory of poetry? 3. How did Dai develop his own interest in Russian literature under the influence of French leftist intellectuals? In what way did his perspective on Russian literature in Hong Kong differ from that in Shanghai? Through an intertextual analysis of 400 of Dai Wangshu’s works of translation, literary criticism and cultural criticism, the project will give weight to the historical environment in which his works appeared and to the cultural and ideological implications of his translations. Treating Dai as a wartime Chinese modernist, the project will extend the study scope of Chinese modernist writers by covering their works published in Hong Kong. It will also testify to the importance of Hong Kong in the development of Chinese modernist literature. Research on Dai Wangshu has been hampered by the relative inaccessibility of his Hong Kong output. During the course of the project, a large corpus of Dai’s undeservedly obscure work will be published and a searchable database relating to his oeuvre will be made freely available for the general public and the interested researcher thereby making a significant contribution to the field of study as well as to facilitate future work in comparative literary studies and translation studies. 本計劃重新整理戴望舒在港時期(1938-49)之創作、翻譯、文學評論及文化評論，探討戰爭下中國現代主義文學發展之複雜性。

447411.label: Realisation of objectives
447411.value: At the time of submission of this completion report, our research team has fully achieved the objectives of the project. The project aimed at carrying out research into the writings and translations of Dai Wangshu, published in Hong Kong during his exile (1938-1949). A book entitled “Dai Wangshu’s Literary Translations in Hong Kong during the Second Sino-Japanese War” has been published. It has compiled and edited Dai Wangshu’s translations published in Hong Kong during the wartime period, including those of André Malraux, Paul Morand, Jules Supervielle and David Garnett, which had never been compiled in Dai Wangshu’s Complete Works or any collection of his works. The PI has written a critical introduction regarding Dai Wangshu’s translations in Hong Kong and their significance. Making use of the hitherto-neglected source materials, we have investigated the poetic ideas he demonstrated in his writings and translated fiction. We have also examined his view on war literature in relation to his literary perspective, with reference to his translations of André Malraux and Alphonse Daudet’s works. Based on the findings of the research project, five peer-review journal papers have been or will be published and five conference papers have also been delivered. We have investigated Dai Wangshu’s translation and retranslation of the French modernist writer Paul Morand in the different historical context of two cities, Shanghai and Hong Kong. We have also examined Dai’s relay translation of Russian literature from the French, Vsevolod Ivanov’s Le Train Blindé Numéro 1469, in the particular Chinese context of the 1930s. An on-line multi-purpose search system, “Research Database of Chinese modernists’ Translations in the 1930s,” for the data of translations of Dai Wangshu and other modernist writers including Shi Zhecun, Ye Lingfeng, Liu Na’ou and Xu Xiacun has been established and made available to the public. (Please refer to URL: http://www.transchimodern.hk/) Given their strong attachment for foreign literature, both comprehensive and comparative studies of Chinese modernists must be founded on a concrete database of their translations. The project has laid a solid foundation for the long-term development of the study of Chinese modernists. It has extended the study scope of Dai Wangshu and other modernists by covering their works published in Hong Kong during the Second Sino-Japanese War. It has also enhanced the important role of Hong Kong in the development of Chinese modernist literature.
