To reconstruct major Protestant theological discourses in this period, highlighting their tensions and interactions, thus contributing to the understanding of church-state relations in China.

To evaluate how the theological discourses have interpreted Christian theological traditions for the present situation of China, thus contributing to the study and development of Chinese contextual theology.
To build up a comprehensive indexed database of articles in Nanjing Theological Review and Tian Feng, thus contributing to future research on Chinese Protestantism.

458411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
458411.value: China’s “reform and open-door” policy have brought tremendous social changes in the recent three decades, resulting in a “socialism with Chinese characteristics,” a combination of a totalistic party-state, state-led capitalistic market economy, and a hybrid mixture of both Western modernity and traditional Chinese culture. At the same time, Protestant Christianity in various forms has been developing rapidly. Scholars have studied the interactions of various forms of Protestantism with the changing political, social, and cultural context. However, with the exception of a few studies of the theology of Bishop K. H. Ting and his program of theological reconstruction, studies of Protestantism in contemporary China seldom investigate theology, which, as a cognitive-discursive dimension of religion, should not be overlooked. The proposed research project fills in an important gap by reconstructing, interpreting, and evaluating Chinese Protestant theology in the reform era. Our primary sources are three decades of articles (essays, sermons, biblical studies, etc.) in Nanjing Theological Review (a journal published by Nanjing Union Theological Seminary, the only national-level seminary in China) and in Tian Feng (a monthly periodical with nation-wide circulation published by the Three-Self Patriotic Movement and the China Christian Council), as well as the books written by individual theologians. Using these primary sources, we seek to identify, reconstruct, interpret, and evaluate the theological discourses in Chinese Protestantism. According to our preliminary understanding, there are three major theological discourses: the dominant discourse of the Protestant church establishment (such as the theology of Ting and his supporters), the critical discourse within the church establishment (such as the dissenters, including the later period of Wang Weifan), and the popular discourse of the more grassroots pastors in local churches. The research project will focus specifically on how these theological discourses have been shaped by and have interpreted Christian theological traditions in response to the dynamic interaction between the Protestant church and the communist party-state, the social changes brought by modernization and the development of the market economy, and the Chinese cultural tradition. The result of the investigation is expected to produce an adequately comprehensive historical account of contemporary Chinese Protestant theology, enhance our understanding of the interaction between Christianity and the changing contemporary Chinese context, and contribute to the further development of Chinese contextual theology in the twenty-first century. 近三十年來中國的改革開放政策帶來巨大的社會變遷，產生了「有中國特色的社會主義」，產生了全能主義黨國、國家主導的資本主義市場經濟、以及西方現代性與中國傳統文化的混雜結合。同時，各種形式的基督新教發展迅速。學者研究過各種形式的基督新教與不斷變化的政治、社會、文化處境的互動。然而，除了幾項對丁光訓主教的神學及其神學思想建設運動的研究，有關當代中國基督新教的研究鮮有以神學為對象者；但神學作為宗教的認知－話語維度實不應忽視。本研究計劃透過重構、詮釋、評價改革開放時期的基督新教神學，填補一個重要的空白。我們的主要資料來源是三十年的《金陵神學誌》（由全國唯一的國家級神學院──金陵協和神學院──出版的期刊 》和《天風》（由三自愛國運動委員會和中國基督教協會出版的全國發行月刊）的文章 （包括論文、講章、聖經研究等），以及個別神學家所寫的書籍。我們使用這些主要資料來源，以識別、 重構、詮釋和評價中國基督新教神學的話語。據我們初步了解，有三套主要的神學話語：教會建制的主導話語（如丁光訓及其支持者）、教會建制內的批判話語（如後期汪維藩及其他異見者），以及在地方教會較基層的牧者的通俗話語。本研究計劃將集中探討這些神學話語如何受基督教神學傳統影響，並它們如何詮釋這些傳統，以回應基督新教教會與中共黨國、現代化及市場經濟發展帶來的社會變遷、以及中國文化傳統三方面的動態互動。研究結果可望得出對當代中國基督新教神學足夠全面的歷史敘述，增進我們了解基督教與不斷變化的中國處境的互動，並對二十一世紀中國處境神學的發展作出貢獻。

458411.label: Realisation of objectives
458411.value: The objectives of the project have substantially been achieved despite challenges. Our published papers and the proposed book have analyzed how Chinese Protestant discourses have interpreted Christian theological traditions for the present situation of China. Objective 3 is thus achieved. Instances of Chinese contextual theology can be found, among others, in Bishop K.H. Ting’s strong affirmation of the possibility of salvation of Chinese non-Christians, in the reinterpretation of biblical texts in Tian Feng (TF) articles in view of the developing market economy, in Wang Weifan’s drawing upon Chinese classical traditions to develop Chinese theology, and in Chinese Protestants’ ingenious ways of adapting to Chinese popular religion. The indexing of articles in TF and Nanjing Theological Review (NTR), that is, objective 4, is completed, and will be published in the proposed book and made available online. We deducted five percent from the “percentage achieved,” for the completion time has lagged behind schedule, and the contents were not as informative as originally planned. The main reason was the longer-than-expected period of recruitment of a full-time research assistant. We explored other possibilities and eventually recruited Dr. Tong Wing-sze as part-time post-doctoral fellow for this project with salary wholly supported by the project. The reconstruction of a historical account of Protestant theology in the political, social, and cultural context of China from 1980 to 2010 (objective 1), has largely been achieved on the basis of the writings published in TF and NTR and by oral history obtained from in-depth interviews. While the indexes to articles provided the “facts,” the transcribed interviews with information about behind-the-scene events offered clues for interpretation. The research outputs have addressed particular historical periods of Chinese theology in their political, economic, and cultural contexts. Yet a comprehensive historical account of the development of Chinese Protestant theology covering the thirty-year period is still a challenge to undertake. As for objective 2, Protestant theological discourses in this period are analyzed in terms of their theological and political positions. The former ranges from conservative to liberal and latter from pro-establishment to anti-establishment. This framework goes beyond the inadequate analysis of church-state relation in China in terms of the opposition between the “Three-Self churches” and the “house churches” and sheds new light on the conflict between Bishop Ting (liberal pro-establishment) and his colleague Wang Weifan (conservative pro-establishment) over the “theological reorientation” campaign. The findings of objectives 1 and 2 will be more fully seen in the proposed book. The inexperience of the PI in managing his first GRF project has led to a significant underestimation of the time for analyzing an overwhelming amount of materials spanning thirty years and for putting the findings in written form. This is expected to improve in his future GRF projects.

458411.label: Major findings and research outcome
458411.value: Theological discourses of Protestantism in China in the reform era is the result of complex negotiations between Chinese Protestantism and the political, economic, cultural, and religious contexts of contemporary China. Not surprisingly, the political situation has been the dominant factor for the discourse of the state sanctioned Protestant church (under the umbrella of the Three-Self Patriotic Movement [TSPM] and the China Christian Council [CCC]). It is not uncommon for articles in Tian Feng (TF) and Nanjing Theological Review (NTR) to echo the prevailing policy of the Chinese Communist Party. This can be a way to demonstrate political loyalty of TSPM/CCC, or a way to avoid being odd when other “patriotic” organizations are toeing the Party’s line. In either case Protestant publications got the space to articulate Christian discourses without undue influences. The campaign of “theological reconstruction,” which dominated TF and NTR from late 1990s to early 2000s, can be seen in this light, as it sought to reconstruct Chinese Protestant theology for adaptation to “socialism,” which practically mean the political reality of China. Yet one should not overlook its theological aim—the suppression of fundamentalism, which has been prevailing in China, but was seen by Bishop K.H. Ting as problematic. This campaign led to the alienation and suppression of many evangelicals, such as Ting’s ally Wang Weifan. The period under investigation saw China’s great economic transformation, especially the development of market economy. A number of articles in TF retrieved and reinterpreted biblical texts to justify “working hard to get rich” and church-run business enterprises while setting Christian boundaries to means of getting rich. Some reinterpretations were uniquely Chinese as they ingeniously gave certain phrases in the Chinese Bible new meanings that were not warranted by the texts in original language. Traditional Chinese culture, exemplified by the Confucian tradition, put a strong emphasis on morality. Chinese Protestantism has inherited this emphasis. Many contents in TF dealt largely with moral issues, especially those related to family and relatives. Filial piety is taken for granted. This poses a dilemma to Chinese Christians. While the official view of Chinese Protestantism rejects many traditional Chinese funeral rites because of their association with Chinese popular religion, which is criticized as “superstitious” and “idolatrous,” Chinese Protestants develop in practice various strategies of adaptation to and negotiation with rites of Chinese popular religion, from limited practices, providing alternatives, to subtle transformation. This shows that the interaction between Protestantism and Chinese culture is more intricate than commonly assumed.

458411.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
458411.value: The research can be further developed in three possible ways. One is to extend its study of the theological discourses of Chinese Protestantism to the period after Xi Jingping came to power, when there has been tightening control of various aspects of Chinese society, including religion. The study of Tian Feng, Nanjing Theological Review, and other publications of the state sanctioned Protestant church can continue. Another way is to extend its study to the theological discourses of autonomous Christian communities (what are commonly called “house churches”). Publications of these communities can be collected first to build up a database for research. The third way is to extend its study to various forms of non-written communication, such as preaching, praying, and sharing in selected Chinese Protestant churches. A team or network of researchers is needed to record, transcribe, and analyze the communication.

458411.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
458411.value: Protestant Christianity has been booming in China. This research project studied its theology, its ideas expressed in various ways, particularly in the official publications of the state sanctioned Protestant church under the umbrella of the Three-Self Patriotic Movement and China Christian Council, from 1980 to 2010. This was a period of China’s tremendous economic reform and social transformation. The project analyzed, interpreted, and evaluated the complex interactions between Protestant theology and the changing political, economic, and cultural situation in China during this period. The affirmation of the possibility of salvation of Chinese non-Christians, the reinterpretation of biblical texts in respond to the developing market economy, the use of Chinese classics to develop Chinese theology, the various ingenious ways of adapting to Chinese funeral rites while preserving Christian identity—these are just some interesting instances of the research findings. The research outcome of the project contributes to the understanding of an overlooked aspect of Christianity in contemporary China, to the study of the complex interactions between religion and society in China, to the review of the limitations and possibilities of state sanctioned Chinese Protestantism, and to the development of resources for the construction of contextual theology in Chinese societies.

459211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
459211.value: In today’s competitive environment, it is imperative that companies are able to develop and market new products quickly. Therefore the abilities of the firm to develop and introduce new product or adopt new production process to improve quality or productivity have significant impact on the firm’s competitive advantages in the market place. These capabilities are generally termed as “innovation capabilities”. As innovation is closely related to applications of new knowledge in product design or process design, intellectual capitals are important determinants of firms’ product innovation capabilities since they are knowledge generating resource. In addition, learning from supply chain partner plays an important role in transforming external knowledge resources into product innovation capability in supply chain context. In this project, we will investigate how companies build product innovation capability through intellectual capitals and supply chain learning using data collected from manufacturing companies in China and United States. First, we will develop and validate measurement scales for intellectual capital and supply chain learning from supply chain perspective. Subsequently, we will test the relationships among intellectual capital, supply chain learning, product innovation capability, and firm performance. We will also examine how financial and physical innovation investments in research and development (R&D) moderate the effects of intellectual capitals and supply chain learning on innovation capabilities and firm performance. Furthermore, we will also investigate the differences in these relationships between the United Stated and China where original innovations based on the firm’s intellectual capitals and innovations based on supply chain learning tend to perform quite different roles in enhancing firms’ innovation capabilities. The results will indicate how companies’ intellectual capitals enhance product innovation capability directly and indirectly through supply chain learning. The results will also show how financial and physical innovation investment influence the effectiveness of intellectual capital and supply chain learning in enhancing innovation capability. The study will also reveal the differences in the effects of intellectual capital and supply chain learning on innovation capabilities in China and USA. The finding from this study will help companies to effectively manage the intangible knowledge assets and external learning process of the firm to build innovation capabilities. This study will contribute to the innovation literature by enhancing our understandings of the roles of intangible knowledge assets and external learning process in building firms’ innovation capability with different levels of financial and physical R&D investments in different institutional environment. 当今激烈的竞争环境需要企业能够快速的开发新产品并将其推向市场。因此，企业开发并引入新产品或采用新的生产技术来提高质量和生产率的能力对企业取得竞争优势有很重要的影响。这些能力一般称作“创新能力”。由于创新关乎在产品与流程设计中引用新的知识，作为知识产生的源泉，智力资本是企业产品创新能力的重要决定因素。此外，在供应链环境下，向供应链合作伙伴学习也在将外部知识资源转化为产品创新能力的过程中起到了重要作用。 在这个项目中，我们将在中国和美国的制造企业样本中研究企业如何通过智力资本和供应链学习来建立产品创新能力。第一，我们将从供应链的角度开发并验证智力资本和供应链学习的测量量表。下一步，我们将测试智力资本，供应链学习，产品创新能力，和企业绩效之间的关系。我们还将检验财务和设备的创新投资是如何调节智力资本和供应链学习对创新能力和企业绩效的影响。此外，我们将研究这些关系在中国和美国企业中的差别，这些差别很可能是由于来源于企业智力资本和供应链学习的知识对企业创新能力提高的不同影响。 研究的结果将显示企业的智力资本如何直接和间接的通过供应链学习提高产品创新能力。研究的结果将会显示财务和设备投资如何影响智力资本和供应链学习对提高创新能力的效率。研究将会展示中国和美国企业关于智力资本和供应链学习对创新能力的不同影响。这个研究的发现将能帮助企业有效地管理无形知识资产和外部学习的过程来建立创新能力。这个研究将会对创新文献进行贡献，提高我们理解无形知识资产和外部学习过程在企业创新能力建立中的作用，同时在不同的制度环境下考虑不同层次的财务和设备研发投入。

459211.label: Realisation of objectives
459211.value: (1) Realisation of objective 1: We have finished the design of new questionnaire based on the results of case studies and the literature review. We also conducted pilot test for the questionnaire among 35 EMBA students. We have validated the measurement scales of intellectual capital and external learning using the data from China (300), United States (200), German(137), and India (231). (2) Realisation of objective 2: We have worked out a paper “Effects of intellectual capital and supply chain learning on supply chain performance: an empirical study in China”. We proposed and empirically tested the impact of three dimensions of intellectual capital on supply chain learning and supply chain responsiveness. We have worked out a paper “Intellectual Capital, Supplier Knowledge Integration and Product Innovation: A Comparison between China and India”. We proposed and empirically test the relationships among intellectual capital, supplier knowledge integration, supply chain adaptability, and innovation performance. (3) Realisation of objective 3: We have worked out a paper “The interactive effects of external knowledge sources and internal resources on the innovative capabilities of Chinese manufacturers”. We proposed and empirically test the moderating effects of external resources (external learning through R&D alliance and external expert involvement) on the relationships between internal resources (human capital, physical capital, financial capital) and innovation performance. We have worked out a paper “Strategic orientations and mass customisation: the moderating effect of product life cycle”. We proposed and empirically test the moderating effects of product life cycle on the effectiveness of internal learning (customization knowledge utilization). We have worked out a paper “Intellectual Capital, Supplier Knowledge Integration and Product Innovation: A Comparison between China and India”. We proposed and empirically test the moderating effects of institutional environment on the effectiveness of intellectual capital and supplier learning (supplier knowledge integration). (4) Realisation of objective 4: We have worked out a paper “Learning initiatives for improving supply chain and innovation performance: contrasts between developed and developing countries”. We proposed and empirically test the relationships among supply chain learning and innovation performance between China and United States. (5) Realisation of objective 5: We have worked out a paper “Modularity in building mass customization capability: the mediating effects of customization knowledge utilization and business process improvement”. We tested the organizational theory in the context of supply chain learning and innovation by investigating the mediating roles of internal learning between modularity and mass customization capability. We have worked out a paper “The impact of social capital on mass customisation and product innovation capabilities.”. We tested the social capital theory in the context of innovation by investigating the relationships among three dimensions of social capital, mass customization capability and product innovation capability. We have worked out a paper “The interactive effects of external knowledge sources and internal resources on the innovative capabilities of Chinese manufacturers”. We tested resource-bases theory and knowledge-based view in the context of innovation by investigating the interactive effects of external knowledge sources and internal resources. We have worked out a paper “Strategic orientations and mass customisation: the moderating effect of product life cycle”. We tested structural contingency theories by investigating the moderating effects of product life cycle. (6) Realisation of objective 6: All of papers generated from this project have practical implications for managers. We also transferred the knowledge generated from this project by teaching in the MBA and EMBA classes. The research findings and cases were also shared with industry practitioners through several executive forums.

459211.label: Major findings and research outcome
459211.value: (1) Major findings concerning the role of intellectual capital or supply chain learning in influencing innovation or company performance In paper “Effects of intellectual capital and supply chain learning on supply chain performance: an empirical study in China”, we find that different dimensions of intellectual capital have direct or indirect influence on supply chain responsiveness through supply chain learning. (2) Major findings concerning the different roles of supply chain learning in different environments In paper “Modularity in building mass customization capability: the mediating effects of customization knowledge utilization and business process improvement”, we confirm the mediating role of internal learning between modularity and mass customization capability. In paper “Strategic orientations and mass customisation: the moderating effect of product life cycle”, we found that different impact of innovation orientation on internal learning in different product life cycle. In paper ” Impact of interpersonal trust in upstream and downstream contact person on product innovation-- The mediating effect of knowledge absorptive capacity”, we find that customer and supplier learning play different mediating roles between interpersonal trust and product innovation. (3) Major findings concerning the role of internal and external resources in influencing innovation and company performance. In paper “The Interactive Effects of External Knowledge Sources and Internal Resources on the Innovative Capabilities of Chinese Manufacturers”, we find that human resources and external expert impact their innovative capabilities through direct and significant interactions. In paper “The triple helix analysis of innovation generation in Chinese manufacturers: a contingency perspective”, we find that dysfunctional competition moderates the relationships among government support, university & research institutes knowledge integration, product/process innovation, and company performance. (4) Major findings concerning the cross-country investigation of the relationships among intellectual capital, supply chain learning, innovation performance, and firm performance. In paper “The effects of intellectual capital and supplier knowledge integration on innovation: A comparison between China and India”, we find that there are both similarities and differences regarding the effects of intellectual capital and supplier knowledge integration on innovation performance in these two countries. In paper “The impacts of business and political ties on product innovation: A comparison between China and India”, we find that there are both similarities and differences regarding the relationships among business and political ties, cognitive capital, institutional support and product innovation performance in China and India. In paper “Learning initiatives for improving supply chain and innovation performance: contrasts between developed and developing countries”, we find that there are both similarities and differences regarding the effects of learning initiatives (customer, supplier, university & research institutes) on product/process innovation.

459211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
459211.value: (1) This study focuses on product innovation in manufacturing firms. Service industries in both China and India are also developing rapidly. Future studies could extend our findings to explore the service innovation in China and India. In addition, it is more interesting to compare the proposed relationships in manufacturing and service industries. However, the measurement scale should be appropriately revised and verified in both industries. (2) This study on supply chain learning and innovation focuses on the technological knowledge transfer and its impact on innovation outcomes. However, learning other types of learning can also exist. McFarland et al., (2008) proposed the idea of “supply chain contagion,” which refers to companies that learn from their customer’ behavior in managing manufacturer-customer dyadic relationships and then apply that knowledge to manage their suppliers in a supplier-manufacturer dyadic relationship. We may consider such learning contents in extending current research.

459211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
459211.value: In this project, we investigate how companies build product innovation capability through intellectual capitals and supply chain learning using data collected from manufacturing companies in China, United States, and India. First, we capture managers’ understanding of intellectual capital, supply chain learning in manufacturing companies of different countries (China, United States, India, and German). Second, due to the differences in culture, institutional environment, development history, and innovation capability, we identify the similarity and differences in relationships among relational ties, intellectual capital, supply chain learning, supply chain performance, innovation performance, and firm performance. For example, there will be different choices in relying on supplier/customer or university for innovation collaboration across different countries. There will also be different choices in using business or political connections in obtaining innovation resources. Third, our findings can be useful in managing relationship, learning, and innovation between supply chain partners. Specially, this study will help companies to effectively manage the intangible knowledge assets and external learning process of the firm to build innovation capabilities.

460511.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
460511.value: Cisplatin combined with radiotherapy has become the corner stone in the treatment of advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). The addition of cisplatin, however, leads to additional toxicities that narrowed the ultimate therapeutic gain. Therefore to identify the group of patients who cannot benefit from the addition of cisplatin can render a more personalized therapy and maximize the therapeutic ratio. Recently, the DNA repair protein ERCC1, is shown to be both a prognostic marker of survival, and also a predictive marker of benefit from cisplatin based adjuvant chemotherapy in patients with surgically resected non-small cell lung cancer. The hypothesis that low/negative ERCC1 expression is predictive of platinum sensitivity has yet to be established outside lung cancer, because most studies are dominated by small and heterogeneous patient populations with some inconsistent data. One important reason may be the lack of effective and reproducible methods for quantification of ERCC1 expression. ERCC1 genotyping is a rational alternative and may circumvent many of the problems to evaluate mRNA and protein expression in clinical samples, since it required only a simple blood sample without too many variables. We propose a companion translational study performed on stored blood samples collected as part of the screening procedures in a large prospective phase 3 clinical trial of NPC, to confirm a prior hypothesis of ERCC1 genotype to discriminate between patients at high and low risk of disease relapse, and its interaction with cisplatin. We will further investigate the relationship of ERCC1 genotype in peripheral blood and its protein and mRNA expression in paired NPC biopsy tissue retrieved from a large tissue and serum bank collection. Our results will be able to define the prognostic and predictive role of ERCC1 genotype in locally advanced NPC treated with radiotherapy or cisplatin-radiotherapy, and filling in missing link between ERCC1 genotype and phenotype in NPC. 460511.label: Realisation of objectives
460511.value: Polymorphisms at Excision Repair Cross Complementation group 1 (ERCC1) has been linked to platinum sensitivity and treatment outcome. We hypothesized that single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) at ERCC1 C118T and C8092A is predictive of relapse free survival (RFS) in nasopharyngeal cancer (NPC), and correlates with ERCC1 protein and mRNA level in paired tumor samples. Hong Kong NPC study group 0502 trial is a multi-center prospective clinical trial to assess adjuvant chemotherapy in NPC patients with detectable plasma EBV-DNA (pEBV) following primary radiotherapy (RT) or cisplatin-RT (CRT) (NCT00370890). Eligible patients with biopsy proven NPC, AJCC stage IIB-IVB, no persistent locoregional disease or distant metastasis, good performance status (ECOG 0-1), adequate organ function, were screened by pEBV at 6-8 weeks after completing RT/CRT. Post-RT pEBV -ve patients received no further treatment. pEBV +ve patients underwent work-up and randomization to adjuvant chemotherapy or observation. We tested our hypothesis using samples collected in the 0502 screening cohort. Primary endpoint is relapse free survival (RFS). ERCC1 genotyping was by TaqMan real time PCR. 450 pts is planned to detect a hazard ratio (HR) of 1.5 for the weaker ERCC1 SNP at 80% power and 2-side 5% alpha level. In subset with available tumor biopsies, we quantified ERCC1 protein expression by immunohistochemistry (IHC) or Western blot (WB) with mouse monoclonal antibody (clone 8F1), and ERCC1 mRNA by quantitative reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). The study has achieved its target subject accrual and completed all planned project objectives.

460511.label: Major findings and research outcome
460511.value: ERCC1 SNP genotype was analyzed in peripheral blood lymphocytes from 576 patients (total biomarker population). Median follow up was 3.76 years (90% confidence interval, C.I. 3.56-3.99). 403 patients (70%) were pEBV-ve, 173 patients (30%) were pEBV+ve, and 81(14%) were randomized. ERCC1 genotype distribution at C118T: 52.8% C/C, 40.6% C/T, 6.6% T/T; C8092A: 39.0% C/C, 49.4% A/C, 11.6% A/A. There was no significant association of ERCC1 genotype with 3-year RFS and overall survival (OS) in the total biomarker population (n=576). No significant correlation was observed in ERCC1 genotype and tumor ERCC1 expression by IHC, WB or mRNA. In subset evaluated by ERCC1 IHC (n=79), pts with ERCC1+ve tumor (H-score > median) had worse RFS (HR 2.34, 95% C.I. 1.06-5.16, p=0.036). Multivariate analysis showed pEBV was the most significant adverse prognosticator for all clinical endpoints. However, there were significant interactions between pEBV status and ERCC1 C118T in both RFS (p=0.0106) and OS (p=0.0067). In pEBV-ve population, there was significant association between ERCC1 C118T genotype and RFS (HR 1.67, 95% C.I. 1.07-2.61, p=0.024) and OS (HR 2.31, 1.22-4.40, p=0.0106), which retained significance in multivariate analysis. No significant association was observed in pEBV+ve population. In conclusion, we found no association of ERCC1 SNP genotype with NPC survival in the total biomarker population, but observed significant biomarker interaction between ERCC1 C118T genotype and post radiotherapy plasma EBV DNA level, which required further validation. Post radiotherapy plasma EBV DNA level was the most significant prognostic biomarker in NPC. The result of this study has been presented as a poster highlight at the 50th annual meeting of the American Society of Clinical Oncology, Chicago, Illinois, 30 May - 3 June, 2014. The full manuscript is being submitted for publication.

460511.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
460511.value: Our study has prospectively validated post-radiotherapy plasma EBV DNA level as the most significant prognostic biomarker in nasopharyngeal cancer (NPC), which is being utilized in the first biomarker driven randomized controlled trial in NPC (Hong Kong NPC study group 0502 trial; NCT00370890). It is possible that the apparent biomarker interaction between ERCC1 C118T genotype and plasma EBV DNA status could represent an underlying interaction between a biomarker and its associated treatment effect, which required further investigation. This can be explored in the randomized arms of the 0502 study when the clinical trial completed. Our result also demonstrated the challenge to equate the expression level of a single gene or protein with total DNA repair capacity, which is a dynamic process comprising of interaction between multiple factors. The complexity of the DNA repair mechanisms along with the heterogeneity in cancer treatments could require multiple putative biomarkers of patient outcome, and the prognostic value of a single biomarker may change in different clinical context.

460511.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
460511.value: Cisplatin chemotherapy combined with radiotherapy is the standard treatment in advanced nasopharyngeal cancer (NPC). Genotype of the DNA repair protein, ERCC1, has been linked to sensitivity to cisplatin and radiotherapy. We analyzed ERCC1 genotype in 576 NPC patients who completed radiotherapy with or without cisplatin chemotherapy. We found no significant association of ERCC1 genotype with treatment outcomes in the total biomarker population. Post-radiotherapy plasma EBV DNA level was the only independent prognosticator for NPC survival. However, we revealed a significant interaction between post-radiotherapy plasma EBV DNA level and ERCC1 C118T genotype, and observed significant association of ERCC1 C118T genotype with NPC survival in the post-radiotherapy plasma EBV DNA positive population, but not in the plasma EBV DNA negative population. Our study has prospectively validated post-radiotherapy plasma EBV DNA level as the most significant prognostic biomarker in NPC, which is being utilized in the first biomarker driven randomized controlled trial in NPC. The apparent biomarker interaction between ERCC1 C118T genotype and plasma EBV DNA status could represent an underlying interaction between a biomarker and its associated treatment effect, which required further investigation.

460611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
460611.value: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) rupture is a very common sport injury resulting in an unstable knee. As a ruptured ACL does not heal, ACL reconstruction (ACLR) is the standard treatment to restore knee function. The surgical procedure of ACLR involves the use of a tendon graft to replace the ruptured ACL. Surgeons drill bone tunnels on distal femur and proximal tibia, insert the tendon graft through the bone tunnels and secure the graft in place. Although the surgical procedure is often successful, the biological healing is often slow and long term morbidity may result. There are ample emphases on "mechanical" solutions to ACLR such as fixation device, but there are very few " biological" consideration. With the advance of tissue engineering, some attempts to improve healing in ACLR mainly focus on the processes related to matrix reconstitution, such as using growth factors, stem cells and scaffolds. However, tissue remodeling may be more important than matrix synthesis in ACLR. Tissue remodeling is the final stage of healing process which refers to restructuring of extracellular matrix towards functional tissues. In ACLR, the remodeling processes involve restructuring processes such as graft incorporation into the bone inside tunnels, and ligamentization of the graft (transformation of graft from tendon tissues to ligament tissues). An ideal remodeling process will lead to firm incoporation of the graft and regain of mechanical properties of the original ligament. In this project, we propose to investigate the potentials of Glycyl-Histydyl-lysine tripeptide (GHK) to modulate tissue remodeling in ACLR for a better healing outcome. GHK, especially in the form of copper complex (GHK-Cu), is an activator of tissue remodeling which is naturally present in low levels in human bodies. It can mediate a number of remodeling-related processes, such as anti-inflammation, chemo-attraction of repair cells and stimulation of protein synthesis of extracellular matrix as well as proteolytic enzymes. Thus supplementation of GHK will be a plausible strategy to promote healing. In fact, the effects of GHK on tissue remodeling in skin wound have been well demonstrated for decades and its commercial use in cosmetic industry is widespread. We hypothesize that GHK-Cu is able to enhance tissue remodeling in ACLR and improve healing outcomes. As there are over 1200 ACLR in Hong Kong per year, with over 200,000 ACLR in US per year and probably millions in the world; our study will not just benefit the patients in Hong Kong but worldwide. 前交叉韌帶撕裂是十分常見的運動創傷,能引致膝關節不穩定.由於前交叉韌帶不能自行癒合,重建手術是標準的治療方法. 前交叉韌帶重建手術主要將肌腱植入物固定在股骨和脛骨的骨隧道中,藉此代替韌帶.雖然手術能暫時回復膝關節的穩定性,但遲緩的癒合反應將誘發其他病狀.現在醫療市場上有許多改善術後膝關節穩定性的產品,例如植入物固定器等,但促進術後癒合的方案卻是少之又少.隨著組織工程學的發展,我們可以考慮利用刺激基質再生的方法促進癒合,但由於肌腱植入物需要的是融入膝關節環境而非增生,故此組織重塑比基質再生更為重要. 組織重塑是癒合過程的最終階段,主要將細胞外基質重構成功能性組織. 在前交叉韌重建手術中, 組織重塑包括肌腱植入物融入骨隧道和肌腱韌帶化的過程.有見及此,我們提出研究利用藍銅胜肽 (GHK-Cu)去調控前交叉韌重建術後的組織重塑過程,從而促進膝關節功能恢復. GHK三勝肽及其含銅化合物藍銅胜肽 (GHK-Cu)能在人體天然生成,但在正常情況下含量極低. 460611.label: Realisation of objectives
460611.value: We have completed all work related to the objective during the period. Using an anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) rat model, we have examined whether post-operative intra-articular injection of GHK-Cu improves the healing outcome after ACLR. After ACLR, the rats received 4 weekly intra-articular injection of saline or GHK-Cu at 2 doses from week 2 post-operation. The healing outcome was examined using various assessment tools. The major outcome include mechanical properties (in terms of anterior-posterior knee laxity and graft pull-out strength) by static knee laxity test and graft pull-out test, as well as examination of the remodeling process by histology. In addition, we have included longitudinal gait analysis to follow the functional recovery. All of the assessments were carried out at 6 and 12 weeks post-operation. The effect of two doses of GHK-Cu (0.3mg/ml and 3mg/ml) to modify graft mechanical properties, graft remodeling, as well as functional recovery, was compared with the saline control group.

460611.label: Major findings and research outcome
460611.value: Mechanical test At 6 weeks post operation, 0.3 or 3 mg/ml (p=0.012, 0.049, Scheffe post-hoc test) GHK-Cu groups resulted in a significantly smaller side-to-side difference in anterior-posterior knee laxity as compared to saline control (ANOVA, p=0.009), but no difference was detected at 12 weeks (p=0.531) (Figure 1). There was no significant difference in failure load of the graft complex between groups at 6 and 12 weeks (p=0.301, 0.834) (Figure 2), however, the stiffness of the graft complex in 0.3 mg/ml GHK-Cu was significantly higher than saline group at 6 weeks (p=0.007) (Figure 3). All grafts failed at mid-substance. (Appendix I-IV) Histology Table 1 showed the histological scoring results. At 6 weeks post operation, 0.3 mg/ml GHK-Cu group exhibited less graft deterioration and better graft incorporation than saline, but the differences become insignificant at 12 weeks. Higher dose of GHK-Cu (3 mg/ml) exhibited no significant difference in graft degeneration and incorporation as compared to saline. At 6 weeks, a complete bony layer surrounding the graft was noticed in GHK groups as compared to the leaky tunnel interface in saline (Figure 4, 6). Graft degeneration (decreased collagen birefringence) was less severe in the 0.3 mg/ml group as compared to saline, but significantly increased cell recruitment to graft mid-substance in 3 mg/ml group also rendered poor graft integrity (Figure 5). (Appendix I, II, IV) Gait analysis Rats with ACLR and ipsilateral flexor tendon donor site injury with 4 intra-articular injections significantly idled the injured limb during walking at 6 week and 12 week (Figure 7). There were no significant differences among experimental groups in all gait parameters (p=0.576, 0.726, 0.896, 0.597 for anchor print ratio, target print ratio, swing duration ratio, and Limb Idleness Index respectively). At 6 weeks, 30% of rats in each group got LII>1.3 that indicates limb idleness. At 12 weeks, rats with LII>1.3 in saline, 0.3 mg/ml and 3 mg/ml GHK-Cu groups were 30%, 30% and 50% respectively but the difference was not significant (Likelihood Ratio test, p=0.477). (Appendix I, IV) Summary Biological modulation by post-operative intra-articular injection of GHK-Cu improved graft remodeling and restoration of A-P knee laxity at 6 weeks post operation, but the treatment effect became insignificant at 12 weeks after cessation of injection. The positive effect on laxity may be attributed to better anchorage at graft tunnel interface and enhanced tissue remodeling in the graft mid-substance. GHK-Cu at 0.3mg/ml was effective in graft healing, but higher dose did not confer to further improvement.

460611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
460611.value: Based on the known effects of GHK-Cu and the observations in histology and mechanical test, we postulated that GHK-Cu may stimulate cell recruitment to the tendon graft and modulate tissue remodeling. Further studies to explore the possible treatment effect could target on cell recruitment and cellular activities related to tissue remodeling, such as MMPs and TIMPs expression. Mechanistic investigations of treatment effect will lead to new development of biological modulation for ACLR. Apart from dosage, injection volume, frequency and treatment duration may affect the final treatment effects. In this study, we tested GHK-Cu concentrations with fixed volume and weekly injection for 4 weeks. Positive treatment effects were observed only at 6 weeks post operation (right after cessation of treatment), while no significant improvement was observed at 12 weeks post operation. The treatment regime could be modified to improve the outcome. As repeated intra-articular injections may cause trauma to the joint, while long term drug administration is needed to modulate the lengthy tissue remodeling process, it is preferable to devise controlled drug release system for GHK delivery. We have put up a further study to develop temperature-sensitive hydrogels encapsulated with GHK-Cu in a proposal for General Research Fund 2013/14 (funded).

460611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
460611.value: This study presents experimental evidences for the effectiveness of post-operative intra-articular injection GHK copper tripeptide to improve graft healing in a well-established rat model of anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR). It is found that a low dose of 0.3 mg/ml GHK-Cu is effective to restore knee laxity and promote graft healing in the animal model. As compared to previous approaches of biological modulation in ACLR, the use of bioactive small molecules may present advantages over the use of protein growth factors and cell supplementation with respect to cost-effectiveness.

460811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
460811.value: 此雙盲、隨機試驗的目的是評估一種新的治療方案（米索前列醇），對低劑量阿司匹林使用並發小腸出血患者小腸潰瘍癒合的作用。 阿司匹林是全球預防心血管疾病最常用的藥物。然而，其引起的小腸出血也逐漸得到重視。小腸出血表現為小腸顯性出血（即黑便或者鮮紅色大便）或者隱匿性失血（即大便正常但血紅蛋白水平逐漸下降），但胃和結腸檢查均正常。由於常規內鏡檢查難以到達小腸，小腸出血一般難以診斷。無線視頻膠囊內鏡的發明給小腸的可視性帶來革命性的進展。膠囊內鏡是一個包含有微型照相機的藥丸，被患者吞下後可以捕捉到小腸的圖像。目前，膠囊內鏡被推薦為發現小腸出血來源的非侵入式方法。 由於阿司匹林使用者的增加，小腸出血的問題逐漸得到重視。在香港的一個地區醫院，每年約有100例阿司匹林相關的小腸顯性出血或者隱性失血患者被確診。在一個前瞻性的隊列研究中，我們發現在有小腸出血病史的阿司匹林使用者中，持續使用阿司匹林的患者其複發性小腸出血的發生率比停用阿司匹林者高4倍。 處理阿司匹林相關的小腸出血是一個重要的臨床挑戰，有以下兩大原因：首先，缺乏治療小腸潰瘍的有效手段。與消化性潰瘍不同，小腸的損傷是非酸依賴的。因此，傳統的胃粘膜保護藥物不能治愈或者預防阿司匹林使用者的小腸潰瘍。改用其他非阿司匹林的抗血小板藥物也不能降低出血的風險。其次，我們研究表明持續使用阿司匹林增加小腸再次出血的風險。然而，停用阿司匹林，患者則可能發生血栓形成相關的合併症。目前，國際國內均無處理阿司匹林相關小腸出血的指南。 抑制前列腺素的合成是阿司匹林引起小腸潰瘍的重要機制。根據這一理論，一系列病例研究的初步結果顯示：一種前列腺素類似物米索前列醇，能夠使阿司匹林使用者的小腸潰瘍癒合。但是，米索前列醇對阿司匹林相關小腸潰瘍的療效尚未在前瞻性隨機試驗中得到證實。 這項雙盲的臨床試驗假設米索前列醇能夠治愈阿司匹林使用者的小腸潰瘍或者多發糜爛。如果上述假設被證實，這項治療阿司匹林相關小腸損傷的有效方法的研究結果，將成為一個里程碑式的發現。由於米索前列醇是非專利藥物，這一重要的臨床問題不會成為製藥企業的一個優先選擇。這項不依賴企業的研究結果，一方面可填補我們知識的空缺，另一方面，對於這一尚無有效治療手段的嚴重疾病，我們的發現可為國際指南委員會提供非常有價值的數據。

460811.label: Major findings and research outcome
460811.value: The intention-to-treat population included all patients who took at least one dose of study drug and returned for follow-up capsule endoscopy (N=72; 35 misoprostol, 37 placebo). Their demographic characteristics were shown in the Table. Twelve patients (34.3%) receiving misoprostol and four (10.8%) receiving placebo had complete healing at 8 weeks (P=0.017). Among patients with small bowel bleeding who receive continuous aspirin therapy, misoprostol is superior to placebo in healing small bowel ulcers.

460811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
460811.value: To date, there is no effective treatment for small bowel enteropathy associated with aspirin use. This is the very first randomized trial that sought to evaluate a potential treatment (misoprostol) for small bowel ulcers using a clinically important endpoint (i.e., complete healing of small bowel ulcers in aspirin users complicated by gastrointestinal bleeding). Although we have shown that misoprostol is superior to placebo in healing small bowel bleeding ulcers among patients receiving continuous aspirin therapy, the overall ulcer healing rate is far from satisfactory. The next important research question is how we can improve the small bowel ulcer healing rate e.g. will the use of combination therapy or alternative drugs enhance small bowel ulcer healing when compared to misoprostol alone?. Our finding will stimulate future research in this important yet largely unknown area to identify the optimal therapy for aspirin users complicated by small bowel bleeding.

460811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
460811.value: Aspirin is increasingly used for prevention of heart attack, stroke, and even colorectal cancer. While acid suppressing drugs are highly effective in preventing peptic ulcer disease associated with aspirin use, there is no effective treatment or prophylaxis against lower gastrointestinal bleeding (i.e., small and large bowel) with aspirin. There is a steady increase in hospital admission for lower gastrointestinal bleeding in our aging population. This is the very first study showing that misoprostol, a synthetic prostaglandin analog, can heal small bowel ulcers in patients with gastrointestinal bleeding who receive continuous aspirin. The current finding is an important breakthrough in the management of small bowel bleeding associated with aspirin. Future studies are needed to identify the optimal treatment strategy for aspirin users who are at risk of lower gastrointestinal bleeding.

462211.label: Project Title(Chinese)
462211.value: 胰腺癌中EZH2/微小RNA-218相互作用的功能解析

462211.label: Project Objectives
462211.value: To delineate the mechanism underlying EZH2 repression on miR-218 expression. Functional characterization of miR-218 in the oncogenic potential of EZH2. Functional characterization of miR-218 in PDAC.
rows: To delineate the mechanism underlying EZH2 repression on miR-218 expression.
Functional characterization of miR-218 in the oncogenic potential of EZH2.
Functional characterization of miR-218 in PDAC.

462211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
462211.value: This proposal aims at the functional characterization of EZH2/microRNA-218 interaction in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). miR-218 is an intragenic miRNA and produced from two unique miRNA precursors: miR-218-1 and miR-218-2. Reduced miR-218 level has been detected in several kinds of solid tumors. miR-218 has been shown to play an important role in tumor metastasis of gastric cancer. However, the functional significance of miR-218 in other cancers remains largely unknown. In pancreatic cancer, there is only one report on the reduced level of miR-218-2 in primary pancreas tumors as compared with normal tissues. The mechanism leading to miR-218 silencing and the functional significance of miR-218 in pancreatic cancer remain elusive. EZH2 is the member of Polycomb repressive complex 2 responsible for silencing target genes through trimethylation of lysine 27 on histone 3. The SET domain in the carboxy terminal of EZH2 is required for the histone methyltransferase activity. We and others have shown EZH2 overexpression in PDAC biopsies. We shown that RNA interference targeting EZH2 markedly inhibited tumor formation and liver metastasis of pancreatic cancer in vivo. To further investigate the oncogenic role of EZH2, we overexpressed EZH2 in non-tumorigenic pancreatic duct epithelial HPDE cells. EZH2 promoted anchorage-independent growth in HPDE cells. Interestingly, EZH2-mediated anchorage-independent growth was independent of its SET domain but dependent on its H-I and H-II domains. To identify miRNAs potentially regulated by EZH2, we performed miRNA profiling. Our preliminary data have shown the repression of miR-218 expression by EZH2. miR-218 expression was silenced by EZH2 overexpression in HPDE cells but re-activated in pancreatic cancer SW1990 cells after EZH2 knockdown. We also shown that miR-218 was silenced in pancreatic cancer cells by DNA methylation and DNA methylation played an important role in EZH2 repression on miR-218. We further found that miR-218 silencing played a key role in the oncogenic potential of EZH2. In this proposal, we will investigate the mechanism underlying EZH2 repression on miR-218 expression. We will characterize the role of miR-218 in the oncogenic activity of EZH2. We will characterize the role of miR-218 in PDAC and identify its targets. Knowledge gained from this project will improve our understanding on the regulation of miR-218 expression and lay the foundation for the development of more effective therapeutics for pancreatic cancer. 本課題的目的為對胰腺癌中EZH2/微小RNA-218相互作用進行功能解析。miR-218是一種微小RNA，有兩種前體物：miR-218-1 and miR-218-2。miR-218表達在胰腺癌中顯著下調。但是，胰腺癌中miR-218表達沉默的機制及其功能意義至今仍不清楚。EZH2是一種多梳蛋白能催化3號組蛋白27位賴氨酸的三甲基化。EZH2羧基端的SET功能域是其發揮組蛋白甲基轉移酶活性所必須。我們及其他研究人員的結果表明EZH2在胰腺癌中高表達。我們的實驗表明以EZH2為靶的RNA干擾在動物體內顯著抑制胰腺癌的生長及肝轉移。為進一步研究EZH2的癌基因活性，我們在非腫瘤的胰腺導管上皮細胞HPDE中過表達EZH2。EZH2促進HPDE細胞的貼壁非依賴性生長。為鑒定受EZH2調控的微小RNA，我們進行了微小RNA表達譜分析。我們初步的研究表明EZH2能抑制miR-218的表達。我們還發現在胰腺癌細胞中DNA甲基化導致miR-218表達沉默，DNA甲基化在EZH2抑制miR-218的表達中起了重要作用。在本課題中，我們將研究EZH2抑制miR-218表達的機制。我們將解析miR-218在EZH2促癌形成中的功能。我們也將解析miR-218在胰腺癌中的功能及鑒定其靶蛋白。本課題所獲得的資訊將為發展新的更有效的胰腺癌治療方法打下堅實的基礎。

462211.label: Realisation of objectives
462211.value: To study the EZH2 repressing mechanism on miR-218, we firstly identify the major locus of miR-218 genes that was subjected to the suppression of EZH2 by measuring the two host genes of miR-218 (SLIT2 and SLIT3) expression as well as the two primary forms of miR-218 (miR-218-1 and miR-218-2) in PDAC cell lines, and determined the one that accounted for the loss of miR-218 level in PDAC cells. We also measured the change of both primary miR-218 forms upon the inhibition of EZH2 by small molecule inhibitor or siRNAs. Subsequently, the level of histone 3 lysine 27 methylation (H3K27me3) and CpG island methylation were studied in PDAC cells depleted with EZH2 by shRNAs. To show the impact of DNA methylation on miR-218 clinically, we also measured the frequency of DNA methylation of the miR-218 promoter in human PDAC tissues by methylation specific PCR. Futhermore, various truncated forms of EZH2 protein were generated and overexpressed in non-tumor human pancreatic ductal epithelial (HPDE) cells. Each mutant had at least one functional domain deleted, and the effect to miR-218 level was determined. Lastly, we studied the effect of EZH2 to heterochromatin factor recruitment. To study the role of miR-218 in EZH2-mediated oncogenic functions, we measured both miR-218 level and EZH2 level in human PDAC tissues and studied the correlation. We then inhibited miR-218 level by transfecting miR-218 inhibitor in PDAC cells depleted with EZH2, and studied the role of miR-218 in PDAC cell growth. Subsequently, we delineated the EZH2-miR-218 pathway by identification of miR-218 functional targets. As such, we could illustrate the impact of downstream targets deregulation to PDAC development and progression. For potential target of miR-218, we had validated the interaction between miR-218 and the 3’ untranslated region by luciferase reporter assay, as well as measuring the change of level in response to the increase or decrease of miR-218 level in cells. To study the functional role of miR-218 in PDAC, we conducted various functional assays upon transiently overexpressed or inhibited miR-218 in PDAC cells by transfecting miR-218 mimics or miR-218 inhibitor respectively. The functional assay included MTT cell proliferation assay, cell migration assay, cell invasion assay, subcutaneous tumor formation assay and metastasis assay. In addition, we identified the putative targets of miR-218 and demonstrated that they contributed to the development and progression of PDAC cells.

462211.label: Major findings and research outcome
462211.value: Our study demonstrates a pivotal role of EZH2 during the suppression of miR-218 in PDAC, and reveals a previously under-emphasized silencing mechanism involving EZH2-induced de novo heterochromatinization in cancer biology. Firstly, we showed that multiple epigenetic mechanisms were induced by EZH2 to silence miR-218 expression at gene locus 2. Then, we demonstrated that EZH2 is a central player leading epigenetic suppression to miR-218 that establish suppressive histone marker H3K27me3, promoter DNA methylation, and recruitment of chromatin-modulating factors at the suppressed miR-218-2 promoter, which gave a new angle to understand the role of EZH2. Heterochromatin induction at miR-218 promoter added an extra dimension to EZH2-mediated aberration that explained a persistent silencing effect. In addition, depletion of EZH2 effectively removed all these suppressive factors from the miR-218-2 promoter, which indicated EZH2 was indispensible during the heterochromatin formation. EZH2 induces permanent repression of miR-218 by induction of heterochromatin around the miR-218-2 promoter in a progressive manner. This persistent effect is essential to alter gene network homeostasis that provides an advantageous condition for cell growth and dissemination. Secondly, the silencing of miR-218 in PDAC cells contributed heavily to the development and progression of PDAC. miR-218 negatively regulates PDAC growth and metastasis by inhibiting PDAC cell proliferation, tumor microvessel formation, and cell migration and invasion. miR-218 also functioned to inhibit in vivo tumor growth and metastasis in nude mice. We then identified the functional targets of miR-218 and showed that EZH2-miR-218 pathway dysregulation increased cell aggressiveness via the upregulation of VOPP1 and UGT8. Expression of VOPP1 could promote PDAC cell growth while UGT8 was critical functional target of miR-218 in promoting PDAC metastasis. More importantly, targeting EZH2 alone sufficiently abolished aberrant epigenetic effects in PDAC. The unveil of novel EZH2 silencing mechanism that involved the formation of heterochromatin at target gene promoter opened a new avenue in studying EZH2 silencing effect. In addition, this study could prompt the development of miR-218 based therapeutic strategies against PDAC, and investigation on the diagnostic and prognostic values of miR-218 pathway.

462211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
462211.value: We have demonstrated the importance of miR-218 in PDAC. The potential role of miR-218 as diagnostic or prognostic markers can be further studied. The potential of diagnostic marker can be evaluate by measuring the expression level of miR-218 in serum/plasma samples of tumor and non-tumor patients. The prognostic value can be determined by correlating miR-218 level with various clinical parameters of the patients such as metastatic rate or recurrence rate. The role of UGT8 is still largely unexplored in PDAC, so we can characterize the functional roles of UGT8 in PDAC cells. According to ncbi gene database, there are several variants of UGT8 expressed in human cells. We can determine the major variant that was upregulated in PDAC cells and promoted metastasis of PDAC cells. Overexpression of UGT8 could be induced in non-tumor human pancreatic duct cells by infecting lentivirus carrying full length transgenes, and the functional roles of UGT8 in non-tumor cells can be determined by various functional assays including Brdu cell proliferation assay, colony formation assay, soft agar assay, cell migration and invasion assay. The in vivo role of UGT8 can also be determined by subcutaneously xenograft growth assay and metastatic assay.

462211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
462211.value: The expression level of a microRNA named miR-218, that played a role in inhibiting cancer development and progression, was reduced by EZH2 which was a protein that had abnormally high expression in PDAC cells. We firstly showed that loss of miR-218 expression in miR-218 gene locus 2 accounted for the loss of miR-218 level in PDAC cells. Then, we showed that increased EZH2 level in PDAC cells induced the trimethylation of histone 3 lysine 27, CpG island methylation and promoted the recruitment of heterochromatin associated factors at the promoter region of miR-218. miR-218 played an important role in the growth and dissemination of PDAC cells triggered by EZH2 protein. miR-218 functioned to reduce cell growth rate of PDAC cells and tumor growth rate in nude mice. miR-218 also functioned to reduced cell migration and invasion rate, and metastasis rate in nude mice. In human PDAC tissues, we observed a correlation between increased EZH2 expression and a reduction of miR-218 level. A reduction of miR-218 was also associated with the increased of miR-218 target UGT8 protein that was highly associated to cell metastasis.

462511.value: 脊椎動物中廣泛存在調節多種生物過程的igf系統，研究提示igf系統在卵巢中發揮重要功能。我們在硬骨魚中發現了一種新穎的性腺特異的igf亞型(igf3)，斑馬魚卵細胞igf3的表達分析顯示igf3在卵泡生成過程中因時期不同而表達不同，其中在完全成熟的卵泡中表達量最高；mRNA和蛋白水平的分析顯示igf3主要分布在卵泡的濾泡層。我們也通過實驗驗證了igf3在斑馬魚卵細胞成熟中作為卵細胞中LH的下遊調節因子行使調節功能。有趣的是，我們發現卵細胞成熟中igf3和LH的功能都能被ifgr的抑制因子中斷。這些結果初步驗證了局部的igf活性通過調節性激素影響卵泡成熟。由此，我們提出以下假設：igf3/igf1r是斑馬魚卵細胞成熟中LH的重要調節因子。在這個研究計劃裏，我們描述了現有的研究結果，並擬定一系列的實驗驗證我們的假設。為此，我們將以斑馬魚為模型，設計實驗完成如下研究目標：研究igf3與igf1rs之間的功能關系；研究igf1rs的時空表達情況和濾泡細胞中LH對igf1rs表達的調控情況；及研究在敲減igf3或者阻遏igf1rs後，卵細胞成熟過程中LH的變化情況。

462511.label: Realisation of objectives
462511.value: Using an array of different approaches as well as biochemical and molecular methods, we have provided both in vitro and in vivo evidence demonstrating that IGF-3 acts as a crucial mediator of LH-induced oocyte maturation in zebrafish. These results not only supply valuable information on the role of IGF on oocyte maturation but also provide insights into a better understanding on the signaling pathway of meiotic resumption in female reproduction in other species.

462511.label: Major findings and research outcome
462511.value: Using this grant, we have successfully substantiated our original hypothesis on the importance of Igf3 in mediating the action of LH on oocyte maturation in zebrafish. The major findings are: 1. The temporal and spatial expression of the Igf ligands and their type 1 receptors in zebrafish during early embryonic development was revealed in detail. The dynamic and overlapping profile of expression suggest the coordination of the divergent functions of the Igf system in zebrafish. 2. The expression of Igfs is regulated by LH through a cAMP pathway in intact follicles as well as in primary cultured follicular cells, with Igf3 expression being the most sensitive to human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) treatment. Moreover, recombinant zebrafish IGF-2a, IGF-2b, and IGF-3 proteins significantly enhanced oocyte maturation via IGF-1 receptors (IGF-1rs), with IGF-3 exhibiting the most potent stimulatory action on oocyte maturation. Furthermore, we have demonstrated that IGF-3 or hCG treatment could stimulate IGF-1rs phosphorylation, and hCG-induced oocyte maturation could be attenuated by IGF-1r inhibitors as well as by an anti-IGF-3 antiserum in vitro and in vivo, indicating that the IGF system especially IGF-3 plays a crucial role in mediating LH action on oocyte maturation. In addition, igf3 expression is significantly attenuated in LH β-subunit (lhb) mutant zebrafish and treatment with recombinant IGF-3 could partially rescue the oocyte maturation defects of the lhb mutants in vitro and in vivo. Collectively, our results clearly demonstrated that IGFs, particularly the gonad-specific IGF-3, act as important mediators of LH action on oocyte maturation in zebrafish.

462511.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
462511.value: Our studies have led us to reveal other interesting findings as described below. First, this gonad-specific growth factor might act as a key factor in regulating the sex of zebrafish to become female. This hypothesis is based on three lines of evidence: (1) a much higher expression level of Igf3 in adult ovary than testis; (2) a significant increased Igf3 expression during the process of sex differentiation; and (3) that Igf3-null zebrafish exclusively develop into fertile male fish. These have led us to ask the following questions: (1) What is the temporal and spatial expression profile of Igf3 during zebrafish gonad differentiation? (2) Is Igf3 crucial for ovary differentiation in zebrafish? and (3) How does Igf3 regulate sex differentiation in zebrafish? Based on this, we have successfully obtained another RGC grant (14119715) to work on these issues. Second, our recent data also suggest that Igf3 is involved in regulating ovulation in zebrafish. This is based on three observations: (1) Igf3 expression could be regulated by LH; (2) ovulation could be induced by recombinant Igf3; and (3) induction of the key ovulatory pathway by LH could be blocked by Igf1r inhibitors. This will constitute another prong of our future research efforts.

462511.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
462511.value: Igf3 is a novel Igf ligand in teleost reported by us. We have identified this novel growth factor in several species of teleost including zebrafish. The gonad-specific expression of Igf3 suggests its important role in the reproductive functions of fish. Using zebrafish as the model, we have recently found that: (1) the unique expression pattern of Igf3 correlates with that of the LH receptor in the ovary; (2) the expression of Igf3 could be regulated by LH via a cAMP-dependent pathway; (3) recombinant Igf3 could stimulate oocyte maturation in zebrafish; and (4) the action of Igf3 and LH on oocyte maturation could be greatly attenuated by an Igf1r inhibitor. These results have led us to postulate that Igf3 exerts its action through binding to Igf1r and the Igf3/Igf1r system serves as an important mediator of LH action on zebrafish oocyte maturation. The present project has indeed uncovered the functional role of Igf3 in mediating the action of LH on oocyte maturation in zebrafish. The successful accomplishment of this project has led to a fuller understanding of the role of the Igf system in fish reproduction. Such information will contribute towards revealing the ovarian signaling network in oocyte maturation across vertebrates.

462611.label: Project Objectives
462611.value: Overall justification: Since the main expenses for this project are on MRI examination and physiological assessment of the vestibular function, with a significant reduction in the allocated budget, we need to cut down the number of the above examinations. The Objectives of the project are unchanged. However, in order to maintain a statistically sound sample size, the total number of cross-sectional study is only slightly reduced from 150 to 125. Since the baseline MRI assessment for morphological changes in semicircular canals, vestibular utricle and saccule and cochlea, as well as the comprehensive standardized physiological tests for vestibular function are equally important as the key objectives and potential prognostic factors in AIS curve progression, we decide to perform both examinations in ALL subjects during their first visit. In the second visit, instead of repeating these expensive investigations, we would only perform the clinical assessment in ALL subjects including measurement of Cobb angle, which serves as the most important marker for any evidence of curve progression. By this modification, we wish to achieve our initial goal of the study without affecting the power of the study. It also avoids the potential selection bias for follow up subjects in our initial proposal. Other modifications as suggested by the GRF Panel: (1) 3Tesla MRI scanner will be used for all MRI examination to improve the resolution of vestibular system. (2) Right and left vestibular system will be assessed as a pair on MRI imaging and computer analysis (3) The length of examination has been shortened for both MRI and vestibular test by modifying the sequences and procedure, in order to reduce the total cost per subject.

462611.label: Realisation of objectives
462611.value: Our first objective of this project is to study the surface and morphology of the vestibular system in AIS. The vestibular system is a small and complex organ inside the inner ear. It has a genus-3 surface which makes it difficult to find an accurate pointwise for surface analysis. To solve such problem, a collaboration with the Dept. of Mathematics in CUHK has been launched. We have applied the quasi-conformal theory and landmark constrained registration of high-genus surfaces to achieve surface diffeomorphic registration. Also, we use an in-house algorithm to measure the length of the semi-circular canals in patients with AIS. Our results found significantly difference between healthy and AIS. Manuscripts regarding this objective have been either submitted or published. Our second objective is to study the relationship between the morphology of the vestibular system to clinical assessment. A series of clinical testing has been done on our AIS and normal subjects. Preliminary results have no significant difference between them, which can be explained by the compensation effect from the neuro system. A manuscript is under preparation and will be submitted by the end of 2015. Our third objective is to study whether vestibule system is related to the curve progression. One of our recent publication has indicated that the AIS group with curve progression has significantly longer vertebral column length, smaller cord-vertebral length ratio, and a higher AP/TS cord ratio. After that, we have started to compare the semi-circular canals. Our results indicated that one of the canals in those AIS patients with progressive curve is shorter compared to those non-progressive curve AIS patients and also to the normal control. This work will be submitted by the end of 2015 partially together with the results from objective 2.

462611.label: Major findings and research outcome
462611.value: Quasi-conformal theory and landmark constrained registration of high-genus surfaces were applied to achieve surface diffeomorphic registration. Then the local thickness and the length of the semi-circular canals were measured. Geometric difference was obtained along the length of the posterior canal in the left-side vestibular system of the AIS [5]. The centerline approach have been further applied to measure the true length of the semi-circular canal in AIS. Results indicated that the lateral canal was also significantly different between AIS and healthy [7]. These findings fulfilled our objective 1 to study the morphology of the vestibular system in AIS. To achieve the second objective, we collaborated with the Dept. of Otorhinolaryngology. A series of postural balancing test was conducted to the evaluate the balancing performance of AIS and healthy subjects. Our results indicated that their performance had no large difference and it was possibly due to compensation effect. One of our recent publication indicated that the AIS group with curve progression had significantly longer vertebral column length, smaller cord-vertebral length ratio, and a higher AP/TS cord ratio. Results were based on the data from those AIS with at least two-years of follow up [6]. The morphology of the vestibular system was compared between AIS patients with and without curve progression. Our results indicated that the distance between the centers of the lateral and superior canals, the angle between the center-joining lings at the posterior canal, and the angle between the center-joining lings at the lateral canal were different between the two groups [8]. Besides, we studied the spine and curve pattern in AIS. Using diffusion tensor imaging, the integrity of the spinal cord was observed. Significant correlation was found between the tonsillar level and fractional anisotropy value at the C4–5 level in AIS [3].

462611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
462611.value: Since our clinical testing on the performance of postural balance in AIS has no significant results possibly due to compensation effect, it would be difficult for us to verify the correlation between dysfunction or deficit of the vestibular system and curve progression in AIS using human model. An alternative approach is to test it with animal model. One of the domain experts in France has previous experience in using frog model to study the relationship between vestibular system and the etiology of AIS. We will seek for further grant support to study the vestibular system in frog model and attempt to find out whether the altered semi-circular canals or the whole morphology of the vestibular system is one of the causes of AIS.

462611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
462611.value: In this project, we have conducted scientific studies based on the objectives we set in the proposal. They have been well studied and articles have been published in specify domain journals. In general, we found that the morphology or the shape of the semi-circular canals are different between patients with AIS and healthy volunteers. But we cannot conclude whether the change of the vestibular system is a cause or consequence of AIS. We have preliminary results that demonstrate the shape and length of the semi-circular canals play a role in the curve progression in AIS. However, some results are inconsistent between studies probably due to the different sample size and the setting of the study.

462611.label: Other impact (e.g. award of patents or prizes, collaboration with other research institutions, technology transfer, etc.)
462611.value: In this project,we worked closely with several other departments in CUHK and overseas universities. Vestibular system is a small organ located inside the inner ear. To obtain a good view of its anatomical structure, we worked together with the Dept. of Imaging and Intervenaional Radiology in CUHK to collect MR images of it using the state-of-the-art techniques. One of our recent collaborations with the Mathematics department at CUHK and Stony Brook University was to study the high-genus surfaces and morphology of the vestibular system. This collaboration brought us to a new direction to study AIS. We have another overseas collaboration with University Medical Center Utrecht to study the asymmetrical spine of AIS. Furthermore, our long-term partnership with the Nanjing University has been continued to study the difference between difference and similarity between AIS and Chiari I. Students exchange and annual meeting have become routine activities to share the latest findings and knowledge. Besides, we participated in many local and international conferences including the Annual Congress of the Hong Kong Orthopaedic Association (HKOA), Meeting of the International Research Society of Spinal Deformities (IRSSD) and the Asian Oceanic Society of Paediatric Radiology (AOSPR) which we received the Best proffered paper award, to share new ideas with domain experts.

462811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
462811.value: Osteoporotic fracture is a challenging healthcare problem to deal with over the world, which constitutes 12% of the total disease burden in Hong Kong. It usually takes longer time for repair due to the poor reparative potential in osteoporotic bone. The mechanism of impaired healing may be multifactorial and reduced mesenchymal stem cell (MSCs) recruitment is one of the causative factors. Therefore, understanding the mechanism of MSCs recruitment in fracture healing is important for orthopaedic researchers. Our previous study has proven that some MSCs involved in fracture repair were systemically mobilized and recruited to the fracture from remote bone marrow sites via peripheral circulation. Recent findings also show that the recruitment of MSCs for fracture healing is through a chemokine, stromal derived factor-1 (SDF-1) that binds to its receptor (CXCR4). These evidences show that circulating MSCs and SDF-1/CXCR4 system play a critical role in fracture repair. Meanwhile, low-magnitude high-frequency vibration (LMHFV), a modality providing systemic mechanical stimulation at 35Hz, 0.3g, is proven effective in accelerating fracture healing. We are the first group to report that LMHFV significantly enhanced both normal and osteoporotic fracture healing by 30% through enhanced callus formation, mineralization and remodeling, where osteoporotic bones interestingly showed good response to LMHFV as normal one. Angiogenesis at fracture callus was significantly enhanced as well. Its efficacy was further confirmed in randomized controlled trial on intertrochanteric fracture patients, with retarded bone loss and enhanced range of motion at hip. The mechanism of LMHFV, however, is not fully explored. On mechanism, we also demonstrated that SDF-1/CXCR4 expression and cell migration of rat-isolated MSCs were enhanced by mechanical stimulation in form of acoustic wave, confirming mechanical loading can modulate SDF-1/CXCR4 system in MSCs. Based on the above scientific evidences, we hypothesize that LMHFV accelerates osteoporotic fracture healing by enhancing systemic recruitment of MSCs through SDF-1/CXCR4. The objectives of this study are to investigate the effect of LMHFV on the recruitment of intravenously administered MSCs to fracture sites in osteoporotic bones; to evaluate the mechanism of MSC recruitment through SDF-1; and to compare the expression of SDF-1 and CXCR4 between treatment and control groups. The labeled MSCs recruitment will be assessed by bioluminescence imaging, while fracture repair is monitored radiographically, densitometrically, histologically and biomechanically. The findings will help us understand the mechanism of LMHFV in MSCs recruitment for osteoporotic fracture healing and may potentially be an approach to further enhance the efficacy of LMHFV. 骨質疏鬆性骨折是全世界面臨而具有挑戰性的醫療保健難題，其相關醫療花費佔香港醫療支出的12%。通常這類骨折由於骨質疏鬆骨的再生機能較差，因而康復時間更長。骨折的修復機制是多因素參與的，而間充質幹細胞 (MSCs)募集減少是一個主要的原因。因此，理解骨折愈合過程中MSCs募集減少的機制對於骨科研究者相當重要。 我們先前的研究證實一些參與骨折修復的MSCs是由全身動員的，並通過外周循環從遠處的骨髓募集到骨折周圍。最近的研究也顯示骨折修復過程中MSCs的募集是通過一種趨化因子—基質細胞衍生因子-1(SDF-1)與其受體 (CXCR4)綁定介導的。這些證據顯示外周循環MSCs和SDF-1/CXCR4系統在骨折修復中扮演關鍵角色。同時，低振幅高頻振動(LMHFV)，一種提供35Hz、0.3g系統性機械刺激的物理療法被證明對加速骨折修復有效。我們的研究團隊首先發現了LMHFV顯著提高正常骨及骨質疏鬆骨骨折30%愈合速度，LMHFV可促進骨痂形成、礦化和重建過程，同時骨質疏鬆骨較正常骨對LHMFV的反應更佳。LMHFV的效果在對粗隆間骨折病人的隨機對照研究中得到進一步證實，可使骨量丟失減緩並增加髖部的活動度。然而LMHFV的機制尚未完全探明。我們也在機制上證明SDF-1/CXCR4表達及從大鼠分離出的MSCs細胞遷移在受到聲波的機械刺激後增強，進一步確認機械負荷可以調節SDF-1/CXCR4系統對MSCs的作用。 基於以上證據，我們推測LMHFV通過SDF-1/CXCR4增加MSCs的系統性募集，加速骨質疏鬆性骨折修復。本研究的目的包括：研究LMHFV影響通過靜脈注射入體內的MSCs向骨質疏鬆骨骨折部位的募集的作用；研究通過SDF-1募集MSC的機制；並比較治療組和對照組之間SDF-1 和CXCR4的表達。被熒光標記的MSCs募集過程將通過生物熒光顯現系統進行評估，而骨折愈合過程將通過影像學、骨密度、組織學及生物力學進行監控。本研究的結果將有助於我們瞭解LMHFV對骨質疏鬆骨折修復過程中MSCs募集的作用機制，同時將來進一步研究加強LMHFV的臨床效用。

462811.label: Realisation of objectives
462811.value: 1. LMHFV was found to enhance fracture healing in osteoporotic fractured rats administered with MSC. The primary outcome of this study was the morphometry of fracture callus by callus width and area. It was found that LMHFV increased callus width in the vibration treated group (VMG) at week 2 and week 3 with significant difference compared to the no-vibration, MSC-injected group (MG). These results are also substantiated by the MicroCT analysis, showing the callus formation was enhanced in the VMG compared to the MG in tissue volume (TV), bone volume (BV) and the BV/TV fraction. Moreover, the intensity of GFP-labelled MSC was found to be higher in the VMG compared to the MG with statistically significant difference at week 2 and week 4 (p<0.005 and p=0.04 respectively) indicating that the recruitment of MSC at the fracture site could be enhanced by LMHFV therapy. Therefore it was concluded that MSC recruitment was enhanced by LMHFV. 2. The objective was investigated with the use of AMD3100 to antagonize the CXCR-4 in the group of VAMG. The enhancement effects of LMHFV therapy was shown to be suppressed in the VAMG group in the callus morphometry (callus width and area), and MicroCT assessments in terms of TV, BV and BV/TV fraction also showed antagonization of CXCR-4 would reduce the enhancement effects of LMHFV. GFP intensity would also be detected to be lower in the VAMG group compared to the VMG group. 3. The serum SDF-1 level was quantified by an ELISA kit. Results have indicated that the vibration treatment was capable of increasing the SDF-1 level in the VMG compared to the CG at week 2 (p=0.011); and higher than MG and CG at week 4 with significant difference (p=0.033 and 0.036 respectively). The results indicated that vibration was able to enhance SDF-1 level in the serum in both the VMG and VAMG groups, but the enhancement effect in fracture healing was suppressed by antagonization of CXCR-4 by AMG-3100.
