477611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
477611.value: A major limitation of percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) with bare-metal stent (BMS) is in-stent restenosis (re-narrowing) which can cause recurrence of symptoms and the need for repeat revascularization. The principal cause of in-stent restenosis is neointimal hyperplasia (scar tissue growth) in response to injury during stent implantation. The advent of drug-eluting stents (DES) that release an anti-proliferative agent has dramatically reduced restenosis and the need for repeat procedures (1). In 2006, >70% of stents placed in Hong Kong were DES (2). Despite the benefits of DES, there is still a role for BMS in contemporary management of coronary artery disease. The cost-effectiveness of DES remains uncertain because DES is 2-3 times more expensive than BMS and clinical benefit of DES is more apparent in patients at high-risk of restenosis. Use of DES in Hong Kong is dependent on patient’s willingness-to-pay. Those who cannot afford DES either opt for BMS or accept government subsidy which invariably means BMS. These patients are at risk of restenosis and recurrence of symptoms which may require repeat procedures and hospitalizations. Therefore, a cost-effective alternative to DES is warranted for patients at high-risk of BMS restenosis. Local delivery of anti-proliferative agents (i.e. paclitaxel) using a special application catheter is an alternative approach for intracoronary pharmacotherapy. Advantages of this technique over DES include (i) no need for drug-carrier coating which is thrombogenic; (ii) ability to treat the whole vessel wall beyond area around stent struts and (iii) each catheter can be used to treat multiple lesions in one patient. A randomized study has shown that local delivery of fluid paclitaxel after BMS was safe and significantly reduced restenosis and clinical events compared with BMS alone in low-risk patients (3). This may decrease healthcare costs when repeat interventions are required for restenosis. Furthermore, procedural cost saving up to 50% is possible if one or more DES is obviated by this technique. This multi-center randomized-controlled study aims to assess safety, efficacy and cost-effectiveness of catheter-based local delivery of fluid paclitaxel in patients at high-risk of restenosis after implantation of BMS compared to BMS alone. Repeat angiography with intravascular ultrasound (and optical coherence tomography in selected patients) at 12-months will assess degree of restenosis. Clinical outcomes are measured up to 3-years. Results of this study have potential to change local and international practice in providing a cost-effective strategy to improve BMS outcomes at a time of escalating healthcare expenditure. 經皮冠狀動脈介入治療（PCI）中放置傳統金屬支架（BMS）的主要缺陷是放置後發生血管支架內再狹窄（再縮小），這可能會導致症狀復發和需要再次血運重建。支架內再狹窄的主要原因是支架植入損傷造成的內膜增生（疤痕組織生長）。釋放抗增殖劑的藥性支架（DES）的問世，大大降低再狹窄和需要再次血運重建的幾率。（1）2006年，70%在香港放置的支架為藥性支架（DES）。（2）儘管藥性支架（DES）的益處較多，金屬支架（BMS）在冠狀動脈疾病的現代治療中仍有一定作用。 藥性支架（DES）的成本效益仍然不明確，因為藥性支架（DES）比金屬支架（BMS）貴2-3倍，而且藥性支架（DES）對再狹窄的高危病人臨床受益更為明顯。在香港應用藥性支架（DES）主要取決于病人是否願意自費治療。不能支付費用的病人會選擇比較便宜的金屬支架（BMS）或者接受政府資助, 而政府資助通常只是金屬支架（BMS）。而由於不能放置藥性支架（DES）, 許多有支架內再狹窄風險的病人將會增加心絞痛復發繼而需要再次PCI和入院治療。因此，一個具有成本效益可以替代藥性支架（DES）的治療方法對於BMS置入后支架再狹窄的高危患者來說是必要的。經特殊導管輸送藥物（例如Paclitaxel）是與藥性支架（DES）相似療效的另一選擇.。與藥性支架（DES）相比這種技術的優勢包括（i）沒有藥物載體涂層的需要，從而不會導致血栓形成;（ii）可治療支架覆蓋範圍以外的整個血管壁；（iii）每個導管可用於治療同一個病人的多個病變。近期已有一個隨機分配、對照試驗顯示在低危的患者放置金屬支架後使用液態Paclitaxel是安全的, 並且與單純放置金屬支架（BMS）相比, 可以有效減少支架內再狹窄的發生率和臨床事件。（3）這可能會降低因為再狹窄重複支架置入的費用。此外， 因為這項技術而少用一個或多個藥性支架（DES），可能節省高達 50％的成本。 這個多中心隨機對照研究，旨在評估與單純植入金屬支架（BMS）相比，在金屬支架（BMS）置入後接受額外經導管使用液態Paclitaxel治療，對再狹窄風險高的病人的安全性，有效性和成本效益。12個月后我們將重複血管造影與進行血管內超聲檢查（並對合適的病人進行光學相干斷層掃描檢查），來評估血管再狹窄的程度。臨床治療效果將在3年后進行評估。在一個醫療開支不斷上升的時代，這項研究結果有可能改變現時香港和國際的治療方法，為改善金屬支架（BMS）的治療效果提供一個具有成本效益的策略。

477611.label: Realisation of objectives
477611.value: This is the first randomized controlled study to access the safety, efficacy and cost-effectiveness of anti-proliferative treatment of coronary arteries with a novel catheter-based delivery of fluid paclitaxel after bare-metal stenting (BMS) to reduce restenosis in high-risk patients. All 3 of our study objectives were achieved. In total, 34 patients were recruited, randomized and underwent the study procedure without complications (Objective 1a & 3c). 12 and 24 month clinical follow-up was complete in all patients. Among the 34 subjects, 3 passed away before 12 month follow up but none were due to cardiac causes. Angiographic follow up was available for 67.7% (n=13/31) patients and 32.3% defaulted follow-up angiography. At 1 year angiographic and intravascular ultrasound follow-up, we found no significant differences in our primary outcome measure of late lumen loss (0.84±0.42 vs. 0.83±0.46, p=NS) or secondary endpoints included binary restenosis rate (23.1% vs. 12.5%), minimal lumen diameter (1.75±0.47mm vs. 1.91±0.56mm), diameter stenosis (33.5±23.7% vs. 31.3±21.1%) between patients who received fluid paclitaxel after BMS and BMS alone (all p=NS) (Objective 1b). There were no differences in adverse clinical outcomes up to 2 years in terms of target lesion revascularization (TLR, 14.3% vs. 0%) and major adverse cardiac events (MACE, including death, myocardial infarction (MI) and TLR, 28.6% vs. 7.7%, both p=NS) (Objective 1c & d). There were no episodes of stent thrombosis (Objective 2a). In the absence of clinical efficacy and incremental cost associated with delivery of fluid paclitaxel, cost-effectiveness of BMS alone dominated (i.e. more costly and less effective) fluid paclitaxel after BMS (Objective 3). Although we did not reach the a priori estimated sample size, we believe the likelihood of a type 2 error (i.e. falsely concluding there was no significant difference, when in fact there was a difference) was low given the consistency of negative results in all primary and secondary endpoints. We did not reach our targeted sample size of 97 patients for a number of reasons: 1. Unforeseen 8 month delay in study start date because of last minute requirement by our ethics committee to apply for a Clinical Trial Certificate (CTC) from the Department of Health in January 2012. We received the CTC in August and final ethics approval to start enrolment in September 2012. 2. Equal enrolment of 33 patients was planned for each 3 sites. We achieved our site target with 34 patients. However, collaborating sites in Singapore (NUHS) and Malaysia (SGH) applied to their respective local authority to use the investigational product (Genie catheter) but did not receive approval in time to contribute to our study. 3. Unforeseen decline in number of patients opting for BMS over the last few years since the design of the study. The number of BMS procedures at our institution was relatively stable from 49.7% in 2004 to 49.6% in 2005, 57% in 2006, 56.4% in 2007, 56.9% in 2008 and 41.7% in 2009. The feasibility and design of our study was calculated based on these figures at the time of grant application in 2010. However, the number of BMS procedures declined dramatically over subsequent years from 36% in 2010 to 28.4% in 2011, 19.8% in 2012, 20.3% in 2013 to 6.9% in 2014 until the end of our study. A major reason for this decline was due to step-up of government subsidy to fund DES for PCI instead of BMS starting in 2014. Given that the majority (86%) of our recruited BMS cases prior to 2014 received government subsidy, this change in policy has greatly reduced eligible patients for recruitment. 4. High screen failure rate of 83%. During the study recruitment period from September 2012 to September 2014, 1,247 patients underwent PCI at our institutions of which 1039 (83.0%) received drug-eluting stents (DES) and 195 (15.6%) received bare-metal stents (BMS). All BMS patients were screened, of which 33.3% (n=65/195) did not meet the inclusion or general exclusion criteria and 29.2% (n=57/195) declined to participate in the study and 37.4% (n=73/195) eligible patients signed informed consent prior to coronary angiography as per protocol. Of these, 53.4% (n=39/73) were excluded after angiography because of normal findings or minor disease or not requiring PCI (34.2%), in-stent restenosis for which DES was indicated and therefore unethical to randomize (6.8%), angiographic exclusion criteria (6.8%) and need for CABG instead of PCI (5.5%). By end of September 2014, 34 patients (17.4% of all BMS patients) have been successful recruited (21 randomized to treatment arm and 13 to placebo arm).

477611.label: Major findings and research outcome
477611.value: We conducted a prospective, randomized trial comparing percutaneous coronary intervention with bare-metal stent (BMS) alone (BMS group, n=13) with local delivery of fluid paclitaxel using a novel drug-delivery balloon after BMS implantation (Paclitaxel group, n=21) in high-risk patients with ≥1 risk factors for in-stent restenosis: (i) diabetes mellitus (47.1%), (ii) target vessel diameter ≤2.5mm (23.5%) or length ≥20mm (35.3%), (iii) bifurcation lesion (8.8%), (iv) chronic total occlusion (11.8%). Primary endpoint was in-stent late lumen loss (LLL) with is the difference in millimeters between the diameter of a stented segment post-procedure compared with the follow-up angiogram at 12 months. Secondary endpoints included binary restenosis rate defined as ≥50% luminal narrowing at follow-up angiography, minimal lumen diameter, percentage diameter stenosis, target lesion revascularization (TLR) which is either repeat percutaneous or surgical revascularization for a lesion within and near the stent and major adverse cardiac events (MACE, including death, myocardial infarction and TLR) at 12 months. All procedures were successful and without complications. One year follow-up coronary angiography with intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) was available in 21 (68%) of patients and showed no significant differences in LLL between Paclitaxel and BMS group (0.84±0.42 vs. 0.83±0.46, p=NS) or rates of binary restenosis (23.1% vs. 12.5%). Rates of myocardial infarction (19.0% vs 0%) and TLR (14.3% vs. 0%) in Paclitaxel compared to BMS group were not significantly different up to 2 years follow-up (all p=NS). There were no episodes of early or late stent thrombosis. We demonstrated that catheter-based delivery of fluid paclitaxel after BMS was safe and feasible but failed to prove efficacy in reducing neo-intimal proliferation, restenosis, and clinical events compared with BMS implantation alone. In the absence of clinical efficacy and incremental cost associated with delivery of fluid paclitaxel, cost-effectiveness of BMS alone dominated (i.e. less costly and non-inferior to) fluid paclitaxel after BMS. We have submitted two abstracts to the largest international interventional cardidology meeting (Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutic) to be held in Washington DC, United States in Oct 2016 to report i) the efficacy & safety of catheter-based delivery of fluid paclitaxel in patients after implantation of BMS and ii) downtrend of the use of BMS over a decade in Hong Kong from ~50% in 2004 to ~7% in 2014. Results of the abstract submissions are pending.

477611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
477611.value: This study highlights the rapidly changing landscape in interventional cardiology practice. At the time of inception of this study, BMS was used in ~50% of cases of which many were at high-risk of in-stent restenosis who would benefit from but were unable to afford the more expensive drug-eluting stents (DES). Therefore, we designed this study to address this clinical need to seek and develop a cost-effctive alternative to DES based on positive results from a number of pre-clinical and a randomized-studies which showed feasibility and efficacy of local delivery of fluid paclitaxel to the coronary vessel after BMS compared to BMS alone in a lower risk population. As described above, the use of BMS declined dramatically from ~50% at the time of study design in 2010 to ~7% at the end of the study period in 2014. The main reason for this unforseen downtrend was due to changes in government reimbursement policy for DES. As a result, we have lost clinical equipoise in pursuing this trial. However, we should not be discouraged in conducting clinically relevant trials to address real clinical problems as in this case.

477611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
477611.value: A major limitation of percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) with bare-metal stent (BMS) is in-stent restenosis (re-narrowing) which can cause symptom recurrence and the need for repeat revascularization. The advent of drug-eluting stents (DES) has dramatically reduced restenosis and need for repeat procedures. However, many patients at high-risk of restenosis were unable to afford DES which is 2 to 3 times more expensive than BMS. Therefore, a cost-effective alternative to DES is needed. To address this clinical problem, we conducted a randomized controlled trial to evaluate intracoronary delivery of fluid paclitaxel (an anti-proliferative agent used in DES) after BMS implantation as a cost-effective alternative to DES compared to BMS alone for high-risk patients. In this study, we demonstrated that catheter-based delivery of fluid paclitaxel after BMS was safe and feasible but failed to prove efficacy in reducing in-stent restenosis and adverse clinical events compared with BMS implantation alone at 1 year follow-up. An unintended finding of this study was the unforeseen downtrend in BMS use in Hong Kong from ~50% in 2010 to ~7% in 2014 as a result of changes in government reimbursement policies. This highlighted the rapidly changing landscape in clinical practice, especially in the field of interventional cardiology.

478011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
478011.value: Transient receptor potential (TRP) channels function as cellular sensors to perceive and respond to a variety of environmental stimuli including temperature, pain, pressure and fluid flow. These channels can be divided into seven subfamilies, which include TRPC, TRPV, TRPP, and four others. Functional TRP channels are tetrameric complexes consisting of four pore-forming subunits. Four pore-forming subunits could be identical (homotetramers) or different (heterotetramers). Heteromeric assembly usually occurs between the members within the same TRP subfamily such as between TRPC1 and -C5. In the preliminary study, we found that, when TRPV4, -C1 and -P2 are co-expressed in HEK293 cells, they form a TRPV4-C1-P2 physical complex. Functionally, this channel mediates flow-induced Ca2+ influx in these cells. This physical complex could either be TRPV4-C1-P2 heteromeric channel, or TRPV4-C1 interacting with TRPP2. If it is confirmed to be TRPV4-C1-P2 heteromeric channels, it would represent a conceptual breakthrough: the first identified TRP channels that are composed of subunits from three different subfamilies. No matter what the detailed interaction mechanisms are, the direct physical interaction of TRP subunits across three different subunits makes the structure and function of TRP channels even more diversified. In the present proposal, we plan to determine the detailed mechanism of interaction among TRPV4, TRPC1 and TRPP2: to answer whether it is TRPV4-C1-P2 heteromeric channel or it is TRPV4-C1 heteromeric channel that interacts with homomeric TRPP2. We also plan to localize the interaction sites where three subunits bind to each other. In addition, we will characterize the electrophysiological and pharmacological properties of the channels. Furthermore, we plan to explore the functional role of this channel in native vascular endothelial cells and native renal epithelial cells. We expect this study to provide novel information on the interaction mechanism among TRPV4, -C1, and -P2, and to elucidate the function role of such interaction in vascular system and kidney. 瞬时受体电位（TRP）离子通道是生物细胞的感受器，它可用来感受各种环境刺激，包括温度，疼痛，压力和流体流动。TRP通道可分为7大家族，其中包括TRPC，TRPV，TRPP，和其他四个家族。每一TRP通道是由四个亚基组成的四聚体复合物。这四个亚基可以相同（homotetramers）或不同（heterotetramers）。亚基的异聚通常发生在同一家族的不同成员。例如在TRPC1与TRPC5之间发生。我们在初步研究中发现，当TRPV4，C1和P2是共同表达在HEK293细胞时，它们会形成一个TRPV4-C1-P2的异聚复合体。这是首次发现此类的异聚复合体。TRPV4-C1-P2的异聚异聚复合体的存在是一个概念上的突破， 这一发现使TRP通道的结构和功能变得更加多样化。在此研究项目中，我们计划以实验TRPV4-TRPC1-TRPP2 异聚复合体的真正存在， 及研究这一离子通道的电生理和药理特性。此外，我们还会探索这一离子通道在血管内皮细胞和肾小管上皮细胞的功能。

478411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
478411.value: Heart failure (HF) is a condition of impaired pump function of the heart. It is a disease with an annual mortality of 8-15% and a high risk of recurrent HF hospitalization. Apart from medical therapy, cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) is the recommended device therapy established in recent years. This therapy works by placing two ventricular (left and right ventricles) and one atrial pacing electrodes to synchronize cardiac pump function. Although the current guidelines suggest CRT for advanced HF patients with a prolonged QRS complex duration, lack of treatment response (called “non-responders”) is common which occurs in about one-third of patients. Therefore it remains a clinical challenge to select the right patients for the right therapy to ensure the risk of device implantation is well outweighed by the benefits and to ensure its cost-effectiveness. This is particularly important for Asia in which device therapy is commonly not being reimbursed by the health care system (including Hong Kong and China), and the cost of health care is considered expensive with reference to the countries’ socio-economic conditions. Despite a number of studies that explored potential predictors of CRT response, they were limited by only examining one single factor at a time, or lack of validation study for the proposed factors, or small sample size. Nonetheless, a number of factors acting in concerto may affect CRT response and to a different extent. Of note, responders of CRT will have a lower mortality and less HF re-hospitalizations, and had significant regression of cardiac chamber enlargement with improvement of contractile function (called reverse remodeling). Therefore, the current study proposal is to establish a comprehensive clinical score that will predict a favorable CRT response. A predictive model will be developed in the first 150 patients that received CRT which encompasses clinical factors and relevant investigations (ECG, echocardiography, biochemical markers), then a scoring system will be established for significant factors that carry different weights. A cutoff value that predicts CRT response will be validated in a 2nd cohort of 150 patients who received CRT. Response to CRT will be assessed primarily by the clinical composite score (that assesses symptomatic response, HF events and mortality), and secondarily by left ventricular reverse remodeling at 1 year follow up. This strategy will ensure the prescription of CRT therapy that will target the right HF patient group, and have significant implication in Asia to ensure the provision of a highly cost-effective therapy.

478411.label: Realisation of objectives
478411.value: We total enrolled 460 patients, with the pre-defined responders based on the clinical end-point. Clinical responders were defined as no mortality, no heart failure hospitalization and NYHA class improvement ≥1 at 6 month. According to the this criteria, there were 270 (58.6%) were CRT clinical responders and 190 (41.4%) were "non-responders". It was found that responders had more severe heart failure symptoms with higher NYHA class, higher prevalence of non-ischemic etiology of heart failure and more LBBB pattern in ECG, and with a lower prevalence of hypertension when compared to non-responders. baseline clinical characteristics were similar between the 2 groups There was no difference in left ventricular end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes, ejection fraction, systolic dyssynchrony and sphericity between the two groups. We have achieved all the study objectives by illustrating the key points as follows: 1. We confirmed a relatively high prevalence of CRT responders at 6-month. The prevalence of Responders when defined with combined end-point was about 60% at 6-month. 2. We further defined the clinical and other key parameters of CRT Non-responder. Based on these parameters, we were able to construct a score system which is simple to use and can be broadly applied to all potential CRT recipients. The advantage of this scoring system is that it used simple clinical and investigation parameters (ECG) which will be captured in all patients before the therapy. 3. It is also easy to apply and to member, rendering it a potentially very useful tool in future CRT recipients. As a result, the therapy will have a higher response rate and even more cost-effective to be used in our local community and even world-wide.

Though positive impact of CRT on clinical status, left ventricular function and myocardial function, not every patient benefits from this therapy or CRT recipients with advanced heart failure (HF) do not always respond well based on the clinical criteria. 2.Identify the responder before the CRT implantation is very important. Moreover, response to CRT is often assessed six months after implantation. We therefore conducted a study to set up a predicting system to predict the clinical responder to CRT at 6-month. 3. We found that around 60% were CRT clinical responders. 4. The symptom of responders had more severe heart failure symptoms. In regrading to the etiology，clinical responders had higher prevalence of non-ischemic etiology of heart failure but lower prevalence of hypertension. 5. There was no difference of baseline echocardiographic parameters between responder and non-responder including left ventricular volumes, ejection fraction. 6. the potential risk factors were sought to predict clinical responders among clinical parameters. In the univariate analysis, age <70 years old, NYHA III-IV, with antiplatelet therapy and LBBB pattern on ECG were associated with clinical response. In multivariate analysis, age <70 years old, non-ischemic etiology of heart failure and LBBB pattern on ECG were independent determinant for Responders 7. All CRT patients were randomly assigned as Derivation group (n=230) and Validation Group (n=230) with 1:1 ratio. Based on the beta value and the constant in the multivariate analysis, we assigned each of the 3 aforementioned variables a number of points that were proportional to its regression coefficient. Table 3 shows the variables from the score of the development set which were included in the final logistic regression model, alongside their associated score component values. 8. The ROC showed the predictive value of our score for clinical response at 6-month follow up. Area under ROC in Derivation group was 0.74 (p<0.001) with the cutoff point of 4, which has a sensitivity of 79% and specificity of 60%. In the Validation group, using the same point of cutoff value, area under ROC was 0.77 (P<0.01) with the sensitivity 84% and specificity of 53%.

478411.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
478411.value: In the current project, the predicting system of the benefits of CRT on clinical mortality and functional class were studied, We confirmed a relatively high prevalence of CRT responders at 6-month. The prevalence of Responders when defined with combined end-point was about 60% at 6-month. We further defined the clinical and other key parameters of CRT Non-responder. Based on these parameters, we were able to construct a score system which is simple to use and can be broadly applied to all potential CRT recipients. The advantage of this scoring system is that it used simple clinical and investigation parameters (ECG) which will be captured in all patients before the therapy. However, the sample size was relatively small, Therefore, it warrants further studies to evaluate the predicting value of this scoring system with larger sample size. In addition, more echocardiographic including advance imaging parameters will be included in the predicting system.

478411.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
478411.value: Many patients with advanced heart failure are refractory to optimal medical therapy and the device therapy is very important. Cardiac resynchronization therapy takes effect by coordinating the ventricular chamber of the failing heart and currently being approved as the standard therapy by the American and European countries for treatment of advanced heart failure. But there are still some patients do not respond to this therapy and therefore pre-operative prediction is important and more cost-effective. In this study, by use of multiple predicting factor,we hope that we can set up a simple and effective predicting system.

479111.value: 目前治療絕經後骨質疏鬆的藥物主要是抑制骨吸收，防止骨質疏鬆進一步惡化。唯一的能夠促進骨形成達到逆轉絕經後骨質疏鬆的藥物是間歇性甲狀旁腺激素給藥（iPTH），但是長期使用會發生骨吸收大於骨形成，造成治療不得不停止。因此，需要開發能夠促進骨形成而不刺激骨吸收的藥物。 我們的前期工作如下：（1）CKIP-1基因敲除小鼠模型與野生型相比表現出骨形成活躍但骨吸收沒有明顯的變化，其他非骨組織沒有異常的表型；（2）隨著增齡，老年雌性小鼠以及老年婦女的骨形成逐漸降低，骨組織CKIP-1表達逐漸升高；（3）開發了能夠特異性攜帶核酸到成骨細胞系的核酸靶向遞送系統；（4）篩選獲得了跨種屬的高靜默效率的CKIP-1小核酸序列。因此，本項研究的假設是應用特異性靶向遞送系統攜帶CKIP-1小核酸能夠逆轉絕經後骨質疏鬆。為了檢驗該假設，研究工作基於老年絕經後骨質疏鬆大鼠模型分成如下三個部分開展：第一部分是研究CKIP-1小核酸在靶向和非靶向遞送攜帶下的組織與細胞水準的分佈特點；第二部分是研究CKIP-1小核酸在靶向和非靶向遞送攜帶下的組織與細胞水準的基因靜默效率；第三部分是研究特異性靶向遞送系統攜帶CKIP-1小核酸對骨組織形態計量學參數、骨量、骨結構參數、骨代謝生化標誌物、非骨組織（肝臟和腎臟）功能。 本項研究的成果有助於建立CKIP-1在老年婦女成骨能力下降的機制中的作用以及向臨床轉化為潛在的小核酸藥物。

500111.label: Project Objectives
500111.value: AVERAGE COST PROBLEMS: Average cost problems are popular among practitioners because they look as static optimization instead of as dynamic optimization. In the literature they are often considered without solid justification. Intuition prevails in developing models. The important mathematical questions like: are the processes ergodic, what is the invariant measure, how the transient process converges towards the steady state, what is the impact of the discount rate are rarely addressed. The solution of these problems involves advanced techniques of ergodic theory and ergodic control, which may be available in a general framework, but not directly implemented in the particular cases to be considered. Of course, some good work exists already in this direction of research, but many developments are needed to address more complex situations. These techniques are even more important as the complexity increases, since then intuition is not sufficient and may be wrong. Besides, the relation between the transient and the steady state is extremely important, since the steady state may be unrealistic or may simply not exist. MODELS FOR DEMAND: One major source of uncertainties and risks relates to the demand of products. Standard models of inventory management assume very simple structures for the demand. In discrete time the demand is often modeled as a sequence of identically independent random variables. In continuous time, it is modeled as a fixed deterministic rate per unit of time plus a random part which is a Wiener process with fixed volatility. This is much too primitive for real situations. A first extension is to allow for jumps. A second extension is to have a more involved model representing the dependence with respect to the past. There may be (possibly hidden) states of nature which influence demand. Finally, demand depends on price which is a decision variable. We will consider these extensions, and will particularly consider the influence of prices. PARTIAL OBSERVATIONS: Inventories and demand may be fully observable, in which case their evolution up to present time is known. In general, they are only partially observable. In spite of the progress which comes from innovation, like RFID technology, there are serious reasons explaining why inventories can only be partially observable. Empirical studies show that pilferage, errors, delays, spoilage and many other causes are not only a source of losses, but also a source of inaccuracy in inventory records. Concerning demand, an obvious reason of partial observation is that unfilled customer requests are not recorded. The record may also be done at some aggregate level, some characteristics may be omitted. External factors mentioned above may not be fully observable. In the US, the P.I. has developed with UTD colleagues a general methodology for partially observed inventories. This methodology will be adapted to the case of partially observed demand and price optimization.

500111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
500111.value: Inventory Control is one of the first and most important domains of application in Operations Research. Although static models like EOQ (Economic Order Quantity) and Newsvendor problem are very old, the dynamic models were considered only in the late fifties and sixties, when Dynamic Programming techniques became available. H. Scarf introduced in 1960 the concept of s,S policy and since then considerable developments have followed both in Applied Mathematics and Operations Research. Motivated by Inventory Control, the Author introduced with J.L. Lions the concept of Quasi-Variational Inequalities to solve Impulse Control problems. Since then, the mathematical developments have followed a route which provides abstract results like existence and uniqueness of the solution of the Q.V.I. and existence of an optimal feedback rule. Numerical Analysis has also progressed considerably. Although essential, these results and methods do not sufficiently meet the need of practitioners to use simple decision rules, even though the complexity has increased considerably. The overwhelming success of s,S policy stems from the fact that it is very intuitive for practitioners. There is a strong need to put the mathematical effort on addressing more realistic and complex problems than the standard ones, still trying to design simple decision rules which can be optimal or quasi-optimal. The advantage of relying on general mathematical results and numerical analysis approaches is that we can obtain a benchmark to test the quality of the decision rules which are designed. In the numerous works in which one tries to extend the Base Stock and s,S policies, this is generally not done, thus the optimality is not proven, or in case of approximations the quality of the approximation is not established. We have chosen three areas of research as the main ones. The first one concerns optimization of average costs, which we want to study with the powerful techniques of Ergodic Theory and Ergodic Control. We want to study how the transients converge towards the steady state. The full justification of the results needs advanced methods of Ergodic Theory. The second area concerns more sophisticated models for the demand. Basic models consider demand external and a sequence of independent variables. Markov demand has been considered only recently. The third area concerns inventory control with partial information, in which the A. has been active in recent years in the U.S.

500111.label: Realisation of objectives
500111.value: The first objective " Average Cost Problems" has been performed quite extensively. In particular a lot of work has been accomplished regarding the mean reverting model. This type of inventory has become popular from the long term empirical observation that it is presumably applicable in the case of commodity products like oil, energy...Usually,the inventory level is assumed to be linearly dependent on the deviation of the inventory level from the long-term mean. However, when the deviation is large, it is reasonable to assume the company might want to increase the intensity of interference to the inventory level significantly rather than in a linear manner. We attempted to model a nonlinear continuous feedback process to inventory replenishment. Regarding average cost, a major advantage is that the problem is stationary, and therefore looks like a one period problem, but at the same time one incorporates all features related to dynamics. So practitioners are interested in implementing this type of model. We have developed a solid theory, within the standard framework of impulse control and Q.V.I. quasi variational inequalities. This mathematical theory allows to obtain results like (s,S) policy in the case of complex dynamics, in which the intuition is of little help. We have significantly extended the theory and the applications. From the mathematical standpoint, we have proven results of convergence of the transient to the ergodic situation, without referring to general results of ergodic theory. We need here a customized approach, because we are dealing with a specific model, for which we want constructive solutions and not general existence results. In the second objective, we have also achieved significant milestones. First of all, our model for demand encompasses jumps as well as Wiener processes. In that framework we have completed significantly the existing theory. We have also combined mean reverting models with jump diffusions. We have focused on inventory dependent demand models, which splits with the traditional approach of considering demand as external. This type of extension of traditional approaches is justified by empirical evidence. For instance, in the retail industry, large piles of displayed goods attract consumers. Another aspect is that goods may deteriorate or change quality during storage. We have solved some open problems stated in the literature. This is due to the power of the Q.V.I. theory which accommodates many situations. However, it is not sufficient just to adapt the general approach. Important modifications have been made in the methodology. Two types of Green functions are introduced. We then have developed extensively the joint price-inventory optimization, which is an important practical situation of non purely external demand. A general extension of the standard s,S policy is the s,S, p policy, or when there is no fixed cost, the base stock list price policy. This theory is developed in particular cases of the dependence of the demand on the price. We have extended significantly the theory to handle various models for demand-price relationship. We provide conditions under which BSLP is optimal. These conditions are easily verifiable. We have developed both the discrete time model and the continuous time model . Note that the continuous case situation has not been studied so far. We also have considered the case of fixed cost, or the case of no fixed cost. In the continuous time situation, the randomness of the demand is modeled by a Wiener process. We have not looked at the case of jumps. We have also considered inflation risk. Since the inflation rate is random, all assets become risky including the conventional risk-free asset, as the real return is discounted by the uncertain inflation. Under this circumstance, whenever we stock less in the inventory level, we are taking higher risks. We formulate this as a portfolio selection problem and derive the efficient frontier by solving the associated HJB equation. We found that, similarly to the mutual fund theorem, the portfolio can be separated into three risky funds. Specifically, besides the fund with nominal interest rate and the mutual fund with risky assets, an additional mutual fund is needed to account for the risk arising from the correlation between inflation and the market risk. In identifying better stochastic models than a simple Brownian motion, a popular model in the literature, which is supported empirically, is regime-switching model. We have studied the formulation and applications of the switching regime extensively with simplifications in order to derive the solutions analytically. We assume that initially we have a portfolio of risky assets and study the application of dynamic programming principles to the proposed stochastic models. In addition, we study the effect of imposing a VaR constraint to the portfolio to limit the risk exposure. Furthermore, we have studied the impact of the insurance to the portfolio risk exposure . In solving the stochastic control problem for a portfolio of risky assets, we also studied the dual formulation and use duality to prove the existence of solution to the problems . Regarding the third objective, we have considered many situations. For instance, we have studied a periodic review inventory model with a non perishable product over an infinite planning horizon. The demand for the nonperishable product arrives according to a Poisson process. Lost sales are unobservable, but the stock-out times are observable. We introduce the possibility of learning on arrival time according to stock-out times. We then compare the system performance with those under other two information scenarios where lost sales are observable or both lost-sales and stock-out times are observable. We have also considered the lack of information on inventory due to the occurrence of an invisible demand coming from spoilage, damage or pilferage. We allow dependence between demand and invisible demand. All these problems become infinite dimensional because the argument is no more a real variable, but a probability distribution. We use the approach to introduce the concept of un-normalized probability distribution, which has the considerable advantage of linearizing the evolution of the conditional probability distribution ( Zakai equation, instead of Kushner equation of nonlinear filtering). We provide a numerical algorithm to obtain the optimal policy. We use it more as a benchmark to test possible simpler solutions. This general methodology has the advantage of defining optimal policies, but it has the drawback of not being very intuitive for practitioners. In that spirit, the idea is to propose more practical policies and to test their accuracy in comparison with the optimal one. An obvious one is the certainty equivalence approach, which consists in taking the average inventory and considering it as the real inventory, then applying the theory of observable inventory. We have developed a more elaborate extension, in which we now the mean and the variance of the inventory. This is meaningful in practice, since it is common to consider a confidence interval around the mean. In this way, we improve the certainty equivalence approach. To sum up, this project has been quite successful for all three objectives. We have considerably improved the knowledge, but also we have proposed meaningful policies and the possibility to check their accuracy. A lot more remains to be done, but this work can remain as a reference.

500111.label: Major findings and research outcome
500111.value: The outcome of our research concerns both the theory and the development of practical solutions. Many publications have been accepted in the relevant journals. We have dealt with more realistic models, than those in the literature, but at the same time we have tried to remain practical in the type of solutions. This is the spirit of research in such a domain, where the theory is complex, but implementable solutions are the only those acceptable.

500111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
500111.value: A lot of development can be thought of. It concerns considering more elaborate models, as well as more elaborate structures for the supply chain. Needless to say, we have remained at the level of management of a single product. A great extension would be the study of several products.

500111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
500111.value: Inventory control remains a key part of Management Science. Inventories are necessary to mitigate risks of shortage, which result in losses and customer frustration. But there are a source of cost. So a very precise optimization has to be performed. A loose inventory control may translate in considerable losses. Applied mathematics and stochastic control provide good approaches to develop the theory and algorithms, including practical ones.

500311.label: Project Title(Chinese)
500311.value: 对于不确定变分不等式的最优转化形式和算法

500311.label: Project Objectives
500311.value: We will give new theoretical results on the solvability, stability, sensitivity and robustness of the EV, BWC and ERM reformulations. Moreover, we will give more suitable conditions that guarantee the consistency of solutions of their approximation problems derived by sampling average approximation. We will develop efficient algorithms for computing the expected values in the stochastic VIP. Moreover, we will develop efficient algorithms to find solutions of the EV, BWC, ERM reformulations. We will use smoothing approximation techniques and generalized gradient to overcome the difficulties arising from nonsmoothness in these reformulations. We will establish the convergence of the smoothing methods and error bounds of approximate solutions. We will develop distributionally robust EV and ERM reformulations when a distribution for the random parameters is not clear. The new reformulations will take into account knowledge about the distribution’s support and a confidence region for its mean and its covariance matrix. We will use value-at-risk (VaR), conditional VaR and other measures to evaluate the risk of outcomes of deterministic optimization reformulations for VIP under uncertainty. We will compare these reformulations based on measures of risk, sensitivity, robustness and other factors. We will apply our new theory and algorithms to various equilibrium problems in engineering and economics. In particular, we will provide new theorems and algorithms for applications of VIP with uncertain data in reliability issues in transportation network analysis.

500311.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
500311.value: The variational inequality problem (VIP) has been widely used as an effective mathematical model in engineering and economics. However, in practice, data given in the VIP often contain uncertainties, and decisions have to be made before the actual data become known. To make decisions under uncertainty, the VIP under uncertainty is reformulated into a deterministic problem by defining a collection of functions on a set of parameters representing future states of knowledge. Many challenging problems arise in using deterministic reformulations to find desirable solutions. First, how can we show a deterministic reformulation is suitable for a particular application? Second, finding a solution of a reformulation often involves both high dimensional integration and a sequence of approximating optimization problems. How can we compute high dimensional integrals efficiently and ensure the convergence of a sequence of solutions of approximating problems to a solution of the original reformulation? Finally, a more challenging difficulty that arises in practice is the need for a prior choice of a probability distribution. Most existing results of VIP under uncertainty depend on the choice of distribution. However, in reality, the distributions can only be estimated based on limited information. How can we find distributionally robust solutions for VIP under uncertainty? This is an important, challenging and new problem. The aim of this project is to establish new significant theoretical results and innovative algorithms for VIP under uncertainty. We will focus on three optimization reformulations: Expected Value reformulation, Best Worst Case reformulation, and Expected Residual Minimization reformulation. Based on these reformulations, new algorithms will be developed, which are not only highly efficient but also resolve the lack of robustness in many previous approaches. For instance, such reformulations allow us to find distributionally robust solutions by adding constrained sets containing possible distributions including the form (discrete, normal, exponential, etc), mean, and covariance matrix. We will investigate the solvability, sensitivity and robustness of these reformulations, and develop efficient algorithms for computing the expected values and finding desirable solutions of these reformulations. We will apply our new results to important equilibrium problems in engineering and economics. Our project is interdisciplinary by cutting across the fields of optimization, integration and approximation. We have excellent collaborations with world leading scientists in these fields. The outcomes of this project will have long-term and high impact in applied mathematics, because variational inequalities under uncertainty have numerous important applications and present many challenging mathematical problems. 变分不等式（VIP），在工程和经济学中已被广泛用作一种有效的数学模型。然而，在实际问题中，VIP中的数据经常含有不确定性，而我们必须在知道真实据前做出决定。为了在有不确定因素的条件下做出决定，我们在一个代表未来知识状态的参数集上定义一个函数集合，使带有不确定因素的VIP被表达成一个确定性的问题。在使用确定性重组来寻找理想方案中有许多具有挑战性的问题。 首先，如何给出一个确定的重组以适应一个特定的应用？其次，寻找一个重组方案往往包含高维整合和寻找逼近优化问题序列两个方面。如何有效地计算高维积分并保证逼近问题的解序列收敛到原重组问题的一个解？最后，实际问题中一个更具有挑战性的问题是需要预先选择一个概率分布。然而，在现实中，我们仅可以基于有限的信息估计出这个概率分布。而这是一个重要的且具体挑战性的崭新问题。 本项目的研究目的是针对带有不确定因素的VIP建立新的重要的理论成果和创新算法。本项目的研究重点是三个优化重组：期望值重组，最佳最差案例重组和期望残值最小化重组。基于这些重组，我们将开发新的算法，使这些算法不仅高效而且可解决之前许多算法缺乏鲁棒性的问题。例如，这些重组使我们可以通过增加蕴含可能分布的约束集，包括可能的形式（离散的，正态的，指数的，等等），均值和协方差矩阵，来找到一个强劲分布解。我们将研究这些重组方案的可解性，敏感性和鲁棒性，并设计有效的算法来计算期望值和寻找这些重组方案的理想解，并把这些新的研究成果应用到工程和经济学中一些重要的平衡点问题中。 本项目是介于优化，整合和逼近的跨学科研究。我们与这些领域的许多著名科学家都有很好的合作关系。由于带有不确定因素的变分不等式有许多重要的应用领域且包含许多带有挑战性的数学问题，本项目的研究成果将在应用数学领域有着长期且重要的影响。

500311.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
500311.value: We established new significant theoretical results and innovative algorithms for variational inequality problems under uncertainty. We focus on three optimization reformulations: Expected Value reformulation, Best Worst Case reformulation, and Expected Residual Minimization reformulation. Based on these reformulations, new algorithms have been be developed, which are not only highly efficient but also resolve the lack of robustness in many previous approaches. For instance, such reformulations allow us to find distributionally robust solutions by adding constrained sets containing possible distributions including the form (discrete, normal, exponential, etc), mean, and covariance matrix. We investigated the solvability, sensitivity and robustness of these reformulations, and developed efficient algorithms for computing the expected values and finding desirable solutions of these reformulations. We applied our new results to important equilibrium problems in engineering and economics. Our project is interdisciplinary by cutting across the fields of optimization, integration and approximation. We have excellent collaborations with world leading scientists in these fields. The outcomes of this project will have long-term and high impact in applied mathematics, because variational inequalities under uncertainty have numerous important applications and present many challenging mathematical problems.

500911.label: Project Objectives
500911.value: We propose to perform combined fs-TRF and fs-TA experiments to directly probe the spectra and dynamics of the excited-states for monomeric systems of m5C, Cyt and selected derivatives. We also propose to use these methods to examine the effects of chemical substitution, solvent and excitation wavelength on the excited-state spectra and dynamics. The experiments are aimed at seeking the explicit spectral signatures and dynamics characters for the excited-states involved. The results will enable unequivocal identification of the excited-states and construction of a clear and detailed picture of decay paths for the excited-states. We propose to perform ps-TR3 experiment to directly probe the excited-state structure(s) for the monomeric systems. The work will enable the acquisition of unique sets of structural fingerprints for the excited-states. The results, in conjunction with those of objective (1), will lay the foundation and provide benchmark data for the following work on Cyt/m5C containing DNAs. We propose to perform combined fs-TRF and fs-TA experiments to directly probe the dynamics and spectra of the excited-states for a series of selected Cyt/m5C containing DNA model compounds. The experiments are aimed at revealing the dynamics and spectral signatures in both the fs-TRF and fs-TA spectra for the systems selected. The results will enable the first comprehensive characterization of these excited-states and will help to untangle the existing puzzles on the dynamics and associated “bright” vs. “dark” nature of the excited-states. By making a comparison of the results from m5C and the counterpart Cyt containing compounds, this work will provide invaluable evidence for understanding the molecular mechanism for the higher level of photodamage displayed by m5C than Cyt in DNA. We propose to perform systematic fs-TRF and fs-TA measurements on carefully chosen model compounds under controlled conditions to explore how base sequence, duplex conformation and inter-base interactions can affect the nature, dynamics and pathway of the excited-states. The findings of this work, in conjunction with those of objective (3) will contribute crucial new evidence for explicit elucidation of the excited-states and to determine the primary pathway(s) and controlling factor(s) of the relaxation processes. The results will also help to resolve the current debate on the role of base pairing vs. stacking in promoting the long-lived states and the intriguing aspects of charge transfer vs. proton transfer in mediating decay of the long-lived states. The results from the objectives (3) and (4) will aid efforts to understand photoexcitation in other multi-chromophoric systems. This will have important implication for development and practical design of supra-molecular optical materials.

500911.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
500911.value: 脫氧核糖核酸吸收紫外光形成激發態，成為導致遺傳物質光穩定或光致破損而變異等複雜過程的起點。因此，激發態的性質和動力學是決定其穩定性和光致破損的重要因素。鹼基單體具有較佳的光穩定性，一般認為這源自於單體超短的激發態壽命。然而有證據顯示，單鏈或雙鏈的鹼基聚體具有較長的激發態壽命。故而聚體的光穩定性應另有機制。核酸激發態的特性是目前備受關注的科研課題，包括化學取代和聚體中鹼基間相互作用對這些特性的影響。含有胞嘧啶或5-甲基胞嘧啶的核酸序列是研究這個課題的原型系統。在胞嘧啶的5位進行甲基化是鹼基的一種自發過程，也是調控基因表達的關鍵。5-甲基胞嘧啶更是紫外光致癌的重要源頭。它較胞嘧啶更易被光破壞，是核酸發生光致破損的“熱灶”。前功雖多，但目前對含有胞嘧啶或5-甲基胞嘧啶核酸的激發態並無確切的認知。為探索這個重要而未知的領域，我們提議利用先進的飛秒時間分辨光譜技術對胞嘧啶、5-甲基胞嘧啶、及特別篩選的核酸序列進行深入和系統的研究。我們所採用的飛秒寬帶時間分辨熒光、瞬態吸收、及皮秒時間分辨共振拉曼光譜技術是取得激發態光譜特性及結構指紋信息的理想方法。我們建議的實驗將是首次對這類化合物的激發態變化進行直接而詳盡的研究，從而探討影響其光穩定性和光致破損而致變異的決定性因素。此項研究將提供全新而重要的實驗數據，對理解核酸激發態具有突破性的意義，並為揭示核酸的光穩定性及光致破損機制提供分子層面的信息。

500911.label: Realisation of objectives
500911.value: For objective 1: 100% achieved We have performed an integrated spectroscopic investigation where we combined steady state measurements with fs broadband time-resolved fluorescence (fs-TRF), fluorescence anisotropy (fs-TRFA), and transient absorption (fs-TA) on cytosine (Cyt) and a series of its N1- and C5-derivatives, including the full set of Cyt nucleosides and nucleotides in DNA and RNA and the nucleosides of 5-methyl cytosine (m5C), 5-methylcytidine and 2’-deoxy-5-methylcytidine. The study was done in water and for comparison in a less polar protic solvent methanol in order to assess the effect of solvents on the dynamics and pathways of the nonradiative deactivation. For objective 2: 40% achieved Raman measurements on Cyt and m5C have been performed in water and methanol with 532nm laser wavelength. The results of these experiments provide structural information on the ground state of the respective compounds. This affords reference data for further excited-state TR3 studies. Efforts have been made to measure TR3 spectra of Cyt and m5C in water and methanol; however the Raman signals obtained are extremely weak. TR3 measurements on more probe wavelengths may help to obtain good S/N ratio TR3 spectra of the nucleic bases. For objective 3: 90% achieved Femtosecond TRF and TA spectra have been obtained for C20, (GC)10, and (AC)10 oligomers. The dynamics and spectral signatures in both the fs-TRF and fs-TA spectra for the systems selected have been revealed. These help to untangle the existing puzzles on the dynamics and associated “bright” vs. “dark” nature of the excited-states. Based on the data, the origin and nature of the long-lived excited states and nonradiative decay mechanisms of the excited states of the oligomers are proposed. For objective 4: 90% achieved Femtosecond TRF and TA spectra have been obtained for (G)20(C)20, and (GC)10(CG)10 double-stranded oligomers. These and results from objective 3 help to resolve the current debate on the role of base pairing vs. stacking in promoting the long-lived states and the intriguing aspects of charge transfer vs. proton transfer in mediating decay of the long-lived states. For objective 5: 90% achieved By performing the research necessary to achieve objectives 3 and 4 above, we have demonstrated that we are able to understand more about the photoexcitation in other multi-chromophoric systems.

500911.label: Major findings and research outcome
500911.value: We have conducted most of the experiments planned in this project. Through these measurements, expected evidences have been obtained for addressing most of the questions posed in the proposal (ref.1, 2 section-8, sections-9-10). Beyond this, We have improved the ultrafast time-resolved techniques and used these methods to study some related photophysics and photochemical processes (ref. 3 section-8). Our comparative fs-TRF and fs-TA study on Cyt, m5C and selected derivatives (ref. 1 section-8) yielded explicit spectral signatures and dynamics characters for the excited-states involved. The results reveal remarkable state-specific effects of the substitution and solvent in tuning distinctively the timescales and pathways of the nonradiative decays. For Cyt and the N1-derivatives, the nonradiative deactivations occur in a common two-state process through three channels, two from the light-absorbing pi-pi* state with respectively the sub-picosecond (~0.2 ps) and the picosecond (~1.5 ps) time constant, and the third is due to an optically dark n-pi* state with the lifetime ranging from several to hundreds of picoseconds depending on solvents and substitutions. Compared to Cyt, the presence of the ribose or deoxyribose moiety at the N1 position of N1-derivatives facilitates the formation of the n-pi* at the sub-picosecond timescale and at the same time increases its lifetime by ~4–6 times in both water and methanol. In sharp contrast, the existence of the methyl group at the C5 position of the C5-derivatives eliminates completely the sub-picosecond pi-pi* channel and the channel due to the n-pi*, but on the other hand slows down the decay of the pi-pi* state which after relaxation exhibits a single time constant of ~4.1 to ~7.6 ps depending on solvents. Varying the solvent from water to methanol accelerates only slightly the decay of the pi-pi* state in all the compounds; while for Cyt and its N1-derivatives, this change of solvent also retards strongly the n-pi* channel, prolongs its lifetime from such as ~7.7 ps in water to ~52 ps in methanol for Cyt and from ~30 ps in water to ~186 ps in methanol for deoxycytidine. Our fs-TRF and fs-TA studies on guanine (G) and its derivatives in various solvents were published as an invited article in the theme issue “Interaction of UV radiation with DNA” in journal of “Photochemical & Photobiological Sciences” (ref. 2 section-8). The finding of this work shows that, aside from oligomers which typically give longer-lived excimer, monomeric G also possesses rather long-lived excited-state.

500911.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
500911.value: Based on the outcome of this project, further research will be attempted towards the following directions: (i) to perform combined fs-TRF and fs-TA experiments to directly probe the dynamics and spectra of the excited-states for more selected Cyt/m5C containing single-stranded DNA compounds. (ii) to perform fs-TRF and fs-TA measurements on more duplex DNAs to study in more detail on how duplex conformation and inter-base interactions can affect the nature, dynamics and pathway of the excited-states.

500911.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
500911.value: This research project is aimed to use a range of the state-of-art time-resolved spectroscopy including femtosecond (fs, 10^(-15) second) broadband time-resolved fluorescence, fs- broadband time-resolved fluorescence anisotropy and fs-transient absorption to directly probe the spectral fingerprints and excited-state dynamics of cytosine (Cyt), Cyt-derivatives and a series of Cyt containing DNA compounds. The data we obtained allow improved characterization of the photophysics and provide direct experimental parameters for the development of theoretical modelling on influences of solvents and substitution on the topographies of the excited-state potential energy surfaces and dynamics of the nonradiative decays. The results also help in understanding the photostability and photodamage of Cyt and the derivatives. The outcomes of this project have led to several publications in top international journals including an invited article in journal of “Photochemical & Photobiological Sciences”. The research grant enables the PI to participate international conferences to give presentations including invited talk in these conferences. It also allows training of several students, at both the undergraduate and post graduated levels.

501011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
501011.value: Catalytic cross-coupling reactions are one the most straightforward and widespread used protocols from where scientists produce marvelous chemical modifications to assemble structurally unprecedented, yet materially and pharmaceutically attractive compounds. This chemical tool has vastly advanced the possibilities for chemists to create sophisticated molecules, in which as complex as those created by nature itself. While innovative researchers have been remarkably adept at coming up with brilliantly creative methods in refining specific bond constructions, the extension of these reactions into a truly general methodology by the application of simple and highly effective catalyst is still in great demand. In fact, the high diversification, thus offering excellent tunability of the catalyst is of significance to deal with various libraries of lead compound in the drug discovery processes since different molecules usually require particular fine-tuned catalysts for optimization. The improvement of current methodologies and exploration of new technologies for versatile bond construction process are of high fundamental importance. The purpose of this project are (1) to rationally design and explore a new class of simple, yet highly tunable catalyst/phosphine ligands (and their chiral variants) utilizing a highly modular and facile approach; (2) to explore the new scope of the highly tunable ligands in tackling problematic as well as unexplored substrates; (3) to investigate the insightful mechanism of catalyst pre-activation and reactive intermediate formation; (4) to study the atropo-enantioselective carbon-carbon and carbon-nitrogen bond formation and their potential application in synthesizing chiral natural molecule motifs; (5) to have breakthrough establishment in direct stereoselective C-H atropo-functionalization. This project is expected to explore a new field in cross-coupling reactions. The proposed study is based on our previous success in the ligand/catalyst synthesis and our extensive experiences in cross-coupling and catalytic asymmetric reactions. 501011.label: Realisation of objectives
501011.value: This is the completion report of 5010/11P. The proposed investigation of this project are mainly focused on developing new series of easily diversified phosphine ligands for tackling difficult/unexplored cross-coupling reactions. With the tools of ligands, the cross-coupling reaction have been advanced. The Objectives 1-3 have been successfully accomplished, and peer-reviewed papers have been published with reference to the output from these areas. The successful finding in stage 1 (objective 1) offered us a platform to further explore diastereomeric axially chiral ligands and their applications in enantioselective reactions . Although the non-chiral version of the ligands developed in stage 1 were highly effective in cross-coupling reactions, the chiral-analogs were found less efficient in facilitating stereoinduction to metal complexes, as well as the substrates. We have achieved the simple chiral ligand synthesis using a diastereomeric approach, and attempted to study the enantioselective catalysis.

501011.label: Major findings and research outcome
501011.value: This is the completion report of 5010/11P. Transition metal-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions have emerged as a versatile tool for synthetic applications of pharmaceutical , fine chemical as well as new materials. In fact, phosphine ligands play an important role to make challenging coupling reactions viable. Phosphine ligand with appropriate structures can allow specific cross-coupling possible. Therefore, a highly tunable and easily accessible ligands are still in high demand. With the support of RGC funding, we investigated the proposed topics. We have developed a new class of hemilabile ligands from readily available components, i.e. diamines and benzaldehyde. These new ligands have been tested in aromatic carbon-carbon bond-construction processes. Remarkably, the catalyst Pd catalyst loading could be as low as 0.01 mol% when the P,N ligand was employed. These research contributions have been published in three SCI peer-reviewed journals, Eur. J. Org. Chem. 2012, 4172-4177; Tetrahedron Lett. 2012, 53, 3754-3757 and Synthesis 2014, 46, 2826-2832. In addition to palladium-catalyzed cross-coupling reaction, we have disclosed an intramolecular C-H bond arylation from aryl chlorides, notably under the transition metal-free conditions. This finding was based on our previous phenanthridines synthesis using Pd-catalyzed approach. These initial research contributions have been published in Organic Letters in 2012 (Org. Lett. 2012, 14, 5306–5309). Moreover, we were recognized and invited by Wiley Publisher to contribute a Review Article with reference to this highly important and emerging area (Chem. Eur. J. 2013, 19, 15802-15814). Direct C-H bond coupling of acetanilides from aldehydes is an attractive coupling protocol for accessing various 2-acylanilines. In fact, the use of toluene derivatives as the aldehyde (acyl) source remains unexplored. With the proposed mechanistic investigation of this palladium-catalyzed C-H cross-coupling, we found that toluene derivatives could be employed as the simple coupling precursors (aldehyde surrogate under the stated conditions) in this coupling reaction. These research contributions have been published in Chemical Communications in 2013 (Chem. Commun. 2013, 49, 689-691, rated as "Highly cited" paper in ISI webofknowledge in 2015). With regard to these leading results, we were invited to contribute a Review to overview the recent development of this Pd-catalyzed cross-coupling of C(sp2)-H bond (Chem. Asian J. 2014, 9, 26-47, also highlighted as Backcover Art). In addition to toluene derivative as the aldehyde source (under oxidative conditions), we also found that benzyl cyanide can serve as the -CN surrogate for the easy synthesis of pharmaceutically useful 3-cyanoindole derivatives. This finding has been published in The Journal of Organic Chemistry (J. Org. Chem. 2013, 78, 3374–3378).

501111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
501111.value: In clinical, epidemiologic and many other biomedical studies multiple outcome variables are often measured repeatedly over a period of time on study subjects. For example, in a genomic study microarray gene expressions of hundreds target genes are collected from cancerous and normal tissues from study subjects at multiple time points (e.g. times of pre- and post- treatment), or in an observational study of hormone reproduction mechanism levels of several reproductive hormones as well and oxidative stress biomarkers are recorded repeatedly at critical time windows of a woman's menstrual cycle. While for certain scientific aims a univariate analysis, which analyzes each individual outcome variable separately while ignoring the other variables, may well serve the purpose, for others longitudinal analysis of all outcome variables together deems desirable because it has clear advantages over the univariate analysis, for example, leading to substantial gain in estimation efficiency (Section 2.3, Diggle et al., 2002). Most of the existing methods for the analysis of multivariate longitudinal responses are concentrated on either parametric or semi- or non-parametric regression models that depend on specific model assumptions, some of which are hard to validate in practice. As a consequence of model misspecification, these model-based approaches may incur misleading results such as estimation bias, inflated standard error and bad control of type I error. To this end, more robust statistical methods are appealing to deal with the multivariate longitudinal data. However, such methods are currently scarce in the statistical literature. This is an area of research that this proposed study will focus on. We plan to develop some robust nonparametric testing procedures that enable us to compare multivariate longitudinal data with minimal model assumptions. These proposed methods are based on ranks among multivariate longitudinal observations from study subjects, providing statistics in a global test for the null hypothesis that the distributions of the outcome variables do not differ between groups at any time points. Next, we will extend these nonparametric procedures to the case of data subject to detection limits below which laboratory-measured biomarkers can not be accurately quantified. These procedures, upon completion, will enlarge the current arsenal of nonparametric hypothesis test for longitudinal data, and have great impact on the design and analysis of repeated measurements arising from clinical, epidemiologic, and many other biomedical studies, where the differences in distributions of the longitudinally measured multiple outcome variables are the primary interest. 在临床，流行病学和许多其它生物医学研究中，对研究个体在一定时段内多变量结果常常被重复测量。举例来说，在基因组学研究中，从研究个体的有癌病与正常组织中, 科学家们搜集了在多个时间点(如预前和预后)的上百个目标基因的芯片基因表达.另一个例子是,在荷尔蒙产生机制的观测研究中,对女性的月经周期的每一个关键时窗,好几种生殖性荷尔蒙和氧化压力生物标记的水平值被重复的记录. 尽管对某些特定的科学研究， 分别分析每一个个体结果变量而忽略其他变量的单变量分析也能发挥作用，然而把所有变量全部纳入考虑的多元纵向分析更加可取.原因是它比单变量分析具有明显的优势, 如Diggle等人2002著作中的2.3节所叙,在估计的效率上有显著的提高.大量已有的对多元纵向相应变量的分析方法着眼于参数的,半参数的,或者非参数的回归模型.这些模型依赖特定的模型假设,而这些假定往往在实际中难以证实为真.如果模型一旦被错误甄别,则基于模型的方法会招致误导性的结果, 如估计偏差,膨胀的标注误,以及对统计中I型误差较坏的控制。为此， 处理多元纵向数据时，引起研究的兴趣的是更加稳健性的统计方法。但是， 在统计文献中，此类方法目前还不多，因而成为本项目申请将着眼的研究领域。 我们计划发展若干稳健性的非参数检验方法，使得在模型假设的最少条件下，能运用于多元纵向数据的比较。以任意时间点的多元变量分布无差别为零假设， 这些方法以研究主体的多元纵向观测的秩值为基础，提供了全局性检验统计量。其次，注意到在生物医学研究中，限于人力物力，对较小值的生物标记的测量往往不能准确量化导致数据遭遇检测限制， 我们将拓展这些非参数方法来处理这类特殊的不完全数据。 以上方法如能得到成功发展，将会是对多元纵向数据的非参数检验方法库的一个扩充。 并且， 当纵向多元变量的分布的差异性为主要研究兴趣时，我们所要发展的方法对源于临床，流行病学和其他生物医学研究的重复观测的实验设计和统计分析将产生重要的影响。

501111.label: Realisation of objectives
501111.value: The objectives of this project have been achieved successfully. Under support from this GRF grant, the PI and Co-I have developed rank-based nonparametric and semiparametric procedures to compare multivariate longitudinal data. We have obtained many statistical results in several areas by developing different methodology and deriving the theory. The main purpose is to provide feasible and reliable approaches for epidemiologist and biomedical researchers to model complex longitudinal data and to monitor clinical trials. One of the main difficulties for effective biomarker selection is that there are too many markers as well as marker measurements are clustered in subjects. To overcome this barricade, the PI and Co-I presented testing statistic based on weighted area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve. We also derived comparison procedures under multiple angles including from the selection of influential biomarkers, considering the classification error on the disease states, and within various semiparametric partial linear model framework, and extension to incomplete data. The aforementioned results have been published in international peer-viewed leading statistical journals and high impact factor biomedical journals. It has also been presented in various meetings, workshops, and conferences. Our current interests are to investigate rank-based procedures for multivariate longitudinal data. Noticing that in the current big data era, the data become more complicated with unbalanced and sparse data and even mixed time-dependent data. We will develop more comparison procedures that can discern the data type and apply broadly. Besides ten peer-reviewed publications that can be tracked in part C, the PI has also developed some functional principle component analysis based testing procedures to compare two sample longitudinal data, checking the equivalence of mean functions and variance-covariance functions. The paper was submitted recently. Because of the originality and adequate work on the objects, the PI will not list the unpublished work in Part C.

501111.label: Major findings and research outcome
501111.value: The PI and Co-I have worked out results in several areas under a wide range of biomedical case studies including causal inference for type 2 diabetes risk, see Song et al. (2012, HMG). When disease status is subject to misspecification. Liu et. al. (2012, Biometrika) derived relative efficiency of Dorfman’s group testing procedure and gained the exact ranges of disease prevalence for different scenarioes. Liu et. al. (2013, FPH) compared several confidence intervals. Zhang et. al. (2014, SIM) gave and compared several simple designs and methods for prevalence estimation that does not specify values of sensitivity and specificity. For semiparametric partial linear models, Tian et. al. (2014, JMV) proposed a new procedure which can simultaneously select significant variables in parametric and nonparametric components. Wei and Liu (2012, JNS) investigated in a generalized LR test statistic to check the validity of linear constraints on the parametric component. For diagnostic biomarker study, Tang et. al. (2012, SIM) presented two procedures for testing the accuracy among clustered markers. Tang et. al. (2013, AcadRadiol.) defined a useful index named discriminatory score to select out informative markers. Liu et. al. (2014, SIM) studied the effects of biomarker misclassification on the design and analysis of stratified biomarker clinical trials. For doubly censored data, which involves limit of detection as a special case, Shen et. al. (2016, CSDA) presented a new EM algorithm to get empirical likelihood confidence regions.

501111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
501111.value: During the procedure to complete the project objectives, we find that, in the literature, when the error terms are distribution free, the existed work to handle multivariate longitudinal data comparison have the challenge of intense computing and even divergence of algorithm. The theory is hard to push forward. The PI therefore has tried to address the difficulty from two perspectives. One is from the prospect of Bayesian statistics. The semiparametric mixture distribution, say a Dirichlet process mixture , will simplify the infinite dimensional problem into finite dimension situation, and thus reduces the load in computing. The other is to model the longitudinal data from the angel of modeling functional data. Then the nonparametric functional principle component analysis can be an ideal tool to push forward the progress in both theory and methodology. The PI has commenced work and effort in afore two directions.

501111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
501111.value: Multidimensional data arise from many biomedical studies, in which multiple outcome variables are measured longitudinally over time. Such data are complex due to various levels of within-subject correlations, ignoring of which in data analysis may cause serious misleading results. In our research, we have completed addressing the problem of two-group comparisons that are primary tasks in a case-control study or a two-arm clinical trial. The focus was on examining differences in various aspects of the measured variables across two groups and then identifying risk factors associated with the difference. We have constructed confidence intervals/regions and conducted hypothesis testing to realize this target. Upon completion of this project, a) in methodology, we proposed appealing empirical likelihood (EL) based methods without specifying a parametric likelihood which is difficult for the longitudinal data and also can bring improvement in both efficiency and adaptivity stemming from EL approach. Also we developed several procedures to improve diagnostics accuracy or select significant biomarkers for data with error-prone response, which is challenged by unknown error distribution; b) in theory, we derived the optimality properties of Dorfman’s group testing procedure in the presence of model misspecification which fills out the known theory gap in literature in this aspect. The value of this exploration is justified by the vast applications. Finally, in the progression of the project, the PI has been inspired by more thinking on broader research areas.
