544011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
544011.value: Empirical approaches to the scientific studies of language developed rapidly in the last few decades due to the introduction of psychological experiments and electronic corpora. As experiment and measurement tools become more and more sophisticated, and corpora grow bigger and more diversified, new research topics are frequently introduced and exciting discoveries are made. However, regardless of these two successful new directions, we still have not overcome one very basic bottleneck in linguistic research: a reasonably representative sampling size. Language is an ability shared by all human beings and a specific language is a convention of behaviours shared by thousands, even millions, of speakers. So far, the experimental approach can only access the language production data of no more than a few scores of speakers, while corpus sampling cannot reflect distributional variations by a number of different speakers. Ideally, linguistic studies should be based on the data produced by a substantial sample of all speakers from different background. The recent development of Mechanical Turk (MTurk) offers a new and unique opportunity to collect linguistic behavior data from a substantial number of speakers effectively and economically. In this research, we will design three linguistic studies using MTurk and compare the results with psycholinguistic experiments and manually corpus annotations in order to explore the linguistic interpretation, psychological co-relations, and computational implementation of this new ‘crowd-sourcing’ approach to linguistic studies. Results from the study will have implications for linguistic research as well as for applications such as public opionion mining in the Chinese context. 過去幾十年來，由於心理學實驗及電子語料庫的引入，實證研究法在語言科學研究中得到了迅速的發展。實驗和測量工具越來越完善，語料庫也逐漸增多及變得多樣化，我們經常可以引入新的研究課題，獲得令人振奮的發現。然而，儘管出現這兩種新的成功趨勢，我們仍沒有克服語言學研究中一個非常基本的瓶頸：一個合理且具有代表性的樣本量。語言是一種人類共享的能力，一種特定的語言是成千上萬個說話人共享的行為慣例。迄今為止，實驗方法僅能獲得不超過數十說話人產出的語料，而語料庫樣本不能反映大量不同說話人的分佈差異。理想上，語言研究應該以一個龐大的樣本量為基礎，這個樣本量應該由來自不同背景的說話人產出的語料所組成。近來Mechanical Turk (Mturk)的發展，提供了一個新穎且獨特的機會，能有效而經濟地從大量說話人中搜集語言行為數據。在本研究中，我們將使用Mturk設計三個語言學實驗，與心理語言學的實驗結果及語料庫中的人工標注進行比較，從而探索這種新的「協作外包」方法，在語言學研究中的語言學解釋、與心理學的相互關係，以及計算機方面的運用。本研究成果，將為漢語環境下，語言學的研究及運用如大眾意見的採集等方面，提供一些啟發。

544011.label: Realisation of objectives
544011.value: Our work has three interrelated general goals concerning the crowdsourcing methodology (objects 1, 2, and 7), language resources (objective 6), and linguistic theoretical issues (objectives 3, 4, and 5). We explored the Mechanical Turk-based linguistic experimentation, and during this process useful language resources were created, and these language resources were then used to investigate various linguistic/psycholinguistic issues. All the project objectives have been achieved. The Mechanical Turk-based linguistic experimentation was explored through three experiments: 1) the pilot experiment, 2) the semantic transparency rating experiment, and 3) the Chinese word segmentation experiment. In the pilot experiment, we tested two international Mechanical Turk platforms, i.e., Amazon's Mechanical Turk (AMT) and Crowdflower, the results suggested that for the moment, Crowdflower is a feasible platform to collect Chinese linguistic data which can yield samples of reasonable size and high quality at acceptable speed. We also discussed a set of data quality control methods including subject validation, data validation, data cleansing, parameter optimization, spammer monitor, etc., and by the pilot experiment, a preliminary framework of Mechanical Turk-based experimentation was proposed. We conducted the second experiment, the semantic transparency rating experiment. It was a large scale experiment which aimed to collect the overall and constituent semantic transparency rating data of about 1,200 Chinese compounds. This experiment was proved to be a success, the data collected showed high internal consistency and the overall semantic data strongly correlated with the constituent semantic data which indicated very good data quality. We then selected 152 compounds from the compound stimuli of the Mechanical Turk-based experiment. A similar laboratory-based experiment was conducted using these compounds as the stimuli. We then compared the data collected from the Mechanical Turk- and laboratory-based experiment, strong correlation was observed (rho>0.9); and we also discussed two data transformation methods, i.e., the z-score transformation (standardization) and adjusted normalization, to unify the scales of the data from these two experiments so make the data from the two experiments directly comparable. In experiment three, we further conducted a large scale Chinese word segmentation experiment, and we proposed an evaluation method named "manual segmentation error rate'' to evaluate the data. There is no Chinese native Mechanical Turk platform by now, therefore, we tried to conduct these Chinese linguistic experiments using the international Mechanical Turk platforms such as Amazon's Mechanical Turk and Crowdflower. However we are facing some special challenges to do so. Are there enough native Chinese speakers on these platforms? How to identify native Chinese speakers on these platforms? And how to deal with different Chinese writing systems (simplified and traditional Chinese characters)? Our studies addressed all these challenges. Our experiments confirmed that at least by now Crowdflower is a feasible platform to conduct Chinese linguistic experiments, however Amazon's Mechanical Turk is not feasible; the accessibility of Amazon's Mechanical Turk for the requesters from outside of the United States is not as convenient as Crowdflower and Crowdflower has a much larger worker pool than Amazon's Mechanical Turk. On a international Mechanical Turk platform like Crowdflower, native Chinese speakers only occupy a tiny proportion of the worker pool. Subject validation must be used to identify native Chinese speakers, and at least three measures can be used to do so. Firstly, we can use country/region white list for our tasks; we should mainly rely on the major Chinese speaking areas; if the major Chinese speaking areas cannot meet our need, we can open minor Chinese speaking areas with cautions; and we should always keep the non-Chinese speaking areas closed. Secondly, we can further use Chinese language tests to block non-native Chinese speakers; according to our experiments, the Chinese character identification question is quite efficient and it can also be used to block robots. And thirdly, we can use a simple language background survey for further analysis. Because the participants from all over the world may use different Chinese writing systems, we usually need to provide both simplified and traditional Chinese character task interfaces; we can put a question in the beginning of a task for a participant to choose which interface he or she wants to use; and then we can use the visibility logic function provided by Crowdflower to switch between two versions of task interfaces according to the participant's choice. The data collected in these experiments constituted useful language resources. Experiment two created a large semantic transparency dataset of Chinese disyllabic nominal compound (SemTransCNC 1.0) which contains the overall and constituent semantic transparency data of about 1,200 compounds. Besides that we also conducted a laboratory-based semantic transparency rating experiment, so a laboratory dataset of semantic transparency was also built; it contains 152 compounds selected from the crowdsourced dataset. Experiment three created a large manual Chinese word segmentation dataset (WordSegCHC 1.0); it contains the manual word segmentation data of 152 Chinese sentences (the total length is about 5,000 characters); all the sentences received 200 segmentation responses in their corresponding crowdsourcing tasks and the numbers of valid response of them range from 123 to 143. And we also conducted a laboratory-based Chinese word segmentation experiment, so a laboratory dataset of word segmentation was also built; it contains 71 Chinese sentences selected from the crowdsourced dataset, and the total length of these sentences is about 2,300 Chinese characters without punctuations; each sentence was segmented by 92 subjects. We investigated the semantic head effect on semantic transparency rating based on the semantic transparency dataset and found that in semantically transparent compounds, semantic heads tended to get higher semantic rating scores than non-heads. We also tested the effect of semantic transparency on the word intuition of Chinese speakers, but we did not find any evidence to support it as least in the case of disyllabic compound. And we also proposed a general method to measure the word intuition of Chinese speakers using word segmentation tasks. We firstly measured word intuition agreement between/among speakers using three methods, i.e., the proportionate agreement, the Cohen's kappa, and the Fleiss' kappa. We find that Chinese speakers agree very well (0.8~0.9) with each other on what is a word intuitively. This means the word concept in Chinese linguistics has a solid psychological foundation. Although kappa based agreement measure cannot be directly compared with F-scores; the fact that word intuition agreement is only about 0.9 among nature speakers suggests that perhaps the pursuit for 0.97+ F-score in current Chinese segmentation bakeoff competition could be a result of overfitting rather than real improvements in methodology. We proposed the concept and the measurement method of intuitive wordhood strength of a segment, i.e., the chance to which the speakers treat a segment to be a word intuitively. The distribution of intuitive wordhood strength of segments supports the hypothesis that word is a prototype category, there are typical words as well as atypical words. The distribution of segments of different lengths (i.e., two-, three-, four-, and five-character segments) and the comparison of their intuitive wordhood strengths confirms the special status of the disyllabic (or two-character) segments in Chinese speakers' word intuition: they are not only the largest in number but also the highest in intuitive wordhood strength.

544011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
544011.value: Empirical linguistic research is driven by linguistic data. However linguistic data collection, be it corpus annotation, scripture and audio material transcription, survey, or psycholinguistic experiment, etc., has been proved to be very time- and resource- intensive. As a result, linguistic researchers have to frequently make compromises on linguistic data. Since linguistic data is the foundation of empirical linguistic research, compromises on linguistic data may corrupt the whole research project. Linguistic data has become the bottleneck of empirical linguistic research. In recent years, the crowdsourcing technology, which means outsourcing tasks to crowds in the form of open call via Internet, has become a promising new method of linguistic data collection to break the bottleneck. This project explored the application of crowdsourcing method, especially the Mechanical Turk-based linguistic experimentation (Mechanical Turk is a primary genre of crowdsourcing), in empirical linguistic research to solve the linguistic data bottleneck problem. We have three correlated general goals which concern methodology, language resource, and linguistic theory respectively: 1) to explore Mechanical Turk-based linguistic experimentation, 2) to build useful linguistic datasets using Mechanical Turk-based experiments, and 3) to investigate some linguistic theoretical issues using the data collected.

544311.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
544311.value: Many companies across industries have shifted manufacturing strategies from doing everything in-house to outsourcing component productions to external suppliers and conducting the final production internally. Outsourcing component production (and perhaps other activities including product design, testing, transportation, etc.) to specialized suppliers allows a manufacturer to focus on core activities such as final assembly and marketing, and the cost throughout the supply chain is often reduced. However, an outsourcing manufacturer inevitably invites its suppliers to be involved in the decision making relevant to overall operations. The suppliers, like the manufacturer itself, will behave strategically and maximize their own benefits, by adopting strategies that may hurt the manufacturer and the channel. While numerous reports and cases are available to update the latest progresses made in outsourcing and raise relevant managerial as well as legal issues, there is a dearth of systematic study capable of providing substantial guidance for outsourcing manufacturers on supply management and performance improvement. We propose an in-depth exploration of the static and dynamic interactions that govern the behaviors of the firms involved in the outsourcing relationships to offer insights on such fundamental issues as managing decision sequencing, supplier competition, and benefit sharing. In practice, a manufacturer has much flexibility in coordinating activities with the suppliers by, for instance, setting the times to negotiate contracts and arrange materials flows with each one of them. We are interested in identifying the best sequence for an outsourcing manufacturer to interact with its suppliers. For the suppliers, a critical consideration factor in their decision makings for supplying components to the manufacturer is the competition they each have to face. We will study the implications on channel performance for the manufacturer to manage or control the competition at suppliers, by either sharing the costs with them or fostering production capabilities at alternative suppliers. Further, fierce market competition has continuously enforced price pressures on the manufacturers. The prices charged by the suppliers for the components they provide to an outsourcing manufacturer account for a large proportion of its cost. By rigorous modeling and analysis, we hope to recommend appropriate steps for the manufacturer to seek cost reduction from the suppliers as well as mechanisms for them extract the most from the cost savings. The insights built from this project will surely signify the importance of, and provide guidelines for, managing the outsourcing sequence jointly with the competition and the efforts at the suppliers. 近年来，越来越多的企业将其配件的生产外包给独立的供应商，内部仅完成最终产品的组装。将配件生产（或者其它诸如产品设计，测试，和运输环节）外包给专业的供应商可以使生产商致力于核心的工作，如产品组装和市场推广，并降低供应链的总成本。外包生产商的运营不可避免地受其供应商决策的影响。而供应商作决策时往往仅为自己的利益最大化考虑，不顾及生产商和整个供应链的利益。虽然有大量的报告和案例对当今外包的新现象和问题做了阐述，但是学术文献中尚缺乏相关的系统化定量的分析研究，为外包生产商提供行之有效的建议以提高系统绩效。我们在本课题中将深入地研究外包过程中涉及的诸多实体间的静态和动态的关系，探讨诸如外包顺序，供应商的竞争，及收益共享等一些实质性的问题。 生产商在实际生产经营过程中可以通过设定与供应商接洽的时间来协调其决策活动。如何选择最优的接洽顺序将是我们研究的一个重点。影响供应商为生产商供货定价的一个关键因素是他们所面对的竞争，其激烈程度受到供应商自身生产成本的直接影响。生产商可以通过分担供应商的生产成本来调节其面对的竞争的强度以影响其决策。我们将研究生产商分担供应商成本对整个系统的影响。另外，激烈的市场竞争迫使生产商不断地降低价格，而供应商对其配件的定价是生产商直接成本中很大的一部分。我们希望能通过严格地建模和分析，为生产商推荐恰当的机制以促使供应商降低成本并从中获得最大的受益。本课题的结论将昭示管理外包顺序以及影响供应商面对的竞争压力的重要性，并为之提供指导。

544311.label: Realisation of objectives
544311.value: We are pleased to report that we have completed the objectives that are set for this project. Some of the research outputs have been published in peer-reviewed quality journals, while others are under review and revision. We explicate our exploration primarily in a setting of one manufacturer that outsources components from external suppliers. Each supplier, in providing its component to the manufacturer, faces direct competition from other potential suppliers that are capable of providing perfectly substitutable components. Market demand is price sensitive and uncertain. We have investigated the best sequence for the manufacturer to source components from external suppliers, with the assistance of online reverse auction tools, and the obtain conclusive statements. The manufacturer can manage the competition at its suppliers in two ways. In one way, it can rely on a sequential sourcing procedure to control the indirect competition among the suppliers that provide complementary components. In another way, it can directly manage the direct competition faced by a supplier in providing its component by, for instance, incubating more potential suppliers to provide substitutable components and incentivizing suppliers to engage in cost reduction and sharing activities. By quantifying the effects of these measures on system performance, we find that sequentializing the sourcing procedure can always make the manufacturer better off, though at the expense of the suppliers' profits in general. It is possible to make each and every individual channel party better off by intensifying the competition pressure at the suppliers. To make further comments on supplier management, we investigate a few practical mechanisms that are influential in the operation interactions. While the suppliers can engage in cooperative decision making, we demonstrate that effective information sharing between them can be a valuable strategic complement to collaboration in operation decisions. As another practical issue, it is common for suppliers to experience shortages in capitals, particularly those component suppliers that are small in size and lack sufficient credit history. This can deliver substantial impacts of their normal production and exert a further impact on the manufacturer which outsources component production to these suppliers. We find that a manufacturer can design two-order contracts to help their suppliers out of financial difficulty and resume operations back to normal. The system performance can benefit from such internal financial assistance. All these findings have solid implications in practice and can offer concrete insights into outsourcing activities. These are what motivated to work on this project.

544311.label: Major findings and research outcome
544311.value: Most manufacturers across industries follow some sequence in sourcing components from suppliers to synchronize production activities and reduce excessive holding cost. It is common for multiple suppliers to offer substitutable components, and online reverse auction has been widely adopted as an effective means for supplier selection. The interplay between sourcing sequence and competitive environment influences channel performance in a subtle, and sometimes dramatic, way. Compared with sourcing various components at the same time, sequentializing sourcing process can benefit both the manufacturer and the suppliers themselves, and it is even possible for all channel parties to agree on the same sourcing sequence. Moreover, the manufacturer can practically manage the competition environment for its components according to their positions in the overall sourcing sequence. Appropriate measures can lead to a better and sometimes substantially improved profit performance to every individual firm, while mismanagement can result in devastating consequences. These findings are documented in a recent publication in POM (Item 1 in Part C). A practical issue in outsourcing management is on the allocation of cost-reduction efforts among manufacturers and their suppliers each facing competition in providing its component. We find that the impacts of suppliers’ cost reduction depend on the competitive supply environments and the sensitivity of final market demand with respect to price change. When the market is less price elastic, the manufacturer can only benefit from the cost saving by the supplier facing a sufficiently less competitive supply environment. As the market becomes more price elastic, it can be entitled to the gains from cost savings at both suppliers, particularly from the one with a smaller marginal effort cost and facing a less competitive environment. Instead of relying on the suppliers to lower costs, the manufacturer may seek cost reduction by itself. The manufacturer can be more aggressive than the suppliers in cost reduction and its reduction activity is more effective to bring about a higher profit to each individual firm. These results have been organized in a working paper, currently under revision for MSOM (Item 4 in Part C). We have investigated two relevant issues in outsourcing environment, suppliers' capital constraints and information sharing. Two technical notes have been published in ORL (Items 2 and 3 in Part C). The key messages are: 1) information sharing and cooperative decision making are strategic complements; and 2) two-order contract is effective to alleviate capital constraints at the suppliers in providing for manufacturers.

544311.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
544311.value: A promising avenue to further develop this research project is to incorporate information issues. With the development of IT, supply chain parties have become more and more connected by timely market data through information communication. This infuses an additional layer of interactions between parties on top of their routine operational relationships, and makes the access to and sharing of information of strategic importance. The key questions to address in an outsourcing setting are how to utilize information to better manage the interactions between manufacturers and their outsourcing partners, and how to rationally disseminate useful information in the system under an incentive compatible ground. The existing literature that sustains information sharing is rather sparse, though information communication is prevalently observed in reality. By building novelty into modeling to capture information ownership and flow, we aim to bridge such a gap and provide insights for firms to manage information relationships. Our preliminary efforts have already led to ground-breaking results to analytically justify incentive-driven full-scale information dissemination. With these results, we should be able to develop a full set of results on information sharing with solid practical implications, not only for an outsourcing setting but for general supply chain settings.

544711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
544711.value: The impact of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) activities on firms’ financial performance is an important issue in management and marketing. Because CSR programs are costly, competing for firms’ limited financial resources (Wang, Choi, and Li 2008), evidence of a positive relationship between CSR and shareholder value is crucial for the support of CSR programs given that shareholders provide the capital necessary to fund these programs (King and Lenox 2001). Recognizing this importance, many prior studies have investigated the impact of CSR activities on firms’ future financial performance. Taken together, these efforts demonstrate no universal link between CSR and firm value (Margolis and Walsh 2003). This lack of a universal relationship shifts the focus to identifying the contingency factors that condition the relationship between social and financial performance. In our study, we focus on the role of investment in marketing communication and its productivity (i.e., marketing communication productivity: MCP) in the association between firms’ CSR activities and firm value. We develop a theory that the higher the firm’s advertising intensity, the better the appreciation of CSR efforts in the security market since advertising is the key instrument which creates marketing intangibles (e.g., brand equity, consumer satisfaction). We also argue that not only the amount of spending on advertising but also the productivity of that spending is an important contingency factor for the link between CSR and firm value. Using multiple-firm-year data on CSR and financial statements, we test whether the extent to which the financial community incorporates CSR in their investment decisions is dependent on advertising and its productivity (MCP). Beyond the stock market’s reaction to CSR, we investigate how financial analysts – an important stakeholder who gathers and processes firms’ information for investors – respond to CSR. Similar to the market’s reaction to CSR, we argue that analysts become more positive to a firm’s CSR when CSR is supported by marketing initiatives and the firm is more capable of translating their advertising into desired financial outcomes. Using analysts’ earnings forecast data, we empirically test the proposed contingency role of marketing communication in the relationship between CSR and analysts’ prediction of firm value. Finally, we also see the possibility that the important findings on investment and efficiency in marketing communication as the contingency factor in the relationship between CSR and firm value can be generalized with the sample of firms in many different countries.

544711.label: Realisation of objectives
544711.value: I think the main objective of the project was achieved. PI and the Co-I's found the results supporting the hypothesized relationship – the moderating effect of marketing communication capability on the relationship between corporate social responsibility (CSR) and firm value. PI also investigated whether marketing communication productivity increases the analysts’ reaction to CSR. However, the PI could not find good results on the relationship. Instead of pursuing the unsupportive research idea, the PI considered marketing as a part of competitive action done by the firm. Focusing on the software industry, which is a highly competitive and has a high litigation risk, the PI found that marketing and other competitive actions moderate the relationship between CSR and corporate financial performance. Although the results for financial analysts were less supported, the moderating effect of competitive action implies that financial analysts, who are important stock market participants, did important roles to deliver the value of CSR to investors. The PI also collected CSR data from other emerging markets such as Korea, China and tested the relationship between CSR and financial performances. Given that the data spans only the short time period – 3~4 years, the results were not promising. But the PI keeps trying to generalize the CSR effect in developing countries. Overall, the PI believes that most of the research objectives were achieved.

544711.label: Major findings and research outcome
544711.value: The PI and the Co-I’s measured marketing communication capability (MCC) using data envelop analysis and found that the MCC moderates the relationship between CSR and firm financial performance even controlling other variables shown to be related to firm financial performance and the level of advertising spending level. That is, the amount of spending on advertising is an important determinant for the effectiveness of CSR but how to use advertising is another important determinant. The PI and other co-authors also considered marketing spending as a part of competitive actions. The PI found that the effect of CSR on firm financial performance depends on the level of competitive action. When competitive action is not enough compared to the competitors, positive CSR is not effective in value creation. However, in that situation, negative CSR is effective in value creation due to cost saving. On the other hand, when the firm spends more competitive actions compared to the competitors, positive CSR is capitalized as financial returns. However, the negative CSR has more negative impact on financial performance. The finding on the contingency effect is interesting. The PI wrote the paper based on the above results and a paper is forthcoming at the Journal of Management which is one of the business journals with the highest impact on practitioners (Journal of Management Impact factor is 6.071).

544711.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
544711.value: Although the PI attempted to examine how analysts react to CSR, he found less supportive results. The PI delves further into why analysts are inefficient interpreting the firm’s CSR activities and their outcomes. Also, the PI keeps trying to understand the effect of CSR on firm performance in under developed economies and how the relationship between CSR and firm financial performance is different between developed market and emerging market. The PI believes the topics are very interesting and keeps pursuing those research ideas.

544711.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
544711.value: Rather than merely identify the impact of social performance on financial performance, researchers have increasingly sought to understand the mechanisms through which firms translate their social efforts into increased shareholder value. This study addresses this question by emphasizing the moderating role of marketing communication capabilities (MCC). Consistent with the call for contingency-based approaches that identify the circumstances under which investments in CSR pay off, this study emphasizes the role of MCC in moderating the relationship between CSR and firm value. Though marketing spending has been identified as a factor influencing whether socially responsible firms perform well financially, the construct of MCC implies that firms differ in the productivity of their marketing programs. Rather than simply pouring money into CSR actions, firms reap financial returns when they combine social performance and effectiveness in their marketing communications.

544911.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
544911.value: Hong Kong positions itself as ‘the world city of Asia’. With strong emphasis on economic progress, the Hong Kong Government is passive to respond to a significant global phenomenon: the coming of the ageing society. In Hong Kong, about 22% of the total population will reach 60 years old or above in the year 2030. Nowadays, people getting old are much healthier and better educated than the previous cohort. They tend to live independently and keep an active lifestyle when they become older. How to design a habitable living environment to cope with this significant demographic change? How to sustain a life with quality for the coming generation of older citizens? In 2002 and 2007, the WHO launched world wide campaigns to promote ‘active ageing’ and ‘age –friendly city’. Major cities have worked together to draft the guidelines for the designing of ‘age –friendly city’ and have included these concepts as guiding principles in their urban development projects. Is it possible to apply such concept of age-friendly city to Hong Kong? For all these urgent issues, the Government has not yet initiated city wide discussions. Our interdisciplinary research team has engaged in environmental gerontology studies and researches since 1998. We agree with WHO which defines ageing as one of the stages of a ‘life course’. To respond constructively to the issues stated above, we wish to promote active ageing from middle age onwards. In order to make people aware of their pending old age, our proposal plans to conduct participatory action researches on the quality of the living environment with informants ageing from 55 onwards. We wish to understand their response to this question: how can the environment be better fit their changing lifestyles and abilities as they age? With an in-depth comparison with the guidelines of age friendly city established by WHO, we plan to draft comprehensive design guidelines for Hong Kong, thus projecting our city into an environment which would enable people to lead a life ‘accompanied by continuing opportunities for health, participation and security.’ (WHO, 2002). In the Mercer ‘world’s most livable cities’ survey, the overall ranking of Hong Kong remains low. To sustain its competitive power, a city should care about the quality of the living environment. Our aim is to forge an alternative paradigm in respect to urban policy and design of our city other than economic development: the quality of life of the citizens. 近年，香港的定位，是「亞洲國際城市」：香港政府的着眼點，就是不斷努力發展香港的經濟增長動力。然而，對於那越來越明顯的趨勢──高齡化社會的來臨，反應卻很被動。於2030年，香港六十歲或以上的人口將會佔總人口的22%。現今時期，踏入高齡階段的人士，比起對上一代，大多數都比較健康，並接受過較多教育 (1960年代出生的人們有多於六 成接受過中等程度教育)。她/他們大多傾向保持活躍的生活方式。面對上述之人口結構及本質的轉變，我們應該怎樣計劃一個可居住的生活環境、怎樣為高齡市民締造有質素的生活？於2002年與2007年，世界衛生組織推行了「活躍高齡」與「高齡友善城市」的世界性活動，邀請了多個主要城市合作草議規劃「高齡友善城市」的綱要指引，並期望將這些指引能納入它們所屬國家內各個城市發展計劃之中。這等有關高齡友善城市的規劃指引能否於香港應用？政府對如此迫切的課題，尚未發起廣泛普及的討論。 我們乃是一跨學科研究隊伍，自1998年起已在進行長者生活環境的研究。此名為「從獨立生活、活躍高齡到長者友善城市--為香港城市環境進入高齡化社會作設計草議」之研究的出發點，乃是基於世界衛生組織對於「高齡化」之定義：即人們年齡漸長，是「生活歷程」其中之一階段。是項研究的目的，乃是對香港進入高齡化社會此嚴重課題，作建設性的回應。我們希望向中老年市民，推廣「活躍高齡」的概念。為了讓普羅市民對即將到來的高齡化社會有所意識，我們計劃以55歲及以上的人士作為受訪者，針對年長人士生活環境質素進行參與式行動研究。我們主要目的，乃希望知道受訪者如何回答以下問題：怎樣的環境，才能更切合他們隨年齡增長而改變的生活方式？再者，我們會將研究所得之資料及分析，跟世衞所訂立的高齡向城市綱要指引作深度比較，以求得出更適合香港的高齡化社會之城市設計方何。我們計劃為香港草議一套全面的設計指引，由此而展示我們的城市如何可能營造成為一個容許年長市民過著「既能保持身健康、能積極參與城市活動和事務、又能維持安穩的生活」的環境（WHO，2002）。 每年，美世人力資源諮詢公司(Mercer)的「世界最適宜居住城市」的調查，香港的總體排名常處於低位。一個城市要維持自己的競爭力，最應該關注的，乃是其生活環境的質素。我們的目標，正是為我們的城市在經濟發展之外，打造一套另類的標準，此即是以公民的生活質素，作為城市政策及設計之核心價值。

545211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
545211.value: 因為越來越多持份者的參與，公眾對公司運作透明度的需求不斷增長，企業社會責任（CSR）已成為世界各地流行的管理重點。所以，製造業在強大的客戶的壓力， 企業社會責任已成為一種必然的責任。製造業要有效地管理企業社會責任，以避免災難性的環境，勞動和社會問題的發生。 隨著中國製造商正在扮演全球供應網絡中世界工廠的角色，他們受到很大實踐企業社會責任管理的壓力，因他們不單只是競爭價格，而且要符合西方客戶的社會價值。然而，企業社會責任對中國廠商影響的研究實證非常有限。從沒有客觀的數據去驗証企業社會責任和中國製造商的盈利能力的關係。 為了填補這一研究上的空白，我們將以客觀數據為基礎進行大規模的縱向研究，以研究CSR對製造商的盈利能力的影響。我們將跟踪中國製造商在過去 15年的財務業績（1996年至2010年），去計算在他們獲得的，如SA 8000，CSC 9000，ISO 14000，OHSAS 18001，ISO 26000等企業社會責任相關的認證後盈利能力有否異常變化。這些認證作為企業社會責任的環境，社會，勞動關係方面的實際執行情況的客觀指標。此外，我們將研究製造商是因增加收入及 (或) 節約成本的途徑去改善盈利能力。最後，我們將調查企業“的特點和經營環境(如行業勞動強度)是否對實踐企業社會責任管理的公司的盈利能力有何影響。這項研究將是推進企業社會責任的理論和實踐的重要貢獻。

545211.label: Realisation of objectives
545211.value: We conducted event study analysis for the CSR certification certified firms (i.e., ISO 9000, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001) of China listing manufacturing firms. We collected both the CSR performance and their firm performance, and investigated how the CSR certification affected their firm profitability, and stock return. We sampled all firms with environmental incidents that were captured by the public media and Non-Government Organization (NGO), such as illegal discharge, chemical pollutions to the working environment. We found that among 552 firms (out of 1700 manufacturing firms in China stock exchanges) that has CSR misconduct records, 381 firms ISO 9000 certified, 296 firms ISO 14001 certified, and 190 firms OHSAS 18001 certified. The percentage of adoption of ISO 9000, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001 are 70%, 53.6% and 34.4% respectively. These firms adopt management certifications as their CSR management process. This is the first empirical evidence CSR certification distribution among the listing manufacturing firms in China. However, the results show that, the adoption of these certification show no significant impact on firm performance in China. The answer for the first objective is negative. We believe that it mainly because the adoption is driven by the institutional pressure, where the symbolic value surpasses the actual technical benefits of the certification. From an institutional theory perspective, the firms are pursuing the legitimacy of the certification from their customers, allowing them to be one of the qualified suppliers. However, the sourcing decision is not mainly based on certification, but also the product and service quality, therefore, the impact of the CSR certifications to firms performance are insignificant. To further investigate the other two research objectives, whether the CSR certification could bring profitability to the firms or not and the moderating effects of labour intensity, we further our data collection to the U.S. listing manufacturing firms. It is because U.S. stock exchange data are available from our institution, and the manufacturers in the U.S. are relatively free from the institutional pressure. We collected certification data, environmental pollution data, and health and safety data of all listing manufacturing firms in the U.S. For the study of the ISO 14001, we found that both the cost and sales performance improved leading to improved profitability in the U.S. manufacturing firms For the OHSAS 18001, we also found similar patterns and firms labour intensity significantly moderate the relationship between OHSAS 18001 adoption and firm profitability.

545211.label: Major findings and research outcome
545211.value: While focusing on specific certifications in our manuscript writing, we published one peer-reviewed article in 2014, and one peer-reviewed conference paper in the world OM conference in 2013. One additional manuscript has been prepared, which is about the ISO 14000 certification impact to U.S. manufacturers. We found that the CSR certifications bring revenue-gain or cost-saving leads to higher profitability. For example the ISO 14001, we found that both the cost and sales performance improved leading to improved profitability in the U.S. manufacturing firms. Please refer to the peer-reviewed conference paper published in the 4th Production and Operations Management World Conference and the 19th International Annual EurOMA Conference. The peer-review manuscript (item no. 2 in Part C question 8) also investigates whether the impact is moderated by the pollution level, and previous experience of ISO 9000. We found that ISO 14001 is more important in highly polluted industry and prior experience of ISO 9000 adoption is a key success factor. This manuscript is ready for submission to top-tier peer-reviewed journals. For the OHSAS 18001 certification, based on a sample of 211 U.S. listed manufacturing firms with OHSAS 18001 certification, we find that certification leads to significant increases in abnormal performance on safety, sales growth, labor productivity, and profitability and that these benefits increase as complexity (measured by labour intensity and R&D intensity) and coupling (measured by inventory level and volatility) increase. These findings provide important implications to both academic and practitioners, because we found that putting resources in adopting health and safety management measures will help firms to obtain more profitability. The improved profitability is come from both sales and costs improvement. The safety performance was also improved, and thus we can conclude that CSR certification do have significant impact to firms’ performance, when their motivation is self-driven. Senior management of China manufacturers should focus on the technical benefits of CSR certification, so that their organization can realize the benefits as if those manufacturing firms in the U.S.

545211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
545211.value: The findings of this study can be further disseminated to some trade journals / magazine where the industry practitioners are the key informants. For example, Quality Digest is an online magazine where the readers are quality and operations managers, where the findings of this study are highly relevant to their daily decision. This study can also be replicated in other developing countries, e.g. ASEAN countries. Although China listing manufacturing firms do not show significant impact, there is no clear empirical findings yet available for other developing countries. The impact of the certification in these countries might be stronger than in China, because they usually lack a proper management system, while previous studies show that a management certification can provide the largest impact to firms with minimum level of management system.

545211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
545211.value: This study found that CSR adoption (i.e., ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001) improved firms’ profitability and it is moderated by the labour intensity. Although this impact is not significant in China manufacturing firms, but we found clear evidence from the manufacturing firms in developed countries. Therefore, when China market continue to develop, where the CSR awareness of the consumer market continue to increase. The profitability from adopting these CSR certification will be realized as if those in the developed countries in the last decade. The insignificant impact in China, should not be interpreted as China manufacturing firms do not need to adopt CSR certifications, but rather they should do so with clearer motivation.

545511.value: 評估中國製造商採用生態控制的情況

545511.label: Project Objectives
545511.value: Examine the awareness of Chinese manufacturers on ESPR-related compliances. Evaluate the current state of adopting eco-control by Chinese manufacturers. Investigate whether Chinese manufacturers vary in their adoption of eco-control, and if so, how their variations in adopting eco-control are related to their awareness of domestic and international environmental ESPR-related compliances. Determine the role of the China-based ESPR-oriented environmental certification in strengthening the adoption of eco-control among Chinese manufacturers. Recommend managerial and policy actions to improve eco-control in the Chinese manufacturing industry.

545511.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
545511.value: Industrial activities in China during the past three decades have brought remarkable growth in wealth and prosperity for the country. This development also leads to various environmental consequences including ecological degradation, excessive resource consumption, and pollution. To alleviate the contraction between rapid industrial development and shortage of resources, the Chinese government has been urging ecological modernisation with a focus on the manufacturing industry to ease the environmental burden. In contributing to the country’s economic growth as global factory, Chinese manufacturers are increasingly requested to balance their productivity gains with environmental performance. Such ecological modernisation goal promulgated by the Chinese central government can be realised by establishing policies and regulations to motivate environmental management practices. Some of these policies and regulations in China are emphasising energy savings and pollution reduction (ESPR). Eco-control, which is concerned with applications of financial and strategic control methods to improve environmental management, is a viable approach for Chinese manufacturers to manage their environmental responsibilities and hence fulfill ESPR-related compliances. With the intensifying regulatory quest for ESPR, Chinese manufacturers are pressurised for adopting eco-control to mitigate the environmental damages caused by their industrial activities. Grounded on the ecological modernisation theory, we propose to investigate the current state of adopting eco-control among Chinese manufacturers and if different manufacturer clusters varying in their adoption of eco-control exist. Specifically, we will examine if Chinese manufacturers’ awareness of domestic and international environmental ESPR-related compliances will enhance their adoption efforts on eco-control, and if so, whether the awareness effect on eco-control adoption is stronger for manufacturers awarded with the ESPR-oriented China environmental labelling certification than those operating without such certification. This proposed study seeks answers for these timely research issues with a large scale empirical study targeted at Chinese manufacturing enterprises to echo the advocate by the Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao on developing a low-carbon economy. The study results will inform whether Chinese manufacturers vary in their pace to ecologically modernise with eco-control and the value of the China-based ESPR-oriented environmental certification to diffuse eco-control adoption among Chinese manufacturers. Practically, Chinese manufacturers will find the results useful to benchmark eco-control for improving the environmental and productivity performance of their operations. Government officials will better understand the eco-control adoption status and how the environmental certification can be leveraged as a policy tool to enhance their implementation outcome of ecological modernisation-based policies and regulations on eco-control in the Chinese manufacturing industry. 過去三十年在中國的工業活動，為國家的財富和繁榮都帶來了明顯的增長。但這種發展也衍生了各樣的環境問題，包括生態破壞，資源過度消耗及污染。為了舒緩工業迅速發展與資源短缺之間的矛盾，中國政府一直極力主張生態現代化，並將重點放於製造業，以減輕對生態環境的破壞及環境負擔。作為促進國家經濟增長的世界工廠，各界對中國製造商在其生產收益與環境績效之間作出平衡的要求越來越強烈。這一個由中國中央政府頒佈的生態現代化目標，可從推動環境管理措施的政策和法規中實現。當中有些政策和法規，都是強調節能減排的 (Energy Savings and Pollution Reduction，簡稱 ESPR)。生態控制是有關財務和戰略控制方法的應用，以改善環境管理，也是中國製造商用來履行他們的環境責任其中一種可行的方式，從而滿足ESPR相關的規範要求。隨著各界不斷增加對ESPR相關條例的需求，中國製造商因而受到壓力並採取一些有關生態控制的措施，用以減輕其工業活動對環境所造成的破壞。建基於生態現代化理論，我們建議在中國製造商之間採用生態控制的現況上作出探討，並研究不同的製造商組群會否對生態控制(措施)存有不同的採納方式。具體來說，我們將會研究增加中國製造商對國內和國際ESPR相關規範的關注度，會否相對提高他們對生態控制措施的採納，如果如此，這種現象又會否對那些獲頒「ESPR為本中國環境標誌認證」的製造商在採納生態控制上，對比沒有相關認證的製造商有更大的影響。這一個研究項目，以中國製造業為主要的探討對象，並進行了大規模的實證研究分析，用以回答上述幾個適時的研究課題，更呼應了由中國國務院總理溫家寶提倡的低碳經濟發展目標。這項研究的結果將顯現出中國製造商在利用生態控制去實踐生態現代化的進程中有否存在不同的步伐，及顯示出利用「ESPR為本中國環境認證」在中國製造商之間用作促進採納生態控制措施的價值。在實際應用上，研究的結果可為中國製造商提供一個有關採納生態控制的參照，用以改善他們業務的環境績效和生產效益。而政府官員將能更了解生態控制被採用的狀況，以及如何在中國製造業上利用環保認證作為一項政策工具，用來提高以生態現代化為基礎的政策和法規之執行成效。

545511.label: Realisation of objectives
545511.value: All the research objectives of this project are successfully achieved. Specifically, the awareness of Chinese manufacturers on ESPR-related compliances are investigated through several related independent studies. Their eco-control adoption is evaluated in terms of their green operations, supply chain partnership, reverse logistics practices, corporate social responsibility, eco-industrial park development, environmental management systems, re-manufacturing practices, green house gas emission control. This study find variations of Chinese manufacturers on their adoption of these eco-control practices and their awareness of ESPR-related compliances plays a role to account for such variations. Considering the growth of pollution arising from different stages of producing, distributing, and disposing of manufactured products, the importance of eco-control for green operations in terms of process and product stewardship to mitigate environmental damages and satisfy the escalating social expectation for environmentally friendly operations among Chinese manufacturers are highlighted. In one study, the boundary spanning role of green operations and the influence of environmental management capability of suppliers on firm performance and pollution reduction are investigated. The findings from Chinese manufacturing firms show that the success of green operation is contingent on environmental management capability of their suppliers. Other than the Chinese manufacturers themselves, the awareness of their suppliers on ESPR-related compliance as part of their environmental management capability should be emphasized in their eco-control adoption. As reverse logistics is an important and emerging trend in China's manufacturing practices, an increasing number of Chinese manufacturers have integrated reverse logistics practices in their operations to develop sustainable competitive advantage. In another study, six broad aspects of practicing reverse logistics which include waste management, recycling, reuse, reprocessing, materials recovery, and design for reverse logistics are identified. Using seemingly unrelated regression, these six reverse logistics practices are found positively related to the organizational bottom line of Chinese manufacturers with respect to their operational, financial, and social performance outcomes. This study extends the frontier of managerial knowledge on eco-control for Chinese manufacturers by highlighting the emerging trends in reverse logistics practices and providing evidence on the business value of adopting reverse logistics practices in the industry. ESPR-oriented environmental certification such as the ISO 14001-based environmental management system and its diffusion is found to bring a positive effect on eco-control practices including green products, green processes, and green supply chain management. Furthermore, corporate social responsibility is identified as an important part for eco-control improvement. Built on the stakeholder theory, this project develops " 7+2" dimensions for corporate social responsibility practices for Chinese enterprises covering organizational governance, human rights, labour practices, the environment, fair operating practices, consumer issues, community involvement and development, supply chain partnership, and political responsibility. These practices are found beneficial for performance which can be used as checklist by Chinese manufacturers to improve their eco-control in the industry.

546111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
546111.value: Business and infrastructure planning has been widely recognized as one of the most important functions for industrial practitioners and government policy makers at all levels. In the tourism industry, planning is particularly important because of the rapid economic and political changes, augmented operational complexity, and complicated tourism businesses. To a large extent, planning relies heavily on accurate forecasts. In other words, accurate forecasts of demand for tourism are crucial for effective planning by all providers of services and products. Practical tourism forecasters concentrate primarily on quantitative causal-relationship and time series methods. Although these techniques have attained a certain level of success in tourism research, they are unable to simulate the relationship of demand for tourism as accurately as Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based techniques such as multiprocessing node-based artificial neural networks. Unfortunately, there exist a very limited number of published articles in the tourism literature that incorporates AI-based techniques into tourism demand analysis. This relative absence of published articles is particularly true in the context of Hong Kong’s recent tourism industry. Different from the major area of research efforts that focus on improving forecasting accuracy in tourism demand modeling and forecasting, this research will investigate the issue of data quality improvement, an area that is largely overlooked by tourism researchers. Applications would be on international demand for travel to Hong Kong, using historical data in the past 30 years. The major origin countries/regions in alphabetic order are: Australia, Germany, Indonesia, Japan, Mainland China, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, the U.K., and the U.S.A. These tourist generating regions that have consistently produced the most number of inbound tourists to Hong Kong will be included in the research. Official publications indicate that the number of tourist arrivals from these origins and their expenditures have constantly contributed to 90% of total tourist arrivals and total tourism receipts in Hong Kong. The anticipated research outcomes can therefore be used to represent the behavior of demand for tourism in Hong Kong and its determining factors for each of these countries/origins. These empirical results, upon their successful development, will benefit tourism managers and government officials in Hong Kong, and likely elsewhere, in better planning and decision making. 业务及基础设施规划作为工业从业者和各级政府决策者最重要的职责之一，已被得到广泛认可。在旅游业，由于经济的飞速发展、政策的变化、运营复杂性的加强以及旅游业务的扩展等因素，规划问题尤为关键。规划在很大程度上依赖于准确的预测。换言之，对旅游需求的准确预测，对所有旅游服务和产品供应商进行有效的规划是至关重要的。 在实际进行旅游预测时，主要使用定量的因果关系和时间序列方法。尽管这些技术在旅游研究中已经取得了一定水平的成功，但是它们是无法像基于多重节点处理技术，如人工智能（AI）技术那样，准确地模拟旅游需求的关系。很可惜，目前针对旅游需求分析的文献中，AI技术的应用还十分有限。在研究近期香港旅游业的文献中，这种相对稀缺的现象同样是确实存在的。 与目前主要研究如何提高旅游需求建模和预测的准确性有所不同，本研究将探讨如何提高数据的质量，这也是被其他研究者忽视的领域。使用过去30年香港旅游业的历史数据，研究以香港为目的地的国际旅游需求。按字母顺序排列，香港旅游业的主要客源国家/地区分别是：澳大利亚，德国，印度尼西亚，日本，中国内地，马来西亚，菲律宾，新加坡，韩国，台湾，泰国，英国和美国。这些客源国为香港输送了大批入境游客，因此都被列入研究范围。官方数据表明，一直以来，来自这些国家的旅游者数量以及消费金额分别占到访港旅客总数以及旅游消费总额的90%。因此，研究成果能够准确地反映香港旅游需求的现状以及影响客源国的各种因素。研究的实证结果将帮助香港旅游业管理者和政府官员更好地进行规划以及决策的制定，并有可能在其他领域获得推广。

546111.label: Major findings and research outcome
546111.value: In recent years, scientific models have been popularly studied to solve hard machine learning problems. The models are important due to their flexible non-parametric modeling abilities using Mercer kernels and the Bayesian framework for probabilistic inference. In this paper, we propose a sparse GPR model for tourism demand forecasting. The sparsification procedure of the GPR model not only decreases the computational complexity but also improves the generalization ability. We experiment the proposed model with monthly demand data that are relevant to Hong Kong’s tourism industry, and compare the performance of the sparse GPR model with those of various kernel based models to show its effectiveness. The proposed sparse GPR model shows that its forecasting capability outperforms those of the ARMA model and the two state-of-the-art SVM models.

546111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
546111.value: There has been significant advancement in tourism demand forecasting. Unfortunately, this advancement has not been matched with similar progress in secondary data preparation, although it is well acknowledged that the performance of a forecasting model is largely determined by the quality of the secondary data. As such, there is a strong need for a systematic method to be developed that can significantly assist researchers in preparing quality secondary data suitable for tourism demand forecasting model construction. This study investigates the issue of data preparation in the context of tourism demand forecasting. The advantages and long term significance that are offered by this research’s outcomes are multi-fold. Over the years, the existing tourism demand forecasting models have been widely examined. At present, it comes to a point that only marginal improvements in accuracy are achieved with significant additional development efforts on these traditional techniques. As a consequence, new revolutionary or evolutionary techniques are needed to further enhance the tourism demand forecasting capacity. By shifting the research focus from the forecasting model improvement to the data quality improvement, this research is expected to benefit all tourism demand forecasting researchers by providing a generic approach on improving the quality of secondary data.

547611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
547611.value: In China, service organizations refer to the many semi-governmental organizations that perform social or public functions, partly or fully on a self-financing basis. Totaling around 1.3 million and employing close to 40 million people, service organizations are the predominant organizational form for delivering major public services such as education, health, welfare, research, and communications. Yet service organizations are not part of the core government bureaucracy. A key item on China’s governance reform agenda is about which service organizations should be integrated back into the core government bureaucracy, and which should be turned into self-financing enterprises units or private, nonprofit organizations. Although few western scholars have written about it, service organization reform has been hotly debated by academics and policy makers in China, resulting in scores of books and hundreds of academic and magazine articles, with the latest wave of studies led by the World Bank and the Development and Reform Committee of China. There is, however, a major gap in the literature—a lack of systematic understanding of what drives the transformation of service organizations at the local level. To fill this gap, the proposed research seeks to perform a longitudinal and cross-jurisdictional study of service organization reform at the local level. Specifically, it seeks to answer four questions: 1) How are service organizations changing in the context of broader governance reform? 2) How have transaction cost and institutional factors shaped these changes? 3) What are the regional variations in service organization reform? and 4) In what ways can existing institutional choice theories be adapted to examining service organization reform in China? These questions will be addressed by conducting interviews with leading officials in service organizations that are affiliated with local environmental protection bureaus (EPBs). The study will be built on our earlier studies on environmental governance reform in the three Chinese cities of Guangzhou, Chengdu, and Dalian. 中国事业单位的改革：追踪和跨行政地区的研究 在中国，事业单位是指众多执行社会或公共职能，在部分或完全自负盈亏的基础上营运的半官方组织。总计约130万，并雇用近400万人，事业单位是主要的机构形式去提供主要的公共服务，，如教育、卫生，福利，科研和通讯等。然而，事业单位并不属于政府官僚架构的核心组织。在中国政府管治改革的议程上的一个重点项目就是关于哪些事业单位应回归到政府的核心架构中，以及哪些应转为自负盈亏的企业单位或商业，非营利组织。 虽然只有少数的西方学者曾经研究过的，事业单位的改革在中国学术界和政策制定者当中已经掀起了广泛而激烈的争论，出现了大量有关这课题的书籍和学术论文，而最近期具影响力的则是由世界银行和中国的发展和改革委员会所出版的研究文集。然而，在研究文献上存在的主要不足之处，就是缺乏对推动事业单位在基层地区改造作系统性的认知。为了填补这一空白，这个研究项目旨在对地方一级的事业单位改革进行追踪和跨行政地区的研究。具体来说，它旨在回答四个问题：1）事业单位在宏观的政府管治改革中如何改变？ 2）交易成本和体制因素是如何主导这些 变化？ 3）事业单位的改革在不同地区有什么差异？ 4）用什么方法可以将现时的制度选择理论应用于研究中国事业单位的改革？ 这些问题会通过与地方环保部门（环保局）下属的事业单位中的领导官员访谈而进行探讨/这些。这项研究是建立于我们较早前在广州，成都，大连等中国的三个城市的环境管治研究的基础上。

547611.label: Realisation of objectives
547611.value: As planned, we have completed the interviews of leading officials of individual service organizations in the environmental protection bureau (EPB) of all the three cities of Dalian, Chengdu and Guangzhou. Since the reform of service organizations is a politically sensitive research topic, it took us years to get all interviews arranged and conducted. We encountered difficulties in arranging the interviews in both Dalian and Guangzhou. In Dalian, our research supporting institution there did not have close contact with all service organizations in the Dalian Environmental Protection Bureau and we could only interview a selected number of service organizations. In Guangzhou, the political climate in this period of time did not welcome external researchers to study the institutional changes of Guangzhou Environmental Bureau and we could only complete the interviews of all service organizations in February 2016. In comparison, the arrangements of interviews of service organizations in Chengdu Environmental Bureau were quite smooth and we were able to get all interviews conducted in October 2014. To conduct cross-city comparison of local EPB’s service organizations in these three cities, we used the research method of semi-structured interviews with a set of 10 questions on the following aspects: 1. The establishment and history development of your service organization (贵事业单位成立及发展历史). 2. The reform measures implemented in your service organization (中央推进事业单位分类改革在贵单位实施的具体情况). 3. Major functions and activities of your service organization (中央推进事业单位分类改革在贵单位实施的具体情况). 4. The management structure and staffing situation (管理体系及人员情况) 5. Work conditions and sources of funding (工作条件及经费来源) 6. The working relationship with municipal environmental protection bureau (与市环保局关系) 7. Major difficulties and problems encountered (面临的主要困难与问题) 8. Future development plan and directions (未来发展计划及方向) 9. Your views and comments on the development and reform of service organizations in your city’s environmental protection bureau (你对贵市在过去十多年环保局属下事业单位的发展和改革情况有什么看法和评价) 10. Give examples to illustrate major changes of services organizations in your city’s environmental protection bureau and identify the reasons (请例举广州市在过去十多年环保属下事业单位的发展重大的转变和原因) Before the interview, we sent the list of these questions to the leading officials of the service organization concerned for information so that they were able to get a clear idea of our research focus and purposes. As a result, many interviewees were quite well-prepared. Each interview last around 60 to 75 minutes. In order to get an accurate picture of the reform situation in each service organization, we insisted to interview either its chief or deputy chief. This also made our study sensitive and increased the difficulties in arranging the interviews. We made all the individual interview records transcribed in April this year and have already conducted preliminary analysis. Based on these interview records, we should be able to identify the general trend of service organization reform in China, to provide an in-depth analysis of the developmental path of all EPB-affiliated service organizations in Guangzhou in the past decade, to compare the practices of service organization reform in the environmental administrative system in different regions in China, to identify various contextual factors, both external and internal to local EPBs, that impact the reform of service organizations in China, and to propose strategies that can help both the central and local governments to reform service organizations in China. In the conclusion of data collection in this project, we judge that we should be able to achieve all the objectives set beforehand. However, we were unable to get the chief/deputy chief of every service organization in each of the three cities’ EPBs interviewed because of various institutional constraints. At the same time, it took us a very long time to arrange interviews in Guangzhou with the latest one completed earlier this year. In order to get an adequate empirical basis for cross-jurisdiction comparison, we added Tianjin in our study and we conducted interviews of all Tianjin EPB’s service organizations in 2015 with help from the Center of Environmental Publicity and Education of the Ministry of Environmental Protection and additional funding support from PolyU. On the whole, we are satisfied with the results in regard to the interviews conducted. Given the richness of interview data and findings, we will able to produce two different sets of research papers, with one focusing on cross-jurisdiction analysis among these three cities (now, Chengdu, Guangzhou and Tianjin) concerning variations of reform approaches and institutional environments, while the other one focusing on the changes of service organization reform and institutional setting over time in Guangzhou. Two papers are now in the final stage of preparation, with one already presented in an international public management conference. Both will be sent out to top journals for review, with one targeted at Public Administration Review and the other one China Journal. We expect to take another two years to get all major findings published in the form of journal papers. To conclude our research experience in this project, we come to realize that it was very difficult to undertake research on service organization reform in China, particularly to interview the officer-in-charge of these service organizations. We were glad to get support from local academic institutions (Tsinghua University for arranging the interviews in Tianjin, Dalian University of Technology for arranging the interviews in Dalian, and Xian Jiaotong University for arranging the interviews in Chengdu) and respective municipal EPBs and their research academies. Finally we would like to thank UGC for their approval for us to use the project funding for obtaining research support from these academic and government institutions in the mainland China.

547611.label: Major findings and research outcome
547611.value: Based on transaction cost considerations, we have developed a conceptual framework of institutional choice in service organization reform in China, arguing that service organizations are more likely to become more independent from their sponsoring government agency if (1) they do not exercise public authority, (2) they provide services that are deemed to be non-essential, (3) there are alternative and reliable vendors, and (4) they have more market opportunities. We also argued that several political and contextual factors may affect the extent to which these transaction cost considerations are applied in actual reform efforts. In this research project, we test the robustness of our institutional choice framework by comparing service organizations reform in Chengdu and Guangzhou. Based on fieldwork and interviews with around ten service organizations in both cities between 2014 and 2016, our analysis shows that some service organizations in Guangzhou have indeed become more independent, following the transaction cost logic; but many have remained tied to the government, driven more by political considerations. In comparison with service organizations in Guangzhou, those in Chengdu have shown less progress toward reform, reflecting the latter’s less open social and political landscapes. Overall, our comparative study shows that the institutional choice framework developed we have developed can be used to explain service organization reform in China, identifies jurisdictional variation in service organization reform, and highlights the contextual constraints for streamlining and rationalizing the Chinese bureaucracy. This same the institutional choice framework has also been adopted to examine the changes of service organization reform in Guangzhou between 2006 and 2015. We found that three service organizations have undergone significant changes. First the enforcement team has been integrated to the administrative framework as part of an enforcement bureau in the provincial government since it exercises the public authority of law enforcement and dispensing penalties on violations. Second the Monitoring Station has now served exclusively for the Guangzhou EPB as its agent for collecting pollution data and monitoring enterprise pollution control performance, stopping from providing paid pollution monitoring services to enterprises since it provides services that are deemed to be essential to EPB. Third, the Guangzhou Academy of Environmental Science has also been asked to support GZEPB’s pollution control planning and research and its EIA (Environmental Impact Assessment) unit has been privatized since it has more market opportunities and at the same time to prevent any conflicts of interest in the EIA process.

547611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
547611.value: This project is one of the rare systematic efforts to conduct the study on the cross-city analysis of service organization reform in China and the reform changes over time. Indeed, the reform of service organizations is an urgent task for Chinese government given its critical impact on shape of government-market and government-society relations. We have developed a conceptual framework that connects contextual factors with institutional choice, based on transaction cost considerations, to capture geographical variations and longitudinal changes in the implementation of service organization reform in the environmental administrative system. Based on the interviews of leading officials of service organizations in the municipal EPBs of Guangzhou, Chengdu, Dalian and Tianjin, we test our framework and the findings suggest the need to contextualize the study of service organization reform in dynamic and diversified institutional settings. As the reform of service organizations in China has from being conclusive, it is strongly desirable to conduct another round of study a few years later on the EPB’s service organizations in these cities in order to provide further empirical support to our theoretical model of contextual changes and service organization reforms.

547611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
547611.value: This project examines the reform of service organizations in China’s environmental protection administration system with the focus on the changes of the reform practices over time at the local level and cross-jurisdiction variations. Specifically, it seeks to answer four questions: 1) How are service organizations changing in the context of broader governance reform? 2) How are service organizations changing in the context of broader governance reform? 3) How are service organizations changing in the context of broader governance reform? 4) How are service organizations changing in the context of broader governance reform? Both the cross-city comparative and longitudinal studies build on our earlier study of service organization reform in the Guangzhou Environmental Protection Bureau in 2007. It uses basically the same set of questions to extend the analysis of cross-sectional study to that of regional variations and temporal changes. In short, our project is the first serious attempt to study how service organization reform practices at the local level may be changing over time and how such changes are influenced by boarder institutional transformation. As a result, this study has advanced the boundary of current research on service organization reform which are predominated case-based and cross-sectional studies.

548111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
548111.value: Improper footwear design causes injuries and illnesses, and hence it is important to understand not only the foot but also the interaction between foot and footwear, namely footwear fit. A literature review has indicated that mostly static footwear fit has been studied to some extent, even though we are well aware that dynamic footwear fit is different. In addition to static fit, illnesses and injuries will occur due to dynamic pressure, friction, and foot movement beyond the normal range of motion. Therefore, more research is needed in dynamic footwear fit. In order to build a dynamic footwear fit model, knowledge of dynamic foot is a prerequisite. Currently foot scanner can capture the 3D foot shape, usually in static state. The dynamic foot capture system is still at research stage and not commercially available. In this proposal, the dynamic foot will be predicted based on static 3D foot shape and angular values of the foot movement in terms of plantar-flexion/dorsi-flexion; eversion/inversion; and adduction/abduction. The dynamic foot is generated by using multi-dimensional transformation of the 3D static foot based on the calculated angular values of the foot movement. The dynamic 3D foot shape will be validated with data from dynamic foot scanner researchers. In order to model dynamic fit, a model similar to NIOSH lifting equation will be used. The dynamic footwear fit (Df) will be calculated by computing static fit (Sf) and several multipliers. These multipliers will account for foot dynamics (Md); footwear style and design (Ms); footwear outsole design and material properties (Mo); footwear upper design and material properties (Mu); and a time factor (Mt). To determine the values and range of the multipliers, several experiments and tests will be carried out. After that a prediction model for the multipliers will be developed based on foot shape, shoe-last shape and material properties. Given that the proposed dynamic fit model is new, it will be time consuming to set all the limits of the multipliers for various material, footwear design and styles, and dynamic situation for different sports. It is expected that the results of this research will initiate more research in dynamic footwear fit to improve foot health and footwear performance. Footwear comfort is related to fit but also has psychological effects. This proposal mainly considers dynamic footwear fit since it is directly related to foot health. It is expected that better footwear fit will also improve footwear comfort. 不合理的鞋子設計會引起足部受傷和疾病；因此，我們不僅需要了解足部信息，還要探索足部與鞋子之間的相互作用（即鞋類適合度）。有文獻指出，儘管人們意識到鞋類在動態和靜態下的適合度是不同的，但目前絕大多數的研究從某種程度來說，都是針對鞋類靜態適合度的研究。即使鞋和腳在靜態時有很好的適合度，但在活動狀態下足部與鞋子之間的壓力、摩擦，以及足部的大量運動都有可能導致足部受傷和疾病。因此，針對鞋類在動態時的適合度，需要更多的研究。 為了建立鞋子動態適合度模型，首先要研究腳的動態活動情況。目前的足部掃描儀能夠得到的通常是靜態的足部三維形狀；而動態的足部掃描系統還處於研發階段，沒有商業化。這項研究將基於靜態的足部模型和運動時足部的各種角度信息來預測動態的足部三維形狀，其中這些信息包括：蹠屈/背屈、外翻/內翻和外展/內收等。然後，基於這些信息，通過對靜態足部模型作多維變形從而得到動態三維腳足部模型。 我們將通過從動態三維足部掃描儀所得到的數據驗證動態三維足部模型。一個類似NIOSH方程的模型將用來模擬動態適合度(Df)的研究。鞋的動態適合度將通過計算靜態適合度(Sf)和一系列參數得到。這些參數分別代表腳的力度(Md)；鞋的式樣 (Ms)；鞋大底的式樣和材質屬性(Mo)；鞋面的式樣和材質屬性(Mu)；以及時間因子(Mt)。這些系數和變化範圍將通過多次試驗和測試得到。最終，基於腳的模型、鞋楦模型和各種材質屬性，得到關於這些參數的動態足部模型。 本課題是一項全新的有關鞋類動態適合度模型的研究，針對鞋子的不同材質、式樣以及各種運動方式，在動態情況下確定相關參數及其閾值的工作需要大量的實驗時間。這項研究結果將在鞋子動態適合度方面做出重要貢獻，對於改善足部健康和鞋類性能有著深遠的意思。鑑於鞋子的舒適性不僅與鞋子適合度有關，還受人們心理因素的影響。本課題主要研究鞋子的動態舒適度，因為這不僅直接關係到足部健康，而且其研究結果能夠更好的改善鞋子的舒適性。

548111.label: Realisation of objectives
548111.value: Realization of objectives In general we have completed all the research work proposed in this study. Some papers are still under progress and it will be completed. This research provides a new venue for dynamic foot modeling and hence further research from different researchers will add new knowledge in this area. Experiments completed to realize the objectives Several experiments were completed to achieve the objectives. One of the main approaches was to obtain 3D foot scanned data using a Microsoft Kinect device. This is a low cost portable device. This was used for obtaining static foot shape and then modeling was done using programs written in matlab. Dynamic foot shape data was obtained first by generating static foot at different heel heights. The different heel heights were custom made platforms. Furthermore the different foot shape at different foot position is by simulation walking and also by having platforms with different plattarflexion-dorsiflexion angles; eversion and inversion angles and different heel heights. The foot dynamics was also obtained using motion capture system and markers. The foot dynamics can be modeled by deforming the static foot shape. The challenge was to accurately obtain the positions of the landmarks when using motion capture systems. As for material properties were evaluated based on thickness, weight, tensile strength, elongation, trouser tear, burst strength, colour fastness to crocking and UV test using appropriate standards. Different shoe styles were developed and tested in one experiment. Shoe design were based on several parameters (Topline, Heel, material, Toe type, Toe design, heel deign and platform height). Participants were used and subjective and objective methods were used to evaluate fit. Finally long term effect of wearing footwear was evaluated. There are numerous results from this research to support the idea that dynamic fit and comfort can be modeled. Further research is needed to build on the results. Validation of the dynamic foot model is based on the shoe design and long term study. 548111.label: Major findings and research outcome
548111.value: First mathematical model have been developed to model 3D feet very accurately (0.7mm). Then feet with different heel height were modeled. Generally, the error is around (3mm) when modeling for higher heel heights (70mm). In order to determine footwear fit, the inside shoe shape was obtained. Also a method to quantify fit using Cartesian distance between foot and shoe-last (or inside shoe shape) at different region was developed. Results have indicated that the Cartesian distance is different at different regions. Also the subjective fit rating at different region of shoe is different. Linear equations between subjective rating and objective regional error have been developed for different types of shoes (pointed, square, round). Once we know about foot shape and fit evaluation, different footwear materials were evaluated based on thickness, weight, tensile strength, elongation, trouser tear, burst strength, colour fastness to crocking and UV test using appropriate standards. Results indicate that footwear materials have wide variation and properties between different types. After the materials have been tested, experiment on shoe styles and its effect on comfort were carried out. Since many parameters in shoe design can influence comfort and fit, seven parameters (Topline, Heel, material, Toe type, Toe design, heel deign and platform height) were used to create a partial factorial design (7-3) with 16 shoe designs. Main effect analysis show that high topline, low heel height, soft material, round toe, open toe, open heel and then platform are better for comfort and fit. This is similar for left and right foot. Long term dynamic comfort and fit was evaluated. In most cases there is no difference between left and right foot. There are no subjective difference in overall length and overall width between morning and afternoon; however there are perceived subjective difference in overall comfort, overall fit, upper comfort, ball width (p =0.065), ball width, toe box, and shoe sole. The long term footwear fit and comfort is dependent on shoe style and number of days the shoe is worn. The range of the perceived overall length is 0.09, but the range of the perceived overall width is 0.16, perceived overall comfort is 0.15, and perceived overall fit is 0.41. Generally, perceived fit improves with time. There are numerous results from this research to support the idea that dynamic fit and comfort can be modeled. Further research is needed to build on the results.

548111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
548111.value: We have proved that footwear fit tolerance at different region of foot is different. It has to be seen how the use of different materials with different properties can be used to provide different level of pressure over the foot surface, in order to create better comport and fit sensation. Foot shape for different heel height and dynamics has been modeled, but still more can be done to improve the modeling. The data on dynamic foot shape, obtained from dynamic foot scanner (provided by our collaborators) has lots of errors; hence new methods need to be considered for dynamic foot scanning. Dynamic and long term footwear fit is not same as static footwear fit. This research is a new step in this direction, however much more research has to be done to have a better understanding of foot anatomy, foot dynamic, materials, footwear styles, and its influence on footwear fit and comfort. The results have indicated that fit and comfort are different. Even though the shoe may fit well, the comfort may be bad, therefore more dimensions of comfort (static and dynamic) have to be studied.

548111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
548111.value: Footwear has become an integral part of our daily life. In mass produced shoes, in order to reduce manufacturing costs few sizes are manufactured to fit a large population. Footwear comfort and fit (F&C) hence is a major problem. In retail shops, during shoe purchase, shoes are worn to evaluate F&C in a very short time (static F&C or short time F&C). When the shoe is worn for longer time, it can be noticed that the fit is no longer the same. We can call this dynamic F&C or long term F&C. Every new shoe requires sometime before it can become relatively comfortable. This time normally known as break-in time will influence whether the shoe will be worn further or discarded. Long term F&C is influenced by the foot shape (not only length and width), upper and sole materials and footwear design. There is a need to develop products that will have short term as well as long term F&C within some acceptable ranges. In addition to long term dynamic foot, the footwear fit and comfort becomes worst from morning to afternoon as the foot swells. This has to be considered during footwear design.
