549211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
549211.value: 社會企業（社企）是使用商業方法應對多種社會問題的非牟利組織。社企在提供社會價值方面的重要性隨着三類傳統部門各自的限制具體化而逐漸提高。這三類部門就是：政府機構（例如削減資源）、傳統商業機構（例如缺乏責任心）、非政府機構（例如效率偏低和依靠捐獻）。社企的市場導向方案獲得公認為能夠通過改善社會結構和經濟發展，真正而直接地改善處於全球收入金字塔底層者的生活質量。由於經濟交易內嵌於社會互動之中，這些效益的核心就是社會資本機制。 社會資本在企業活動開展和成功的每個階段都扮演着重要的角色，提供一個可以透視社企如何創造社會價值的機制。然而，由於有關社企產生社會效益的評估不多，我們並不知悉社企在強化社會資本方面的角色。社企因為獲得收入，角色一向被推廣為正面的，但我們的試驗研究結果顯示，社企對於社會資本有可能產生負面作用，比如將手段工具的因素加入到現存的社會關係中，因此，我們擬進行全面的研究，以確定我們觀察所得是不尋常現象，抑或這種作用其實比觀察中更加明顯。我們也希望探討可能構成社企獲得收入對社會資本產生正面／負面作用的各種緩和因素。 要解答上述問題並不容易，原因是社企跟營利企業不同。社企的成功不能以利潤和市場佔有率來衡量。當大多數的微型貸款項目都誇耀還款率，其他社企又標榜受益人收入水平提高，作為成功里程碑的時候，這似乎成為了主流的評估方法。一些學者曾經指出，這些項目的成功應該以社會價值的增加來衡量。社會凝聚力、社會互動、集體行動，其實都是社會資本的體現。社企與社會資本之間的連繫又因為社會資本涉及多元觀點而變得更加複雜。每一個觀點都可能構成關於社會關係和互動結構機制的一種演繹。 經參考文獻，我們識別出關於社會資本的四種觀點：社會結構觀點、社群主義觀點、個體中心網絡（結構洞）觀點、批判觀點。我們的初步試驗研究結果顯示，農村環境的社會互動可以從多元觀點的社會資本來考慮，而個別社企的效益就視乎項目如何推行，以及從哪個社會資本觀點來衡量社會效益。 我們建議使用綜合方法，從多個社會資本觀點深入社企的效益。這項研究將會在中國和印度進行，目的在於探討社企會否和何時促進互相衝突和非互相衝突的社會資本效益。我們預期這項研究對於實際做法有重要的意義。社會企業家十分需要關於如何最好地設立和經營社企的信息。到底他們應該完全集中於獲得收入的問題（希望社會問題會得到處理），還是應該明確地集中於社會問題？他們應該集中於個人層面的社會效益？還是應該關注到群體／社群層面的社會效益？這項研究可以讓大家更加瞭解社企的社會效益，同時有助於提出有所根據的建議。

549211.label: Major findings and research outcome
549211.value: The insights provided by our qualitative study lead us to make several predictions. As a main effect, we propose that different types of network ties exert very different influences on the likelihood of institutional entrepreneurship. Homophilic ties, rooted in kinship or shared history, often exert a highly constraining force upon individuals to refrain from engaging in behavior that contradicts existing norms. Comparatively, heterophilic ties, being much more diverse in nature, exert an enabling force that encourages individuals to engage in activities that represent social change. However, the patterns within our data also suggest a high degree of dynamism. More specifically, because most social networks consist of both homophilic and heterophilic ties, our study suggests three important contingencies to predict when such opposing forces will ultimately lead to instances of institutional entrepreneurship: (1) tie frequency; (2) the sequencing of tie contact, and; (3) the prevailing social norms in which tie contact takes place. Our study contributes to theory on institutional entrepreneurship by applying a network lens to better understand the early-stage process of institutional change, and to help further explain why some ‘deviant’ ideas are acted upon by individuals while others are not. We also contribute directly to theory on social networks by highlighting the path dependency of different types of network ties on changing individual behavior. Finally, our study suggests a number of practical implications for social entrepreneurs specifically, and institutional entrepreneurs more generally, as they attempt to navigate the complex set of supportive and unsupportive forces in their environment.

549211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
549211.value: Various proposition that we made in this study, based on our qualitative research, can now be tested using a large scale quantitative study. These propositions are: P1a: Different types of network ties will significantly affect the likelihood of institutional entrepreneurship. Specifically, homophilic ties will have a constraining effect and heterophilic ties an enabling effect. P1b: The extent to which different types of ties affect the likelihood of institutional entrepreneurship is dependent upon tie frequency. Specifically, both frequent and infrequent homophilic ties will have a relatively uniform constraining effect while frequent heterophilic ties will be largely enabling and infrequent heterophilic ties largely indifferent. P2: The extent to which different types of ties affect the likelihood of institutional entrepreneurship is dependent upon tie sequencing. Specifically, instances in which contact with homophilic ties precedes that with heterophilic ties will be less likely to result in institutional entrepreneurship than instances in which contact with heterophilic ties precedes that with homophilic ties.

549211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
549211.value: While the past decade has produced a number of insights into the process of institutional change, scholars still lack a comprehensive understanding of the germinal stages of institutional entrepreneurship. More specifically, further knowledge is needed into what factors cause certain individuals to initiate norm-breaking behavior while others continue to adhere to societal expectations. Prior work seeking to inform this question has focused either on individual-level or environmental-level explanations. Comparatively, we employ a social network perspective as a ‘meso-level’ lens into the space where actors and their environment intersect. Based upon our qualitative findings, we propose that social ties can serve as an important factor in enabling (heterophilic ties) as well as constraining (homophilic ties) institutional change. However, our data also suggest that these network forces are highly dynamic and contingent upon tie frequency, the sequencing of tie contact, and the prevailing social norms in which tie contact takes place.

Do any of a), b), and d) above differ systematically among transient, quasi-indexing or dedicated institutions due to their different investment horizon and strategy?

549511.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
549511.value: Stock market’s response to earnings announcements, measured by the absolute or squared abnormal stock returns or abnormal trading volume around the announcement dates, has progressively been increasing over time (Landsman and Maydew 2002). This evidence is intriguing, and has generated a debate amongst researchers as to what causes it and how to interpret it. In this paper, we contribute to this debate and examine whether changing investor composition over time is associated with the over-time increase in the stock price reaction to the earnings announcements. We are motivated by recent papers that document that in recent decades (i) individual investors have been supplanted by institutions (Gompers and Metrick 2001; Stein 2009), and (ii) transient investors, most notably hedge funds, have grown in importance and size within the institutional landscape (Stein 2009). We hypothesize that the shift in the “representative” investor from individuals to institutional investors and hedge funds has contributed to the increasing stock market response to earnings announcements over time. Specifically, we identify and test for indirect as well as direct channels that could drive this relationship. Greater institutional dominance could indirectly increase stock price sensitivity to earnings announcements by improving the monitoring of corporate managers (Chen et al 2007), thereby increasing the quality of the reported earnings (Chung et al. 2002) and/or increasing the amount of the concurrent disclosure. Alternatively, greater institutional holding can directly increase the stock market sensitivity to the reported earnings by lowering the short-sale constraints (Berkman et al. 2009) and/or because institutions are more sophisticated investors than individual investors (Mikhail et al. 2007), who not only have better access to information but also possess superior ability to interpret and trade on value-relevant information such as earnings. Our study is perhaps the first that examines how a significant over-time change within capital market—the institutionalization of the investors—influences the relation between accounting information and stock market parameters. In particular, we provide insights into the debate as to whether or not the over-time increase in stock market response to earnings necessarily imply an increase in the “informative” of earnings over time in the sense that the reported accounting information provides increasingly better or/and more precise information about future firm fundamentals.

549511.label: Realisation of objectives
549511.value: We show a) an increase in institutional ownership and b) an upward trend in the stock market response to earnings announcement proxied by both return volatility and trading volume, and c) an association between institutional ownership and stock market response to earnings announcement. In the above test, we control for other value-relevant disclosure (proxied by analysts forecast revisions) and the informativeness of earnings for future earnings. We find some evidence that transient vs. dedicated institutions are differently associated with the market response to earnings announcements. We wrote up the results in a working paper which was posted on SSRN (http://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1946605). However, we are not able to convince reviewers that the association we document can be interpreted as causality. Also, since we cannot pin-down the channel through which increased institutional ownership increase market response to earnings announcements, we were not able to successfully publish the paper. We do not think these issues can be remedied using the current research design and dataset. For example, if we believe that the increase in other relevant disclosure is the underlined reason, our current proxy (analyst forecast revision around earnings announcement) is not sufficient and we probably need to use factiva news database to identify all other disclosure issued by the firms. More importanlty, even if we do so, this finding would not be innovate enough and contribute to our knowledge beyond what Francis et al. (2002b) have documented. We then decompose the earnings into cash flow earnings and accruals earnings and ask the question whether transient (short-term) institutions exacerbate or alleviate the mispricing related to accruals. We find robust evidence that short-term shareholders exacerbate the accruals mispricing, specifically, for stocks predominantly owned by short term shareholders, high (low) accrual stocks are more over- (under-) valued than stocks. We wrote up a working paper which is under review at the moment. Therefore for the research output, we report this paper instead.

549511.label: Major findings and research outcome
549511.value: We document that the proportion of short-horizon investors among the shareholders of a firm is positively associated with the accruals-related mispricing of the stock. Specifically, among the high (low) accruals stocks, those that are disproportionally owned by short-horizon investors become more overvalued (undervalued) than the other stocks. We identify the following two reasons as the likely explanations of our results: the payoff of an accruals-related strategy accrues over a longer horizon and an accruals-based strategy requires ‘contrarian’ bets. We further document this relation is especially pronounced during periods of high VIX, when short-horizon investors face greater market uncertainty and risk management constraint.

549511.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
549511.value: The current working paper is under review. We plan to continue our effort in publishing this work.

549511.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
549511.value: Researchers have long debated the source of the accruals anomaly (that is, high (low) accrual stocks experience negative (positive) abnormal returns in the subsequent period). Its behavioral explanation attributes it to investors’ fixation on earnings and their limited attention to the accruals and cash flow components of earnings. The key finding of this paper is that the proportion of short-horizon investors among the shareholders of a firm exacerbates the accruals-related mispricing of the stock. Overall, the link between shareholder composition and the accruals anomaly that we document appears to be more consistent with the behavioral view, rather than the risk-based explanation, of the anomaly. Our findings also suggest that investors should consider the ownership of short-horizon investors in conjunction with stocks’ accrual magnitude in devising accruals-based trading strategies.

549811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
549811.value: 黃子華是香港娛樂事業的著名藝人，在電視、電影、電臺和舞臺表演各方面都有發展，然而最受歡迎的相信還是他的棟篤笑表演。棟篤笑成功地引進香港，黃子華功不可抹。在1990年代初，廣東話棟篤笑竹簡稱為香港的一種藝術形式，而黃子華的名字亦視為棟篤笑的同義詞。黃氏自覺地把自己對社會、政治的關注融入棟篤笑。此舉不但發掘此一藝術形式的多樣性，同時為表演加添歷史感。故此，黃氏在香港及世界其他廣東話地區廣受歡迎。 此項研究分兩部份探討廣東話棟篤笑。首部份關於棟篤笑引進香港文化場景時所產生的混成過程（hybridization）。廣東話棟篤笑與英語地區的具有明顯差別。後者偏向即興：在小小的場地（如酒吧），只拿一支麥克風、幾件道具就可表演。相反，香港的廣東話棟篤笑已發展為大型的娛樂製作。參與其中的除了藝人，還有一眾技術與藝術人員。而面對上千的觀眾，廣東話棟篤笑還得尋找其他與觀眾交流情感的方法。 次部分討論歷史認知與喜劇想像（comic vision）的相互聯繫。棟篤笑於香港興起，正值大眾論述享有空前未有的開放的意識形態之時。此不但見於演出的基調，而且見於題材的選擇和演繹。舉例而言，黃子華很多的笑話都是建基於他對香港歷史的獨特見解。近二十年，香港經歷各種變化，黃氏的喜劇想像亦然。此研究亦將企圖解答歷史與藝術之間的動態關係。

549811.label: Realisation of objectives
549811.value: This project has fulfilled in full the first two objectives of presenting two papers at international conferences. The first paper examines the adaptation and the hybridization of the standup art in Wong Tze-wah, as exemplified in his interlingual jokes as well as the transformation of the form in his hand. The second paper deals with Wong’s blending of historical and artistic vision into his particular brand of political satire. The third objective of revising the two papers in publishable articles has also been realized. The first article has already been published, while the second will appear in Interdisciplinary approaches to Political Humor in China, a book to be published by Springer, Asia in 2016. In addition, the PI is at present co-writing with Professor Sharon Wesoky an introduction to the book, in which he will include a discussion of Wong’s role as a participant in the political discussion of the 1990s and 2000s in Hong Kong. Groudwork has been laid – as stated in Objective 4 – for a study of i) standup comedy in Hong Kong and ii) Wong’s contributions to Hong Kong culture in his entertainment career as a film and TV star. In relation to i) he PI has also produced an article discussing both Cantonese and English standup comedy in Hong Kong. The article, entitled “Hong Kong-style and American-style: The Performance Context of Standup Comedy in Hong Kong,” was submitted to Journal of Popular Culture, but was unfortunately declined for publication. The PI is now revising it, and will submit it to another journal for publication when it is ready. In relation to ii), the book mentioned above, Interdisciplinary Approaches, will allude to Wong’s other accomplishments. The PI had envisioned a closer relationship with Wong in the beginning of the project. At first, Wong was responsive to the PI’s approaches, but soon his busy work schedule made it impossible for him to involve in the project. It would appear that Wong, like many artists, is disinclined to discuss his work, perhaps from a suspicion that scholarly analysis is anathema to artistic creativity.

549811.value: The research outcome of this project consists of the following: 1. Article: 香港口語表演藝術的語言特色： 棟篤笑的雙語幽默。《新亞學報》31卷。 2013年6月。頁 471-488 2. Paper:“Political Jokes, Caricatures and Satire in Wong Tze-wah Standup Comedy” at International Conference: Political Humor in Modern China, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, December 10-11, 2013. 3. The above paper has been revised to an article. It will be published, together with an Introduction co-written by the PI and Professor Sharon Wesoky, in Interdisciplinary Approaches to Political Humor in China, Springer, forthcoming in 2016. The article, the conference paper as well as the Springer book contract can be found in Part C Research Output. The PI is now also revising the article “Hong Kong-style and American-style: The performance Context of Standup Comedy in Hong Kong” for publication.

549811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
549811.value: Wong Tze-wah’s standup comedy came into being as part of the unusually open political and cultural atmosphere of the late 1980s and early 1990s. This project has focused on matters inherent in the artistic form, even as it relates them to larger issues of political satire and the use of language. More can be done to contextualize Wong Tze-wah in the overall picture of popular culture on the one hand, and the role such popular cultural form could play in the cultural discourses of the times on the other. Wong declared that there is a turn away from politics in his work after 1997, even though he seemed to return to it with a vengeance in his latest performance that came at the same time as the “umbrella movement” in 2014. Nevertheless, the fact remains that his comments on social mores also deserves a fuller study than what this project can provide. These are two possible directions for further development. Even though they lie outside the scope of the present project, the PI will attempt to incorporate them in his future studies.

549811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
549811.value: This project has produced two articles on the study of Wong Tze-wah’s standup comedy. A book, which includes a chapter that discusses Wong in his role as a political satirist, is under preparation. Wong is a prominent figure in the entertainment industry in Hong Kong and in Chinese communities in other places in the world, with an active career not only in standup comedy but also in film and TV acting. What prove particularly popular with Wong’s standup comedy are his deft use of language and his unique brand of political satire informed by his idiosyncratic view of Hong Kong history. These two articles mentioned above have examined these two aspects of Wong’s work, while the book, Interdisciplinary Approaches to Political Humor in China, considers Wong together with other works of political humor in the twentieth century. Together, the articles and the book represent the first serious look at this new form of entertainment in Hong Kong.

550611.label: Project Title(Chinese)
550611.value: 行業集中度與安達信會計師事務所破產事件在核數行業中的全球效應

550611.label: Co - Investigator(s)
550611.value: Prof Cheng, Louis T W Dr Leung, Tak Yan

550611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
550611.value: Accounting literature has documented substantial evidence on the effects of Arthur Andersen’s (AA) bankruptcy. Earlier research on bankruptcy mainly demonstrates a negative stock price or “contagion” effect (Warner 1977). In this project, we focus on the issue of forced auditor switches of former AA audit clients globally. Lang and Stulz (1992) show a positive stock price effect for surviving firms during bankruptcy announcements for highly concentrated industries. Consequently, we propose to employ an industry concentration measure (i.e., Herfindahl (H) index) to model the competition between the Big-4 and Non-Big-4 audit services upon the AA failure. If the audit service market in a given country is less oligopolistic, the non-Big-4 auditors can better compete with the Big-4 counterparts, leading to a higher defection of former AA auditees to Non-Big-4 auditors (downward audit switch). Our initial data screening results in 42 countries with sufficient number of AA clients. The large variation of the Big-5 H-index among countries right before AA’s failure (2.8 for India and 7240 for Spain) reveals that the competition between Big-4 and Non-Big-4 groups differs substantially. Based on the contagion effect argument, we first expect that AA’s bankruptcy creates a greater reputational damage (contagion) and therefore a stronger negative effect to the business of Big-4 relative to Non-Big-4 auditors across all countries. However, how much AA’s auditing business would be captured by the Non-Big-4 group would depend on how competitive these smaller auditors are. We conjecture that the lower the concentration of the auditing industry in a given country (measured by the H index of the Big-5 before AA’s bankruptcy), the stronger the competitiveness of the Non-Big-4 auditors in terms of audit quality, capacity, and track record should be. These competitiveness features would translate into stronger ability to compete for former AA clients in low-concentration countries. In short, we hypothesize that when the oligopolistic power of the Big-4 in a given country is weak, the Non-Big-4 group is able to capture more audit business (downward switches) from former AA clients due to contagion. In addition, we also evaluate the relative performance of the former AA clients choosing Big-4 (lateral switch) relative to Non-Big-4 auditors (downward switch) globally. Such a comparison would shed light on how auditor choice of former AA clients may be related to firm level performance and industry concentration. 大量會計文獻表明，安達信會計師事務所（AA）破產造成了各種影響。早期的研究主要證明了股票價格所受到的負面影響或者“傳染效應”（Warner 1977）。在本課題中，我們側重於全球範圍內前AA客戶被迫更改核數師的問題。Lang和Stulz（1992）顯示對於在高度集中的行業中破產事件后仍然存活的公司，其股票價格可有積極表現。因此，我們提出使用行業集中度衡量（即赫芬達爾/Herfindahl（H）指數）對AA破產后四大與非四大會計師事務所之間的競爭進行建模。 如果某國的審計服務市場寡頭壟斷情況較少，那麼非四大審計人員可以更好地與四大審計人員進行競爭，從而導致了更多前AA審計客戶流向非四大核數師（向下審計變換）。我們首輪的數據篩選檢查了分佈在42個國家的大量AA客戶。AA破產前，不同國家之間的五大H指數存在較大差異（印度2.8，西班牙7240），顯示四大與非四大之間的競爭情況也有明顯的差異。 根據傳染效應的說法，我們起初認為整體而言，四大相對非四大在AA破產事件中受到更多的聲望上的損失（傳染），進而所受到的負面影響更為嚴重。然而，非四大能贏得的原AA的市場份額取決於這些小型事務所的競爭力。我們猜想，若某國的審計行業集中度較低（用AA破產前的五大H指數來判斷），則非四大事務所的競爭力將較強，而競爭力可表現為審計質量，業務容量，業績記錄等。在低集中度的國家里，這些競爭特徵將可轉化為爭奪前AA客戶時的優勢。總之，我們推測，當某國四大的寡頭力量薄弱時，由於傳染效應非四大事務所能夠獲得更多的前AA客戶（向下變換）。 此外，我們還評估了全世界範圍內選擇四大（橫向變換）與非四大（向下變換）的前AA客戶的業績表現。這樣的比較可以啟示我們，在前AA客戶對核數師的選擇與企業業績表現和興業集中度之間可能存在某種聯繫。

551011.label: Project Title(Chinese)
551011.value: 多级供应链中的外包, 谈判和产能决策

551011.label: Project Objectives
551011.value: To model the price negotiation process as a GNB scheme under both control and delegation outsourcing structures, derive the negotiation-induced contract manufacturing costs and component purchasing costs and explore which outsourcing structure leads to cost savings for the OEM/CM. Later we will extend it to other negotiation processes. To explore how the relative bargaining powers of the OEM, CM and supplier affect the negotiation-characterized wholesale prices and answer the question of whether a powerful OEM should control the procurement function in-house, whereas a smaller one should delegate it to a powerful CM. To investigate the role played by quantity commitment in outsourcing by comparing two inventory/capacity risk mechanisms, i.e., pull versus push, and identify the conditions under which the OEM should order in advance and make a quantity commitment by considering such parameters as the market demand distribution, the capacity installation costs of the CM and the supplier, and the distribution of the bargaining powers. To gain the understanding of the capacity-building incentives of the CM and the supplier under both control and delegation outsourcing structures, and derive the equilibrium capacities of the CM and the supplier. Based on these equilibrium capacities, to investigate the inventory availability of the supplier’s components, as the inventory availability of key components is a critical issue in ensuring the smooth production in the outsourcing context. Based on the foregoing analysis, to provide advice and suggestions to industrial practitioners on the outsourcing manufacturing and/or procurement functions, such as when the OEM needs to make an advance purchase and when it can delegate the procurement function to a third party.

Based on the foregoing analysis, to provide advice and suggestions to industrial practitioners on the outsourcing manufacturing and/or procurement functions, such as when the OEM needs to make an advance purchase and when it can delegate the procurement function to a third party.

551011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
551011.value: The growing global economy has facilitated China to become “the world’s factory”. With over 70 % of Chinese manufacturers in the electronics industry involved in the contract manufacturing business, studies on outsourcing, in particular, contract manufacturing, are very important for China and can also contribute to the academic society. Outsoucing production to a contract manufacturer (CM) raises a lot of questions: (1) How shall wholesale prices be negotiated? (2) How large shall the CM set up its capacity? (3) How much shall the OEM order? (4) When shall the OEM order, before demand realization or after it? (5) Shall the function of the procurement of raw materials/components be outsourced to the CM? Answering these questions is not easy as a supply chain usually consists of multiple parties and each party has its own incentives and objectives which may not be aligned with the system optimal requirement. In the project proposed herein, we will study the above questions by adopting a comprehensive approach which combines the wholesale price bargaining with newsvendor-type quantity decision. We investigate a serial multi-tier supply chain comprising an OEM, a CM and a supplier where the OEM outsources all manufacturing activities to the CM. We consider two outsourcing structures, control and delegation. Under the former, the OEM contracts with the CM and the supplier directly; under the latter, the OEM contracts with the CM, and the CM subcontracts with the supplier. We also consider two types of contracts regarding different order timings: push and pull. Under a push contract, both price negotiation and quantity ordering occur before demand realization, whereas under a pull contract, they occur after it. The type of contract directly affects capacity-building decisions of the CM and the supplier. In summary, we consider four scenarios formed by the different combinations of outsourcing structures and order timings. Under each scenario, we will derive the negotiation-induced wholesale prices, the equilibrium ordering decision for the OEM and the capacity decisions for the CM and supplier. These outcomes will directly answer questions (1)-(3). We will then conduct a comparison of game outcomes along two dimensions. By comparing results under push and pull contracts, we can answer question (4), and by comparing those under control and delegation, we can answer question (5).

551011.label: Realisation of objectives
551011.value: There are different ways that the companies bargain with their business partners in their outsourcing. One common way is the one-short bargaining where one party has the full bargaining power (such as Walmart) while the other party (such as the small suppliers in the developing countries) just takes the contract as it is or rejects the contract. The other common way is that the firms cooperatively bargain and negotiate over their business trade and the outcome is often illustrated via the Nash bargaining concept. In this project, I considered both. For the former, we considered the outsourcing contracting via pull and push contracts (outsource before or after the market demand realization) and for the latter we adopted the generalized Nash bargaining scheme. And we correspondingly generated two papers. For both papers, we investigate a three-tier supply chain comprising an original equipment manufacturer (OEM), a contract manufacturer (CM), and a supplier. There exist two typical outsourcing structures: control and delegation. Under the control structure, the OEM contracts with the CM and the supplier respectively. Under the delegation structure, the OEM contracts with the CM only and the CM subcontracts with the supplier. We derived corresponding equilibrium wholesale prices, order quantities, and capacities and compared the system performances. We then identified conditions under which delegation or control is preferred by each party. Such conditions can facilitate the industrial practitioners to make decisions regarding outsourcing manufacturing and/or procurement function. We find that the equilibrium production quantity is higher under control than under delegation for the push contract whereas the reverse holds for the pull contract. Both the OEM and the CM prefer control over delegation under the push contract. However, under the pull contract, the OEM prefers control over delegation whereas the CM and the supplier prefer delegation over control. We also show that for a given outsourcing structure, the OEM prefers the pull contract over the push contract. When the three parties negotiate, assuming that the intermediary party decides who to contract with first, we obtain a chain rule that determines the parties' procurement outsourcing preferences when they negotiate over both wholesale prices and ordering quantity. When they negotiate on wholesale prices only, we show that bilateral contract negotiation over price could not coordinate the supply chain, and the parties' procurement outsourcing preferences depend on their negotiation powers in a more complex way.

551011.label: Major findings and research outcome
551011.value: Outsourcing has been a prominent phenomenon in the business world due to the advance of information technology and transportation means. Which outsourcing structure to adopt and which contracting form to use are very important decisions that the supply chain managers need to make. In this project, we considered two business realities over outsourcing bargaining: the one-shot ultimatum game, in which one party has full bargaining power and makes a take-it-or-leave-it offer; and the cooperative negotiation game where the bargaining power is allocated among the parties. We then generated two papers. For the first reality, we studied two common contracts in outsourcing, pull and push contracts. We investigated how these two different contracts affect the outsourcing preferences of the OEM, CM and supplier. The paper generated "The Comparison of Two Vertical Outsourcing Structures under Push and Pull Contracts" has been accepted and published by the Production and Operations Managements (POM), a prestigious UT-Dallas business school journal. For the second common way, we study the generalized Nash bargaining among the three business partners, the OEM, the CM and the supplier. The study has been presented in the different international conferences with the conference proceedings, such as MSOM 2012 proceeding and APDSI 2013 (proceeding website: http://gebrc.nccu.edu.tw/proceedings/APDSI/2013/proc/P130114003.pdf). The outcome of this cooperative Nash bargaining case, titled "Bilateral Bargaining and Outsourcing Strategies in a Three-Tier Supply Chain" has gone through three rounds of major revision with Production and Operations Management (POM). Unfortunately, at the end of the third revision and the resubmission, out of three reviewers, although two reviewers had recommended acceptance, one reviewer still recommended rejection. The result was negative and the paper was eventually rejected by the POM. We were very disappointed by this review result and we do not agree with the opinion of the third negative reviewer. We think we do make substantial contribution to the outsourcing literature by studying a representative triad outsourcing supply chain. We re-think carefully over the business background we investigate and the corresponding model setting. We now reposition our research outcome of the bargaining framework under the service sourcing literature. We have finished the wrap-up of this repositioned paper and submitted it to the journal Manufacturing and Service Operations Management (M&SOM), another flagship business-school journal for the consideration of the publication (manuscript ID: MSOM-15-094).

551011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
551011.value: For the ongoing second research paper (which is now under review of the M&SOM, manuscript ID: MSOM-15-094), we have repositioned our research outcome, that is, the bargaining framework under the service sourcing literature. We now consider the motivating example from procurement outsourcing. Whether to outsource procurement is a tough decision to make: on the one hand, procurement outsourcing may help buyers reduce costs and improve efficiency; on the other hand, procurement, as one of the few fundamental functions that support a company's other functions, directly affects the company's performance and thus buyers need to seriously consider whether to outsource this function or keep it inhouse, especially when how to contract on procurement outsourcing and allocate the profit gains are unclear. In the new positioning of our study, we focus on studying how the contract form (terms to contract on) affects the procurement outsourcing decisions. Specifically, we consider the following two contract forms over "which terms to contract on": (1) contracting on both wholesale prices and ordering quantity, and (2) contracting on the wholesale prices only. We are now waiting for the feedback of the review team. We will further revise this manuscript after we receive the feedback from the review team.

551011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
551011.value: In outsourcing, some OEMs adopt pull contract, placing orders during the selling season, and upstream CMs and suppliers have to bear all inventory risk. Other OEMs ease the uncertainty of CMs and suppliers by adopting push contract, sourcing before the selling season. In this project, we find that under push contract both the OEM and the CM prefer letting the OEM source directly from the supplier. However, under pull contract, the OEM prefers sourcing from the supplier itself whereas the CM and supplier prefer letting the CM source from the supplier. This provides the guidance to the OEM over which outsourcing structure to adopt under a given contract. Also in outsourcing, companies that rely on procurement agent for procurement services believe that the purchasing agent can negotiate better terms with the supplier and thus help improve their performances. However, buyers such as Zara and Wal-Mart planned to terminate their procurement contracts. What is the reason behind? In this project, we identify a chain rule over the bargaining power relationship that determines the parties' procurement outsourcing preferences. Such chain rule gives a quantitative measure facilitating buyers' decision-making over whether to use the service of procurement agents such as Li & Fung.

553011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
553011.value: Defined as an individual’s ability to control own and others’ resources (Galinsky, Fruenfeld, and Magee, 2003), power is a force that touches on most social interactions. For instance, individuals are likely to feel powerless when meeting with bosses, but powerful when giving advice. However, the experience of power can also be activated in non-social contexts. For instance, the provision of choices can increase an individual’s sense of environmental control and lead to an evaluated state of power (Deci and Ryan, 1987; Snibbe and Markus, 2005). The proposed project will investigate the influences of power on consumers’ decision making. Drawing on the approach and inhibition framework proposed by Keltner, Gruenfeld, and Anderson (2003), we will argue that the possession of power, which activates a general tendency to pursue and obtain rewards, propels consumers to change their status quo and increases their tendencies to make choices. We also propose that the effect of power on consumer choice is mitigated when the perceived controllability of the choice task is high. When the controllability is high, both powerful and powerless individuals show the same tendencies to change their status quo or make more choices, because they predict that the decision outcome will lead to power elevation or retention. Most prior research on the effect of power is mainly focused on social behavior. The consequences of power on consumer decision making is largely overlooked in the literature. Our proposed research is among the first to investigate how power influences consumer tendencies to change their status quo and to make more (vs. less) choices. Moreover, exploring moderating factors for the effect of power can help us better predict under what conditions the effect is more likely to be evident. In terms of managerial implications, understanding the effect of power on consumer decision making will help marketers better understand their target consumers and communicate with them in a more effective way. We will test our hypotheses using data involving both hypothetical choice tasks and real consumer choice. 权力是指一个人对自己和他人所使用的资源的控制能力。权力涉及社会交往的方方面面。例如，一个人和老板在一起时可能会觉得很弱势，没有权力；但同一个人又可能在给别人提供建议时感到自己有权力。不过，权力并不局限于社交场合。研究发现当人们在做自主选择的时候，会感到对周围的环境有更大的控制力，从而有更强烈的权力感。 我们这个课题研究权力对消费者决策的影响。在Keltner, Gruenfeld, 和Anderson（2003）提出的模型基础上，我们提出权力会促使消费者去追求新的利益，从而使消费者更愿意改变现状，做出变化。 我们又提出权力对决策的影响还取决于消费者对所面临决策的主观控制能力。当消费者认为自己对决策的结果可以较好地控制时，权力对决策的影响会减弱。权力小的消费者群体也同样愿意作出改变，因为改变本身可以让决策者觉得自己有更强的控制力，即更有权力。 目前，大多数有关权力的研究主要集中于社会行为。对权力和消费者行为的文献还很有限。我们这个课题是迄今为止第一个调查权力对消费者改变现状意愿的研究。同时，对其他因素的调查将有助于更好地预测在哪些情况下权力对消费者的影响更加显著。对营销实践而言，了解权利对消费者决策的影响将有利于更好地了解目标市场以及与目标市场进行更有效的沟通。

553011.label: Realisation of objectives
553011.value: Objective 1 has been achieved. We have found that when consumers feel more powerful, they are more likely to exhibit switching behavior, such as switching to a new brand or a new flavor. In other words, heighted power status increases a consumer's tendency to change her status quo. Evidence also suggested that power may cause consumers to favor the option with more choices (Objective 2). Moreover, we have found that power influences consumer switching behavior because power activates a tendency to take actions, and in most cases a switching option is associated with greater action. This revealed mechanism addresses Objective 3 and explains why power has an influence on switching behavior.

553011.label: Major findings and research outcome
553011.value: We have found that incidentally heightened states of power influences consumer switching behavior. Placing consumers in a high state of power leads to a greater propensity to engage in product/brand switching in a variety of contexts. Moreover, the effect of power on switching was mediated by power-activated action orientation. We made a journal publication and a conference presentation based on these research findings (please refer to Part C).

553011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
553011.value: In our studies, we used both psychological act (the decision to switch to a new brand) and physical act (squeezing a rubber ball for 30 seconds). Future research needs to better identify the difference between the two acts. For instance, would the amount of action involved in making a mental decision be enough to foster a sense of greater action than a physical action? Another interesting topic for future research is whether or not we would observe repeated switching, as opposed to one-time switching, with real behavior. That is, if a consumer engages in actual physical action, this may sate their need to switch, rendering it hard to find repeated switching behavior when real action occurs. Although this is a possibility, repeated switching may also occur. Again, we need to have a better understanding of how strong the desire to act that power can activate, and the amount of action needed to satisfy the desire.

553011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
553011.value: This project focuses on how status of power influences consumer switching behavior. Because high power is associated with a readiness to act, and switching behavior often requires taking action in some form, inducing consumers to feel powerful can increase consumer switching. This project contributes to the consumer switching literature by demonstrating power as a new psychological catalyst for switching behavior. This work also adds to the power literature by demonstrating that power activates action-taking as a goal. In other words, power does not create a desire for action that rolls down the hill building momentum like a snowball; rather, it creates a need that can be sated.

560011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
560011.value: Diabetes mellitus affects 9.7 percent of the population in China (Yang et al. 2010) and foot ulcer is a debilitating complication of diabetes. Biomechanical strength of wound tissue is known to reflect the quality of wound healing. In animal studies, the measurement of tensile strength of excised wound tissue is a common practice to assess wound healing; however, such an invasive procedure cannot be adopted in clinical studies. Interestingly, our recently developed Optical-coherence-tomography (OCT)-based air-jet indentation system can be used to characterize the biomechanical property of wound bed in a non-contact manner. The non-invasive, quantitative features of the device make it a potential clinical assessment to monitor healing of chronic wound. Diabetes interferes with wound healing at various phases, from early hemostasis to matrix deposition and angiogenesis (Martin et al. 2003). Diabetes may alter the blood flow, impairs neutrophil activity, and interferes with inflammatory mechanisms associated with abnormal chemokine expression. Besides, vascular endothelial growth factor is critical to blood vessel formation, but it is depleted in diabetic wound. Some preliminary evidence has shown that monochromatic infrared energy (MIRE) and pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) can accelerate healing of various types of wound, but the mechanisms are unclear. Therefore, the present project includes two parts: 1)Study I will be conducted in non-diabetic rats that aim to determine whether the OCT-based-air-jet indentation system can be used as a quantitative measurement to monitor phases of wound healing in vivo. We shall compare the biomechanical property for wound tissue measured by a new non-invasive method using the air-jet indentation system to a standard invasive approach adopted in animal studies using Material Testing System. This study will examine the relationship between the elasticity measurement of wound bed by the air-jet indentation system and data obtained from standard biological analyses at different phases of wound healing. After completing Study I in non-diabetic wound, we shall extend the assessment to a diabetic ulcer model in Study II because wound assessment is crucial for clinical management of chronic wound. 2)Study II will determine whether PEMF or MIRE would be more effective in accelerating healing of diabetic ulcer in rats, which leads to an increase in elasticity of wound bed measured by the air-jet indentation system. After the intervention period, we shall explore the relationship between the change in elasticity measurement by using the air-jet indentation system and standard biological analyses for wound healing. 根據統計資料顯示, 中國有9.7％的人口受到糖尿病影響, 而足部潰瘍是慢性糖尿病人常見的併發症之一。傷口組織的生物力學強度能夠反映傷口癒合的速度及質量。在動物研究中，傷口組織的抗拉強度測量是慣常用作評估傷口癒合的做法，然而，這種侵入性的程序不能在臨床研究中採用。本研究項目使用一部新開發基於光學層析成像的氣沖印壓系統，以非接觸方式進行傷口生物力學性能的測量。利用這部非侵入性的量度儀器，研究人員便可對慢性傷口的癒合進度作出臨床評估。 傷口癒合期間，從早期的止血到基質沉積和血管生成都可能會被糖尿病干擾。糖尿病可改變血液的流動，損害中性粒細胞的活動，並與趨化因子的表達異常相關的炎症機制的干擾。此外，血管內皮生長因子是血管形成的關鍵，但在糖尿病傷口可能會耗盡。本項目會研究脈衝電磁場（PEMF）可否加快各種類型的傷口癒合，並找尋可能的機理。

560011.label: Realisation of objectives
560011.value: Biomechanical properties of wounds can reflect the ultimate strength and integrity of the wounds, which provide useful information to monitor wound healing stages, predict prognosis and guide treatments. Tensiometry is a conventional method for testing tensile biomechanical properties. However, the testing procedures will cause tissue damage, rendering it not applicable as a clinical assessment. The novel OCT-based air-jet indentation system is plausible for non-invasive and repeated clinical measurement of biomechanical property of diabetic wounds. The present study validated the use of a recently developed OCT-based air-jet indentation system in measuring the biomechani¬cal properties of wounds in vivo. Moreover, the correlation between the indentation stiffness measured by the OCT-based air-jet indentation system, tensile biomechanical properties and collagen properties of diabetic wound tissues were investigated. One hundred and nineteen male Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats of 10 weeks old with streptozotocin (STZ)-induced diabetes were wounded using 6-mm biopsy punches on their hind limbs. The biomechanical properties of wound tissues were assessed by both the non-invasive OCT-based air-jet indentation system and the invasive tensiometry on post-wounding days 3, 7, 10, 14, and 21. Wound sections were stained with picro-sirius red for collagen analyses. Data obtained on different time points were charted to reflect the changes in biomechanical properties over time, and then pooled to examine the correlation between indentation stiffness and tensile biomechanical properties. Separate correlations were also included for early healing phase (day 3, 5 and 7) and later healing phase (day 10, 14 and 21) of the wounds. Quantitative analysis was performed to determine if correlations exist between indentation stiffness measured by the air-jet indentation system and the collagen properties including deposition, maturation and orientation. Elasticity of wound bed soft tissue was measured by the use of OCT-based-air-jet indentation system over phases of wound healing non-invasively. The greater indentation stiffness at wound periphery might imply the wound tissue is less elastic, more viscous and more deformable with tensile loading. We found a negative correlation between the indentation stiffness as measured by the OCT-based air-jet indentation system and the biomechanical properties of wound as measured by Material Testing System. This implies that the wound with low indentation stiffness tends to have high maximum load, maximum tensile stress, Young’s modulus and maximum strain. Our findings on the correlations between low-loading and high-loading tensile biomechanical properties in wounds provides ground work for future clinical research on low-loading biomechanical assessments feasible for chronic wounds. The indentation stiffness at centre and periphery of the wound was compared from wounding day 0 to day 21. Also, relationships between the elasticity of wound bed soft tissue and orientation of collagen fibres were examined at different healing phases. Collagen fibres are found to be oriented according to tensile or compressive loading. The correlations with collagen properties were even stronger than those with tensile biomechanical properties. This suggests that indentation stiffness might represent the underlying collagen histology more than the tensile biomechanical properties. In addition, the orien¬tation of collagen fibres changed with the indenta¬tion stiffness during wound healing. Our findings support the use of optical coherence tomography-based air-jet indentation system to evaluate the biomechanical properties of wounds in a non-contact manner. It can reflect the actual tensile biomechanical properties and collagen histology of diabetic wounds. Due to its non-invasive nature, it may be a potential clinical device that allows repeated examination of the biomechanical properties of chronic wounds over time. PEMF has been used in promoting healing of diabetic wounds in both human and animal models. PEMF-enhanced collagen deposition might contribute to the change in biomechanical properties especially in the early phase of diabetic wound healing. The effect of pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) on the deposition of type I collagen during diabetic wound healing and the potential relationship between myofibroblast population and collagen deposition was examined. Besides, we also investigated the effects of PEMF on type I collagen fibril alignment and fibre orientation. Forty 10-week-old male STZ-induced diabetic SD rats were randomly assigned to either the PEMF group or control group. Square wounds of 2cm x 2cm were made at the back of the rats. The PEMF group received daily exposure of PEMF to the wounds, while control group was handled in the same manner except that the PEMF device was not activated. Wound tissues harvested on post-wounding day 7, 10 and 14 were fixed, processed and sectioned. The abundance, fibril alignment and fibre orientation of type I collagen were quantified with picro-sirius polarization method and image analysis software. Myofibroblast population were assessed semi-quantitatively (4 for >75% of ROI; 3 for >50%; 2 for >25%; 1 for <25%; 0 for 0%) by two independent raters for better reliability. Correlation between myofibroblast population and collagen fibre deposition was examined. The PEMF group showed an accelerated early wound healing of diabetic ulcer in STZ-induced diabetic rat models by promoting myofibroblasts-induced collagen deposition. PEMF also transiently upregulated the myofibroblast population for healing on days 7–10 post-wounding, that were involved in wound contraction, which subsequently result in enhanced wound closure through the contractile activity of the myofibroblasts. The effects of PEMF on the tensile biomechanical properties of the diabetic wounds at different phases of wound healing were examined. A hundred and eleven 10-week-old male STZ-induced diabetic SD rats were randomly assigned to the PEMF group and sham group. Six-millimetre biopsy punched full thickness wounds were made on the lateral side of their hind limbs. The PEMF groups received active PEMF delivered at 25Hz with intensity of either 2mT or 10mT daily, while the sham group was handled in a similar way except they were not exposed to PEMF. Wound tissues were harvested for tensiometry on post-wound day 3, 5, 7, 10, 14 and 21. Load-relaxation behaviour, total relaxation, load at 5% strain, maximum load, maximum stress, energy absorption capacity, Young’s modulus, maximum strain and thickness of wound tissue were measured. The present findings demonstrated that the PEMF delivered at 10mT can improve mass-dependent energy absorption capacity of diabetic wounds in the early healing phase. However, PEMF (both 2-mT and 10-mT) seems to impair those mass-independent biomechanical properties (maximum stress and Young’s modulus) in the remodeling phase. The biomechanical strength is contributed mainly by collagen content in the wounds. Therefore, the correlation between the elasticity measurement by using the air-jet indentation system and collagen deposition for wound healing after the intervention was also established. Male STZ-induced diabetic SD rats received PEMF treatment and the excised wounds were measured by the air-jet indentation system. Spearman’s rho correlation was used to examine the correlation between the wound indentations stiffness and collagen abundance. PEMF can be a useful treatment for accelerating wound closure and collagen deposition, but it might not be applied in the remodeling phase to avoid hindering collagen alignment and orientation. Therefore, the objectives stated in the original proposal have all been achieved.

560011.label: Major findings and research outcome
560011.value: At the central wound bed, the stiffness measured by the air-jet system was significantly increased from Day 0 (19.85.3 N/m), peaked at Day 7 (52.120.6 N/m), then decreased progressively until Day 21 (23.7N03.2 N/m). In contrast, the biomechanical parameters of the skin wound measured by the tensiometer showed a marked reduction upon wounding, but gradually increased with time (all p<0.05) (Section 9 No 1). The indentation stiffness measured by the OCT-based air-jet indentation system was significantly negatively correlated to the maximum load, maximum tensile stress, Young’s modulus and maximum strain by the material testing system (all p<0.05) (Section 8 No 3 and 5; Section 9 No 2). PEMF produced significantly greater abundance of type I collagen fibre than did the control group on day 7 (p=0.013). PEMF also significantly increased myofibroblast population on day 7 and day 10 than did the control (day 7: P=.042; day 10: P=.024). In addition, positive correlation was found between collagen fibre deposition and myofibroblast population on day 7 (r=0.729, p=0.007) (Section 8 No 4; Section 9 No 3 and 4). We found that deposition of type I collagen in the monochromatic infrared energy group was higher than did the control group at the end of week 2 (p=0.05), however monochromatic infrared energy treated rats showed no significant difference in wound closure and histological examinations of re-epithelialisation, cellular content and granulation tissue as compared with the control group at each time point (Section 8 No 1). Pulsed electromagnetic therapy significantly enhanced wound closure (day 10 and 14 post-wounding) and reepithelialization (day 10 post-wounding) and these improvements were no longer observed at later stages of wound healing process. Using immunohistochemistry against α-smooth muscle actin, significantly more myofibroblasts were detected on day 7 and day 10 post-wounding in the PEMF groups as compared to the control group (Section 8 No 2). On post-wounding day 5, PEMF delivered at 10mT and 25Hz significantly increased the energy absorption capacity (p<0.05) and appeared to increase the maximum load. However, 10-mT PEMF decreased Young’s modulus on day 14 (p<0.05). Both 2-mT and 10-mT PEMF significantly increased the overall thickness (p<0.001) but decreased the overall maximum stress (p<0.01) of the wounds (Section 8 No 6). Significant correlation was found between biomechanical properties measured by the air-jet indentation system and collagen abundance after the intervention by Spearman’s rho correlations (r=-0.900, p=0.037).

560011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
560011.value: The indentation stiffness measured by the OCT-based air-jet indentation system was significantly negatively correlated to the maximum load, maximum tensile stress, Young’s modulus and maximum strain by material testing system, as well as to the collagen abundance and anisotropy. However, the relationships between the indentation stiffness and collagen properties as well as other extracellular matrix are still unclear. Further research on the histology of extracellular matrix and indentation stiffness of wounds is needed. We found that PEMF promotes diabetic wound healing in terms of accelerated wound closure and increased collagen deposition, while the association of enhanced myofibroblasts population with collagen deposition suggests a potential mechanism of PEMF on collagen deposition during wound healing that needs to be confirmed by future study. Our findings also demonstrated that there is a therapeutic window of PEMF parameters; different combinations of intensity and treatment time might produce different effects, further studies are warranted to confirm the optimal treatment parameters for enhancing diabetic wound healing and to determine the underlying mechanisms that promote myofibroblast population and collagen deposition, as well as the biomechanical strength during diabetic wound healing, in particular, to examine whether PEMF promotes wound healing by collagen deposition or contraction, regeneration or scarring.

560011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
560011.value: Foot ulcer is commonly observed in people with diabetes but there is a lack of quantitative assessment method for assessing chronic wound. The biomechanical property of the wound tissue reflects the organization of the collagen fibers. Measurements made by the newly developed OCT air-jet indentation system were compared to that by tradition material testing systems. Even though the principles adopted by the two measurements devices are different, but both reflect the biomechanical properties of wound tissue. The air-jet indentation system allows measurement of the biomechani¬cal properties of wounds non-invasively that is a potential useful clinical device that allows quantitative assessment of chronic wounds such as diabetic ulcers to be conducted in a non-contact manner. Moreover, the objective and quantitative assessment of chronic wounds would provide useful information in determining early, optimal treatment strategies and prognosis prediction for managing chronic wounds such as diabetic ulcers. By using the optimal treatment protocol, we have demonstrated for the first time that PEMF treatment increased the myofibroblast population in diabetic rats and improve the biomechanical properties of wound that contributing to quicker wound closure.

560211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
560211.value: Botulinum Neurotoxins (BoNTs) are the causative agents of human botulism and have been recognized as the most toxic substance to human and a potential bioterrorism weapon. Local application at extremely low dose of BoNTs have found broad clinical applications in an increasing number of neurological diseases, such as dystonia, glabellar facial lines and axillary hyperhidrosis, as well as cosmetic and numerous experimental/off-label uses. However, the potential villainous misuse of BoNTs in a bioterrorist action and medical overdoses could result in mass casualties requiring post-exposure therapy. Effective medical countermeasures that target, inactivate and clear toxin from the nerve cell are the most effective treatments after signs and symptoms of botulism have occurred, while these therapies are currently limited in availability. The unique mechanism of extended substrate requirement for efficient BoNT substrate cleavage suggests that the substrate-based peptide inhibitor can be a potent countermeasure for BoNT intoxication. We propose to develop substrate-based peptide and peptodmimetic inhibitors against intoxications caused by BoNT serotype A, which accounts for most of the natural human botulisms and is currently being used in numerous clinical applications. In this study, first, peptide that contains two known LC/A inhibitors, which inhibit both the active site and substrate binding regions of LC/A, will be used to screen for high affinity peptides using random mutagenesis library and phage display approach. Second, high affinity peptides selected in the initial study will be developed into non-hydrolyzed inhibitors by cleavage site mutation or the incorporation of “transition-state isostere” to the scissile bond. Last, a cell penetrating peptide-and BoNT/C heavy chain-based delivery systems will be developed to deliver the peptide and peptidomimetic inhibitors into neuronal cells and the efficiency of the inhibition inside the neuron will be assayed. 肉毒神經毒素（BoNTs）是人類肉毒毒素中毒的病原體，並已被公認為最有毒物質和潛在的生物恐怖武器。局部使用極低劑量的BoNTs被廣闊應用在越來越多的臨床的神經系統疾病，如肌張力障礙，眉間臉部線條和腋下多汗症，以及化妝品和很多實驗性和無標籤使用。然而，BoNTs潛在的生物恐怖應用和醫療過量都可能會導致大量人員傷亡，並需要中毒後後治療。當肉毒桿菌中毒症狀發生時，滅活和從神經細胞中清除毒素是最有效的治療方法，而目前卻缺少這些療法。肉毒毒素的特異的底物識別機製表明，以底物為基礎的多肽抑製劑將是一個治療肉毒毒素中毒的方法。 我們建議開發以底物為基礎的多肽抑製劑來治療血清A型肉毒毒素引起的中毒，因為A型毒素引起多數的天然肉毒毒素中毒，且目前被大量使用於臨床。在這項研究中，首先，我們用包含兩個已知的A型肉毒毒素的多肽抑製劑，即抑制毒素活性中心和底物結合區域，的多肽為模板，利用隨機突變庫和噬菌體展示的方法用去篩選高親和力的多肽。二，將此高親和力肽通過酶切位點突變開發成為非水解性的抑製劑並測其體外的抑製活性。最後，我們將為此多肽抑製劑開發以細胞滲透肽為基礎的傳輸系統， 同時將檢測此多肽抑製劑抑制神經細胞的效率。

560211.label: Major findings and research outcome
560211.value: The objectives of the proposal are to: 1) develop high affinity peptides for LC/A; 2) develop non-hydrolyzed high affinity peptide inhibitors and 3) develop peptide inhibitor delivery system. After 2 years’ research on this project, we have achieved all these goals and also expand our research to understand the basis of substrate recognition and specificity of different Botulinum Neurotoxins. The major finding of the project include following several aspects. Development of high affinity peptides for LC/A Using phage two hybrid and structural analysis, we observed that mutations at various sites of SNAP25 could enhance the binding affinity to LC/A by 10~20 folds, with SNAP25 (H162D) and (R180L) being the most efficient mutations. Further incorporated double mutants of SNAP25, for example, SNAP25 (H162D, R180L) and SNAP25 (T190V, M202F), however, did not enhance the cleavage efficiency by LC/A. Development of inhibitors using SNAP25 based peptides with enhanced affinity After acquisition of high affinity peptide, we then developed inhibitors for BoNT/A. Based on our previous studies, we selected SNAP25(80-197-RRGF), SNAP25(80-197- WTKFL) and SNAP25 (80~196-C) as the backbone of the inhibitor and designated as R1, R2 and R197C respectively. The IC50 of these three inhibitors, R1, R2 and R197C, were determined to be 17.15µM, 15.71µM and 2.22µM respectively. After incorporating different substitutions, inhibitor R1 (R180L) displayed the highest inhibition effect, with a IC50 of 0.28 μM and Ki of 0.22 μM. Inhibitor, R1 (H162D) and R1 (H162D, T190V) had a slightly higher IC50 and Ki than R1(R180L). Inhibitor R2 (H162D) exhibited IC50 of 1.11 μM and Ki of 0.88 μM and R2 (T190V) exhibited almost the same inhibitory effect. For the R197C type of inhibitor, R197C (D186H) exhibited IC50 of 0.28 μM and Ki of 0.22 μM. Additional inhibitors, such as SNAP25(80-196-RGF), which was designated as R1-RGF, plus other derivatives, were generated. Inhibitor R1-RGF exhibited a very low IC50 of 0.0021µM and a Ki of 0.0017 µM. Inhibitor R1-RLF exhibited an IC50 of 0.93µM and a Ki of 0.83µM. Development of inhibitor delivery system and in vivo inhibition The oligoarginines (R12) was coupled to four most promising peptide inhibitors, namely R1 (R180L), R2 (T190V), R197C and R1-RGF to develop cell permeable inhibitors. Consistent with our in vitro results, these four peptide inhibitors exhibited high LC/A inhibition effect in vivo as well. About 0.7 µM R12-R1 (R180L) and R12-R197C inhibited >60% activity of LC/A, with the latter exhibiting slightly higher inhibitory effects on LC/A in vivo; however, the in vitro inhibition effect of R1 (R180L) was about 10-fold higher than that of R197C. similar amount of LC/A been expressed in each treatment (data not shown). Full protection of BoNT/A intoxication by SNAP25 inhibitors in mice Our data in vivo mice protection assay showed that a dose of 2µg R12-R1-RGF or higher could fully protect the challenge of 2 x LD50 of BoNT/A (Fig 4A), a dose of 10µg or higher could protect 4 x LD50 challenge by BoNT/A (Fig 4B). At higher doses (8 x LD50 and 16 x LD50) of BoNT/A challenge, the protective effects of R1-RGF were not apparent, but the application of inhibitors at 10µg or higher could delay the killing of mice by BoNT/A (Fig 4C, D). Most importantly, application of up to10mg of R12-R1-RGF did not cause any observable toxicity in mice suggesting the high safety of the inhibitor, which agreed with the fact that SNAP25-based inhibitors were mainly human proteins. Other than the previsous study, we have also investigated the substrate recognition mechanisms of LC/D and LC/F leading to several publications.

560211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
560211.value: Further study for this project includes at least two aspects. First is to further improve the potency of some of the peptide inhibitors. One observation on the inhibitor is its high potency at lower concentration, while the potency reduced at higher concentration. We postulated that the inhibitor may form dimmer or multimer at high concentration, which reduces its potency. We would like to figure out the dimerization mechanisms of these peptide inhibitor and further engineer it into a monomer peptide inhibitors to improve its potency. Second is to develop better and specific delivery system for our peptide inhibitor. One of the delivery system is to use BoNT based delivery system, where we will try heavy chain based delivery system or inactive whole toxin based delivery system. Another option is to develop cholera toxin based delivery system.

560211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
560211.value: Botulinum neurotoxins (BoNTs) are the most potent protein toxins causing human botulism and widely used therapeutics for numerous neuromuscular disorders. Attempts have been made to search for potent inhibitors for this class of toxins for years with no promising candidate being found so far, which is due to their unique substrate recognition mechanisms requiring both active site substrate catalysis and distal substrate binding. Small molecular inhibitors targeting the active site of BoNT do not provide enough binding affinity therefore lacking the potency for clinical application. Our group have depicted the detail substrate recognition mechanisms for BoNTs and discovered the third site interaction between LC/A and SNAP25 that provides further binding affinity. In this study, we use SNAP25(80-197) that contains both binding sites as backbone for LC/A inhibitor and further improve its binding affinity through optimizing the binding sites and engineering the best interaction at the active site. We then developed a serial of SNAP25-based inhibitors with nanomolar inhibitory strength both in vitro and in vivo. Most importantly, these inhibitors for the first time showed full protection of mice intoxicated with 4XLD50 of BoNT/A. This is by far the first BoNT/A inhibitor with potential clinical application.

560611.value: 腫瘤化療的其中一個主要問題是產生多藥耐藥性。抗癌藥物被泵到細胞外，藥品的積累降低從而導致耐藥性。三種ABC转运器（ABCB1，ABCC1和ABCG2（也稱為 BCRP;乳腺癌耐藥蛋白）均可以把藥物泵到細胞外。我們的研究集中於設計並合成一系列新的黃酮類二聚體，作為抑制ABCB1和ABCC1藥物泵的活動，從而恢復耐藥性腫瘤的敏感性。其中一些黃酮類二聚體也有很高的抑制BCRP效能（EC50 =5 nM）， 比較最有效的BCRP抑製劑Ko143（EC50= 11 nm）還要有效。一些黃酮類二聚體還有對 BCRP的特異性和對P - gp和MRP1有非常低的交叉反應。初步結果表明，黃酮類二聚體對BCRP跟P-gp和MRP1有不同的抑制機制。 在這個研究項目中，我們將對黃酮類二聚體進行優化，主要目標為發展有效，安全，具體和不會引起不良的藥物相互作用的 BCRP抑製劑。我們還將探討其作用機制。最後，我們將利用異種移植瘤模型測試BCRP調製器的體內療效 。

560611.label: Realisation of objectives
560611.value: Objective 1: Discovery and lead optimization of flavonoid dimers for modulating ABCG2-mediated cancer drug resistance We have synthesized 32 acetylene and 20 azide flavonoid monomers. We have synthesized more than 300 new flavonoid dimers using click chemistry and screen 85 of them for their ability in reversing BCRP-mediated topotecan resistance in either HEC293/R2 or MCF7-MX100 cells. Among this series of new triazole-containing flavonoid dimers, most of them are promising in modulating BCRP-mediated topotecan resistance with EC50 in nM range with 25 of them below 10 nM. Such activity is comparable to the well-known BCRP modulator Ko143. For examples, Ac5Az9 (EC50=0.9±0.3 nM), Ac15Az8 (EC50=1.3±0.7 nM) and Ac22Az8 (EC50=0.9±0.1 nM) were more potent than Ko143 (EC50=9.0±1.5 nM) in modulating BCRP-mediated topotecan resistance. In addition to their high potency, these new flavonoid dimers also have high therapeutic index with 66 compounds having IC50 towards normal L929 fibroblasts greater than 100 µM. As far as we know, flavonoid dimer represents one of the most potent BCRP modulators reported in literature and they are relatively safe to use in vitro. Objective 2: Investigation of the mechanisms of how flavonoid dimers modulate ABCG2 Mechanistically, Ac15Az8 treatment of BCRP-overexpressing S1M180 cells resulted in an increase in topotecan and doxorubicin accumulation by inhibiting its drug efflux. Using microsomes derived from S1M180 cells, candidate compound Ac15Az8 exhibited dose-dependent inhibition of vanadate-inhibitable ATPase activity with EC50 ¬at about 54 nM, suggesting that Ac15Az8 inhibits BCRP by virtue of inhibiting BCRP ATPase activity. We have also determined the kinetics of doxorubicin accumulation and determined that Ac15Az8 binds to BCRP in a mixed mode rather than a simple competitive manner. Together, Ac15Az8 is different from our previously-characterized flavonoid dimers in that the former is inhibiting ATPase activity and is not a pure competitive inhibitor of BCRP. Unexpectedly, we discovered that Ac15Az8 was less potent in moderating BCRP-mediated topotecan resistance in S1M180 cells (EC50 at around 84 nM) than in MX100 cells (1.3 nM). We discovered that BCRP in S1M180 carried a R482G mutation whereas BCRP in MX100 cells carried wild-type genotype (R482). Such R482G mutation has been reported to affect substrate specificity. This result suggested that Ac15Az8 is binding to the substrate binding site of BCRP, possibly overlapping with R482 position. We have also found that Ac15Az8 did not affect the subcellular localization of BCRP or the overall expression level. Altogether, Ac15Az8 inhibits BCRP by virtue of a new mechanism which involves inhibiting both ATPase and binding to the substrate binding domain of BCRP. Objective 3: In vivo efficacy studies of flavonoid dimers in reversing cancer drug resistance in xenograft tumor model One of the most potent compounds, Ac15Az8, was chosen for further in vivo studies. Its EC50 were 1.3±0.7 nM and 4.5±3.5 nM in reversing topotecan resistance in BCRP-overexpressing cell lines MCF7/MX100 and HEK/293/R2 respectively. The pharmacokinetics of Ac15Az8 was investigated. We have established a LCMSMS-based detection method of Ac15Az8. Ac15Az8 was first converted to hydrogen chloride salt form, Ac15Az8HCl, in order to increase its solubility. We have optimized the formulation for dissolving Ac15Az8HCl: 10% NMP, 10% cremophor-EL, 80% 0.9% saline. Intravenous administration resulted in higher AUC (area) (for 1mg/kg, 51348 ng-min/ml) when compared to the intraperitoneal administration AUC (area) (for 15mg/kg, 25117.7 ng-min/ml). This pharmacokinetics study suggests that either intravenous or intraperitoneal administration will be suitable for future animal model studies. But intraperitoneal administration was chosen for subsequent studies because it can maintain a relatively high plasma level than that in intravenous administration. We investigated the effect of Ac15Az8HCl on topotecan pharmacokinetics. The AUC of topotecan (24873.3 ng-min/ml) is increased 1.7 fold when co-administered with Ac15Az8HCl (42875.8 ng-min/ml). To test the in vivo efficacy of Ac15Az8 in modulating BCRP, we have established a xenograft model of S1M180 in immunocomprimized Balb/c mice. To test the ability of Ac15Az8 in reversing BCRP-mediated topotecan resistance in vivo, we have compared the tumor volume of S1M180 xenograft on day 60 post implantation, either with topotecan alone (7449 +/- 604 mm3) or together with Ac15Az8 (5048 +/- 444 mm3). We found that co-administration of Ac15Az8 can significantly sensitize S1M180 xenograft to topotecan, suggesting that Ac15Az8 can inhibit BCRP in vivo. However, the tumor volume reduction is less than expected, possibly due to the unexpected fast growth rate of S1M180.

560611.label: Major findings and research outcome
560611.value: Major findings: Overexpression of breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) increased drug efflux, causing multidrug resistance in cancer. In this project, we have designed, synthesized and characterized a new class of BCRP modulator based on novel flavonoid dimers that target specifically the dimeric structure of BCRP. We have increased the structural diversity of flavonoid dimers by using click chemistry to join together 2 flavonoid monomers, each containing either alkyne or azide. We have screened hundreds of novel triazole-containing flavonoid dimers for their BCRP-modulating activity and have discovered a highly potent BCRP modulator Ac15Az8 with nM activity in reversing topotecan resistance in BCRP-overexpressing cells like S1M180, MX100 and HEK293R2. We have determined that Ac15Az8 exerts a mixed mode of modulation on BCRP because it can inhibit BCRP ATPase activity as well as binding to the substrate-binding site of BCRP. We have optimized the formulation of dissolving Ac15Az8, studied pharmacokinetics of Ac15Az8 and determined the optimal route and dose of administration of Ac15Az8 for in vivo animal efficacy study. We have set up a topotecan-resistant breast cancer animal model using S1M180 xenograft. Co-administration of Ac15Az8 resulted in moderate sanitization of S1M180 xenograft to topotecan. In summary, we have designed, synthesized and characterized a new class of potent (nM) BCRP modulator in vitro and in vivo which can be used in reversing BCRP-mediated drug resistance in cancer.

560611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
560611.value: The discovery of this new class of potent BCRP modulator has been filed in a patent. The patent has been trasnferred to Athenix Ltd (previously Kinex) on Feb-2015 for further pre-clinical and clinical develoment.

560611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
560611.value: We have discovered a new way to reverse one of major cause of drug resistance in cancer mediated by the overexpression of a membrane protein (breast cancer resistance protein) in drug resistant cancer cells. We have designed new small molecules (flavonoid dimers) that can prevent the drug resistant cells from pumping drugs out of cancer cells. This new class of small molecules are very potent and can work at nanomolar range. We have chosen the most potent compound and characterized it in both cell lines and animal experiments. In addition, we have determine the mechanism by which this group of compound in reversing cancer drug resistance: by binding to a membrane transporter which would otherwise pump cancer drugs out of the cells. Through this work, we have filed a patent for this important discovert. We have subsequently licensed the patent to an international pharmaceutical company for future pre-clinical and clinical trials. In summary, we have combined medicinal chemistry and the expertise in drug resistance in cancer to develop a new way to deal with drug resistance in cancer.

561011.label: Realisation of objectives
561011.value: The research project should be considered as quite successful. Twenty-five refereed journal papers and six presentations, including invited seminars and posters, at the International Conferences have resulted from this project. In particular, the PI has been invited to publish a book chapter on our novel dimers in the book entitled “Brain Disorders (In Tech)”. Furthermore, two PhD students had been trained and one of them has graduated with impressive publications mainly sponsored by this grant. In addition, two post-docs have been trained throughout of the period of this project. Thus, the research directed towards the above objectives distinguishes itself not only academically, but also on the basis of medical promise. For objective 1, we have demonstrated that, among the tacrine and huperzine A-derived dimers, bis(3)-cognitin (1 μM) has shown the most potent activity in the stimulation of MEF2 gene transcription activity under the basal condition in SN4741 cells. In addition, MPP+ (500 μM) reduced the expression of MEF2D in the mitochondria, and DNA binding and gene transcription activities of MEF2D in the nucleus of SN4741 cells. By using electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA) and Western blotting analysis, we have shown that 2 hours pre-incubation of bis(3)-cognitin (1-10 μM) significantly restored the levels of MPP+-induced decline of mitochondrial MEF2D and prevented the MEF2D nuclear functions. For objective 2, we have shown that bis(3)-cognitin (1-10 uM) might prevent alpha-synuclein- or MPP+-induced neurotoxicity via recovering the MEF2D dysfunctions. Overexpression of A53T alpha-synuclein might cause the cell death in SN4741 cells and bis(3)-cognitin (10 μM) might protect these cells from the alpha-synuclein-induced apoptosis. It was further demonstrated that knockdown MEF2D by siRNA significantly abolished the neuroprotective effects of bis(3)-cogintin (10 μM) against MPP+. Moreover, bis(3)-cognitin (10 μM) restored MPP+-induced decrease of pSer473-Akt and pSer9-GSK3β, indicating that bis(3)-cognitin prevents MPP+-induced neurotoxicity and MEF2D dysfunctions via activating Akt/ GSK3β pathway. For objective 3, we have shown that Bis(3)-cognitin (0.1-10 μM) and bis(12)- hupyridone (0.1-3 μM ) significantly prevent glutamate-induced neuronal loss in CGNs. Moreover, co-incubation of bis(3)-cognitin (0.3-10 μM) substantially protects against neuronal death induced by serum and potassium deprivation in CGNs. In addition, we have further demonstrate that bis(3)-cognitin blocks serum and potassium deprivation-induced apoptosis in CGN via regulating VEGFR-2/Akt/GSK3β and VEGFR-2/ERK pathways. For objective 4, we have demonstrated that 6OHDA might activate GSK3β, leading to neuronal loss in PC12 cells. The activation of GSK3β might inhibit the transcriptional activity of MEF2 gene. We have shown that indirubin-3-oxime (3-10 μM), a synthetic derivative of indirubin, might prevent 6OHDA-induced neurotoxicity and inhibit the activation of GSK3β. In addition, the decreased expression of MEF2D by shRNA transfection significantly abolished the neuroprotective effects of indirubin-3-oxime against 6-OHDA-induced neurotoxicity in PC12 cells. Taken together, indirubin-3-oxime might protect against the 6OHDA-induced neuronal apoptosis by restoring the dysfunctions of MEF2D, possibly through inhibiting the activation of GSK3β. For objective 5, we have evaluated the neuroprotective effects of selective dimers on mice treated with MPTP. 10 consecutive daily i.p. injection of MPTP (8 mg/kg) to C57BL/6 mice causes the decrease of mitochondrial and nuclear MEF2D, the loss of TH-positive neurons, and the impairments of movement. Co-injection of bis(3)-cognitin (1 mg/kg) substantially protects against MPTP-induced MEF2D dysfunctions, DA neuronal loss and movement abnormality in mice.
