646411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
646411.value: Internal migration in China on an unprecedented scale has affected a large fraction of Chinese children. Many children are left behind by one or both parents. Others accompany their parents and share the difficulties experienced by migrants in China. In Hong Kong since 1997, the increasing cross-border migration, which involves a large proportion of children, has been a major force of population growth and but also a source of social problems in the city. Among few studies of migration impact on children' well-beings, most tend to focus on educational opportunities and material resources, while the disruptive effects of parental absence due to migration on children' intellectual and psychological development are yet to be examined. Children of migrants are typically compared to their counterparts in either origin or destination, but not both. Finally, internal migration and international (cross-border) migration, despite of their resemblances, are seldom compared directly. This project aims to collect and analyze the first national representative survey data in China on migrant children and children left behind, as well as, for comparison, rural and urban children living with their parents. While the focus is put on China, the project will take advantage of the secondary survey data collected in Hong Kong to examine the consequences of immigration for children from mainland China, in comparison to migration children within mainland China. Specifically, the project plans: (1) to examine the process or determinants of children's migration in China; (2) to investigate the socioeconomic and psychological consequences of migration on children and their interactions in both China and Hong Kong; (3) to compare and contrast internal migration in China and cross-border (international) migration in Hong Kong to show how effects of institutions, community, and families shape the wellbeing of children, including educational and cognitive development, physical health, emotional health, and risky behaviors. Such comprehensive studies of children affected by migration within mainland China and to Hong Kong will permit an assessment of the way migration affects children well-beings in general and how such (adverse) effects are mediated by institutional arrangement pertaining to migrants in destinations. Findings from the project will also have important policy implications for the design of intervention programs by local governments and global development organizations, to reinforce the benefits while mitigating the costs of migration for children. 中国内地的大规模的城乡移民产生了相当一部分留守儿童，因为父母一方或双方离家,对儿童青少年的身心发展都产生了很大的影响。而那些跟随父母到城市生活的儿童,又因为没有当地的户口而在就学和成长中面临诸多问题。1997年香港回归以来日益增长的内地跨境移民中有相当一部分是儿童青少年(港人内地子女）， 他们是香港人口增长的主要来源,但也是香港面临诸多社会问题的主要群体。以往的研究, 只是关注移民对儿童青少年的教育和其他物质资源的影响, 而由于父母不在带来的对小孩的智力和心理发展的影响, 鲜有关注。 通常对移民子女的研究, 要么将他们与此同时移民来源地的同龄人比较, 要么与移民目的地的同龄人比较, 却没有同时比较这三个群体的。此外，尽管国内移民与跨境界移民有很多相似之出, 很少有人将他们直接对比。 本项研究旨在搜集中国第一个具有代表性的有关移民儿童和留守儿童的调查资料，并且也包括城乡当地的父母非移民的儿童作为比较参照组。尽管本项目关注的重点是内地，研究也利用香港的二手调查资料，研究内地儿童移民在香港的情况, 以作为比较. 具体地说，项目计划包括（1）研究中国决定儿童移民的因素； （2） 研究迁移对儿童社会经济和心理的影响, 以及它们之间的交互作用。 （3）比较中国的国内移民和跨境移民， 以检视制度、社区、家庭是如何影响儿童的身心健康和智力发展的。 本项研究的发现将对政策研究、干预来降低迁移对儿童的不利影响具有重要的启示。

646411.label: Realisation of objectives
646411.value: The project drew data from different sources concerning both population censuses and sampling surveys to analyze the impact of migrant/immigrant status on various outcomes for both adults and children (including ethnic minorities) in mainland China as a whole and in selected regions (such as Hong Kong immigrants in Shenzhen and Han migrants in Xinjiang). The survey data included both secondary data that are publicly available and also data collected by the research team. For data collection, we joined in a school-based survey project (Chinese Education Panel Survey, CEPS) run by Renmin University of China to ensure that we had a sufficient migrant sub-sample for analyses. Several papers with PhD student Duoduo Xu (published and unpublished) attempt to address the issues of migration, hukou and students' academic performance, health, and subjective wellbeing. Part of the fund was used to collect the third wave of the Hong Kong Panel Study of Social Dynamics (HKPSSD) in 2015. The proportion of children in the successfully followed-up households, was unexpected lower (N=507), however. We explores the data from the first wave (N=958), perhaps extended to the analytic sample to those above age 15 but under age 18. In addition, we utilized the school-based PISA survey in Hong Kong and Shanghai and addressed some important issues in the study of migration and child wellbeing (Xu and Dronker 2016; Xu and Wu 2016; Zhang 2014, and three working papers with Duoduo Xu). In addition, the project also explored the impact of migration, hukou conversion on well-being for both adults and children. For adults, we looked at the hukou conversion and migration process (Zhang and Treiman 2013) and the consequences of hukou conversion on socioeconomic attainment (Zheng and Wu 2013) , the role of occupational segregation in creating migration-local gaps (Zhang Wu 2016; 吴晓刚, 张卓妮 2014), the impact of urbanization on health (Miao and Wu 2016), and how migrants competed with other disadvantaged groups in the labor market (e.g., Uyghurs in Xinjiang, Wu and Song 2014), among others. We proposed and elaborated the origin-designation approach in migration studies (Wu and Zhang 2015) for children school enrollment. This approach has been further applied to analyze immigrants in Hong Kong in comparison to those who stayed in Guangdong, using two comparable panel data sets (HKPSSD and the Guangdong self-representative sample of Chinese Family Panel Study [CFPS]) (Zhang, Song and Wu 2016 working paper). The project has produced fourteen published articles and trained seven PhD students and two M Phil students. Some students have either co-authored papers with me or and published alone, which I allowed them. Zhuoni Zhang, who I originally planned to hire to run the project, started her faculty job (assistant professor) at City U of Hong Kong in 2013. She has received two GRF projects tied to this project: "Neighborhood Characteristics, Parental Practices and Immigrant Children's Academic Performance and Non-Cognitive Skills in Hong Kong" (Early Career Scheme [ECS], 2014 - 2016); and "Mode and Timing of Immigration from Mainland China to Hong Kong: an Origin-Destination Comparison" (2017-2019). Duoduo Xu will complete her dissertation defense in December and start her new job as a Research Assistant Professor in Social Science and Junior Fellow at the Institute for Advanced Study, HKUST. She has been involved in a survey on nursery and kindergarten students in Hong Kong, to be launched early next year, with a team consisting of members from HKUST, Poly U, and HKU. The difficulty we have encountered in the analysis is that the data from China and Hong Kong are not truly comparable, as there are a huge regional variations in China, whereas Hong Kong is much smaller. However, we should negate the values of comparable studies. Future research should aim to compare the comparable. We have received a new GRF to study temporary migrants and their adaptation in Shenzhen ("Ethnic Enclaves, Migrant Settlement, and Socio-spatial Differentiation in Metropolitan Shenzhen, 2000-2010"). Shanghai may be another suitable case for comparison.

646411.label: Major findings and research outcome
646411.value: 1. In mainland China, migration is always closely tied to the household registration system. Permanent migration with a change of hukou status is found to bring benefits (health and mental health) to those of rural origins, although the benefits vary by different groups and the timing of the conversion. Children in urban areas are more likely to change hukou and converters who spent their childhood in rural areas are significantly happier but less healthy than urban residents (Zhang and Treiman 2013). The benefits of urban hukou may depend on the channel of hukou change and only those through individual efforts seem to benefit from the change, which suggest that selectivity plays an important role in hukou changes (Zheng and Wu 2013). For those migrants without hukou, their access to well-paying jobs is much more limited in the urban labor market, and hukou-based occupational segregation account for most part of the earnings gaps between migrants and local workers (Zhang and Wu 2017). 2. The lack of urban hukou may also place the constraints on migrants children's educational opportunities. These children are less likely than not only urban children but also their peers in rural villages to be enrolled in school (Wu and Zhang). They are also more likely to be segregated in low-quality school in urban areas, and such segregation has a negative impact on migrant children's academic performance (Xu and Wu 2016). 3. Migration brings both benefits and costs to affected children. Bringing rural children to cities significantly improved their school performance and physical health on the one hand, but also reduced their educational aspirations and increased their anxiety towards the future on the other hand. Leaving children in the countryside, while avoiding potential social exclusions in cities, results in a negative impact on their physical and mental health. Gaining local urban hukou status can improve rural-born children’s academic achievement to some extent but has no effect on the other wellbeing indicators (Xu, Dronkers, and Wu 2016). 4. In Hong Kong, without hukou constraints, children of immigrant parents enjoy advantages in education, occupation, and earnings compared to children of native parents. A successful transition to triumph, however, is contingent upon their parents’ socioeconomic backgrounds: the success of these second-generation immigrants seems to be more pronounced among those from lower socioeconomic status families (Xu and Wu 2016; Zhang 2014).

646411.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
646411.value: Based on what we have learned about migrant children's motivation in mainland and Hong Kong, it seems that motivation for success is an important factor affecting their academic success. In urban China, migrant status reduces students' educational aspirations and increases their anxieties for the future, due to social exclusion without local hukou, whereas in Hong Kong, the strong motivation for upward mobility and parental expectation explain migrant children's outstanding performance. Therefore, institutional designs and public policy should be directed to the social psychological process of how migrant children adjust to their new homes.

646411.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
646411.value: This project aims to collect and analyze the first national representative survey data in China on migrant children and non-migrant children whose parents have migrated, as well as, for comparison, rural and urban non-migrant children living with their parents. While the focus is on China, the project will take advantage of the secondary survey data collected in Hong Kong to examine the consequences of immigration for children from mainland China in comparison to migrant children within mainland China. Specifically, the project plans: (1) to examine the process or determinants of children's migration in China; (2) to investigate the socioeconomic and psychological consequences of migration on children and their interactions in both China and Hong Kong; (3) to compare and contrast internal migration in China and cross-border (international) migration in Hong Kong to show how institutions, community, and family effects shape the wellbeing of children, including educational and cognitive development, physical health, emotional health, and risky behavior. Such comprehensive studies of children affected by migration within mainland China and to Hong Kong will permit an assessment of the way migration affects children's wellbeing in general and how such adverse effects are mediated by institutional arrangement pertaining to migrants in their destinations.

646911.label: Project Objectives
646911.value: To examine and compare the efficacy and efficiency of signaling quality through sellers’ advance-selling strategies, such as pricing, capacity rationing, advertising, and their various combinations; Our focus here is to investigate (i) whether the signal(s) can ensure complete separation of sellers with different product quality; (ii) compared with the benchmark case where customers know quality in advance, whether and how the high-quality seller should distort his selling strategy to differentiate himself from the low-quality seller; (iii) how much profit the high-quality seller has to forgo due to such distortions in strategy (also known as signaling cost); and (iv) among all the combinations of signals, which one can achieve the separation of sellers with the lowest signaling cost. To explore how these signaling strategies depend on sellers’ operational capabilities (e.g., total capacity, production cost) and market condition (e.g., customer heterogeneity); Our focus here is to examine how the efficacy and efficiency of the signals vary (i) when the sellers are endowed with different levels of total capacity and production cost; and (ii) when customers are heterogeneous in different aspects. To understand the welfare implications of these signaling strategies to customers, sellers, and society. Our focus here is to study the impact of different signaling strategies on customers’ surplus, sellers’ profit, and social welfare. In particular, we seek to shed light on how signaling affects the profitability of advance selling and sellers’ decisions on whether, when, and how to offer advance selling.

646911.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
646911.value: Many sellers offer customers opportunities to purchase a product or service considerably before it is available to be consumed. This practice, known as advance selling, has become a standard marketing policy in service industries including travel and entertainment, as well as many retailing industries. Examples range from toys, books, electronic gadgets, through wines, to condominiums. A well-known example in Hong Kong is advance selling of moon-cakes prior to the Mid-Autumn Festival by the Maxim’s Bakery. Prior research shows that sellers and customers can all benefit from advance selling, and in particular, sellers’ profit can be improved by as much as 100%. Despite the widespread application and considerable benefits of advance selling, many customers may hesitate to buy in advance due to uncertainties associated with product quality. Such uncertainties may be related to the product (e.g., aroma, flavor, and taste of wines) or the seller (e.g., financial stability of the condominiums builder). Customers’ concern about quality may significantly impair sales potential and profit advantage of advance selling. On the other hand, sellers usually have better information about quality than customers. They, however, may have different incentives. Naturally, a seller offering a high-quality product desires to distinguish herself from a seller with a low-quality product. On the other hand, a seller with a low-quality product wants to conceal quality information to the farthest possible extent. If the high-quality sellers can deploy certain strategies (e.g., spending a lot on advertising), which cannot be mimicked by the low-quality sellers, customers can infer high quality upon observing those strategies (i.e., signals) and then more favorably consider buying in advance. Credibly signaling quality to customers is more difficult and also more important in case of advance selling. Surprisingly, this critical topic has not been studied. In this project, we will investigate whether a seller can convey credible signal to indicate product quality in advance selling, and, if so, how. We will also explore how sellers’ signaling strategies affect customers’ purchasing behavior and sellers’ profits. Specifically, we will investigate (1) the efficacy and efficiency of signaling quality through advance-selling strategies, such as pricing, capacity rationing, advertising, refunding upon order cancellation, and their various combinations; (2) how the signaling strategies depend on sellers’ operational capabilities (e.g., capacity, cost, and outsourcing) and market conditions (e.g., customer heterogeneity, demand variability, and seller competition); (3) the welfare implications of signaling quality to customers, sellers, and society. 现今很多商家在销售产品或者服务的时候采用一种提前销售的策略，也就是容许顾客在产品上市或者享受服务之前提前购买该产品或服务。提前销售战略现已成为很多行业（如旅游、娱乐、和零售等）中的一种常见的营销手段，顾客们可以利用商家提前销售的机会预定各种商品，比如机票，酒店住宿，玩具，书籍，电子产品，酒类，和住宅公寓等等。在香港，广为人知的一个提前销售的成功案例是美心集团每年在中秋节之前几周就开始提前销售月饼。研究表明商家和顾客都可以从提前销售/购买活动中获利，特别是商家在某些情况下利润可增加100%。 尽管提前销售策略应用广泛收益良多，很多顾客却因为对产品质量的不确定而不愿意提前购买。这种不确定可能是对于产品本身的质量（例如酒类的香气和口感）或者是对于商家的信誉（例如住宅公寓开发商的财务稳定性）。顾客对于产品质量的担忧会严重影响提前销售策略的有效性和获利能力。另一方面，相对于顾客，商家通常拥有更准确的产品质量信息， 然而不同产品质量的商家会有不同的目标：提供优质产品的商家希望把真实的质量信息传递给顾客，从而把自己和劣质产品的商家区分开来，而劣质产品的销售者则希望尽可能的掩盖质量信息。如果优质产品的商家可以采取某些无法被劣质商家模仿的策略（比如投入大量的资金用于广告宣传），那么顾客就可以从这些策略（通常被称为信号）中推出关于产品质量的真实信息，从而更加愿意提前购买。 有效的传递关于质量信息的信号在提前销售的情况下更加困难，却至关重要。令人吃惊的是这个重要的问题却从来没有被研究过。在本课题中，我们将要研究商家如何在采用提前销售策略的同时有效的传递关于质量信息的信号。我们还将探讨这些信号传递策略对于顾客消费行为和商家利润的影响。具体来说，我们将会要研究 （1） 各种提前销售策略（比如定价，供应限额，广告，以及他们的各种组合）在传递质量信息信号方面的效力和效率； （2） 质量信息的信号传递策略应如何随着商家的运作能力（比如产能，成本）和市场状况（比如顾客需求的多样性和多变性）而改变； （3） 质量信息的信号传递策略对于消费者效用，商家利润，和社会总福利的影响。

646911.label: Realisation of objectives
646911.value: 1. This objective has been fully achieved. We have examined and compared three signals of quality in advance selling: pricing, capacity rationing, and advertising. We have also evaluated the combination of the three signals. We find that all the signals and their combinations can ensure separation of sellers with different quality, even though the high-quality seller always needs to distort his advance-selling strategy to differentiate from the low-quality seller. Specifically, the high-quality seller can signal his type via strategy distortion of either lower price, or less capacity ration, or higher advertising expenditure, or a combination of the three. Among all these alternatives, a combination of lower price and less capacity ration during advance selling achieves the seller separation at the lowest signaling cost. 2. This objective has been fully achieved. We have characterized the seller’s signaling strategies as functions of the seller’s total capacity, the seller’s marginal cost of production (or service), the difference in quality between high-quality and low-quality sellers, as well as the heterogeneity in consumers’ valuations. We find that signaling in advance selling is effective only if the seller’s total capacity is sufficiently large and the seller’s marginal cost is sufficiently low. As the quality difference increases, to signal quality, the high-quality seller needs to distort his strategy more (e.g., reserve more capacity to sell in the spot market). Meanwhile, consumers’ valuation heterogeneity does not affect the efficacy or efficiency of the quality signals in advance selling. 3. This objective has been fully achieved. We find that signaling does not affect low-quality seller’s profit, but always hurts the high-quality seller’s profit. On the other hand, signaling does not influence the seller’s decision on whether and when to offer advance selling, but does make an impact on how to do it (as described in the second point). In the meantime, signaling quality does not affect aggregate consumer surplus, and in general reduces the overall social surplus.

646911.label: Major findings and research outcome
646911.value: As a benchmark, we first examine the case where the seller and the consumers have symmetric information about quality. We describe how the seller’s optimal strategy and benefits of advance selling depend on the interdependence of consumer valuation, as well as capacity level and other market parameters. We find that a change in valuation interdependence can lead to dramatically different policies for the seller. For example, when individual valuations are highly diverse and consumer population is large, the seller must offer a discount during advance selling, but she may limit the advance sales. On the other hand, when valuations are highly correlated, the seller can charge a premium price during advance selling. For the same valuation interdependence, the qualitative nature of the optimal strategy changes with available capacity. A paper based on this work, titled “Advance Selling: Effects of Interdependent Consumer Valuations and Seller’s Capacity”, has been accepted by Management Science. For the main case when the information about quality is asymmetric during advance selling, we characterize the seller's signaling strategy and find that rationing of capacity in the advance period is an effective tool of signaling product quality. We find that the high-quality seller can distinguish herself by allocating less capacity than the low-quality seller in the advance period. We show that this signaling mechanism exists whenever advance selling would be optimal for both the high-quality and low-quality sellers if quality was known by the consumers. Interestingly, when compared to the case when rationing is not allowed, the seller's ability to ration (rationing flexibility) sometimes makes the seller worse off, independently of her quality. A paper based on this work, titled “Rationing Capacity in Advance Selling to Signal Quality”, has been accepted by Management Science.

646911.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
646911.value: A potential direction to extend the work is to examine advance selling of multiple products. In particular, it is of much practical value to evaluate how the relationships among the products (e.g., complementarity or substitutability, positive or negative correlations in valuations) affect the strategies of advance selling and the efficacy of quality signals. A research proposal has been submitted to RGC about this further research.

646911.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
646911.value: Advance selling is a standard marketing policy in many service industries. Although advance selling can substantially improve sellers’ profit, many consumers hesitate to buy in advance, due to their uncertainties associated with product quality. On the other hand, the sellers usually have better information about quality than consumers and have different incentives depending on the quality of their products. This project shows how a seller offering high-quality products can convey a signal of her quality to consumers during advance selling. We show that limiting supply in advance can be a very effective signaling strategy and it can be more efficient than other commonly-used signals such as pricing or advertising. In the meanwhile, signalling quality in advance selling can be very costly to the high-quality seller, as she has to distort her strategy from what she would do if the quality was known by the consumers. Thus, such a strategy needs to be carefully evaluated and adopted with caution.

647011.value: 由期权价格推算的随机风险溢率

647011.label: Project Objectives
647011.value: In the first stage, the simplest functional form of the stochastic discount factor will be chosen which contains a factor related to stochastic volatility, in addition to the wealth level. This simplest functional form corresponds to the so-called affine jump-diffusion models in the options pricing literature. The purpose is to establish the dependence of risk premiums on stochastic volatility. In the second stage, more flexible functional forms will be used as alternative hypotheses to the affine jump-diffusion models. The purpose is to explore the direction in which the options pricing models can be improved, as recent empirical studies indicate that the affine jump-diffusion models are mis-specified.

This simplest functional form corresponds to the so-called affine jump-diffusion models in the options pricing literature. In the second stage, more flexible functional forms will be used as alternative hypotheses to the affine jump-diffusion models. The purpose is to explore the direction in which the options pricing models can be improved, as recent empirical studies indicate that the affine jump-diffusion models are mis-specified.

647011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
647011.value: This project proposes to investigate the dependence of asset pricing risk premiums on the stochastic volatility of the aggregate wealth. In conventional models variables such as consumption and wealth levels are use as the state variables. Models using these variables face certain empirical challenges. The choice of the stochastic volatility of the aggregate wealth as the additional state variable has both good economic reasons and strong practical support. Classical, static asset pricing models have used unconditional market portfolio volatility as a measure of the risk of market portfolio. It is natural to use the conditional market volatility as a state variable in a dynamic model. On the practical side, various volatility indexes have been designed and derivatives using them as underlying have been traded in major exchanges around world. This is the evidence that the conditional market volatility plays an important role in asset pricing. The proposed project uses options data to infer and verify the dependence of risk premiums on conditional market volatility, as the cross-sections of options data provide unambiguous estimation of the conditional distribution of future asset prices, which cannot be accomplished by the time-series of the underlying market return itself. The results of the project will shed light on several asset pricing puzzles and enhance our understanding of asset pricing practice in the real world. 本课题研究资产定价中的风险溢酬对非常规的经济状态变量的依赖。 由消费或财富等常规的经济状态变量所构成的风险溢酬在实证研究中受到挑战。 本课题所选用的非常规的经济状态变量是代表总体经济的股票市场的随机波幅。 这一选择既有很好的经济理论依据,又有很强的实际背景。 经典的静态资产定价模型用无条件的市场组合的波幅作为市场组合的风险度量。 在动态模型中将此推广为随机波幅极为自然。在实际的市场中, 各种波幅指数已被设计出来。 以它们为标的物的衍生工具在各大交易所有着大量的交易。 这一现象见证了市场随机波幅在资产定价中的重要作用。 本课题利用期权数据推断和验证风险溢酬对市场随机波幅的依赖, 因为期权的横截面数据可以对未来证券价格的条件分布给出确切的估算, 而标的物的时间序列数据则无法做到这点。 本课题的结果将对资产定价研究中的若干疑难问题找出解答, 并提升我们对资产定价理论在实践中应用的理解。

647011.label: Realisation of objectives
647011.value: All the initial objectives have been realized. I proposed a model using a simple functional form of stochastic discount factor which contains a factor related to stochastic volatility, in addition to the wealth level. With a former student, I estimated the model using S&P 500 index options data. This simple functional form corresponds to the so-called affine jump-diffusion models in the options pricing literature. It established the dependence of risk premiums on stochastic volatility. The simple affine jump-diffusion models, however, are too restrictive. More flexible functional forms are to be specified that improve model performance. We formally tested the inadequacy of the affine jump diffusion models and proposed several alternatives. We used simulation, as the closed-form solutions of the alternatives are not available, to show that these alternative specifications indeed improve option pricing.

The purpose is to explore the direction in which the options pricing models can be improved, as recent empirical studies indicate that the affine jump-diffusion models are mis-specified.

647011.label: Major findings and research outcome
647011.value: We found that affine jump-diffusion models are unsatisfactory in describing the options data and the problem is often attributed to the diffusion term of the unobserved state variables. Using prices of variance-swaps (i.e., squared VIX) implied from options prices, we provided fresh evidence regarding the misspecification of affine jump-diffusion models, as variance-swap prices are affine functions of the state variables in a broader class of models that do not restrict the diffusion term of the state variables. We applied the nonparametric methodology, supplemented with bootstrap tests and other parametric tests, to the S&P 500 index options data. We found that, while the affine diffusion term of the state variables may contribute to the misspecification as the literature has suggested, the affine drift of the state variables, jump intensities, and risk premiums are also sources of misspecification. Part of the results of the project is published in the Journal of Financial Economics in 2013.

647011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
647011.value: The results of the project open the door for further tests of potential non-affine models of options pricing. I plan to first examine the feasibility of quadratic models of options pricing. As closed forms are difficult to come by, semi-parametric approaches combined with simulation will be used.

647011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
647011.value: This project investigated the dependence of asset pricing risk premiums on the stochastic volatility of the aggregate wealth. In conventional models variables such as consumption and wealth levels are use as the state variables. Models using these variables face certain empirical challenges. The choice of the stochastic volatility of the aggregate wealth as the additional state variable has both good economic reasons and strong practical support. It is natural to use the conditional market volatility as a state variable in a dynamic model. On the practical side, various volatility indexes have been designed and derivatives using them as underlying have been traded in major exchanges around world. This is the evidence that the conditional market volatility plays an important role in asset pricing. The existing models in the literature with linear specifications are not good enough in their performance. This project used options data to infer and verify the dependence of risk premiums on conditional market volatility and provide evidence that the dependence of asset prices on the state variables are non-linear. It opened door for researchers to further improve model specifications. The results of the project shed light on several asset pricing puzzles and enhanced understanding of asset pricing practice in the real world.

647111.label: Project Title(Chinese)
647111.value: 会计准则，资本分配和经济效率

647111.label: Project Objectives
647111.value: To develop a theoretical model that integrates the role of accounting standards into an established asset pricing framework. To determine theoretically how the quality of accounting standards impact asset prices, expected returns (costs of capital), and systematic risks. To demonstrate how changes in accounting standards affect the real decisions of firms in different risk classes, and how capital allocation in the economy is affected. To examine how total welfare is affected by a change in accounting standards, and the different channels via which welfare is affected.
rows: To develop a theoretical model that integrates the role of accounting standards into an established asset pricing framework.
To determine theoretically how the quality of accounting standards impact asset prices, expected returns (costs of capital), and systematic risks.
To demonstrate how changes in accounting standards affect the real decisions of firms in different risk classes, and how capital allocation in the economy is affected.
To examine how total welfare is affected by a change in accounting standards, and the different channels via which welfare is affected.

647111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
647111.value: I propose to conduct a theoretical study to examine how the quality of accounting standards impacts real investment activity and capital allocation in an economy. A key function of capital markets is to guide capital towards profitable investment opportunities. Proper functioning of capital markets hinges on accurate business information about firms. Accounting standards are developed to govern the content and form of company reporting. In practice, investors’ information needs are not always well served because of distortions in reported data, and the information investors receive often does not represent an objective and accurate view of the underlying businesses. Thus, it is important that high-quality accounting standards be established to facilitate the production and reporting of truthful information. While regulators and investors generally believe that good accounting standards are vital for keeping capital markets in order and ensuring the efficient flow of capital to productive uses, there has been a paucity of theoretical research examining the role of accounting standards. At a conceptual level, how standards influence market trading and real activity is still not well-understood. My purpose in this project is to develop a theoretical model to examine the real and financial impact of accounting standards. I will first extend a classical asset pricing setting (such as that of the Capital Asset Pricing Model) by introducing real investment opportunities at the firm level. I will consider two types of uncertainty about the cash flows from real projects: one arising from imperfect measurement of realized business activities, and the other caused by unpredictable future economic events. Accounting standards dictate how individual firms measure their economic activities, and because firms must adopt the same set of standards their financial reports contain errors correlated with one another. Accounting errors distort the view of business operations, and this adds to the total uncertainty faced by investors. Furthermore, because errors are correlated across firms, they cannot be diversified away. Improving the quality of accounting standards will reduce the accounting-induced uncertainty, which will benefit both investors (due to a smaller total risk) and firms (which will make more accurate investment decisions). In my analysis, I will examine how uncertainties arising from imperfect accounting standards affect asset valuations and the cost of capital. More importantly, I will examine how an improvement in accounting standards can cause firms to adjust their real investment activities and how this leads to changes in capital allocation and welfare. 本研究项目从理论上探讨会计准则的质量对实体经济投资活动及资本分配的影响。 资本市场的主要功能是进行有效的资源分配、促进实体经济的发展，而会计准则在当中扮演重要角色。现实中，公司披露的信息往往缺乏真实性，不能客观、准确地展示公司的经营活动和效益，从而妨碍合理的资金分配。高质量的会计及披露准则有助于提高公司提供的信息的有用性，更好地让投资者了解公司的经济状况。但是，对于会计准则究竟怎样在资本市场及实体经济中起积极的作用目前还缺乏理论研究。 本研究的目的是通过建立理论模型，分析会计准则的质量对以下几个方面的影响：（1）投资者面临的不确定性，（2）公司的资金成本，（3）资本投资的效率，及（4）经济体系内资源分布。

647311.label: Project Title(Chinese)
647311.value: 长尾理论-无穷的选择是否意味着无尽的需求？

647311.label: Project Objectives
647311.value: Examine comprehensive book-sales data and investigate the limitations of the long tail theory. Compare the predictive validity of the long tail theory and the preferential attachment theory. Offer managerial implications to niche product sellers.
rows: Examine comprehensive book-sales data and investigate the limitations of the long tail theory.
Compare the predictive validity of the long tail theory and the preferential attachment theory.
Offer managerial implications to niche product sellers.

647311.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
647311.value: The long tail theory states that as a result of the Internet, the economy is increasingly shifting away from a small number of hit products at the head of the demand curve and toward niches in the tail. It implies that niche producers should have more sales today. We will examine this theory in the book industry. Our initial results based on a sample dataset suggest that while niche books indeed sell more copies, in each book category, the share of the top performers increases over time, suggesting a superstar effect. More interestingly, this superstar effect is stronger for book sales from online channels than from offline channels, and is also stronger in regions with more Internet usage. These results imply that the benefit of the long tail at the industry level goes disproportionately to the few top performers within each category, and on average a niche product today is more likely to have lower sales than before. Our study tests between two very influential but competing theories, the long tail theory and the preferential attachment theory. The former claims that firms applying the long tail strategy can realize significant profit from selling a great variety of niche products instead of only selling large volumes of a few hit products. The preferential attachment theory, on the other hand, suggests that products that are already popular will be more popular in proportion to their popularity. This effect is also referred to, in various contexts, as the Yule process, Gilbrat’s law, Matthew effect, or “the rich get richer” effect. If we receive support for this proposal and are able to find similar results using the full dataset containing all book sales from 2004 to 2009, we could convincingly demonstrate that the long tail at the industry level is actually a "wrong" tail and that firms should not base their strategies on this influential theory. If we cannot replicate this result with the full dataset, then our findings will imply that the preferential attachment theory is not valid in this context. This can also be interesting because for researchers in many fields, preferential attachment theory is considered to be a law. 长尾理论指出，互联网的应用会导致市场需求由少数的位于需求曲线前端的热门产品，向需求曲线尾部的小众产品偏移。这个理论暗示着，在互联网日趋普及的今天，利基产品生产商应该会获得更多的销售额。我们将利用图书行业的数据来检验这个理论。 根据我们现在对样本数据的分析，结果显示在每个给定的图书类别内，虽然小众图书的销量确实上升了，但是随着时间的推移，畅销书的销售量占总销售量的比例越来越高，表现出一种超级明星效应。更有意思的是，恰恰与长尾理论的预期结果相反，和线下市场相比，这种超级明星效应在线上市场中更为显著；而且不同地区相比较，互联网用户越多的地区，这种超级明星效应也更强大。这就意味着，从行业层面的数据来看，在给定的图书类别中，长尾市场产生的利益不成比例的被畅销者获取了，而小众产品平均下来获得的销售量，更有可能比传统市场更低。 在解释市场需求分布的理论中，有两个影响力巨大但相互排斥的理论。一个是长尾理论，这个理论指出如果企业销售的产品的种类越多，差异越多，而不仅仅是销售大量的一两部畅销作品，那么企业就能获得更多的利润。另一个是依附理论，相反的，这个理论指出畅销的产品会变得越来越畅销，占总销售额的比重会越来越高。依附理论和长尾理论一样，非常著名，它有很多别名，例如马太效应，尤尔过程，吉尔布拉特定律，富人越来越富效应等等。我们的研究能够有力的验证究竟这两个理论中哪一个理论在图书行业中产生了实际的影响。 如果我们的研究能获得支持，让我们能够使用2004年至2009年的所有图书销售数据作进一步分析的话，假如我们进一步发现相似结论，我们就可以确信的指出长尾理论在图书行业中并不适用，企业不应该依照长尾理论来制定商业策略。但是假如我们用完整的数据之后无法再重现相似的结果，那就暗示着依附理论在图书行业中是不适用的。这样的结论依然很有价值，因为很多领域中的研究者都认为依附理论是一个普适定律。

647311.label: Realisation of objectives
647311.value: All the objectives are achieved. We examined comprehensive book-sales data and found the limitations of the long tail theory. We verified the validity of preferential attachment theory and found that near the head of the distribution, the long tail theory loses to to the preferential attachment theory. From a managerial point of view, our research suggests that the long tail theory applies more in the tail of the distribution. Its validity in the head does not always hold.

647311.label: Major findings and research outcome
647311.value: Our major findings is that the long tail theory needs to be modified. Specifically, we find that products in the head of the distribution do not always lose market share to niche products. So instead of a counter-clockwise rotation of the demand curve, we have a steeper head and a flatter tail. The long tail theory can only explain the flatter tail and may have a wrong conclusion with respect to the change in the head.

647311.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
647311.value: Since the data used in this study is from book sales. We do not know how the long tail theory should be modified for other products such as DVDs, music, etc. Future work should examine other markets and see if the long tail theory needs to be completely changed or just slightly modified for some product categories.

647311.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
647311.value: The long tail theory states that as a result of the Internet, the economy is increasingly shifting away from a small number of hit products at the head of the demand curve and toward niches in the tail. It implies that niche producers should have more sales today. We examined this theory in the book industry. Our results show that while niche books indeed sell more copies, in each book category, the share of the top performers also increased over time. This superstar effect is stronger for book sales from online channels than from offline channels, and is also stronger in regions with more Internet usage. We demonstrate that the “long tail” at the industry level is actually a "wrong" tail and that firms should not base their strategies on this influential theory. Instead, the preferential attachment theory remains to be a law in similar settings to better describe book sales.

647611.label: Project Title(Chinese)
647611.value: 具有多个非可靠供应渠道的存货系统管理

647611.label: Co - Investigator(s)
647611.value: Prof Li, Qing Prof Yao, David

647611.label: Project Objectives
647611.value: To study inventory systems with multiple unreliable suppliers, where each supplier may suffer from random disruption. We will explore the structures of the optimal policy, and the structures of the objective functions which will help to determine the optimal policy, and will study the value and impact of supply diversification. To study the replenishment problem for systems with multiple suppliers and random yields. We will explore the structural properties of the policy and objective function, derive conditions under which there exists simple optimal policy, and study the impacts of yield variability on the firm's return and on the replenishment strategy. These will provide insight about how manufacturers select their suppliers, and will also help to characterize the supplier incentive to improve production stability.
rows: To study inventory systems with multiple unreliable suppliers, where each supplier may suffer from random disruption. We will explore the structures of the optimal policy, and the structures of the objective functions which will help to determine the optimal policy, and will study the value and impact of supply diversification.

To study the replenishment problem for systems with multiple suppliers and random yields. We will explore the structural properties of the policy and objective function, derive conditions under which there exists simple optimal policy, and study the impacts of yield variability on the firm's return and on the replenishment strategy. These will provide insight about how manufacturers select their suppliers, and will also help to characterize the supplier incentive to improve production stability.

647611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
647611.value: Under the trend of globalization and with a great pressure from cost competition, outsourcing is popularly used by many companies. For such companies, the efficiency of operations relies heavily on its suppliers’ reliability. A supplier could be unreliable due to possible production disruptions, yield randomness, or uncertainties in available capacity. When faced with these kinds of supply sources, it is imperative that the company’s replenishment decisions take into account the supply risks and related cost implications. In particular, the company may need to protect itself from the unreliability by having diversified suppliers. In this project, we will study a periodic-review inventory system with multiple supply sources under general settings, considering various uncertainties of the supply sources. The suppliers may differ in their unit prices, delivery lead times, probabilities of disruptions / yields of production (delivery), and distributions of available supply capacities. We aim at developing simple optimal dynamic control policies that determine the order quantities from each of the suppliers in each period, taking into account the supply risk as well as the cost/lead time implication. We will identify conditions under which the optimal policy has a monotonic structure, or is of threshold type. We will also explore various structural properties of the objective function which will help simplify the procedure for searching for the optimal policy. Since it is technically challenging to compute the optimal policy and practically inconvenient to implement it for systems with random yield, in this project we will also develop simple and efficient heuristic policies that could be easily determined and implemented. In addition, we will also study the operational effect of supply uncertainty (risk). In particular, we will study how the yield and capacity variability of supply sources impact the optimal replenishment policy and the firm's performance. This will provide useful insight into the management of such a system. Findings from this project will (1) advance the state of art of supply chain research by studying a new inventory replenishment model which is theoretically significant, and (2) generate insights and new tools that help companies to manage various supply risks, which is of practical importance in supply chain management. 供应商经常由于不同原因具有不同程度的可靠性。 拥有这样供应商的公司在考虑存货管理时，必须同时考虑价格和供应风险的影响。 策略之一是使用多个供应商以分散风险。 本课题研究具有两个非可靠供应商的多时段存货系统。两个供应商在价格，送货时间，可靠性等都有不同。 我们将致力于寻找简单的动态优化管理策略，以决定从每个供应商的订货量。我们将确定在什么条件下，最优策略具有简单的结构。 我们也将研究目标函数的性质， 以及供应非确定性对系统的影响。

647711.label: Project Title(Chinese)
647711.value: 管理消費者體驗: 人們如何記住、評估及推薦混合的消費體驗?

647711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
647711.value: In recent years, the field of marketing has evolved away from the discipline of selling products to the discipline of creating experiences for consumers. Indeed, practitioners and academics alike are writing extensively about how to create memorable consumer experiences and stressing the role of good experiences in subsequent purchasing behavior. These strategies include enhancing the positive elements of the experience, and mitigating the effects of the negative elements (e.g., waiting times, negative emotions). Given this new focus on consumer experiences and their importance in satisfaction and repeat purchasing behavior, it is imperative for consumer researchers to understand how consumers remember, value, choose from, and recommend experiences. In the proposed research, our goal is to understand consumer experiences and decision-making through a consumer psychology lens. In particular, we ask the following questions: 1) How do consumers remember rich and mixed experiences (i.e., experiences that have elements of both pleasure – e.g., a Disneyland ride – and a cost – e.g. waiting and driving through traffic to get there)? Which elements of the experience remain relatively untouched by time, and which ones decay? 2) Based on memories of the past, how do consumers evaluate those mixed experiences? This question is crucial as such evaluation usually drives the way consumers make decisions about future consumption and their recommendations to others. 3) How do factors related to the nature of the experience, the consumer, or the decision context, affect the memory and valuation of experiences? 4) How can marketers best structure these experiences to maximize value to consumers? Our research aims to be amongst the first to propose a comprehensive framework that is both psychologically descriptive and managerially prescriptive. 近年來，市場營銷的領域逐步由售賣貨品演化成創造消費者體驗。事實上，從業人員和學者在廣泛地撰寫如何創造難忘的消費者體驗和強調美好體驗在其後的購物行為中擔當的角色。這些策略包括提升體驗中的正面原素及緩和負面原素的影響（例如等候時間、負面情緒）。基於現在對消費者體驗的注重及其在重購和滿意度上的重要性，消費行為的研究者必須明白消費者如何記住、評估、選擇及推薦他們的體驗。 在這個研究提案中，我們的目標是要透過消費者的心理角度從而明白消費者的體驗和決策行為。我們會特別地問及以下的問題： １． 消費者如何記憶內容豐富和混合的體驗（即體驗既包含愉快－例如：迪士尼之旅－又有成本原素－例如：要經過堵車時的等候及駕車時間才能到達迪士尼）？哪些體驗原素相對地未受時間影響及哪些原素會減弱？ ２． 基於過往的記憶，消費者如何評估這些混合體驗？這是個十分關鍵的問題，因為這些評估通常會決定消費者在將來如何作有關消費決定及向別人推薦。 ３． 和體驗本身、消費者或決策情景有關的因素如何影響對體驗的記憶及評估？ ４． 營銷人員如何能最佳地組織這些體驗以實現給予消費者的價值最大化？ 我們的研究目的旨在成為最先提出一個具有心理層面描述和管理層面規定的全面框架。

647711.label: Realisation of objectives
647711.value: In this research, we seek to understand the psychology behind the way people remember and evaluate rich and mixed consumption experiences. Our first broad objective is to investigate the heuristics and strategies that people rely on to come up with an evaluation based on memory of a past experience. We argue that rather than fully integrating the elements in a mixed experience with both positive and negative events (value accounting) which requires too much cognitive resources, people may utilize a simple heuristic called “valence accounting”. That is, people’s global evaluation may be driven by the net number of positive events (i.e., the number of positive events minus the number of negative events). Another heuristic that people may use is to evaluate an experience based on key features in the experience such as peak points and end points. Results from our field studies and experiments had provided evidence for using such heuristics and identified conditions under which people use them. Apart from the strategies that people employ, we also aim to understand how the composition and structure of a mixed experience influences people’s memory and judgment. In particular, we looked at how the length of runs of positive and negative events within the experience influence the evaluation and how this factor interacts with the timing of the evaluation (made right after the experience vs. after a delay). We expect that if an experience involves positive and negative events that follow each other in short runs, such experience would be perceived as less extreme than if there are longer runs of positive and negative events (i.e., events of positive and negative valence are separated in time). In addition, we predict that for experience with longer runs, people’s evaluation would be driven either by primacy or recency effects depending on the timing of the evaluation. We have found support for such hypotheses in a series of studies. Lastly, we study how consumer-related and contextual factors influence consumers’ evaluation of past experience with mixed valence. In particular, we believe that the psychological distance with which people makes the evaluation would have an impact on what aspects of the experience they focus on. Finally, we extend our research to study cross-cultural differences in memory and evaluation of mixed experience. Several studies (including cross-cultural studies) have been run for this purpose. Till now, we have achieved all the objectives of this research.

647711.label: Major findings and research outcome
647711.value: First, in order to investigate the heuristics that people use to evaluate an experience with mixed valence, we ran some field studies and experiments. In these studies, participants actually went through (or were told to imagine that they went through) a series of events, then they were asked to recall and evaluate their overall experience. Our results suggest that their retrospective evaluation is driven by valence accounting, rather than value accounting. In other words, they rely on the net number of positive events (i.e., the number of positive events minus the number of negative events) as a cue. In addition, we found when people’s cognitive resources are strained, even valence accounting becomes too taxing. Under such circumstances, people would resort to certain key features in the sequence (e.g., peak, end) to assess the experience. In the second part of the research, we studied how the structure of the mixed experience influences how people remember and evaluate it. We ran several experiments where people read about and imagined that they went through a series of events with either short runs or long runs. Results indeed suggest that people perceive an experience to be less extreme when positive and negative events follow each other in short runs than when there are longer runs of positive and negative events. Furthermore, we found that different parts of the experience carry varying weights depending on when the experience is evaluated. When evaluation is made immediately afterwards, the last few events drive the overall evaluation to a great extent (recency effects). However, after a delay, people’s evaluation is influenced mostly by the first few events in the consumption experiences (primacy effects). In the last project of the research, we studied the implications of psychological distance. In particular, we found that when people feel psychologically distant from a past experience, their evaluation is driven mostly by desirability aspects of the experience (how interesting the sights were). In contrast, when they feel psychologically close to the past experience, they based the evaluation more on feasibility aspects (such as the weather and traffic jam). In addition, in several cross-cultural studies, we compared the way people from different cultures evaluate past consumption experiences of mixed valence. It was found that consumers from interdependent cultures focused more on feasibility concerns whereas people from independent cultures paid more attention to desirability concerns.

647711.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
647711.value: We are in the process of writing up the results as two papers to be submitted to journals. In addition, we plan to offer some insights to managers on how service providers and marketing managers could better design their offerings so as to ensure favorable retrospective evaluation of consumption experiences and positive word-of-mouth.

647711.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
647711.value: A mixed consumption experience (such as a vacation or a visit to a theme park) is interspersed with events of both positive (e.g., a fun ride) and negative valence (e.g., bad service at a restaurant). People often evaluate such experience retrospectively because such assessment would help them make future decisions or make recommendations to others. This research investigates the strategies that people use to arrive at such an evaluation. It was found that consumers often rely on some simple heuristics such as tallying the number of positive versus negative events or focusing on a few key events that are most memorable. In addition, we study factors related to the consumers or the experience itself that may influence this memory-based evaluation process. With an understanding of the underlying psychological processes, we hope to offer some insights as to how marketers could better allocate resources and manage the overall consumption experience to increase evaluation and satisfaction. This greater satisfaction could then translate into repeat purchase or favorable recommendation to others.

647911.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
647911.value: Payment methods evolve. Commodity money, dominant in a significant part of documented history, is a payment method in past. Government-issued currency or cash, the leading textbook example of payment methods and part of most people's daily experience, only serves a small portion of transaction volumes in any developed economy. In such an economy, payment methods such as credit cards, debit cards and direct transfer to bank accounts have sharply increased their market shares over the last quarter century. Payments by those methods, in contrast to cash payments, rely on complicated payment systems that involve intermediate institutions (e.g. banks), clearing house, settlement rules, etc. Policy related questions abound. Should the government encourage one payment method over another? Should there be or not be free entry of a new payment method? What should be the goals and criteria to regulate a payment system? What are the roles of a central bank in a payment system? How should monetary policy be conducted when conventionally-defined money, cash and demand deposits, serves a declining portion of people's expenditures? To address these questions, one should have a framework to tell the social and private costs of a payment method and the social and private benefits of that method. In this project, we propose a common approach to payment methods and payment systems. The starting point is that different payment methods in practice share a common function---create messages about actions which are not publicly monitored. Beyond this function, they may differ in many aspects. For example, a check payment has a default risk but a cash payment does not. The common approach is to model the common monitoring function and the critical differences among different payment methods. 付款方式是發展的。商品貨幣，政府發行的貨幣或現金，信用卡，借記卡和銀行賬戶直接轉移是爲人熟知例子。政策相關的問題比比皆是。政府是否應鼓勵某一種付款方式？如果是否應鼓勵私人企業自由提供一個新的付款方式？規範支付系統的目標和標准應該是什麼？什麼是中央銀行在支付系統的角色？ 爲了解決這些問題，應該有一個框架能夠分析付款方式的社會和私人利益的社會成本和私人成本。在這個項目中，我們提出了一個關於支付方式和支付系統的共同的模型。其出發點是不同的付款方式在實踐中共享一個共同的功能---創建有關這部分監測行動的消息。此功能之外，它們可能在許多方面有所不同。我們將模型這個共同的監控功能和不同的付款方式之間的關鍵差異。這是我們在項目的方法。

660011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
660011.value: The posttranslational modification of proteins by the addition of various sugar groups is known as glycosylation and proteins modified in this way are called glycoproteins. Glycosylation is an evolutionarily conserved feature of eukaryotic cells that is carried out by enzymes called glycosyltransferases. Initiation of glycosylation begins in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) whereafter glycoproteins are subject to further sugar addition in the Golgi apparatus. In the Golgi, glycosyltransferases sequentially modify glycoproteins as they transit the various sub-compartments of this organelle. Glycosyltransferases exhibit Golgi sub-compartment specific distributions, which often reflect the sequential order in which they act in glycosylation. The severity and broad nature of diseases in humans that are associated with glycosylation defects exemplify the importance of glycosylation for eukaryotic organisms. Such in born errors of metabolism are known as congenital deficiencies in glycosylation (CDG). The spectrum of symptoms displayed by patients with CDG reveal the central importance of glycosylation in development and in the nervous system. In addition to their importance in the synthesis of glycoproteins, glycosyltransferases have served as tools by which to study mechanisms of protein localization within the Golgi. Glycosyltransferases are type II integral membrane proteins comprised of a short (5-20 amino acid) cytoplasmically exposed carboxy terminal (C-terminal) region, followed by a single transmembrane spanning sequence and an amino terminal (N-terminal) luminal enzymatic domain. In a previously funded GRF proposal my laboratory identified a novel mechanism by which glycosyltransferases are retained in the Golgi (Tu et al., (2008) Science, 321, 404-7). This process is dependent on an evolutionarily conserved peripheral Golgi membrane protein termed Vps74p. Vps74p binds directly to the cytoplasmic “tails” of Golgi resident glycosyltransferases as well as to the Golgi transport vesicle-generating coat complex, known as COPI. Since our discovery, Vps74p has been shown to be a novel PI(4)P-binding protein, and in human cells a homologue of Vps74p, GOLPH3, was identified as a novel oncogene - observations that suggest a link between Vps74p / GOLPH3 and Golgi-directed intracellular signaling pathways. In this funding application I propose to identify the binding sites on Vps74p for glycosyltransferase C-terminal tails as well as the binding sites on COPI and Vps74p that mediate their mutual interactions. In addition, I propose to identify intra-cellular signaling pathways that mediate Vps74p-dependent alterations to Golgi protein retention that occur in response to changes in nutrient composition. 蛋白质的翻译后修饰过程中的一种被称为糖基化，经过糖基化过程修饰的蛋白质被称为糖蛋白。糖基化是真核细胞进化过程中得以保留的一种特性，这一过程是通过糖基转移酶来完成的。糖基化过程起始于内质网，之后糖蛋白上的糖基延长在高尔基体中完成。在高尔基体内，随着糖蛋白经过高尔基体各个分区，不同的区域的糖基转移酶依次对糖蛋白进行修饰。糖基转移酶特异性的分布在高尔基体的各个分区，这一特异性分布的特点也与它们在糖基化过程中的作用次序相对应。在人类细胞中，糖基化过程的缺陷往往导致广泛而且严重的人类疾病，比如说先天性糖基化缺陷症，这类病人表现出的一系列症状，反映出糖基化过程在发育和神经系统中的重要的核心作用。这例证了糖基化对于真核细胞生物的重要意义。 糖基转移酶除了在糖蛋白合成过程中起到重要的作用之外，它们还是研究高尔基体中蛋白定位机制的重要工具。糖基转移酶是二型跨膜蛋白，由三部分结构和功能区域构成：存在于细胞基质中的氨基端序列（通常为5－20个氨基酸），单一的跨膜序列，和存在于细胞器内部的羟基端的酶功能区域。在前一个GRF资助的研究计划书中，我的实验室研究发现并鉴定出了新的糖基转移酶在高尔基体中定位的机制［Tu et al., (2008) Science, 321, 404-7］。这一新的机制受到一个在进化过程中高度保守的高尔基体外周膜蛋白Vps74p的调控。Vps74p与位于高尔基体的糖基转移酶的细胞基质尾部序列有直接的相互作用，同时Vps74p也能与生成高尔基体运输膜泡的包被蛋白复合体COPI有直接相互作用。在我们研究发现了Vps74p的功能之后，其他科研小组又发现Vps74p是一个新的与PI(4)P有相互作用的蛋白，以及在人类细胞中，Vps74p的同源蛋白GOLPH3被发现是一个新的致癌基因——这一系列的发现暗示了Vps74p/GOLPH3和以高尔基体为核心的细胞内信号传导途径的相关性。 在此次科研项目资金申请中，我提议在Vps74p上寻找糖基转移酶氨基端尾部序列的作用位点，以及分别在COPI和Vps74p上，寻找这两个蛋白之间相互作用的位点。另外，我提议鉴定出在营养成分发生变化的情况下，介导依赖于Vps74p的高尔基体蛋白定位变化的细胞内信号传导途径。

660011.label: Major findings and research outcome
660011.value: This study has provided additional important mechanistic insight into how Vps74 (and its mammalian counterpart(s)) mediate the retention of glycosyltransferases in the Golgi. The main findings from this work have been published (Tu, L., Chen, L. and Banfield, D.K. (2012) A Conserved N-terminal Arginine-Motif in GOLPH3-Family Proteins Mediates Binding to Coatomer. Traffic 13: 1496-1507.) We have identified the amino acids required for coupling Vps74p to the COPI-coat, and additionally, identified residues on Vps74p that are required for binding of the N-terminus of Kre2p (a medial resident glycosyltransferase). Importantly, this mechanism seems also to be relevant to human cells as human Vps74 (GOLPH3) functions similarly in our assays. Of additional significance is the finding that uncoupling the ability of Vps74p to bind to COPI is sufficient to prevent retention of one glycosyltransferase (Kre2p) in the Golgi. These data rule-out any indirect effect on Golgi lipid composition as has been proposed by others - based on Vps74p's relationship with the PI4P phosphatase Sac1p. Indeed, our unpublished data reveals that disruption of the interaction between Vps74p and Sac1p is phenotypically no worse than that of a sac1 deletion, and that deletion of the sac1 gene does not phenocopy a vps74 deletion.

660011.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
660011.value: Over the duration of this research proposal we have expanded the scope of the Vps74 studies considerably. Manuscripts are in preparation describing the relationship between two ER/Golgi resident phosphodiesterases as well as one in which additional Golgi residents are identified as substrates for Vps74p-mediated retention. We have leveraged a temperature sensitive phenotype of one allele of vps74 to conduct dosage suppressor screens. These screens have revealed several heretofore anticipated components of the Golgi trafficking machinery as well as revealing unexpected relationships between Vps74p, phosphodiesterases and the cell cycle, the spindle checkpoint and DNA repair. These data will form the basis for a GRF submission in the 2015/16 cycle.

660011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
660011.value: Glycosylation is perhaps the most prevalent form of protein modification in cells and defects in this process have been linked to cancer as well as to a number development deficiencies in humans. A critical requirement of proper glycosylation is the correct order of the enzymatic reactions involved, which is in turn mediated by a number of distinct glycosylation enzymes. The genetics and cell biology of glycosyltransferase localization is best addressed using a simple cell model organism - budding yeast. This research investigated the mechanism by which a key set of cellular enzymes (the Golgi resident glycosyltransferases) maintained their normal localization. We have established that such localization is reliant upon interactions between the enzymes, a sorting receptor (Vps74p) and components of the transport vesicle generating system - termed coatomer / COPI. Specifically, amino acid sequence alternations that disrupt interactions between the sorting receptor and coatomer were identified and characterised. We have also ascertained that disruption of the ability of the sorting receptor to bind to enzymes, coatomer or Golgi membranes disrupts enzyme localization. The experiment studies conducted during this research project have laid the ground work to expand the scope of future research into areas that directly relate to cell signalling processes that connect the Golgi to the cell cycle machinery.

660211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
660211.value: Motivated by the need to deliver therapeutic agents to the intracellular space, we aim to develop a polymeric vehicle to exploit cell-penetrating peptides (CPPs) for transporting cargos across the cell membrane. The first goal is to maximize the efficiency of CPP-mediated delivery. Based on previous experimental and simulation results, high peptide concentration increases the distribution in cytoplasm, either via direct translocation across the membrane or enhanced escape from endocytic vesicles. We hypothesize that a high local peptide concentration by attaching multiple copies of CPPs to the polymer is key to an efficient delivery vehicle. By choosing a biocompatible, hydrophilic polymer of appropriate size, the polymer shield will prolong the circulation half-life of CPPs, increase their stability, and enable passive targeting to the tumor tissues. The second goal is to improve the specificity of CPPs such that intracellular delivery will be localized at the targeted tissues. We propose to construct a polymer-CPP conjugate containing anionic quenchers linked to CPPs via peptide sequences cleavable by specific proteases. Since the electrostatic interaction between cationic CPPs and the negatively charged cell membrane is an essential first step for the intracellular entry, anionic sequences neutralizing CPPs and sterically hindering peptide-membrane contact will suppress the activity of CPPs. When the polymer-peptide conjugate reaches the target tissue where there is an overexpression of proteases, the anionic quenchers are released to restore the function of CPPs. Diseases such as cancer and arthritis are characterized by the overexpression of proteases and thus a proteolytic trigger is an appealing tool to target CPP activity. In this project, we will design and synthesize a new protease-activatable polymer-CPP conjugate, evaluate the dependence of intracellular distribution on loading density, carrier size and protease expression, and investigate the carrier’s potential for delivering anticancer therapeutics in vitro. By completing these objectives, we aim to provide a delivery vehicle useful for intracellular drug delivery and further the understanding of CPP-mediated delivery of macromolecular cargoes. 基於對細胞內藥物傳遞的需求，我們將致力於開發一種使用细胞穿透肽的聚合物運載工具來實現這一目標。第一步是最大限度地提高細胞穿透肽介導下藥物傳遞的效率。根據先前的實驗和模擬結果，丌論機理上是直接穿越細胞膜傳遞還是增強了從內吞囊泡逃逸的能力，細胞穿透肽濃度的升高都將提升其在細胞質之中的分佈。因此，我們假定通過將多份細胞穿透肽連接于聚合物從而達到較高的局部肽濃度是成為一個有效運載工具的關鍵。同時，通過使用一種具有合適尺寸和良好生物相容性的親水聚合物加以保護，細胞穿透肽的半衰期將得到有效的延長，其穩定性和對腫瘤組織的被動靶向作用也將得到提升。 第二步目標是提高細胞穿透肽的特異性，使其可以針對特定靶向組織進行細胞內藥物傳遞。我們計劃構建一種聚合物-細胞穿透肽共聚物，其中包含的陰離子猝滅劑通過一段可被特定蛋白裂解的肽和細胞穿透肽相連。由於帶正電的細胞穿透肽和帶負電的細胞膜之間的靜電作用是進入細胞內部的首要步驟，因而陰離子猝滅劑的中和作用以及細胞膜和共聚物之間的空間位阻效應都將抑制細胞穿透肽的活性。只有當共聚物到達有過表達蛋白酶所在的靶向組織時，陰離子猝滅劑才會將細胞穿透肽釋放，從而還原其功能。癌癥、關節炎等疾病均具有蛋白酶過標達的特徵，因此，有理由相信蛋白裂解將會有效控制細胞穿透肽的靶向作用。 在本項目中，我們將設計并合成一種新型的由蛋白酶激活的聚合物-細胞穿透肽共聚物，其次確定裝填密度，載體尺寸和蛋白酶表達與其在細胞內分佈之間的關係；同時，我們還將在體外環境下研究該載體在抗癌藥物傳遞方面的潛能。通過完成以上各級目標，我們希望能夠提供一種在細胞內藥物傳遞方面有效可行的運載工具，并進一步瞭解細胞穿透肽介導下的大分子藥物傳遞的相關機理。

660211.label: Realisation of objectives
660211.value: Oligoarginine is one of the most efficient cell-penetrating peptides (CPP) and has successfully delivered various cargoes intracellularly with its superior cellular uptake capacity. However, oligoarginine as well as other cell-penetrating peptides have disadvantages such as low drug carrying capacity and weak cargo protection. Also, the mechanism of the oligoarginine-mediated cellular uptake is still a controversial issue. In this project, we introduced this peptide into biodegradable polymeric nanoparticles through surface modification for uptake enhancement. Biodegradable block copolymer poly(ethylene glycol)-b-poly(ε-caprolactone) (PEG-b-PCL) was synthesized and modified by three different oligoarginines (R1, R4 and R8) respectively via one-step click chemistry. Narrowly-dispersed nanoparticles were obtained by self-assembly of modified block polymers, and all particles were found highly positively charged after modification. Cellular uptake and endocytic trafficking of the complexes were monitored using confocal microscope and flow cytometry. Moreover, we investigated the intracellular trafficking of different oligoarginine-modified polymeric particles, unveiling the effect of arginine density on uptake capacity, endocytic mechanism, subcellular localization and endosomal escape. In summary, the length of oligoarginine peptide modified on the particle surface determines the endocytic pathway and subcellular localization, while the density of arginine groups determines the cellular uptake and endosomal escape capacity. These findings will help the rational design of intracellular carriers or subcellular targeting carriers for different drug delivery purposes. Therefore, objectives 1-3 have been successfully completed. Technical difficulty was encountered to accomplish objective 4 and 5 on the synthesis and purification due to electrostatic interaction of the quenchers and CPP. Despite numerous attempts in changing the reaction conditions, polymer-CPP conjugates with anionic quenchers were not obtained. Subsequently, we altered our approach, quenching the CPP-polymer conjugates with an anionic polyelectrolyte, polyglutamate. This configuration allowed us to study mechanism of polymer-CPP conjugates as anticancer agent. These findings have been summarized in the research output (by Jieying Zhong and Ying Chau). Due to the deviation from objective 4 and 5, we chose to focus the applications involving CPP on subcellular targeting. To fulfill objective 6, we explored the possible applications of the oligoarginine-modified polymeric nanoparticles for mitochondria-targeting delivery of doxorubicin, a cancer therapeutic molecule. Enhanced cytotoxicity as well as increased apoptosis were observed.

660211.label: Major findings and research outcome
660211.value: 1) Enhanced cellular uptake by oligoarginine-modified nanoparticles The results showed that R4PECL and R8PECL particles enhanced cellular uptake on Hela cells within 30 min. At 24 h, R8PECL particle effectively increased cellular uptake up to ~12-fold, R4PECL increased cellular uptake by ~4-fold, while the effect of R1 modification on cellular uptake was negligible. Except from Hela cell, R8PECL particle also showed enhanced cellular uptake capacity on various cell lines. 2) Endocytic mechanism and intracellular trafficking of oligoarginine-modified nanoparticles We further demonstrated the endocytic mechanisms of different particles: 1) R1PECL particle entered cells via clathrin-mediated endocytosis and no endosomal escape was observed; 2) MβCD suppressed uptake of both R4PECL and R8PECL particles, indicating these two particles were internalized through lipid-raft-dependent pathways; 3) Only amiloride can inhibit the uptake of R8PECL, indicating this particle was mainly taken up via macropinocytosis. Though both R4PECL and R8PECL particles enhanced cellular uptake, only R8PECL particle was able to escape from endosomes. At 24h, most R4PECL particles were trapped inside lysosomes, while R8PECL showed diffusive pattern in cytosol. Further experimental results confirmed the strong endosomal escape capacity of R8PECL nanoparticles was due to its high density of arginine groups on the surface. Decreasing the density of peptides on the particle surface weaken its endosomal escape capacity, but does not alter its endocytic pathway via macropinocytosis. We further clarified the escape process and subcellular locations of R4PECL and R8PECL particles using immunostaining and live imaging trackers: R4PECL particle only enters lysosomes up to 24h; while R8PECL can escape from late endosomes and partially enter ER and mitochondria after 4h incubation. The subcellular location of particle is dependent on the length of oligoarginine rather than the peptide density on the particle surface. 3) Applications of oligoarginine-modified nanoparticles Doxorubicin has been used for the treatment of a wide range of cancers, including leukemias, bladder, breast, lung, stomach and others. Its chief mechanism of action is the inhibition of DNA topoisomerase II, an enzyme that presents both in mitochondria and nuclei of human cells. Since the free doxorubicin molecules only enters nucleus but cannot target mitochondria, we designed a mitochondria-targeting nanocarrier for doxorubicin delivery. R8 was selected as a mitochondria-targeting ligand. A greater cytotoxic effect was observed with the mitochondria-targeting doxorubicin-loaded nanoparticles. Doxorubicin localization in both mitochondria and nucleus accounts for the enhanced apoptosis and cytotoxicity of doxorubicin encapsulated in the targeted nanoparticles. With the understanding of the intracellular delivery capacity of oligoarginine-modified nanoparticles, we have explored the use of these nanocarriers to deliver DB-213 (and HIV enzyme inhibitor) and nucleic acid.

660211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
660211.value: Polymeric vesicles modified with cell-penetrating peptide Polymeric vesicle owns unique structures and physicochemical properties, making it an attractive candidate in various applications, especially in drug delivery. Extensive efforts have been made to search for suitable polymers for vesiculation, but few studies have been performed to optimize the vesicle preparation method, while the current method may suffer from disadvantages including broad size polydispersity, low yield and long preparation time. We developed a robust and efficient method for polymeric vesicle formation, which we named as temperature-assisted nanoprecipitation (TAN). Poly(ethylene glycol)-b-poly(ε-caprolactone) (PEG-b-PCL) block copolymers with proper hydrophilic ratios were then successfully nanoprecipitated into narrowly-dispersed vesicles using TAN, as confirmed by cryo-transmission electron microscopy (cryo-TEM) and dynamic light scattering (DLS). The same polymers resulted in micelles instead using conventional nanoprecipitation at 20 °C. These micelles could be converted to vesicles upon heating above melting temperature of the constituent polymers. This method enables the production of oligoarginine-modified polymeric vesicles for the delivery of both hydrophobic and hydrophilic therapeutics.

660211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
660211.value: Short cell-penetrating peptides (CPP) composed of 1, 4 and 8 arginine residues (oligoarginines R1, R4 and R8 were conjugated to the block-copolymer (poly(ethylene glycol)-b-polycaprolactone). The modified polymer was assembled into nano-sized particles that present oligoarginines on the surface. By controlling the size of the nanoparticles, and varying the length and density of the oligoarginine peptides, we have clarified the functions of the peptides. At least 4 arginine residues were required to increase cellular uptake of the particles, and the density of arginine residues was found to be the determinant of the rate of this process. The length of the peptides dictates the pathway by which the nanoparticles enter cells, and the subsequent intracellular fate and subcellular locations of the nanoparticles. Particles modified with R8 were found to escape most efficiently from endosomes, an important feature for delivering labile therapeutics to the cytosol and other subcellular compartments. In addition, R8-modified particles are capable of homing to endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and mitochondria. With this understanding, an anticancer compound, doxorubicin was delivered to mitochondria using R8-modified particles to increase the therapeutic activity on apoptosis (programmed cell death).
