706711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
706711.value: The primary objective of this proposal is to develop an efficient approach to prepare a spin ensemble with large scale quantum entanglement, an important resource for quantum information processing. This resource can be crucial for nuclear spins in solid state systems, which are well known for the capability of ultra-long quantum storage and hold promises for room temperature quantum information processing. The methods for quantum manipulations of nuclear spins are unfortunately limited as compared to other types of quantum information carriers. Preload the nuclear spin ensemble with the resource of large scale entanglement may significantly reduce the number of qubit-entangling gates required for universal quantum information processing and boost the chance of realizing scalable quantum computer. However, the conventional approaches for generating large scale entanglement are based on quantum controls not possible for nuclear spin systems. In this proposal, we plan to exploit a novel discovery by our preliminary studies and develop a conceptually new approach for generating large scale entanglement in a general spin ensemble using only collective spin raising and lowering operations. The entanglement generation here is also accompanied by squeeze of collective spin and its uncertainties in all directions, which is of significance since collective spin uncertainty as a source of quantum noises can be largely removed, e.g. in the case of a quantum object in a spin bath. This unique approach for entanglement generation and spin squeezing will be most suitable for nuclear spin ensembles since collective spin raising and lowering operations are generic to the process of dynamical nuclear polarization by electrons, one of the few ways for nuclear spin manipulations. We will investigate how the approach can be efficiently implemented in various nuclear spin systems of interests to quantum technologies. We will also investigate the application of this approach in other physical systems of wide interest in quantum physics including atoms or ions in optical lattices, and optically controllable electron spins localized by quantum dots or impurity centers in semiconductors. 本研究項目的主要目標是發展一套新辦法用於在自旋系綜中高效率的產生大尺度量子糾纏(一種量子信息處理中的關鍵資源). 這種資源對於由固體系統中核自旋來實現的量子計算設想尤為關鍵。基於核自旋的量子計算具有一項特別的優勢：核自旋比特擁有超長的量子相幹時間，有在室溫下實現量子計算的前景。而跟其他的量子計算實現方案相比劣勢則在於用於操控核自旋的辦法相對有限。如果能在核自旋系綜中預先的載入大尺度的量子糾纏，那麽實現普適量子計算所需要的量子糾纏操控就可以大幅度的減少，在核自旋系統中實現可擴展量子計算的機會就會大幅增加。然而現有的絕大部分用於產生大尺度量子糾纏的辦法在此都不適用，因為所需要的操控無法在核自旋系統中實現。這裏我們提出利用我們初步研究中的一個發現來發展一種概念上全新的，基於集體的自旋升降操作的辦法用於在自旋系綜中產生大尺度量子糾纏。這種量子糾纏的產生同時還伴隨著自旋漲落的減小，所以這個辦法還有另一重要的應用，即降低自旋環境對某些量子系統帶來的噪聲。這個獨特的產生量子糾纏並壓縮自旋漲落的辦法對於核自旋系綜特別適用，因為所需要的自旋升降操作能夠在電子動態極化核自旋的過程中自然實現。後者是一種用於操控核自旋的普遍辦法。我們將研究怎樣在各類具有應用意義的核自旋系統中來實現這種量子糾纏的制備。同時我們還要研究能否將這種辦法也用於其他具有廣泛應用的量子系統，比如光學晶格中的原子或者離子，束縛在半導體量子點或雜質中心的可由光學辦法操控的電子自旋等。

706711.label: Realisation of objectives
706711.value: Objective 1: This objective has been fully achieved. We have developed approaches for generating several types of large scale quantum entangled states in spin qubit ensembles, including the manybody singlets, the spin coherent states with entanglement, the ALKT states, and asymmetric and symmetric Dicke states. The approaches utilise collective raising and lower operations, realized through quantum channels coupled collectively to the spin qubits in the ensemble. These states have multipartite entanglement, and we have also analysed the bipartite entanglement between two subgroups of the spin ensemble as well as between two individual qubits in the ensemble. For the manybody singlets and the spin coherent states with entanglement, the entanglement generation is also accompanied by the squeezing of collective spin and its uncertainties. Objective 2: This objective has been fully achieved. We have implemented the above entanglement generation approaches in different physical systems including atomic ensembles in optical lattice and optical cavity, donor nuclear spins in semiconductors. The generated large scale entanglement are found useful for quantum algorithms such as quantum telecoloning and secret sharing protocol. We have also investigated the use of the prepared states and also the collective raising and lowering operations for quantum metrology applications including the measurement of magnetic field gradient and the temperature of atomic gases. The collective raising and lowering operations are also explored for detecting quantum entanglement in the spin ensemble. Objective 3: This objective has been fully achieved. We have analysed the various loss mechanisms and error sources on the entanglement generation and spin squeezing, including the spin decoherence, the spin relaxation, and inhomogeneity in the system parameters which can lead to unknown phase and amplitude errors in the collective coupling to the quantum channels. The entanglement generation schemes are found to have sufficient robustness against the various type of errors. For the various preparation schemes studied in different physical systems, we have analysed how to optimise the entanglement generation in presence of these error sources with the proper choice of the control scenarios and control parameters.

706711.label: Major findings and research outcome
706711.value: 1. We developed a scheme to generate spin coherent states with largescale quantum-entanglement, where the collective spin quantum numbers are substantially squeezed. We show how to prepare the entanglement resources for the 1-to-N/2 quantum tele cloning, for the secret sharing protocol, and to prepare the large-scale Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki state. We investigated the effects of decoherence and loss mechanisms on the efficiency of the entanglement generation and spin squeezing. Error analysis shows that high-fidelity state engineering is possible for N∼O(100) spins in the presence of decoherence. We showed how to implement for atomic spin qubits in an optical lattice. (Publication 1 in part C, PRA 84, 032337 (2011)). 2. We developed schemes to prepare various symmetric and asymmetric Dicke states that contain large-scale entanglement useful for quantum information tasks. We showed how the schemes can be implemented for donor nuclear spins in silicon, utilising cooperative pumping of nuclear spins by coupled donor electrons. This scheme only requires a sub-gigahertz donor exchange coupling, which can be readily achieved without atomically precise donor placement, and hence it offers a practical way to prepare multipartite entanglement of spins in silicon with current technology. All desired Dicke states appear as the steady state under various pumping scenarios, so the preparation is robust and does not require accurate temporal controls. Numerical simulations with realistic parameters show that Dicke states of 10–20 qubits can be prepared with high fidelity in presence of decoherence and unwanted dynamics. (Publication 2 in part C, PRB 85, 155304 (2012)). 3. We discovered novel uses of the collective raising/lowering operations on atomic spin ensembles (spontaneously Raman scattering). We show that far-field diffraction images of the Raman photons can be used for detection of spin entanglement and for metrology of field gradients in cold atomic ensembles. For many-body states with small or maximum uncertainty in the spin-excitation number, entanglement is simply witnessed by the presence of a sharp diffraction peak or dip. The gradient vector of external fields is measured by the displacement of a diffraction peak due to inhomogeneous spin precession, which suggests a possibility for precision measurements beyond the standard quantum limit without entanglement. Monitoring of the temporal decay of the diffraction peak can also realize a nondemolition probe of the temperature and collisional interactions in trapped cold atomic gases. The approach can be readily generalized to cold molecules, trapped ions, and solid-state spin ensembles. (Publication 3 in part C, PRA 87, 042303 (2013)).

706711.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
706711.value: This GRF project is to explore new approach to generate large-scale entanglement in a spin ensemble, and we discovered several approaches to prepare certain types of large-scale multipartite entangled state including the manybody singlets, the spin coherent states with entanglement, the various Dicke states etc., which are useful resources for quantum information tasks. Unlike conventional approaches, here we utilise the collective quantum channels that couple to all spins which have the advantage of easy implementation in systems that lack the individual addressability, and the preparation is realized with incoherent pumping instead of coherent operations which has the advantage of robustness. Future development along this direction is to explore the general possibility of using collective quantum channels and incoherent processes to prepare quantum entanglement, and to explore other types of multipartite quantum entanglement that can be generated in this way, e.g. the cluster states which are known to be the key resources for measurement based universal quantum computations. As further development of the research along this direction, the PI is currently carrying out a 5-year research project titled: "Manipulate correlations & entanglement in spin ensembles via collective channels", funded by the Croucher Foundation under the Croucher Innovation Award in 2013.

706711.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
706711.value: Quantum entanglement between the individual quantum registers (quantum bit or qubit) is a critical resource for quantum information processing and quantum computation. Conventional approaches in generation quantum entanglement rely on individual addressability of qubits and their mutual interactions which may not be available or very difficult to realise in many physical systems including nuclear spins in semiconductors. This research project aims to find novel approaches to generate large-scale entanglement in spin ensembles not using control of individual spins, but using instead collective quantum channels that couple simultaneously to all spins in the ensemble. These approaches may have the advantage of easy implementation, in particular for systems such as nuclear spins in semiconductors (where the hyperfine coupling with electrons can act as collective quantum channels) and for atomic spin ensembles (where the spins can couple collectively with photons). In this research project, we have successfully discovered a number of schemes for generation various quantum states with large-scale entanglement in spin ensembles, and have implemented the approaches in systems including donor nuclear spins in semiconductors and atomic spin ensembles. These are very useful additions to the toolbox for preparing resources for quantum information tasks.

706811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
706811.value: Let K[x,y,z] be the polynomial algebra of rank three over a field K. Every tame K-automorphism (i.e. an automorphism which can be decomposed as a product of linear and elementary automorphisms) of K[x,y,z] can be lifted to a K-automorphism of the free associative algebra K, as obviously, every linear or elementary K-automorphisms can be lifted to that of K. However, it is an important open question (the Lifting Problem) whether a wild K-automorphism of K[x,y,z] can be lifted to a K-automorphism of K. Note that due to Shestakov-Umirbaev's affirmative solution to the famous Nagata Conjecture [SU2], there indeed exist wild automorphisms of K[x,y,z] for char(K)=0. In this proposal, we plan to attack the above Lifting Problem by methodology of Degree estimate, Tietze transformation, and the methodology motivated by Quillen-Suslin's solution to the famous Serre conjecture, among other things. The expected solution of the Lifting Problem would be extremely helpful for us to understand the structure of the two automorphism groups Aut(K) and Aut(K[x,y,z]), and the nature of the close connection between the two groups. Moreover, the expected solution would lead a unified proof of the famous Nagata Conjecture over arbitrary characteristic (previously Shestakov-Umibaev [SU2] only proved the Nagata Conjecture over zero characteristic). This proposal is closely related to the famous Embedding Conjecture in Affine Algebraic Geometry via a Key Question. Therefore, by carrying out the proposed research, we would obtain some essential input to the Embedding Conjecture. 中文摘要 本项目研究自同构提升问题和任意域上的NAGATA猜想. 驯服多项式代数的自同构可被提升, 因为线性和初等自同构可被提升. 野自同构是否能提升是仿射代数几何和非交换代数领域的一个重要的公开问题(提升问题). 注意Shestakov-Umirbaev 近来证明了特征0的NAGATA猜想,从而证明了存在 多项式代数的野自同构. 本项目用次数估计,Tietze Transformation, 以及Quillen-Suslin等方法 研究自同构提升问题和任意域上的NAGATA猜想. 本项目和著名的仿射代数几何领域的 "嵌入猜想" 密切相关, 通过本项目我们亦期望 对"嵌入猜想"的研究取得实质性的进展.

707011.label: Major findings and research outcome
707011.value: With the support of this grant, I have successfully proved the the Cameron-Edmonds conjecture on box-perfectness of parity graphs, and established some other important classes of box-perfect graphs. I have also made significant progress on characterizing and recognizing all box-perfect graphs, and I believe the solutions to the whole problems are within reach. Moreover, jointly with my collaborators, I have managed to resolve several long-standing open problems, such as the Seymour-Thomas conjecture on circumference and Tuza's problems on graph coloring.

707011.value: A complete characterization of all box-perfect graphs.

707011.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
707011.value: The project has both great theoretical interest and practical value. First, our characterizations of box-perfect graphs yield significant and deep mathematical theorems. Second, our findings lead to polynomial-time solutions to several classical optimization problems on box-perfect graphs. Third, the notion of perfect graph was motivated by Shannon's work on communication theory (and more precisely by the zero-error capacity of a noisy channel). So the results obtained in this project can be applied directly to solve some real-world problems originating from this area. Finally, Edmonds' problem is closely related to the celebrated strong perfect graph conjecture. Although this conjecture has been proved and the problem of recognizing perfect graphs has also been resolved in polynomial time, efficient combinatorial algorithms for the aforementioned four optimization problems have yet to be found. The solution techniques introduced in our investigation and a wealth of structural properties exhibited in this project can certainly be carried over to this research direction.

707211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
707211.value: Condensed matter states are classified in terms of their symmetries. One of the concepts in modern condensed matter physics is the spontaneous symmetry broken. Taking a magnet as an example. The underlying interactions in a magnet are rotational symmetric in space, but a magnet breaks rotational symmetry. Spontaneous symmetry broken states are associated with non-vanishing order parameters such as magnetism. The development of condensed matter physics in the past half century has been largely related to the symmetry breaking and the associated physical properties of these states such as antiferromagnet, superconductor and superfluid. The discovery of quantum Hall effect in early of 1980s opened a new direction. The quantized Hall state is a topological state, a terminology used in mathematics to classify different geometric objects into broad classes. A quantized Hall state is a topoloigcal insulator, in which the electronic states have a bulk energy gap and topology protected gapless edge states. The high precision of quantization of the transverse conductance is a consequence of the topological properties of the state. For its importance in science, Nobel Prizes have been awarded twice to the quantized Hall effects. Recent development of topological matters was initiated with theoretical efforts to generalize the quantized Hall states to time invariant topological states. This has led to the experiment discoveries in two- and three- dimensional topological insulators and the proposal of topological superconductors. This field is exploring for its fundamental basic science and potential applications. In the present proposal, we plan to theoretical study two important aspects in this field. One is the spin Hall effect on the surface of three-dimensional topological insulators, and the other is the defects such as impurities and vortex states in topological superconductors. Our study should explore interesting properties and advance our understanding of these new quantum states. The study of spin transport in these topological states may shed new light to the field of spin electronics and to the potential applications of the materials. 707211.value: This project has led to 5 publications , including 1 Phys. Rev. Letts, and 4 Phys. Rev. B. In the paper published in Phys. Rev. Letts, (publication 1 in Part C), chiral p-wave superconductivity in a mesoscopic system was examined. It is predicted that there is a re-entrance phenomenon for small size device: a magnetic field may induce a superconducting state due to the winding number of 1 associated with the chiral p-wave topology. This work has generated a lot of interest in the community. In a paper published in Phys. Rev. B (see publication number 2 in Part C of the report), possible superconductivity is studied for the edge state in quantum spin Hall system. It is found that the bulk remains to be insulator with a gap, and the edge states may become superconducting for pairing strength above a threshold. In a paper published in Phys. Rev. B (Publication number 5 in Part C of the report), the focus is on the majorana fermion pair and its effect. Majorana fermion was a type of fermions originally proposed in particle physics. Recent development in condensed matter has led to possible realization of such particles first in condensed matter systems as an collective particles. Majorana fermions are appearing in pairs and nonlocally distributed at the two ends of the wire. The electron transport through a normal lead-quantum dot-topological superconductor-quantum dot-normal lead junction is studied in tha paper, and it is shown that the two nonlocal processes can be directly controlled by gating the energy level of quantum dots.

707211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
707211.value: The chiral p-wave superconductivity and its detect have become very important part in study of topological matter. The theory proposed in the project is expected to have a lasting impact and continuation of the study along this direction would be very fruitful.

707211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
707211.value: This project has used theoretical method including analytical and numerical simulations to address a number of current issues related to topological insulator, which is insulator in bulk and conducting at edges or surfaces. These surface or edge states may be good candidate for dissipation-less, similar to free highway. Particularly, the project examined a type of superconductivity with a clock-wise moving current on the disk edge and left-right moving current on a rectangular.

707311.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
707311.value: We propose to conduct unbiased molecular line surveys of a large sample of evolved stars utilizing radio telescopes, with the aim of searching for new molecular species and investigating circumstellar chemistry in different environments and evolutionary stages. When low- and intermediate-mass stars evolve into the stage of the asymptotic giant branch (AGB), they expel material from their surface into space and form circumstellar envelopes (CEs). With further evolution, the central stars become hotter and hotter, and eventually photo-ionize the surrounding CEs, resulting in planetary nebulae (PNe). The expanding envelopes are active sites of chemical synthesis of molecules. During the short time intervals from pre-PN to PN phases, the physical conditions of CEs change dramatically, and a wide variety of complex organic molecules is rapidly processed. However, the connection between the changes in physical conditions and those in chemical compositions in different evolutionary stages has never been comprehensively understood. To investigate this problem, we plan to detect and analyse millimeter wave molecular emission lines in AGB stars, proto-PNe, and PNe. Our observations will cover a relatively wide frequency range, where a large number of molecular species will be expected to be detected. Through the observations, we are able to investigate the roles of dust, stellar wind, and UV/X-ray from the central stars in circumstellar chemistry. Because of its proximity, IRC+10216 has been the most frequently studied carbon-star envelope. More than seven line surveys have been presented for this object. It often serves as a standard reference for studying circumstellar chemistry. However, an important, yet unsettled problem is whether IRC+10216 is a typical late-type star or has a unique chemical environment. To solve this issue, we propose to carry out systematical molecular line observations of other carbon-star envelopes. This research will shed new insights in the understanding of chemical processes in circumstellar envelopes. Moreover, the envelopes surrounding evolved stars are a substantial site for the synthesis of complex organic molecules. Our research, therefore, could provide clues to the origin of life in space. Another purpose of this research project is to promote radio astronomy education in Hong Kong. We encourage local students to attend our group discussions and plan to nurture 1–2 MPhil/PhD students through in this project. We will invite international experts in this field to contribute their expertise to this project and give guest lectures. Through these ways, we can develop a good educational environment. 我们计划利用射电望远镜对大样本的演化晚期恒星包层进行无偏的分子搜寻。我们的目的在于寻找新的分子并且研究不同环境和演化状态下的星周化学。 当中小质量恒星演化到渐进巨星支（AGB）阶段，它们会把表面的物质抛射到星际空间中形成星周包层。随着进一步的演化，中心恒星的温度变得越来越高，最终发出的紫外光子将星周气体电离，从而形成行星状星云。在膨胀的星周包层中，分子能够被高效地合成。在行星状星云形成的很短时间内，星周包层的物理状态急剧变化，各种复杂有机物迅速形成并相互反应。然而，在不同星周演化状态的物理条件和化学成分之间存在何种联系目前并不清楚。我们计划分析AGB星包层，原初行星状星云和行星状星云中的分子发射线来调查这一问题。我们的观测将会覆盖很宽的频率范围以确保我们能探测到尽可能多的分子。我们还能利用我们的观测数据研究尘埃、星风和中心星发出的紫外及X射线在星周化学中扮演的角色。 IRC+10216是目前研究得最多的富碳AGB星，主要是因为它离我们非常近。对于这个天体已有超过7个发表的分子搜寻工作。在研究星周化学中，天文学家通常把它作为一个标准源。然而，问题在于，IRC+10216是否是一个典型的AGB星，或者是否它的化学成分比较特殊？这是一个重要但仍未解决的问题。我们计划通过系统观测一个大样本碳星包层的分子线来解决这一问题。 我们的这项研究不仅能帮助我们理解星周包层的化学过程，更重要的是，由于分子包层是复杂有机物的合成场所，我们的研究还能够对生命在空间的起源提供重要线索。 我们计划的另一个目的在于提高香港的射电教育，我们鼓励当地的学生参加我们的小组讨论，我们期望借助这项计划培养一到两个硕士或者博士，我们将会邀请这个领域的国际专家来访问和做学术报告，从而提高我们教育环境和学术氛围。

707311.label: Realisation of objectives
707311.value: 1. We detected many new transitions from known interstellar molecules in several PPNe. We have, for the first time, tentatively discovered hydrogenated C60 in a PPN. No new complex organic compounds was detected because of their intrinsic weakness and the limited instrumental sensitivity. Nevertheless, our observations can put an upper limit on the molecular abundances. 2. Our studies reveal that certain species are enhanced or depleted during the evolution of circumstellar envelopes. We found that the relative line intensities of some molecules can be used to distinguish different sources. 3. Under our detection sensitivity, we do not find that the chemical compositions of IRC+10216 differ from the other sources in the same evolutionary stage. The abundant species detected in IRC+10216 can be attributed to its nearby location. 4. We have trained a Mphil student, Mr. Wayne Chau. He has learned how to perform radio observations, and has published a ApJ paper as the leading author.

707311.label: Major findings and research outcome
707311.value: This project results in ten papers published in top astrophysics journals and three manuscripts that are ready to be submitted. We found that the spectral behaviors of IRC+10216 and CIT6 are similar at 7mm window, suggesting that the former is a typical C star and can be used as a standard to study circumstellar chemistry. The long carbon molecule HC7N was detected in CIT6 for the first time. We also found that cyanopolyyne molecules are enhanced in CIT6, which can be explained in terms of gas-phase chemistry since CIT6 is more evolved than IRC+10216 (Chau et al. 2012). Through analyzing the 3mm and 1.3mm spectra of the PPN CRL2688, we detect a large number of molecular lines. The results show that circumstellar molecules can be effectively reprocessed during the short transition stage of evolved stars. Specifically, CN-bearing molecules are enhanced while the Si-containing species are depleted in this PPN. Our observations provide the most complete and most sensitive line survey of this object to date (Zhang et al. 2013). We carried out a systematical radio observations of the 21micron and 30micron sources (Zhang et al. 2016, to be submitted). The results show that some compounds are clearly enhanced in these sources, and the Si-bearing and C-chain molecules can be used to distinguish objects at different evolutionary stages. The research provides clue to identify the carriers of the 21micron and 30micron features. We discovered C60 and hydrogenated C60 in a PPN for the first time (Zhang & Kwok 2013), indicating that fullerenes and their derivatives can be readily formed in circumstellar environments. Inspired by our discovery, some astronomers have attempted to search for C60+ absorption in this PPN. They found that C60+ bands are extremely strong and might have a circumstellar origin. These studies provide important implication for the long unsolved DIB (diffuse interstellar band) problem.

707311.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
707311.value: As a long-term project to understand circumstellar chemistry, we plan to extend our research to a larger sample and wider frequency coverage. Our current study is limited by small sample size. In order to obtain statistically meaningful results, we need to observe more sources with different properties. These circumstellar envelopes will be systematically grouped according to their properties. The connections between molecular compositions and various physical properties, revealed from a larger sample, can validate (or reject) the predictions of our current study. Extending the frequency range of our observations, we can detect more molecules. We intend to search for more complex organics, especially those of biological interest. For this purpose, we require to carry out very deep spectroscopy utilizing high-sensitive instruments. Our future goal is to achieve a systematical and accurate classification of circumstellar spectra at radio.

707311.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
707311.value: Current studies show that the molecules in space are significantly more diverse than expected before. Complex organic compounds can be naturally formed in the envelopes surrounding dead stars, supporting the possibility that the building blocks of life came from space. However, the picture of circumstellar chemistry is far from complete. In this project, through observing a sample of evolved stars, we have investigated how molecules are produced and reprocessed in various environments. The sample can be viewed as an evolutionary sequence. Using the dynamic timescale of each evolutionary phase, we put constraints on the chemical efficiency. The results show that death stars can quickly synthesize complex molecules such as close-caged carbon molecules. On the other hand, the statuses of our sample targets are well known, which we found can be manifested by the emission of some molecules. This can help to identify the nature of some unknown sources.

707511.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
707511.value: It has been proposed that the formation of giant Sediment-hosted Stratiform Copper (SSC) deposits was linked to the breakup of supercontinents, but there is no known example of a SSC deposit that formed during breakup of the relatively newly proposed Paleoproterozoic Columbia supercontinent. It is known that the breakup of this continent was accompanied by a major oxidation event that allowed the formation of extensive red beds, a condition required for the formation of SSC deposits. Thus, documenting the existence of Paleoproterozoic SSC deposits and their link to the breakup of Columbia is of great significance in terms of not only mineral exploration but also understanding the genetic relationship between these events. Stratiform copper deposits in the western Yangtze Block, SW China, known as the “Dongchuan-style” deposits for decades, have been the major sources of Cu metal for the country, but their origin and significance are poorly understood. The deposits are hosted in the late Paleoproteorzoic(~1.7Ga) Dongchuan Group that was deposited in an intra-continental rift basin believed to be related to the breakup of Columbia. Our preliminary studies show that these deposits were formed at ~1.7 Ga, essentially the same age as the hosting sedimentary rocks. We propose a combined detailed field and laboratory study on selected deposits. Electron microprobe, C-H-O stable isotope and fluid inclusion studies will be carried out to determine the sources of metals and origin of the fluids. The selected deposits will be dated using Ar-Ar methods on muscovite and biotite and Re-Os isotopic system on molybdenite. Our objectives are to better constrain the age and tectonic setting of the deposits and to trace the source of metals and the origin of ore fluids. In combination with the precise age and tectonic setting of the hosting strata, the findings of this project should allow us to establish an ore-forming model in which the formation of the copper deposits is linked to a rift basin filled with the red-bed related to the great oxidation in the Earth's history. Thus, our study will provide the first examples to link the formation of SSC deposits with the breakup of Columbia. Our work may provide guidance to mineral exploration and will have significant implications for the formation of SSC deposits and will shed light on the relationship of the Yangtze Block and the Columbia supercontinent. 沉积岩型层状铜矿床（SSC）的形成常被认为与超大陆的裂解有重要联系。哥伦比亚超大陆的裂解开始于古元古代，但以此有关的SSC矿床未见报道。广泛认为，哥伦比亚超大陆的裂解与地球早期大氧化事件近于同时，在此期间形成的了大量红层沉积，有利于SSC矿床的形成。因此，寻找古元古代SSC矿床以及探讨它们与哥伦比亚超大陆裂解的关系，不仅能更好地了解这些事件之间的成因联系，更有助于指导找矿。在中国扬子地块西缘，分布有大量沉积岩型层状铜矿床，是中国铜金属的重要来源地。这些矿床因其独特性常被称为“东川式”，但实际上，它们的成因以及地质意义远远没有弄清楚。铜矿床均赋存于古元古代晚期东川群中（~1.7 Ga），该群形成于大陆裂谷盆地，被认为与哥伦比亚超大陆的裂解有关。我们的初步工作显示，层状同矿床的形成时代为~1.7 Ga，大致与东川群相当。因此，在这基础上，本研究选择该区代表性的铜矿床，开展详细的野外和室内实验工作。通过运用电子探针、C-H-O同位素和流体包裹体分析，约束金属的来源及流体的成因；运用白云母和黑云母的Ar-Ar和辉钼矿的Re-Os定年，确定铜矿床的形成时代以及构造环境；最后结合围岩地层的精确定年和构造环境判别，建立成矿模式并认为层状铜矿床的形成很可能与含有地球早期大氧化事件红层的裂谷盆地有关。综上所述，本研究不仅可首次获得SSC矿床与哥伦比亚超大陆裂解之间的成因联系，更重要的是能深入了解SSC矿床的形成机制并指导区域找矿。此外，本研究的实施也将为理解扬子地块与哥伦比亚超大陆之间的联系提供重要帮助。

707511.label: Realisation of objectives
707511.value: This project involved a post-doctor, Xin-Fu Zhao, and three post-graduate students, Wei Chen, Wei Wang and Xiaochun Li. These students were essential for field excursions and obtaining datasets as they received training. Two major periods of field work were involved during the processing of this project. In August 2011, Dr Xin-Fu Zhao, Wang Wei and a student spent more than 20 days in the Dongchun area, northern Kangdian region, SW China to investigate some major stratiform Cu deposits and sedimentary succesions. Prof. Zhou joined their field trip for two weeks to provide guidance. Systematic sampling of Paleoproterozoic strata and mapping of local deposit were conducted during this trip. In October 2012, Prof. Mei-Fu Zhou, Dr Xin-Fu Zhao, Wei Chen and Xiaochun Li spent three weeks in the Kangdian region to investigate typical sections of Paleo- to Meso-proterozoic strata and associated stratiform Cu and Fe-(Cu) deposits. Key outcrops are examined and some samples were collected. Sufficient analyses necessary for the research were obtained after systematic sampling. The students and postdoctor attended the 34th international geology conference held in Brisbane 2012. Dr Zhao presented a talk and two students presented posters related to this project to the conference. Although insufficient funds, the work has been progressing with a lot of new insights and analytical data. This is evidenced by a large number of publications in the highly ranked international journals. Specifically the origin of the Cu and Fe-(Cu) deposits, and tectonic implications of both the Paleoproterozoic and Mesoproterozoic strata, e.g., the Dongchuan, Hekou and Julin groups and their relationship to the breakup of the supercontinent Columbia and assembly of Rodinia supercontinent are now much better known. This project provides good examples for comparison of contemporary successions around the world. There are many major findings in this project that are linked with the original objectives. We did not have major problems during the study.

707511.label: Major findings and research outcome
707511.value: 1. The position of the Yangtze Block in the Columbia supercontinent Our work established the order of Paleo- to early-Mesoproterozoic sedimentary successions in the SW Yangtze Block. The ~1.7-1.5 Ga strata were interpreted to be rifting successions related to the breakup of Columbia. Based on comparison of coeval sedimentation and magmatism among continents involving in the assembly and breakup of Columbia, the Yangtze Block was suggested to be connected to north Australia and northwestern Laurentia (Chen et al., 2013; Wang et al., 2014). 2. Timing of the SSC deposits in the Kangdian region Using zircon U-Pb ages of hosting strata and doleritic dykes intruding orebodies, the SSC deposits was constrained to form at ~1700 Ma, consistent with the Re-Os ages (1667±67 Ma) of Cu-sulfides (Zhao et al., 2013, MD). The new ages suggest that the formation of these SSC deposits was coeval with the initial breakup of Columbia. Vein-type Cu ores have Re-Os ages of ~1431 Ma, representing a younger hydrothermal event (Huang et al., 2013). 3. Origin of the SSC deposits in the Kangdian region. The fluids of SSC deposits were constrained to involve oxidized saline brines derived from underlying red-bed sequence, and have interacted with partially to wholly lithified dolostones. Sulfide precipitation was ascribed to redox reactions and fluid pH changes resulting from dolostones and sulfate dissolution during early evolution of the rifting basin (Zhao et al., 2012). 4. Timing and fluid evolution of IOCG deposits in the Kangdian region The IOCG deposits were constrained to be formed at ~1660 Ma, coeval to the SSC deposits in the region, suggesting both SSC and IOCG deposits are linked with the breakup of Columbia. A younger Re-Os age (~1450 Ma) for the hydrothermal sulfide veins indicates a younger thermal event (Zhao et al., 2013, EG). Preliminary Sr isotopic study on the Lala IOCG deposit, northern Kangdian suggests that the fluids for Fe and Cu mineralization may have different sources (Chen et al., 2014, OGR). 5. Petrogenesis of late-Mesoproterozoic mafic rocks in the SW Yangtze Block. The ~1050 Ma metabasalts in the Julin Group, SW Yangtze Block have geochemical affinity of within-plate rocks, and were suggested to have formed in a continental rift. Our work does not support the existence of a Grenvillian orogenic belt in the SW Yangtze Block, arguing against that the Yangtze Block was located in the interior of the Rodinia supercontinent (Chen et al., 2014, PR).

707511.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
707511.value: There are extensive studies on these rifting successions and associated SSC deposits in this project, essentially carried out by the PDF, Dr Xin-Fu Zhao, Wei Chen and Wei Wang. In addition to the work on the sedimentary strata and SSC deposits, we also worked on the spatially associated IOCG deposits and the Paleoproterozoic to Mesoproterozoic igneous plutons. We will also extend our work to the remobilization, transportation and mineralization of REEs in these deposits. With the continuation of this project, a new PhD student, Xiaochun Li has already choose the REE-rich IOCG deposit, the Yinachang deposit in the central part of the Kangdian region. So far, we have obtained abundant geochemical data and new findings about the origin of the IOCG deposits and petrogenesis and tectonic affinity of the igneous rocks. Some of the research results are to be submitted for publications. Moreover, we will extend our studies to the late Mesoproterozoic sedimentary successions that are uncomfortably above the Paleoproterozoic to early Mesoproterozoic strata, in an order to reconstruct the Yangtze Block in the supercontinent cycle from Columbia to Rodinia.

707511.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
707511.value: The project investigated in detail the Paleo- to Meso-proterozoic rifting successions in the SW Yangtze Block. These are now correlated to the breakup of the Columbia supercontinent, thus confirming the linkage of the Yangtze Block with Columbia. Based on coeval rifting-related sedimentation and magmatism involved in the assembly and breakup of the Columbia supercontinent, our study suggests that the Yangtze Block was in a triangle framework and was connected to north Australia and northwestern Laurentia in the Columbia supercontinent. Both SSC deposits and spatially associated IOCG Fe-Cu deposits in the Kangdian region are linked with the breakup of the Columbia supercontinent. We have also indentified some younger hydrothermal events in the Kangdian region, and determined petrogenesis and tectonic implications of late Mesoproterozoic mafic volcanic rocks in the southwestern Yangtze Block, SW China. These new findings shed new lights on the time framework of events in the Kangdian region, SW China. Proposed models for the origin of the SSC and IOCG deposits will also provide important information on regional mineral exploration. The study has resulted in numerous publications in top-ranked international journals. Three PhD students and one PDF were trained during the project.

710111.label: Project Objectives
710111.value: To devise a unified model for service behaviour that predicts not only static and dynamic responses, but also long-term time-dependent responses taking into account concrete creep and shrinkage, and cable relaxation; To study the failure mechanisms under loading with and without transverse eccentricity for more accurate evaluation of safety-related attributes such as ductility and deformability; and To formulate rational design guidance for engineers for this kind of bridges particularly with the use of high-strength materials.

710111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
710111.value: Bridge engineers have been searching for efficient structural forms to satisfy various attributes under the performance-based concept, namely safety, serviceability, durability, constructability, maintainability, environmental friendliness, economy, etc. Traditionally steel and prestressed concrete are popular for short to medium span ranges. Steel-concrete hybrid bridges have become popular taking advantage of both materials. In particular, concrete bridges with corrugated steel webs (i.e. with a series of parallel ridges and furrows) and external prestressing have emerged as one of the promising bridge forms. Since its debut in France with the construction of Cognac Bridge in 1986, this form of bridge has continuously evolved and spread to USA, UK, Germany, Korea, Japan, China, etc, with Japan having a stock of over 200 because of its good seismic resistance. Steel webs enable substantial weight reduction and hence longer spans. Corrugated steel webs provide high shear resistance and high transverse stiffness without the need for stiffeners as in flat steel webs. Because of the so-called "accordion effect" of corrugated webs, prestress can be introduced efficiently to the top and bottom concrete flanges. Prestressing is often achieved by both internal and external tendons. Because of the thin webs, increasing structural depth has insignificant effect on the self-weight. To further reduce the weight of the flanges, high strength concrete can be employed. This structural form therefore provides excellent structural efficiency with the flanges taking bending and the corrugated steel webs taking shear. However, concrete bridges with corrugated steel webs are known to have lower stiffness and torsional resistance compared to the total concrete version, leading to larger deflections. Although some initial design guidance has been formulated, there are still various issues to resolve in order to fully harness their potential. Without a practical yet reliable model for analyses of concrete bridges with corrugated steel webs and external tendons, accurate prediction of their static, dynamic and long-term behaviour will be difficult. Their full-range behaviour covering the service and failure stages is complicated because of interaction among components of different strength and ductility, possible buckling of corrugated steel webs under excessive shear, interaction between flexure and torsion in the presence of external tendons, etc, but it has not been systematically studied. This project is therefore proposed (a) to devise a unified model for prediction of service behaviour; (b) to study the failure mechanism for more accurate evaluation of safety-related attributes such as ductility and deformability; and (c) to formulate rational design guidance for engineers. 橋樑工程師們一直在尋求高效的結構形式，以滿足各種基於性能的需求，包括安全性，適用性，耐久性，可建造性，可維護性，以及環保和經濟方面的考慮。從傳統設計理念上來講，鋼樑橋和預應力混凝土樑橋一般適用於中短跨徑。鋼–混凝土組合樑橋由於其同時發揮了鋼和混凝土這兩種材料的優點，從而越來越受橋樑工程師們的歡迎。一種特別的鋼–混凝土組合樑橋形式，是其鋼腹板使用了波形鋼（腹板成波形起伏狀），以及利用了體外預應力技術，使得這種結構形式能發揮更高的結構效率。自從于1986年在法國建成的第一座此類型的干邑橋(Cognac Bridge)，這種結構形式就一直不斷發展，這種技術也傳播到美國，英國，德國，韓國，日本，中國等地。其中，由於其優越的抗震性能，日本建成超過200座波形鋼腹板混凝土樑橋。 鋼腹板可以有效地減輕結構自重，從而增加橋樑的跨徑。波形鋼腹板又提供了比平鋼腹板更高的剪切強度和剪切剛度，而不需要額外設置加勁肋。因為波形鋼腹板存在所謂的“手風琴效應”，預應力可以更高效地施加在混凝土上下翼緣。預應力一般是由體內和體外預應力筋施加的。由於腹板較薄，增加截面高度並不會顯著地增加結構自重。在翼緣還可以採用高強度混凝土以便進一步降低結構自重。這種結構形式由於使翼緣專門受拉壓，腹板專門受剪，從而提供一流的結構效率。 由於波形鋼腹板混凝土樑橋的剪切剛度和扭轉剛度都比純混凝土樑橋要小，因此波形鋼腹板混凝土樑橋的撓度較大。雖然有初步的設計指南，但是爲了發揮這種結構形式的全部潛力，波形鋼腹板混凝土樑橋仍有許多問題有待解決。如果沒有可靠實用的模型，那麼將很難準確預測波形鋼腹板混凝土樑橋的靜力、動力及長期性能。由於在不同強度和延性的各組件之間存在相互作用，波形鋼腹板在高剪力下可能發生屈曲，以及由體外預應力筋引致的彎扭相關性，導致包括正常使用極限狀態和承載能力極限狀態下，波形鋼腹板混凝土樑橋的全過程行為非常複雜。在這些方面都未曾有系統的研究。 因此提出這項研究計劃是爲了： 1. 推導在正常使用極限狀態下，波形鋼腹板混凝土樑橋的統一模型； 2. 研究波形鋼腹板混凝土樑橋的破壞模式，以便更準確地評估其在安全性方面的性能，如延性和變形能力； 3. 提出合理的波形鋼腹板混凝土樑橋設計指南。

710111.label: Realisation of objectives
710111.value: To study the structural behaviour of prestressed concrete (PC) bridges with corrugated steel webs, the team has carried out numerical and experimental investigation. The team has developed two numerical approaches, including extended sandwich beam and modified Timoshenko beam theories, to investigate both the static and dynamic behaviour of this kind of bridges. The finite element models are also formulated based on the beam theories. The numerical models have been verified by tests. Using the above models, some parametric studies have been carried out to facilitate better understanding of the behaviour of these bridges. Details are elaborated below. (a) Literature review An extensive literature review of topics related to the design of PC bridges with corrugated steel webs has been carried out covering not only relevant papers in English, but also those in Chinese and Japanese. (b) Theoretical study of corrugated steel webs Various possible simplified models for corrugated steel webs as orthotropic plates have been studied with emphasis on elastic deformation and various types of buckling behaviour. Apart from analytical studies, numerical investigations by finite element method have also been carried out. (c) Theoretical study of PC bridges with corrugated steel webs Numerical studies of PC bridges with corrugated steel webs by finite element method have been carried out with special emphasis on the modelling of corrugated steel webs, diaphragms and external prestressing tendons. The service behaviour, dynamic properties and time-dependent behaviour taking into account the presence of diaphragms and external tendons have been studied. In addition, numerical studies have been carried out on the web-flange junction as the shear characteristics affect the overall shear behaviour of the section. (d) Full-range behaviour of PC bridges with corrugated steel webs The failure mechanisms have been studied experimentally and numerically for more accurate evaluation of safety-related attributes such as ductility and deformability. The performance of plastic hinge and its size has been studied thoroughly as it is essential to the prediction of full-range behaviour of the bridge. (e) Experimental investigation To investigate the behaviour of the bridges as well as to verify the methods proposed, tests have been carried out. The tested specimens include 14 PC and reinforced concrete beams with corrugated steel webs, and 12 steel beams with corrugated steel webs.

710111.label: Major findings and research outcome
710111.value: Various methods have been developed to examine the behaviour of prestressed concrete bridges with corrugated steel webs. Finite element computer programmes have been developed to investigate the static and dynamic performance of the bridges. Various numerical examples have demonstrated the accuracy and capability of the proposed methods. The diaphragms have significant effect on the deflection, stress distribution and stress resultants. The presence of diaphragms can be considered by imposing additional constraints against relative longitudinal displacement of the flanges. A convenient criterion has also been proposed for judging if the diaphragms can be considered as “rigid”. In serviceability limit state design, the stress concentration in flanges due to effects of diaphragm and interaction should be examined carefully, especially in the vicinity of point loads and diaphragms. To relieve the stress concentration, diaphragms can be provided with haunches. The diaphragms have significant effect on the flexural natural frequencies and mode shapes only for bridges with short spans and/or low ratios of section shear rigidity to flange local bending rigidity. For bridges with long spans and/or high ratios of section shear rigidity to flange local bending rigidity, the flexural natural frequencies and mode shapes obtained from the sandwich beam model, the classical Euler-Bernoulli and Timoshenko models tend to be the same, and hence the classical beam models possibly with unbonded tendons may be applied for simplicity. For bridges with wide flanges where shear lag effect may be present, the use of effective flange width in stiffness calculation improves the accuracy. The ductility, deformability and strength of reinforced concrete and partially prestressed concrete sections with corrugated steel webs have been studied and compared with those of conventional sections. Concrete bridges with corrugated steel webs perform reasonably well in respect of flexural ductility and deformability. The interaction effects between web shear deformation and local bending of concrete flanges are sensitive to the arrangement of span and loading, as well as sectional properties. Owing to the presence of external tendons and shear-deformable corrugated steel webs with negligible axial stiffness in this type of bridges, the flange plastic hinge and full-depth plastic hinge may form and interact with each other. Experimental results show that the equivalent interactive plastic hinge length, critical region length and plastic behaviour are primarily governed by the formation of flange plastic hinge. A simplified method is proposed to predict the displacement and load-carrying capacity of the bridge.

710111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
710111.value: The current work can be further extended as follows: (a) The analytical and finite element modelling of behaviour of prestressed concrete bridges with corrugated steel webs can be further improved considering flexible shear connectors. The possible delamination and relative slip at the interface can also be taken into account. (b) The deformation due to the vertical compression should be considered when a point load is applied near a support. A higher-order theory may be developed to solve the problem. (c) The interaction between bending, shear and torsion should be studied to have better understanding of the structural behaviour of this form of bridges. (d) The vehicle-bridge interaction of the prestressed concrete bridges with corrugated steel webs can be investigated by extending the models proposed.

710111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
710111.value: Owing to the large shear deformation and negligible axial stiffness of the corrugated steel webs, the assumption that plane sections remain plane commonly adopted in classical beam models is no longer valid for prestressed concrete bridges with corrugated steel webs. The research team has developed extended sandwich beam model and modified Timoshenko beam model to predict the behaviour of this form of bridges taking into account the presence of external tendons and diaphragms. Finite element models have been formulated accordingly to provide a tool for practical applications. The models proposed are verified by experiments. The static behaviour, dynamic behaviour and time-dependent behaviour have been investigated by the models developed. The full-range behaviour, covering ductility, deformability and ultimate load, has also been studied numerically and experimentally. Based on the study, some design recommendations are provided. It is found that the interaction between shear deformation of the corrugated steel webs and local bending of concrete flanges would cause serious stress concentration in the concrete flanges and affect the structural behaviour, which should be carefully examined in design.

710211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
710211.value: Soil alone is not always a satisfactory foundation, slope or back-fill material. It has been common for centuries to reinforce the soil by means of inclusions, with today’s typically used inclusions being nails, anchors, or geotextiles. This has allowed many challenging designs to be built, such as the very steep slopes around the island of Hong Kong. Some limitations however have been identified, such as the durability and efficiency of these reinforcements, for example the corrosion of metallic nails in situ, or the unidirectional layering and resistance of geotextiles. In this project it is proposed to examine the performance of a new type of soil reinforcement consisting of discrete fibres. Soil fibre-reinforcement is a relatively new research topic that has developed in the last fifteen years and has been studied predominantly on uniformly graded sand for application in slopes and foundations. Because the research was carried out on different soils with different fibres, no consistent behaviour could be identified until recently, when sufficient data on the behaviour of one given uniform sand reinforced with one type of polypropylene fibres allowed the development of a unified framework. Well graded soils such as residual soils, which are naturally occurring all over the world and include the local Hong Kong completely decomposed granite (CDG), have rarely been the host soil in these studies. To date, there is only one very recent and fairly simple study of fibre reinforcement in CDG where continuous fibres were used rather than short discrete mono-filament fibres. In the proposed research, a complete characterization of decomposed granite reinforced with different types of discrete fibres will be performed and an optimized fibre-CDG mixture will be identified. The practicality of creating the fibre-soil mixture will be studied in parallel. The project outcomes will be a better understanding of fibre-soil interaction and the potential use of fibres as reinforcing material in well graded soils. It is expected that the project will generate new avenues of research in the application of fibre reinforcement to geotechnical problems in CDG and other residuals soils. 對於天然土本身來說，無論在基礎、斜坡或是回填工程中，都不適合直接使用。幾百年來，工程師們嘗試在土中加入各種材料以強化天然土，例如現在常用的土釘，錨杆以及土工織物。這些嘗試使得許多頗具挑戰性的工程得以設計、建造，如環香港島的陡坡。儘管如此，工程中仍有很多限制，比如這些加固材料本身的耐久性和效用如何，例如實際中金屬制土釘的銹蚀，或是土工織物的單向分層及承載力。本項目將研究一種新型的使用離散纖維加固土體的方法。在過去的十五年里，利用纖維加固土 是一個相對嶄新的研究課題，對於級配均勻的沙土已經有了大量的研究并應用到了斜坡和基礎工程中。然而，由於這類研究常常是不同的纖維用在不同種類的土中，因此试验结果不具有統一的參考性。直至最近，通過 對 大量的關於一種聚丙烯纖維對某種給定級配的沙土進行加固的實驗數據 的分析，才使得一個統一框架得以建立。而對於級配較好的土，如于世界各地广泛分布的殘餘土，自然也包括香港本地的完全風化花崗岩（CDG），卻很少作為纖維加固對象而開展進一步的研究。迄今為止，只有一項較為簡單的纖維加固CDG的研究，而且该试验中使用的是連續纖維而非較短的離散單絲纖維。在本項目中，基于使用各種不同類型的離散纖維加固CDG的试验，一個完整的特徵體系將被建立，同時在该體系内最優的纖維-CDG組合也将被選出。除此之外，對於如何在實際工程應用该纖維土也將被研究。本項目的研究成果將進一步提升對纖維-土相互作用的理解以及使用纖維加固良好級配土的潛在應用價值。可以預見的是，本項目將會在使用纖維作為加固CDG及其他殘餘土方面拓展開一條新的研究道路。

710211.label: Realisation of objectives
710211.value: Laboratory tests on reinforced soils have also been carried out. The fibres were sourced from Brasil (similar to the ones reported in the literature), India and China. Polypropylene fibres of 0.023mm diameter and two different lengths, 24mm and 50mm, were sourced from Brasil, directly from Prof. Consoli. Another type of polypropylene fibre (mesh-type) of 0.1mm diameter and two different lengths of 24mm and 50mm were sourced from India (Kalyani Polymers Pvt. Ltd). Finally, polyethylene fibres of 0.5mm diameter and two different lengths were sourced from Mainland China (Alljoy Industry & Trading Co., Ltd). One-dimensional tests were carried out on reinforced soil using all types of fibres, with different proportions. Unconfined compression tests and triaxial tests were performed using the two types of fibres that have been reported as highly successful in reinforcing soils in the literature (from Brasil). Objectives 1 and 2: (a) About 20 uniaxial unconfined compression tests were performed on CDG reinforced with 24mm polypropylene fibres in different proportions (0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1% by weight) and densities (100, 95, 90, 85% optimum dry density). It was found that reinforcing CDG increased its strength by up to tenfold. (b) CDG reinforced with polypropylene and polyester fibres was tested in one-dimensional compression for optimizing fibre length and fibre content. With 24mm polypropylene and polyethylene fibres it was found that fibre contents in excess of 0.3% did not contribute any additional significant strength. Moreover, particle breakage in CDG at 7MPa was found to be significantly reduced when using polypropylene fibres (both from Brasil and India) but the amount of grain breakage did not change when polyethylene fibres were used. (c) A series of 25 successful triaxial tests was performed on CDG reinforced with 0.3% 24mm polypropylene fibres. It was found that the strength improved by five to tenfold in comparison to the pure CDG and that the reinforced soil was able to arrest dilation and improve the volumetric behaviour. The reinforced soils were even able to prevent the formation of shear planes in the specimen with the fibres acting as a matrix around the soil. This was established as the optimum dosage for this type of fibres and soil. (d) A unique normal compression line and critical state line were found for the fibre-CDG mixture, which lie above the corresponding lines found for the pure CDG. This seems to indicate that overall the soil performance is improved by fibre reinforcement. (e) A series of high pressure tests (up to 20MPa) was carried out at University College London on the unreinforced CDG and CDG reinforced at the optimum dosage, enabling to confirm the trends for the normal compression line and critical state lines found from the triaxial tests. Objective 3: (a) Additional triaxial tests were carried out by preparing large samples of fibre-reinforced CDG at the optimum dosage and coring specimens for testing in the triaxial apparatus at different inclinations. This helped determine whether the orientation of the fibres, which might be preferential after mixing and compaction, influences the mechanical behaviour significantly. This was the limit of what could be done in the laboratory to investigate objective 3.

710211.label: Major findings and research outcome
710211.value: The major findings from this research are: (a) the completely decomposed granite (CDG) used as host soil is sensitive to the method of preparation, so that when water is added in great quantity it alters the fabric and then the mechanical behavior of the soil (when compared to soil prepared moist-tamped). (b) when discrete fibres are added to the CDG there is an homogenizing effect that cancels the effects of the sample preparation i.e. the behavior of the reinforced soil is independent of the preparation method. (c) in contrast to other studies on fibre reinforcement, which used uniform, usually dilative sand as host soil, the CDG is well-graded and contractant. As the fibers are mobilised in tension this implies that more strength is initially mobilized in the fibre-uniform sand than in the fibre-CDG, but as stress levels increase the added strength in the former reduces as the behaviour turns contractant, while in the latter it remains even at large stresses. This is a difference that is worth noticing and will influence models developed for fibre-reinforced soils.

710211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
710211.value: Now that the fundamental research on fibre-reinforced soil is well advanced (different type of soil, different types of fibres), there is a need for real application studies. This would require further funding.

710211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
710211.value: Adding fibres to completely decomposed granite (CDG) improves its strength and stiffness properties. It also has the effect of homogenizing the soil so that differences in behaviour observed in the CDG prepared with large amounts of water (e.g. slurry) and prepared by moist-tamping (e.g. compaction) are erased when fibres are added. Unlike in other, more dilative sands, the gain in strength provided by the fibres remains even at large stress levels.

710611.label: Project Objectives
710611.value: Design and development of a dynamic image-based rendering system to acquire more reliable depth maps and evaluate its performance. Develop new techniques for joint calibration of the video cameras and depth sensors, fusion of range and image data, and estimation and compression of the dynamic partial 3D geometry of scene objects for relighting and other applications.

Develop new techniques for joint calibration of the video cameras and depth sensors, fusion of range and image data, and estimation and compression of the dynamic partial 3D geometry of scene objects for relighting and other applications.

710611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
710611.value: Image-based rendering (IBR) is a promising technology for photo-realistic rendering of scenes and objects from a collection of densely sampled images and videos. It is able to support a continuum of viewpoints according to users’ interaction in contrast to a set of fixed viewpoints found in conventional images and videos. More importantly, it helps to synthesis intermediate views and compute partial geometry models required by multiview TV displays and other applications. One of the key problems with IBR is the acquisition of reliable depth maps. Conventional techniques are mostly based on computer vision techniques. However, in texture-less regions, the performance of matching techniques are somewhat limited. On the other hand, the resolutions of depth sensing devices are relatively low and they suffer from outliers resulting from low reflectance. This proposal studies the design and associated processing algorithms for dynamic IBR systems, which combines multiple video cameras with multiple depth sensing devices, such as invisible infrared laser range finders and time-of-flight (TOF) cameras, in order to improve the reliability in computing the depth maps. The main idea is to resolve depth values at texture-less regions by random depth sampling using invisible depth sensors and employ multiview vision and regularization techniques to improve the resolution. Using this new system, we wish to: 1. develop techniques for joint calibration of the video cameras and depth sensors, 2. develop new fusion techniques for range and image data in order to acquire a more reliable and higher resolution depth map and evaluate its performance, 3. estimate dynamic partial 3D geometry of the objects so that they can be relighted and manipulated in other applications. The ultimate aims of the project are to develop more reliable and especially real-time techniques for capturing dynamic image-based representations and acquisition of the scene geometry for relighting, cultural heritage preservation and other applications. 圖像繪製（IBR）是一個有前途的視頻處理技術。 它能夠利用密集採樣的圖像和視頻逼真的合成新的視點。 因為它呈現真實和優越的效果, 因此在多視角和3D電視中具有重要的應用。 IBR關鍵問題之一是需要可靠的深度圖。傳統技術大多是基於計算機視覺技術。然而，在平坦的地方，匹配技術的性能比較有限。隨著新的深度感測裝置面世, 這個問題可能得到解決。 這項研究探索擁有多種深度感測裝置的多視角動態 IBR系統的設計和相關處理算法。該系統將結合紅外激光測距儀和多個攝像機以改善深度圖估計的可靠性。 我們希望從這項研究的經驗可以： 1. 制定攝像機和深度傳感器的校準技術， 2. 開發測距儀和圖像數據的新融合技術，以獲得更可靠和更高分辨率的深度圖，並評估其性能， 3. 估計物體的部分三維幾何和開發可以再照明和修改它們三維幾何模型的其他應用程序。 該項目的最終目標是開發出更可靠和更真實的，特別是實時的動態IBR系統和發展它在文化遺產保護及其他的應用。

710611.label: Realisation of objectives
710611.value: During this project, we have proposed a general framework for high resolution depth estimation using stereo and kinect v1 depth sensing devices. We have designed and constructed a dynamic image-based rendering system to acquire more reliable depth maps. Methods for calibrating, fusion and restoration of the kinect-v1 depth camera and stereo cameras were also developed. The system, framework and some applications have been reported in a number of publications [R1-R4]. [R1] Shuai Zhang, Chong Wang, S. C. Chan, "A New High Resolution Depth Map Estimation System Using Stereo Vision and Kinect Depth Sensing," Journal Signal Processing Systems, published online Aug. 2013. [R2] C. Wang, Z. Y. Zhu and S. C. Chan and H. Y. Shum, “Real-Time Depth Image Acquisition and Restoration for Image Based Rendering and Processing Systems,” Journal Signal Processing Systems, Published online July 2013. [R3] S. C. Chan, Chong Wang, Cheuk-Hei Ho, An-Ling Liu and H. Y. Shum, "A New Kinect Assisted Object-Based System for Real-Time Image-Based Rendering and Compression," to be submitted to IEEE Trans. Multimedia. [R4] S. Zhang, C. Wang, and S. C. Chan, “A new high resolution depth map estimation system using stereo vision and depth sensing device,” presented at the 9th IEEE Colloquium on Signal Processing and its Applications (CSPA), Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, 8-10 Mar., 2013. Overall, the feasibility of the fusion approach and its good performance for acquiring high resolution depth maps have been demonstrated. This is a very important contribution because high resolution depth has been considered as a key obstacle for computer vision and image-based rendering. It is envisioned that better performance can be achieved with depth cameras with higher resolution and reduced sensor noise such as the recently introduced kinect-v2. It would be interesting to explore techniques to further improve the performance for large environment as the depth cameras have limited sensing range of about 8 meters. Better integration of the stereo and depth cameras may be desirable in the future.

710611.label: Major findings and research outcome
710611.value: Below is a summary of the findings in the two objectives. Objective 1 We have constructed a multiview video and depth video system using kinect-v1 and a stereo camera for partial 3D model reconstruction. Moreover, we have developed real-time processing algorithms and compression algorithms based on the AVS algorithm. The findings are reported [R3]. Due to the computational burden of real-time fusion of the stereo and depth video data, the depth map used in the above system is considerably simplified though the rendering results are still acceptable. We have also captured another multiview sequences with more cameras and more results will be reported in the future. Objective 2 In the above system, new techniques for joint calibration of the video cameras and depth sensors, fusion of range and image data, and estimation and compression of the dynamic partial 3D geometry of scene objects have been developed [R1-R3]. The techniques for joint calibration and fusion of range and image data are reported in [R1,R2], while the compression algorithm and a real-time simplified rendering system were reported in [R3]. Recently, the fusion algorithm in [R1] has also been ported to a GPU and it can now run at 15 fps at 720p resolution. An improved quality depth map has also been obtained and a journal publication is under preparation. Overall, the objectives of the project are largely accomplished and we are currently preparing a longer version of [R1] to report our findings.

710611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
710611.value: The project can be further developed in the following two directions 1. With the introduction of kinect-v2, it is expected even better depth maps can be obtained using the current approach. This is particular helpful in indoor applications. On the other hand, better methods should be developed to address the limited sensing range of the depth cameras in large indoor environment. 2. A larger scale system can be constructed based on the techniques developed in this project for large-scale image-image rendering for indoor environment modeling or virtual navigation.

710611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
710611.value: Depth estimation is an important problem in image-based rendering and computer vision. During this project, we have proposed a general framework for high resolution depth estimation using stereo and kinect v1 depth sensing devices. We have designed and constructed a dynamic image-based rendering system to acquire more reliable depth maps and developed new methods for calibrating, fusion and restoration of the kinect-v1 depth camera and stereo cameras. The system, framework and some applications have been reported in a number of publications. The framework will benefit further development of high resolution depth cameras.

710711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
710711.value: Two global issues, namely environmental deterioration and fossil fuel crisis, have forced researchers to develop renewable and sustainable energy sources. The NASA estimated that more than 91 thousand TWh of accessible energy can be harnessed from the ocean annually. Also, our Government estimated that the wave energy source potential around Hong Kong is about 104 kWh/m2 per year. Therefore, the development of wave power generation is highly desirable, both globally and locally. Wave energy is in the form of low-speed reciprocating motion with very high forces. In order to capture this wave energy, a linear-to-rotary mechanism is usually employed to drive a conventional rotary machine for electricity generation. However, this mechanism not only suffers from bulky size and inefficient transmission, but also desires regular maintenance. Thus, the development of linear machines for direct-drive wave power generation is becoming attractive. Additionally, these linear machines can be completely submerged and fixed on the seabed, which receive wider public acceptance and are less vulnerable in storm. Among various linear machines, including the linear induction machine, linear switched reluctance machine, linear permanent magnet (PM) synchronous machine, linear transverse-flux PM machine and linear vernier PM machine, they can not simultaneously achieve the desired high force density, high efficiency and high power factor for direct-drive wave power generation. In order to achieve these goals, the idea of machine integration is born. Namely, a linear magnetic gear will be integrated into the linear PM synchronous machine in such a way that the high efficiency and high power factor can be inherited from the linear PM synchronous machine while the high force density can be imported from the linear magnetic gear. The purpose of this proposal is to develop a novel low-speed high-force linear PM machine for direct-drive wave power generation. The corresponding objectives are: (1) develop a novel linear PM machine topology which can simultaneously offer high force density, high efficiency and high power factor for direct-drive wave power generation; (2) develop a new modeling approach to analyze the performance of the proposed machine, including the electromagnetic force, cogging force, efficiency and power factor; (3) develop a new control strategy for the proposed machine, hence achieving maximum power point tracking under fluctuating wave motion; and (4) evaluate the proposed machine, including both technical performances and commercial values, for wave power generation. 當今有兩大全球性問題：即環境惡化和化石燃料危機，迫使研究人員開發可再生和可持續能源。美國宇航局估計，每年有超過91000億千瓦時的能量可以從海洋中獲取。此外，香港政府估計，香港周邊潛在的波浪能每年每平方米約有104千瓦時。因此，在全球和本地發展波浪能發電都是非常可取的。 波浪能一般是基於低速高力的往復運動。為了捕捉這種能量，傳統的發電機通常需要利用一種直線到旋轉的機制。但是，這種機制不僅體積龐大，效率不高，而且必須定期維護。因此，發展直接驅動的直線波浪能發電機越來越有吸引力。此外，這些直線發電機可以完全被海水覆蓋，並固定在海底，大大提高廣大市民的接受程度和減少受風暴的影響。 在各種直線電機中：包括直線感應電機，直線開關磁阻電機，直線永磁同步電機，直線橫向磁通永磁電機和直線游標永磁電機，他們都不能達到直接驅動波浪能發電機所要求的高力密度，高效率和高功率因數。為了實現這些目標，我們採用電機一體化的理念。也就是說，我們將直線磁齒輪結合直線永磁同步電機，從而承繼直線永磁同步電機的高效率和高功率因數及直線磁齒輪的高力密度。 本項目的目的是開發一種新型低速高力直接驅動的直線永磁波浪能發電機。相應的目標如下：（1）開發一種新型直線永磁電機的結構，它可同時提供高力密度，高效率和高功率因數;（2）制定新的建模方法來分析新開發的電機，包括電磁力，齒槽力，效率和功率因數;（3）制定一個新的控制策略來操作新開發的電機，從而實現在波浪波動下最大功率的運作;（4）考核新開發的電機，包括其技術性能和商業價值。

710711.label: Realisation of objectives
710711.value: The 1st objective has been fully achieved. To achieve effective direct-drive wave power generation, it is desirable to develop novel linear machine topologies having the features of high force density and low operating speed. Thus, two themes are identified: the integration of magnetic gears into permanent-magnet (PM) machines, and the development of PM machines based on the magnetic gearing effect. Firstly, by utilizing the modulation ring to modulate the high-speed armature field of the stator to match with the low-speed PM field of the rotor, the double-stator magnetic-geared machines are developed which can provide the desired low-speed high-torque feature. They can adopt either the dual-ring structure or the single-ring structure to achieve lower core loss or higher torque density. Secondly, based on the magnetic gearing effect, the PM vernier machines are developed which can inherently offer high torque density and low operating speed. The corresponding PM poles can be located in the rotor or in the stator, hence achieving higher torque density or lower PM cost. Consequently, these topologies are extended from the radial-field morphology to the linear morphology which can eliminate the rotary-to-linear mechanism and the associated transmission loss, leading to simultaneously offer high force density and high efficiency. Furthermore, by utilizing an auxiliary DC field winding to provide additional excitation, the linear hybrid PM vernier machines can significantly improve the power factor for wave power generation. The 2nd objective has been fully achieved. In order to analytically model the proposed machines which involve the magnetic gears or magnetic gearing effect, it is desirable to develop new analytically modeling approaches. Thus, two approaches are identified: one for the magnetic-geared machines, and one for the PM vernier machines. Firstly, due to the presence of iron segments and airspaces in a zebra-striped manner in the field modulation region of the magnetic-geared machines, the concept of anisotropic magnetic permeability is developed to handle the field modulation region. Hence, by solving the Laplace's and Poisson's equations, the corresponding magnetic field distributions can be analytically determined. Then, the machine performances including the electromagnetic force, cogging force, efficiency and power factor can be analytically assessed. Secondly, due to the presence of severe flux leakage in the vernier structure and multipole configuration of the PM vernier machines, the concept of magnetic equivalent network is developed. By taking into account the fringing effect in the air-gap to calculate the permeances at different tooth positions, the corresponding magnetic field distributions and hence machine performances can be analytically assessed. The 3rd objective has been fully achieved. In order to maximize the wave energy harvesting, the development of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) for the proposed low-speed high-force linear PM machines is highly desirable. For wave power generation, the maximum power absorption is attained when the natural frequency of the wave energy converter coincides with the wave frequency. Thus, the impedance of the linear PM machine can be purposely set equal to the complex conjugate of the impedance of the wave energy converter, hence achieving maximum power absorption. Consequently, the complex-conjugate control is developed for the proposed linear magnetic-geared machines and linear PM vernier machines, which forces the machines operating resonantly with the incident waves to achieve MPPT under fluctuating wave motion. In addition, after incorporating an auxiliary DC field winding, the linear hybrid PM vernier machine allows flexible air-gap flux control. Hence, by online tuning the field current, the power factor control of the linear hybrid PM vernier machine is developed. The 4th objective has been fully achieved. In order to comprehensively evaluate the proposed machines for wave power generation, their technical performances and commercial values are critically assessed. Firstly, the performance and cost comparisons between the radial morphology and linear morphology of the proposed machines are conducted. Secondly, the performance and cost comparisons between the linear PM machines and linear magnetless machines are made. Thirdly, the performance and cost comparisons between the non-rare-earth PM and rare-earth PM based linear machines are carried out. Hence, these comparisons reveal that the proposed linear magnetic-geared PM machines and linear PM vernier machines are of excellent technical performances and high commercial values for wave power generation. Moreover, when the cost-effectiveness needs to be emphasized, the use of non-rare-earth PM material is preferred. On top of the original objectives, two special kinds of linear machines are also developed for wave power generation. Since the transverse-flux PM machines are well known to offer high torque density, the transverse flux concept is extended to the flux-reversal PM machine. The resulting linear transverse-flux-reversal machine is developed which can offer excellent low-speed high-force feature. Moreover, by adopting the doubly salient structure with both armature and field windings located in the stator while simple laminated iron core in the mover, the linear flux-controllable variable reluctance machine is developed, which takes the advantages of wide constant-power range, high robustness and easy to manufacture.
