767711.label: Major findings and research outcome
767711.value: We have developed an approach to quantitatively determine the Waddington landscape for stem cell differentiation. Specifically we found that the differentiated state is more stable than the undifferentiated state of ES cell culture. The reason for maintaining ES cell population is the faster proliferation of ES cell stabilized the stem cell population. This discovery is confirmed both indirectly with population data and modeling, as well as direct observation via live cell imaging. This is a novel finding. We are preparing a manuscript for this body of work. In order to archive dynamic tracking of cell fate, we developed an high precision autofocus system for fluorescence microscope. It is can be used in many other applications such as 3D imaging and super resolution microscope. This work is published in the leading instrumentation journal: Review of Scientific Instruments in 2013 (see attached pdf file) We also implemented an piggybac transposson system for multiplex gene transfer in ES cells. We are able to stably transfer 6 gene effectively in a single cell, a critical step for implementing reporter and gene perturbation circuit in mammalian cells. It was published on PLoS On in 2014 (see attached pdf files). We also improved automatic imaging processing method to identify and tracing cell movement, division and differentiation. It is significantly better than the commercial solutions. We are preparing another manuscript on it.

767711.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
767711.value: We expanded our research into more later stage of ES cell differentiation with multiple reporters. Specifically we studied the differentiation of ES cell to Epiblast stem cell. Original studies that established the derivation of Epiblast stem cell cannot agree on the characterization of the state. One side said that it is Rex1-/Oct4+/Nanog+, the other side said that it is Rex1-/Oct4+/Nanog-. Based on single cell analysis and cell fate dynamics, we found that it is heterogeneous and identified three populations in the Epiblast stem cell culture. We plan to further pursue this direction, and characterize these three populations and transition among them. We hope to find a way to optimize culture condition to obtain pure population. This is fundamental for stem cell differentiation studies. Quantitatively perturbing critical genes such as Oct4 will unveil the best target for alter cell fate. However, people usually use chemical inducible gene regulation systems that lead to heterogeneity in gene expressions. We implemented an light controlled gene expression system to allow for wide range of gene expression modulation and reducing heterogeneity. We are currently working on quantitative tuning of Oct4 in ES cells. The cell lines are currently characterizing. We are also building novel optical systems to further reduce the heterogeneity. It would open a new field of study if we can carry this project through.

767711.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
767711.value: Previous studies took the stem cell population average approach. We dedicated ourselves to develop single cell-based cellular dynamic characterization. We developed several key technology necessary, including genetic, optical and mathematical tools. Our novel discoveries including: 1)Quantifying the hypothetical Waddington Landscape for stem cell for the first time; 2) differentiation cell is more stable than stem cell but stem cell proliferate faster to stabilize its fate at the population level.

767811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
767811.value: Our genome faces constant challenge from a host of DNA damaging agents. To protect genome integrity, the cell has evolved an intricate network of proteins that makes up the DNA damage response (DDR). The DDR entails the sensing and propagation of the DNA damage signal, and governs the activation of various effector systems, including cell cycle checkpoint control, DNA repair, cellular senescence and apoptosis. The intimate link between genome instability and tumorigenesis is evident from the many human cancer-predisposing diseases where mutations are found in components involved in the DDR pathways. Thus, mechanistic insights in the operations of the DDR warrant in-depth scrutiny, and will reveal novel targets and strategies for therapeutic intervention. In line with our overall goal in dissecting the DDR protein network, we have recently identified Ubiquitin Specific Protease 34 (USP34) as a putative factor involved in cellular responses to DNA damage. Accordingly, we found that USP34-depleted cells were hypersensitive to DNA damaging agents. More importantly, and consistent with direct roles of USP34 in maintaining genome stability, USP34 localises at DNA breaks, which overlaps extensively with those of the DNA damage marker γH2AX. In addition, USP34 accumulation at DNA breaks is strictly dependent on the recently identified DNA damage-signaling ubiquitin ligases RNF8 and the RIDDLE syndrome protein RNF168, strongly suggesting that USP34 functions at DNA breaks are regulated by the established DNA damage-signaling pathway. Together, these results strongly implicate USP34 in the mammalian DDR. To further probe the roles of USP34 in the DDR, we will study USP34 functions in checkpoint responses and cell survival, and examine the physical factors that regulate these USP34-dependent processes. We will delineate the regulatory pathway(s) that promote USP34 accumulation and functions at DNA breaks, and dissect the USP34-executed molecular events that contribute to the maintenance of genome stability. Finally, through the identification of USP34-associated factors, we hope to gain a more comprehensive understanding of the molecular makeup of the DDR pathway. Our proposed study, which aims to mechanistically unravel the roles of USP34 in the DDR pathway, will contribute significantly to our understanding of the molecular bases that enable the cell to respond and cope with DNA damage. Given the link between genome instability and tumorigenesis, it is conceivable that DDR components, such as in this case USP34, might represent novel markers for early cancer detection and drug targets for the treatment of human cancers. 为了维持基因组的稳定，细胞利用其错综复杂的蛋白网络以察觉和应答DNA损伤，从而保证遗传物质的正确传递。这种应对基因组毒性的细胞防御机制总称为DNA损伤应答(DNA damage response, DDR)，包括蛋白质信号转导级联，调控细胞周期检查点，DNA修复，细胞衰老和凋亡。最近的研究表明转译后蛋白修饰因子在DNA损伤应答的激活和调节中起着重要的分子开关角色。DNA损伤应答的调节异常会导致肿瘤发生，提示DDR因子在体内发挥肿瘤抑制功能，可充当癌症药物治疗的生物标记和靶点。 我們最近研究結果發現泛具體肽酶USP34在DNA損傷反應中發揮重要作用。本项目中我们将利用基本分子和細胞生物學技術探討泛具體肽酶USP34在DNA損傷反應中的角色, 包括USP34功能調控和USP34與其他DDR因子的關聯。 通過了解DDR因子在DNA損傷反應中的機制, 我们将進一步揭露DDR系統在体内发挥肿瘤抑制功能, 其將有助於治療性干預和發展早期診斷標誌物。

767811.value: We have identifed USP34 as a new regulator of signaling events at DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs). 768211.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
768211.value: 心肌再灌注是指对缺血心脏进行供血，这对抢救局部缺血的心肌是必不可少的。然而，长时间缺血（如心肌梗死）后再灌注会引发氧化应激并对心肌造成损伤。心肌再灌注损伤同样可见于直接经皮冠状动脉介入术中，该治疗可引起心肌梗塞从而可能致病甚至引起死亡。 因此，预防心肌再灌注损伤已成为当前医疗研究的重要方向。在长时间缺血前对心肌进行短时间的反复缺血再灌注可对心肌起保护作用，这种现象称为缺血预处理（Ischemic preconditioning，IPC）。虽然IPC已被证实有效，但这种治疗方法必须通过冠状血管进行操作，而这在大多数病例中并不具备可操作性。而另一方面，通过气囊反复充气和放气的后处理方法虽然已被认定为有效的治疗手段，却可能诱发动脉粥样硬化及远心端的栓塞。最新研究结果表明，远程缺血预处理（RIPC），即通过血压表套袖对肱动脉进行加压从而实现短时的无害封闭（无创性肢端缺血预处理，NLIP），在心脏缺血治疗中具有显著临床效果且无副作用。 然而，IPC的心脏保护效果在糖尿病患者中并未得到体现，表明糖尿病患者心脏对预处理的敏感性是受损的，而其中的机理目前尚未阐明。已有的NLIP研究并未在糖尿病患者中进行试验，因而糖尿病患者能否受益于这一重要的无创性RIPC疗法目前尚为谜题。 研究表明糖尿病患者心脏中的蛋白激酶信号通路（尤其是PI3K/AKT通路和JAK/STAT通路，这是实现心肌保护的主要信号通路，缺血预处理正是通过这两个通路实现对心脏的保护作用），可能受损，这可能导致在该病理条件下机体无法对心脏实施保护。本实验室早期的研究结果表明，促进心肌STAT激酶活化能够提高糖尿病心脏对药物预处理的敏感性。因而我们假设，抑制心肌STAT-3会降低糖尿病心脏对预处理的敏感性。假如这一假设成立，我们则将进一步研究NLIP强化能否修复糖尿病心脏对RIPC的敏感性。 因此，本研究的主要目的是鉴定糖尿病患者对RIPC丧失敏感性的主要诱因，并寻找修复该敏感性的可能治疗手段。该研究将有助于开发及完善新的有效治疗手段。特别地，强化的NLIP是安全且简单易操作的治疗手段，如果该方法能够在糖尿病患者中得到有效应用，则能够进一步与其他治疗手段结合从而在严重病理条件（如糖尿病）下发挥心脏保护作用。

768211.label: Realisation of objectives
768211.value: We have conducted series of in vivo and in vitro studies and confirmed that NLIP, when applied days (and repeated) before inducing index myocardial ischemia in diabetic rats is effective in protecting against myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury in diabetic rodents at various duration, and that STAT3 activation is key for NLIP to confirm cardioprotection. Therefore, objectives 1 and 2 are fulfilled. We have found that SAFE pathway,but not RISK pathway plays dominant role in NLIP cardioprotection, and therefore, this part of study was extended to explore the mechanism other than RISK pathway that may affect STAT3 activation in diabetes (i.e., PKC-epsilon).

768411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
768411.value: 慢性牙周炎對循環內皮祖細胞作用的分子機制之研究及臨床意義 背景：牙周病是人類最常見的疾病（2001年吉尼斯世界紀錄記載）。嚴重的牙周病（牙周炎）是全球成年人牙齒喪失的主要原因。最近新的科學證據表明，牙周病與心血管疾病和糖尿病有顯著的關係。 焦點：循環內皮祖細胞（EPCs）是一種骨髓衍生幹細胞，能夠促進血管內皮的修復和保持血管的完整性。因此，循環內皮祖細胞功能障礙會直接參與心血管疾病和糖尿病的產生及發展。炎症會顯著影響循環內皮祖細胞的功能，隨後導致血管內皮損傷和功能障礙。 拟研究解決的問題：牙周病是一種“無聲”且嚴重的感染。它顯著增加全身炎症水平(如C -反應蛋白和白細胞介素6水平增高)，並增加了心血管疾病和糖尿病的風險。牙齦卟啉菌是牙周病的一種主要細菌，它能促進動脈粥樣硬化和心血管疾病的發展。科學證據表明, 牙周病的治療有利於降低全身炎症水平，改善血管內皮功能和外周血單核細胞的基因表達。 我們牙科-醫科研究團隊最近的研究首次發現: 1）人類牙齦能直接產生C -反應蛋白, 其活動與白細胞介素6相關; 2）中度至重度牙周病與內皮祖細胞水平的提高有關。這些新的發現提供了進一步的證據，以支持牙周病與心血管疾病和糖尿病的關係。而相關的分子機制和臨床意義尚不清楚。 研究目的：1）調查牙周病與循環內皮祖細胞水平和功能的關係，並研究牙周治療對其影響; 2）研究牙周治療對循環內皮祖細胞全基因表達的影響; 3）闡明牙齦卟啉菌內毒素對人類內皮細胞和內皮祖細胞的影響，以及相關的分子機制。 相關性與意義：本研究將提供牙周病與心血管疾病和糖尿病關係的新證據，以及相關的分子機制。這些新發現有助於發展與制訂新的策略預防和控制牙周病，從而改善口腔健康和全身健康。

768411.label: Realisation of objectives
768411.value: P. gingivalis is currently claimed to be the 'keystone' pathogen for chronic periodontitis (Hajishengallis et al, 2012, Nat Rev Microbiol). P. gingivalis LPS is a crucial virulence factor and it has two typical isoforms of P. gingivalis LPS1690 and P. gingivalis LPS1435/1450. Our previous studies have preliminarily shown that i) these P. gingivalis LPSs with featured lipid A structural heterogeneity markedly modulate immuno-inflammatory response in human gingiva and subsequently weaken the innate host defense system (Jin 2011, Periodontology 2000); and ii) human chronic periodontitis is significantly associated with endothelial progenitor cells in subjects without diabetes that warrant the potential utilization as additional biomarkers in future studies on periodontal medicine (Li et al. 2011, J Dent Res). To timely address the emerging trend in this hot research field, within the overall framework of the study the weighting of objectives has been adjusted to reflect the current research trend. This project has therefore extended to investigate the effects of these typical isoforms of P. gingivalis LPS on human endothelial cells and oral cells as well as the underlying molecular mechanisms (Experimental arm of the study); and further explored the potential effects of chronic periodontitis and P. gingivalis LPS on circulating endothelial cells and related endothelial function in both diabetes and non-diabetic patients, as well as their clinical implications (Clinical arm of the study). The experimental arm of the study has been well undertaken, and multiple papers have been published in international journals. The clinical arm of the project in non-diabetic subjects has been performed with one paper published. While, the clinical study in diabetic patients is still ongoing, due to unforeseen difficulties in patient recruitment who meet all inclusion criteria and shortage of manpower to undertake and coordinate the research work (e.g. one co-investigator left after completion of PhD study, due to personal reasons). These issues have been addressed and the study goes well. The data will be presented for publication in due course. The lesson learned would be valuable for smoothly carrying large-scale clinical trials in the near future. As very recent studies have demonstrated the crucial role of inflammation and endothelial dysfunction in the development of cognitive impairment (Nelles et al 2015, Neurology), the current clinical studies have also explored the link of multiple tooth loss due to severe periodontitis with vascular cognitive impairment through collaboration with medical professionals. The interesting findings have been published in an international journal.

768411.label: Major findings and research outcome
768411.value: 1) The in vitro studies on human endothelial cells demonstrate that the two isoforms of P. gingivalis LPS1690 and LPS1435/1450 differentially induce the expression of IL-6 and IL-8 as well as other inflammatory mediators involved in the formation of atherosclerosis and related TLR signaling molecules. P. gingivalis LPS also contributes to the dysfunction of human endothelial cells (e.g. HUVEC) with a reduced migration rate and inhibition of their tube formation. These findings suggest that the P. gingivalis LPS1435/1450 released in high-hemin levels with uncontrolled periodontal inflammation could significantly affect the innate host defense and healing capacity in human endothelial cells, thereby contributing to atherosclerosis and the development of cardiovascular disease. 2) The extended in vitro studies on human oral keratinocytes and gingival fibroblasts show that P. gingivalis LPS1690 and LPS1435/1449 differentially regulate the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines (e.g. IL-6 and IL-8, and MMPs) and an important innate defense molecule (LPS-binding protein, LBP), via TLR4-mediated NF-kB signaling pathway and both TLR2 and TLR4 as well as NF-кB and p38 MAPK signaling pathways, respectively (Papers 1-4). P. gingivalis LPS-upregulated pro-inflammatory cytokine expression could be downregulated by baicalin via negative regulation of TLR signaling (Paper 5). These findings indicate that P. gingivalis as a keystone pathogen enables to evade innate host defense and contribute to disease development. 3) Adipocyte fatty acid-binding protein (A-FABP) is expressed in adipocytes, macrophages and microvascular endothelial cells, and it plays a central role in inflammation, atherosclerosis and metabolic responses. The clinical arm of the project has investigated for the first time the effect of nonsurgical periodontal therapy on the serum levels of A-FABP in subjects with chronic periodontitis. The findings provide the first evidence that effective treatment of periodontitis may significantly decrease the serum levels of A-FABP (Paper 6), and potentially contribute to control of atherosclerosis and related systemic inflammation. Further study is required to confirm this hypothesis. 4) Recent studies have shown that inflammatory cascade and vascular endothelial dysfunction are significantly associated with cognitive impairment (Nelles et al 2015). The current clinical studies have extended to investigate the possible association of multiple tooth loss due to severe periodontitis with vascular cognitive impairment. This study provides the first evidence that multiple tooth loss is independently associated with vascular cognitive impairment in patients with acute ischemic stroke (Paper 7). Further studies may assess the clinical benefits of holistic oral care in aging populations through the teamwork with medical professionals.

768411.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
768411.value: 1) P. gingivalis is the 'keystone' pathogen of chronic periodontitis. Further investigation on the effects of host microenvironmental factors like inflammation on its genotype, epigenotype and phenotype and expression of various virulent factors is highly warranted. These studies will a) enhance our understanding on the critical roles of this pathogen in periodontal pathogenesis and its effects on endothelial cell functions; b) contribute to developing novel approaches against this pathogen; and c) appreciate the clinical importance of controlling oral inflammation in prevention and effective management of periodontal disease. Our other RGC-funded ongoing projects will to some extent elucidate these critical issues. New proposals will be submitted for seeking RGC funds in due course. 2) Current evidence demonstrates that periodontal disease is significantly inter-connected with major non-communicable diseases that account for 60% of human mortality (Ezzati & Riboli 2012; Science) such as cardiovascular disease and diabetes, through infection-inflammation pathways and common risk factors (e.g. smoking). The recent studies of others and ours have highlighted the great importance of incorporating oral/periodontal healthcare into general health agenda, through close collaboration and teamwork of dental-medical professionals for optimal oral and general health. Large-scale clinical trials and related public health projects should be undertaken in Hong Kong.

768411.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
768411.value: The recent Global Burden of Diseases Study indicates that severe gum disease (periodontitis) is the 6th most common disease in humans with huge socio-economic impacts worldwide (Murray et al, 2012, Lancet; Kassebaum et al. 2014 J Dent Res; Chapple 2014, BMJ). It not only significantly affects oral health, being the major cause of tooth loss in adults, but also strongly links with life-threatening systemic diseases such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes mellitus and dementia, through the oral-body inter-connected infectious and inflammatory pathways as well as sharing common risk factors like smoking and obesity. The findings from this project have important clinical implications. Oral/periodontal health is an essential component of general health and well-being. Currently, the overall awareness of oral/periodontal health remains low among the public community. Moreover, oral/periodontal diseases share a number of risk factors with major systemic diseases like diabetes and heart disease (e.g. tobacco smoking, unhealthy diet, stress and obesity). Oral health-care professionals should closely collaborate with medical professionals and health authorities/organization on tackling these common risk factors for optimal oral and general health as well as enhancing quality of life in the aging population.

768511.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
768511.value: There is a growing evidence that habitat and environmental factors have a profound influence on cetacean societal structures such as socio-behavioural dynamics, demographic parameters, larger-scale geographic patterns and genetic structures. Even though our understanding of these processes is only recent and incomplete, the apparent frequent association between habitat, genetic structure and social structure observed in delphinids suggests the inter-relatedness of these factors within cetacean species. In this project we examine the processes that shape the structure, connectivity, and socio-behavioural dynamics of island-associated dolphin populations; with prior studies used to provide bases for testing previously proposed models in a new location, geographically different but with comparable features of habitat and ecology, and with a new analytical framework. The research will take place in Solomon Islands, western Pacific. Equipped with genetic and photo-identification mark-recapture techniques, we will quantify metapopulation dynamics of two sympatric island-associated dolphin species that differ in ecology; two socio-ecological model systems (two dolphin species) within one ecosystem (an oceanic archipelago) -- a potentially excellent natural "laboratoty" furnishing a valuable evolutionary comparative perspective. We will deliver quantitative analyses of population parameters, geographic fidelity, genetic structure, dispersal patterns, and rigorous models of socio-behavioural dynamics. By means of comparative analyses with earlier research, we will examine whether and how habitat differences between regions influence dolphin demographic parameters and socio-ecological patterns, gaining a greater understanding of the ecological factors responsible for the variation in dispersal and social structure. This is an excellent opportunity to investigate processes that are fundamental to the functioning of free-ranging delphinid populations, with testing conceptual models that relate behavioural plasticity to environmental variation. Our results will contribute to an understanding of the influence of behaviour and geography on the genetic structuring of populations and what are the further implications on population processes and socio-behavioural group dynamics. This study will also deliver vital information for the conservation and management; both species investigated in this project experience substantial anthropogenic pressures and our work will be instrumental in assessing the severity of impacts and proposing management measures. These assessments will likely prove valuable to conservation efforts elsewhere, especially in terms of developing predictive management models. 768611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
768611.value: Freshwater ecosystems are experiencing calamitous losses of biodiversity and have been described as the most imperiled habitats in the world. Conserving biodiversity in these environments is essential for maintenance of the ecosystem goods and services they provide to humans. Studies have demonstrated a strong link between biodiversity and ecosystem functioning; ecosystems with higher diversity tend towards higher stability in ecosystem processes. Further research is needed, particularly at realistic temporal and spatial scales, to fully resolve these relationships so that we may better predict how anthropogenic impacts, such as those associated with climate change, will affect the functioning of freshwater ecosystems. Larval amphibians are important vertebrate components of freshwater environments, often occurring at high densities, occupying a variety of positions in the food web, affecting carbon cycling, primary production, and nutrient dynamics, and even modifying their environments in small water bodies. In addition, amphibians are among the most threatened animals, having suffered catastrophic global declines in recent decades. These features make them exceptional target organisms for studies of links between diversity and ecosystem functioning. We propose to examine how diversity in larval amphibian communities regulates ecosystem responses and determine at what levels of complexity increasing densities and water temperature destabilize these communities. To do this we will carry out the following experiments: (1) Evaluate ecosystem responses, including carbon cycling, primary production, and nutrient dynamics, to manipulation of diversity in larval amphibian communities; (2) Quantify organism-level contributions to ecosystem responses in multi-species assemblages by measuring interaction strength, competitive strength, and constituent strength of component species and by defining functional roles; (3) Characterize the role that larval amphibian densities play in mediating ecosystem responses; (4) Examine ecosystem-level responses when larval amphibian assemblages are exposed to increases in water temperatures predicted for the end of this century by climate change scenarios; and (5) Develop models that characterize how the combined effects of larval amphibian densities and increased temperatures will affect primary production, carbon cycling, and nutrient dynamics in aquatic ecosystems. Given the high abundance and demonstrated importance of larval amphibians to aquatic environments, an investigation of the connections between biodiversity and ecosystem functioning in amphibian communities may lend novel insights to our understanding these relationships in freshwater ecosystems. This study will also more fully resolve how larval densities, an important factor in structuring communities and populations, and increasing temperatures alter biodiversity-ecosystem functioning relationships. 淡水生態系統被視為世界上最受威脅的生境，其生物多樣性正在急劇下降。保育淡水生物多樣性對維持生態系統服務（ecosystem services）尤其重要。有研究顯示生物多樣性與生態系統的運作有著密切的關係，高多樣化的生態系統往往有較高的穩定性。要了解人類對淡水生態系統運作的影響，譬如氣候變化，需要更多跨時空的研究。兩棲動物幼體是淡水生境中重要的脊椎動物。牠們的密度甚高，於食物網中佔據多個不同的席位，並影響碳循環（carbon cycling）、初級生產（primary production）及養份動態（nutrient dynamics）。於小型水體內，牠們甚至能夠改造其周遭的環境。此外，兩棲類是最受威脅的動物之一，近數十年內其數量在全球正急劇下降。故此，兩棲動物是研究生物多樣性及生態系統運作的重要對象。我們建議研究兩棲幼體群種的多樣性如何調節生態系統的運作，並推斷出於何等程度的水溫及幼體密度上升會引致群種失衡。我們計劃進行以下實驗：（一）藉著調控兩棲幼體群種的多樣性以評估其對生境的影響，包括碳循環、初級生產及養份動態；（二）藉著量度物種之間的相互關係及功能角色（functional roles），以量化兩棲幼體在多物種集群（multi-species assemblages）內對生態系統的重要性；（三）描繪兩棲幼體密度在調節生態系統運作上的角色；（四）評估當兩棲幼體處於本世紀末的預測水溫下對生態系統運作的影響；（五）建立模型以描繪兩棲幼體密度及水溫上升的相互作用對水生環境的影響，包括碳循環、初級生產及養份動態。鑑於兩棲幼體的高密度及對水生環境的的重要性，研究其生物多樣性與生態系統的關係能增進我們對淡水生態系統的了解。這項研究能有助我們充份地掌握兩棲幼體密度及氣溫上升對生物多樣性及生態系統關係的轉變。

769711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
769711.value: Psychotic disorder (Including schizophrenia and related disorders) involve complex brain dysfunctions affecting up to 3% of the population. They constitute one of the highest disease burdens globally and locally. The conditions inflict devastating consequences for youth and adults at the most productive years in their lives. It is estimated that each year 1000-2000 individuals in Hong Kong develop a psychotic disorder for the first time in their lives. Despite progress in the development of medication with fewer side effects, the treatment often cannot alleviate the disability associated with this chronic form of illness. Deficit symptoms and cognitive impairment, which appear to be the greatest determinants of disability, remain largely beyond the reach of current forms of treatment. The treatment outcome is often poor and associated with extensive cost, burden, morbidity and mortality. Emerging evidence suggests that much of the disability associated with psychotic illness, particularly schizophrenia, develops long before the onset of frank psychosis. This pre-onset or prodromal period is characterised by non-specific symptoms such as depressed mood and anxiety as well as sub-threshold symptoms. Cortical changes during this period are associated with cognitive, social and motivational dysfunctions. Intervention during the prodromal phase may create an opportunity to prevent or minimize later ill health. The overall aim of the proposed study is to evaluate the effectiveness of cognitive behavioural therapy on young people with high-risk of developing psychosis. The results will not only facilitate our understanding on the type and timing of intervention that we should plan for the high risk subjects in this critical phase of illness progression in our local population, but they may also shed light on the possibility of delaying, ameliorating or preventing the onset of schizophrenia and related psychotic disorders, thereby reducing the stigmatization, burden, disability and economic consequences associated with these disorders. 精神疾病(包括精神分裂及相關精神疾病)影響著3%人口的生活。在全球及本地的疾病負擔研究中，精神病病人的疾病負擔皆高踞首位。這個疾病為青年及成年患者帶來深遠的影響。每年本地新症發病個案大約有1000-2000宗。隨著精神醫學的進步，藥物治療的副作用正逐步減少，但仍未能紓緩長期患病帶來的生活限制。其中陰性症狀及認知能力下降尤其對病患生活造成破壞，而現時的治療效用未見顯著。另外問題亦包括低療效高成本、疾病負擔、發病率及死亡率高。 研究顯示精神疾病相關的生活限制遠在病發之先已出現，這在精神分裂患者中尤其嚴重。思覺失調高風險階段常見的不明顯徵狀包括抑鬱情緒及焦慮等前驅徵狀。大腦皮層的轉變與認知、社交和動力下降等問題有著密切的關係。及早在高風險階段進行干預或許有助預防及減低日後嚴重的後遺症。 本研究旨在了解認知行為治療方法是否能有效預防思覺失調高風險人士發病及消除現有的病徵。研究有助確認對年輕思覺失調高風險人士最有效的治療方法及進行干預的最佳時機。推遲、改善及預防精神分裂及相關精神疾病發病的同時，減低隨之而來的負面標籤、疾病負擔及經濟成本。

769811.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
769811.value: With economic development and increasingly obesogenic environments, an epidemic of type 2 diabetes is emerging. Diabetes is particularly prevalent in Asia, where rates have outstripped levels in some long-term industrialized populations. Environmental and lifestyle changes enabled by rapid economic development and rural to urban migration are undoubtedly driving this epidemic. However, the high rate of diabetes in Asia in relatively non-obese populations suggests additional factors may be relevant. Increasingly not only adult lifestyles but also environmental influences over the life course or over generations, perhaps driven by epigenetic mechanisms, are thought to play a role. Over generations of economic development in long-term developed populations, there have been several secular trends, most obviously increasing height but also earlier sexual maturation and increases in frame size and bulk. Muscle mass is a sink for glucose disposal, which protects against diabetes. Currently Asians have less muscle mass than long-term developed populations. Body composition is known to be relevant to diabetes, however to date interest has largely focused on the role of adipose tissue, perhaps because the epidemic of diabetes in long-term developed population is primarily driven by adiposity. However the potentially complementary role of muscle mass may be important - particularly in non-western populations where diabetes is common at relatively low levels of obesity. Peak muscle mass occurs at the completion of growth and is promoted by sex-steroids. In this proposal, building on an existing, large, well-characterized, population-representative birth cohort of adolescents from a recently developed Chinese population, we will examine the role of pubertal muscle mass, and its determinants, on glucose metabolism. We will test the hypothesis that pubertal muscle mass is positively associated with glucose metabolism in a large, well-characterized random sample of Hong Kong Chinese adolescents (n=750) from a developed non-western setting. We will also take advantage of our well-characterized cohort to test the hypotheses that pubertal muscle mass is positively associated with living conditions over generations, birth weight and current lifestyle potentially via sex steroids, with potentially greater effects amongst boys than girls. This proposal will examine a novel hypothesis in an under-studied population, and thereby answer a question relevant to the health of a large proportion of the global population from the developing world. It also has the potential to identify an often overlooked developmental stage, i.e., puberty, as a potential window of intervention for long-term health. It may provide information about potential intervention policies. 隨著經濟發展與致肥環境影響，二型糖尿病發病率開始增高。糖尿病在亞洲、特別一些早已工業化的地區發病率偏高。 高速經濟發展導致環境與生活方式的改變，以及農村往城市的移動，都是造成這一現象的原因。 然而，亞洲非肥胖人群中的高糖尿病發病率意味著其他致病因素的存在。除了成年人的生活方式，一生甚至幾代的生活環境，及其產生之表觀遺傳，都可能是導致糖尿病高發的原因。 已有長期經濟發展的人群通常都具有以下的趨勢：身高增長、早熟及體格較大。肌肉能吸收多餘葡萄糖，有助於預防糖尿病。身體結構與糖尿病有很大關聯，但是可能由於多數發達地區人群的糖尿病是由於高脂肪而引發，現在大多數研究都集中在脂肪和糖尿病的關係。現在的亞洲人較其他已發達地區人群擁有較少的肌肉，肌肉和糖尿病於生活在肥胖率較低的非西方發達地區的人群中可能有重要的關係。性激素於發育時期增加人體肌肉的重量，而人體的肌肉於發育結束時亦發展完成。此建議書將建立在一個對於這一代的中國青少年具有代表性的獨特大型出生隊列上。我們會測試青春期肌肉含量對於葡萄糖代謝的影響。我們會於這非西方發達地區的出生隊列中隨機抽样調查的香港華人青少年中（n=750），研究青春期肌肉重量對於葡萄糖代謝有的影響。我們也同時研究幾代生活質素，出生重量，當前生活習慣對於青春期肌肉含量與性激素的影響，以及研究這些因素是否對於男性的肌肉含量有影響較大。 此建議書會測試一個在較少被研究的人群中的新穎假設，從而解答發展中國家的人群的健康相關問題。此研究有助於了解青春期對於長期健康的影響，並對於糖尿病的預防措施帶來新的資訊。

769811.label: Realisation of objectives
769811.value: We have implemented the research plan and examined a sub-sample of the “Children of 1997” birth cohort, including the assessment of muscle mass and sex-steroids. This new information builds on the existing information we have assembled on the cohort throughout their lives. We have analyzed the data collected to answer the research questions in the main and secondary objectives. a) Main objective: Higher skeletal muscle mass was, as hypothesized, associated with lower fasting glucose, insulin and HOMA-IR in Chinese adolescents. The association of testosterone with fasting glucose, insulin and HOMA-IR was, as hypothesized, partially mediated by skeletal muscle mass in Chinese adolescents. b) Secondary objective: Higher testosterone, meat consumption, and physical activity were associated with greater skeletal muscle mass in Chinese adolescents, whereas mother place of birth was not associated with greater muscle mass. As such these results suggest that adolescence may be a key window of intervention for diabetes prevention in our setting, by building muscle mass. We have completed all the tasks and objectives in the proposal.

769811.label: Major findings and research outcome
769811.value: Our first study found higher testosterone level is associated with better glucose metabolism, which is partially mediated by pubertal muscle mass. And the association was mediated by pubertal muscle mass. Total testosterone was negatively associated with fasting glucose (-0.008, 95% confidence interval (CI) -0.015 to -0.002), insulin (-0.43, 95% CI -0.56 to -0.30) and HOMA-IR (-0.089, 95% CI -0.12 to -0.062) adjusted for sex, birth weight, highest parental education, mother’s place of birth and physical activity. These associations were attenuated by additional adjustment for skeletal muscle mass. The second study found physical activity and meat consumption are associated with higher pubertal muscle mass in adolescents, where mother’s place of birth was not associated with pubertal muscle mass. Higher physical activity was associated with higher skeletal muscle mass (0.154, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.058 to 0.251), adjusted for sex, mother’s place of birth and highest parental education. More frequent meat eating was also associated with higher SMI adjusting for sex (0.193, 95% CI 0.021 to 0.365), but the association was attenuated after further adjusting for mother’s place of birth and highest parental education (0.159, 95% CI -0.016 to 0.334).

769811.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
769811.value: One abstract has been submitted and several full papers are to follow. A publication form this project is under review at an international journal, as the Diabetic Medicine Journal. Further papers are anticipated. Given, this project has been very successful in identifying the testosterone and pubertal muscle mass’s association with glucose metabolism in adolescents, indicating the potential role of sex steroid and body composition in diabetes. Future studies examining effects of other sex steroids on diabetes and other chronic diseases may be carried out. We have used the same approach to find out if there an association of serum estradiol with blood glucose in adolescents, thereby affecting long-term risk of diabetes. Data collected during this project are particularly valuable for future researches on adolescent sex steroid level and its potential long-term health effects.

769811.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
769811.value: With rapid economic development, an aging population, and decreasing levels of physical activity, a diabetes epidemic is emerging in Asia despite its relatively non-obese population. We hypothesize that environmentally driven muscle mass acquisition at puberty may also be relevant. Our study recruited adolescent participants from a large, population representative “Children of 1997” birth cohort in a developed region of China (Hong Kong), to examine the association of pubertal testosterone with skeletal muscle mass and with fasting glucose, fasting insulin, and insulin resistance in adolescence. Most relevant previous studies were conducted in older participants and patients with diabetes, which might have subjected to reverse causality. Our results show pubertal testosterone and skeletal muscle mass were both negatively associated with fasting glucose, fasting insulin, and insulin resistance. Given that few studies have addressed the association in Chinese population, it may shed some light on understanding risk factors for the emerging epidemic of diabetes in developing countries.

770211.label: Realisation of objectives
770211.value: For objective 1, we have successfully discovered several novel paramyxoviruses in animals, including novel feline morbillivirus (FmoPV) in cats, novel variant of Beilong virus (BeV) in rats, novel porcine parainfluenza virus 1 (PPIV-1) in pigs and novel anaconda paramyxovirus in green anaconda. The genome sequences of these novel paramyxoviruses have been determined and analyzed to determine their phylogenetic position and genome evolution. Complete genome sequencing showed that FmoPV, PPIV-1 ad novel anaconda paramyxovirus represents novel paramyxoviruses. Complete genome sequencing showed that PPIV-1 represented a novel paramyxovirus within the genus Respirovirus, being most closely related to human parainfluenza virus 1 (HPIV-1) and Sendai virus (SeV). Genome analysis of the novel BeV variant supports the grouping of BeV, Tailam virus, and J virus into a new genus of Paramyxovirinae. For objective 2, we have designed various consensus and specific primers, and developed RT-PCR assays to detect these novel paramyxoviruses in different animals Using the RT-PCR assays, we have also studied the epidemiology of these viruses. FmoPV was detected in 56 (12.3%) of 457 stray cats by RT-PCR. A case control study using the RT-PCR assay showed the presence of TIN in 7 of 12 cats with FmoPV infection, but only 2 of 15 cats without FmoPV infection (P<0.05). A novel variant of BeV was detected in 40 kidney and 9 spleen samples from 43 rats in Hong Kong by RT-PCR (40 brown rats and 3 black rats) PPIV-1 was detected in 12 (3.1 %) of 386 nasopharyngeal and two (0.7 %) of 303 rectal swab samples from 386 deceased pigs by RT-PCR, RT-PCR for the novel anaconda paramyxovirus was positive (viral loads of 2.33 × 10(4) to 1.05 × 10(8) copies/mg tissue) in specimens from anaconda juveniles that died but negative in specimens from anaconda that survived. For objective 3, we have developed western blot assays to study the seroprevalence of FmPV in domestic cats. IgG against FmoPV N protein was positive in 49 (76.7%) sera of 56 RT-PCR-positive cats, but 78 (19.4%) of 401 RT-PCR-negative cats (P<0.0001) by western blot. However, development of serological tests were not successful for other paramyxoviruses, due to unavailability of animal sera or low antigenicity of expressed N proteins. In addition to serological tests, we have also developed various cell culture platforms for isolation of FmoPV and anaconda paramyxovirus, although isolation of BeV and PPIV-1 was not successful. These cell culture systems will enable downstream pathogenicity studies.

770211.label: Major findings and research outcome
770211.value: We have designed consensus primers and developed RT-PCR assays to detect paramyxoviruses in different animal samples. During the process, we have successfully discovered several novel paramyxoviruses in animals, including novel feline morbillivirus (FmoPV) in cats, novel variant of Beilong virus (BeV) in rats, novel porcine parainfluenza virus 1 (PPIV-1) in pigs and novel anaconda paramyxovirus in green anaconda (see Part C). FmoPV was isolated from domestic cat (Felis catus) in Hong Kong using CRFK feline kidney cells. FmoPV was detected in 56 (12.3%) of 457 stray cats by RT-PCR. Complete genome sequencing showed that FmoPV represents a novel paramyxovirus species. Serological studies showed that IgG against FmoPV N protein was positive in 49 (76.7%) sera of 56 RT-PCR-positive cats, but 78 (19.4%) of 401 RT-PCR-negative cats (P<0.0001) by western blot. Histological examination of necropsy tissues in two FmoPV-positive cats revealed features of tubulointerstitial nephritis (TIN). A case control study showed the presence of TIN in 7 of 12 cats with FmoPV infection, but only 2 of 15 cats without FmoPV infection (P<0.05), suggesting an association between FmoPV and TIN. BeV has been isolated from a rat cell line but the animal reservoir remains uncertain. A novel variant of BeV was detected in 40 kidney and 9 spleen samples from 43 rats in Hong Kong by RT-PCR (40 brown rats and 3 black rats), suggesting that these animals are the reservoir of BeV. Detection of BeV in kidney and spleen samples suggested that they are probably systemic viruses excreted in urine. Phylogenetic and genomic evidence support the grouping of BeV, Tailam virus, and J virus into a new genus of Paramyxovirinae. PPIV-1 was detected in 12 (3.1 %) of 386 nasopharyngeal and two (0.7 %) of 303 rectal swab samples from 386 deceased pigs by RT-PCR, with viral loads of up to 10(6) copies ml(-1). Complete genome sequencing showed that PPIV-1 represented a novel paramyxovirus within the genus Respirovirus. The presence of PPIV-1 in mainly respiratory samples suggests a possible association with respiratory disease. 31 green anaconda (Eunectes murinus) juveniles from an oceanarium in Hong Kong died in 2011, with systemic multiorgan necrotizing inflammation. RT-PCR showed that a novel anaconda paramyxovirus was present in specimens from anaconda juveniles that died but negative in specimens from anaconda that survived. The virus was isolated from BHK21 cells. Epidemiological and genomic analyses suggested that the anaconda juveniles acquired the virus perinatally from the anaconda mother.

770211.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
770211.value: FmoPV represents the first documentation of paramyxoviruses found in the domestic cat and is associated with TIN. Renal failure is a common cause of deaths in cats and the cause of renal failure is often obscure. Therefore, we plan to establish an animal model to explore the causative role of FmoPV in renal failure in cats. Moreover, our study represents the first to demonstrate an association between a paramyxovirus and TIN. We will examine the role of paramyxoviruses in renal diseases in human and other animals. Based on our study on BeV, we speculate that the ancestor of BeV and related paramyxoviruses infected the common ancestor of rats and mice. Therefore, we are in search for other novel paramyxoviruses in rodents so as to better understand the evolution of this group of paramyxoviruses which may represent a novel genus. Pigs are important food animals worldwide. We plan to further study the role of PPIV-1 in respiratory illness and mortalities in swine population, which may help understand the economic impact of PPIV-1 and the potential for vaccine development. We will also continue to study the epidemiology, pathogenicity and transmission dynamics of anaconda paramyxovirus in anaconda population in our oceanarium.

770211.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
770211.value: We have discovered several novel paramyxoviruses in animals, including novel feline morbillivirus (FmoPV) in cats, novel variant of Beilong virus (BeV) in rats, novel porcine parainfluenza virus 1 (PPIV-1) in pigs and novel anaconda paramyxovirus in green anaconda in Hong Kong. We have also developed new rapid detection and serological tests for detection of these novel paramyxoviruses. FmoPV was detected in 56 (12.3%) of 457 stray cats. We also showed that FmoPV is associated with tubulointerstitial nephritis in cats. We detected a novel variant of BeV in kidney and spleen samples of rats in Hong Kong, suggesting that these animals are the reservoir of BeV and that they are systemic viruses excreted in urine. PPIV-1 was detected in 12 (3.1 %) of 386 nasopharyngeal and two (0.7 %) of 303 rectal swab samples from 386 deceased pigs. The presence of PPIV-1 in mainly respiratory samples suggests a possible association with respiratory disease. We detected novel anaconda paramyxovirus in green anaconda juveniles from an oceanarium in Hong Kong that died in 2011. Epidemiological and genomic analyses suggested that the anaconda juveniles acquired the virus perinatally from the anaconda mother rather than from other reptiles in the park, with subsequent interanaconda juvenile transmission.

770411.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
770411.value: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a disease with a strong genetic component. Recent genome-wide association studies (GWAS) including our own identified dozens of common genetic variants associated with the disease. However, the GWAS findings only explain a small proportion of genetic heritability. It is believed that rare alleles may play a vital role in complex diseases such as SLE. Novel methodology is required to identify rare variants involved in diseases since GWAS and family-based linkage and association studies are all seriously underpowered. Rapid advances in the next generation sequencing (NGS) technology make it possible to detect these rare variants through sequencing. While whole genome sequencing is still too expensive to apply on complex diseases, exome sequencing, by focusing on the coding regions that constitute only 1% of human genome that has high chances of harboring functional rare variants, seems to be a valid tool in moving genetics of complex diseases beyond GWAS. To apply NGS technology to complex diseases, patients need to be stratified and groups of patients who are most likely to harbor high penetrant rare variants need to be selected in the discovery stage. Secondly, pooling samples is necessary to increase power of discovery and to contain cost. Thirdly, valid verification approaches, both statistical and experimental, need to be in place to replicate findings from exome sequencing. In this study, we propose to use whole exome sequencing on a number of well-selected SLE patients with familial aggregation and very early onset for the initial discovery of coding variants involved in this disease. In the next stage, selected number of coding variants will be further examined in other SLE patients with a much larger sample size and healthy controls to confirm the sequencing findings. The next wave of discovery after GWAS may lie in the identification of rare variants. Fully utilizing the sample collection we have with a total of more than 8,000 cases and more than 10,000 controls, this project promises to make new discoveries on rare variants and to significantly improve our understanding of the genetics of SLE. It is necessary to do this on Asian populations in light of the higher disease prevalence and predicted population differences in genetic factors involved in this disease. Exploration in the methodology and experimental design in using exome sequencing for complex disease is also an important attempt that could have impact on studies of other diseases. 系統性紅斑狼瘡（SLE）是具有很強的遺傳成分的一種疾病。最近的全基因組關聯研究（GWAS），包括我們自己的工作，確定了幾十个常見的与疾病有關的基因變異。然而，GWAS結果只解釋一小部分的遺傳基因。據認為，罕見等位基因在複雜的疾病中可能發揮至關重要的作用。新一代測序（NGS）技術使人們有可能通過測序快速檢測這些罕見的變異。雖然全基因組測序仍然過於昂貴，外顯子組測序，通過集中測序只佔人類基因組1％的編碼地區，具有很高的機會发现具有功能性的罕見變異，似乎是一個有效的工具。首先，我们需要对患者進行分析，看哪些病人最有可能含有高滲透性的罕見的變異。其次，集中樣品测序可能增加效能和控制成本。第三，以有效的核查方法对外顯子組測序結果進行複製。在這項研究中，我們建議使用全外顯子組測序的方法检测精心挑選的有家族聚集性的和较早发病的SLE患者来發現參與了這一疾病的編碼變異。在下一階段，我们會進一步用更大的樣本检验经过挑選的編碼變種。 充分利用我們採集的共8000多例病例和超過 10,000的对照，該項目有望發現新的罕見變種，並顯著改善我們对SLE遺傳學的理解。

770611.label: Project Title(Chinese)
770611.value: 以體素為基礎的病變-症狀映射方法研究中文語法特徵

770611.label: Co - Investigator(s)
770611.value: Dr Copland, David Dr Kong, Anthony Pak Hin Dr Lee, Alice Su-Ying Dr Wong, Chun Sing

770611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
770611.value: 一直以來，腦與語言行為之間的關係在神經語言學和心理語言學都引起廣泛興趣。一個多世紀以來，我們對語言加工的神經代表性的知識來源於觀察局部性腦損傷病人腦部損傷部位與語言缺陷的相關性。這種傳統的病變研究，往往是由於樣本量小，大的病變，高度複雜的神經心理檔案，難以利用客觀的統計分析而限制了研究結果的普遍性和特殊性。 雖然這些缺點可以利用在近幾十年來非常流行的功能成像方法對正常人研究來規避，腦活動的高度互動性往往難以對大腦區域的特定語言功能的必要性作出結論。此外，在掃描儀內執行任務對被試的行為反應有一定的限制，最主要的是言語產生。沿著病變的研究方向，相對較新的方法是以體素為基礎的病變-症狀映射 (VLSM; Bates et al., 2003)。這種方法，通過從一組腦損傷人士在掃描儀外的行為表現，以分體素基礎，觀察腦和認知的映射關係。該VLSM方法使研究人員能夠在行為表現的基礎上使用各種統計來作推論。它也因此在近年來很快被採納來研究多種認知功能。 這項試驗性研究將採用VLSM技術研究中文其中一個最重要語法特徵的神經關聯。中文是聲調語言。它具有相對較少的屈折語素，導致詞類之間缺乏明確的區分。它還容許句子中的主語及謂語有較鬆散的關係，以及在清晰的語景下，省略主語和賓語。這些特性導致了中文定性為一種以話語而不是句子為導向的語言。我們會探討聲調的感知和產生的神經關聯。我們還將評估我們的研究結果及前人的研究結果的銜接程度。 我們認為，探討一個在類型上與歐洲語言折然不同的語言將帶出有趣的對比和挑戰，啟發和深化我們對人類語言加工的神經系統基本特徵的認識。 此外，目前的研究具有一個潛在巨大的臨床意義，這就是產生一個包括對腦部損傷部位和語言表現，神經心理檔案，以及從中文失語症病人的人口背景詳細分析資料的數據庫。 該數據庫將可能使臨床醫生更好地預測中風後失語症患者的語言能力，類似於PLORAS系統（Predicting Language Outcome and Recovery After Stroke; Price, Seghier, & Leff, 2010），因而可能會提高復康服務的質素。

771011.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
771011.value: CD38 is a trans-membrane protein ubiquitously expressed in virtually all mammalian tissues. Two decades of work has revealed that it is a novel signaling enzyme responsible for synthesizing and metabolizing cyclic ADP-ribose (cADPR), a novel Ca2+ messenger that modulates the channel activity of the ryanodine receptor and mobilizes the endoplasmic Ca2+ stores. Gene knockout studies have established that CD38 regulates a wide range of physiological functions, from insulin secretion, susceptibility to bacterial infection, to social behavior of mice through modulating neuronal oxytocin secretion. The mechanism of how it catalyzes the multiple reactions responsible for metabolizing cADPR has also been elucidated to atomic resolution by X-ray crystallography. The stage is now set for engineering CD38 to generate useful constructs for altering the cADPR levels in cells and tissues. The success of this project not only will produce the much needed tools for modulating Ca2+ signaling in cells, but also provide valuable insights into the endogenous regulatory mechanisms of this novel Ca2+ signaling enzyme. The specific Aims are: Aim 1: To engineer a soluble form of CD38 for calcium signaling. Aim 2: To delineate the determinants of membrane topology of CD38. Aim 3: To elucidate the membrane topology of endogenous CD38. CD38是一种在几乎所有的哺乳动物组织中都表达的跨膜蛋白。二十年的工作已经表明，它是一个新的合成和代谢循环环腺苷二磷酸核糖（cADPR）的信号酶。cADPR是一种新型的钙信使，它能通过调节兰诺定受体的通道活性来释放内质网的钙。基因敲除的研究已经证明了CD38的广泛的生理功能，包括调节胰岛素的分泌，引起细菌感染，和通过调节神经催产素分泌来影响小鼠的社会行为。原子分辨率的X射线晶体学也已阐明CD38是如何代谢cADPR的多种催化反应机制。现阶段的工作是如何设计加工有用的CD38结构以改变细胞和组织中的cADPR水平。这一项目的成功不仅会产生急需的调节钙信号的工具，并且能提供关于这个新的钙信号酶的内源性调控机制的有价值的见解。具体目标是： 目的1：设计加工可溶性CD38来研究钙信号。 目的2：找出CD38的膜拓扑结构的决定因素。 目的3：阐明内源性CD38的膜拓扑结构

771011.label: Realisation of objectives
771011.value: The original grant holder, HC Lee, left HKU in 2013 and his colleague and collaborator, Q Hao, took over the project. The objective of the project is 100% completed. We have succeeded in engineering a soluble form of CD38 and a type III membrane bound form of CD38. In both cases, the catalytic domains are in the cytosol and are biologically active in raising the cellular cADPR contents. We have also determined the critical determinants in controlling the membrane topology of CD38. The results are so novel and original that Science has selected our article as its Editor's Choice (see attached) .

771111.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
771111.value: 肝癌是世界上第五大常見惡性腫瘤，在東南亞和香港是位居第二的癌症“殺手”。由於肝癌患者出現症狀就診時通常已處於中晚期，因此預後很差。中晚期肝癌很多已出現多處轉移灶。癌症的轉移是一個複雜過程，涉及到多個激酶的激活，但是肝癌轉移的分子機制尚不清楚。近來，蛋白絲氨酸/蘇氨酸磷酸化被認為是一個重要的翻譯後修飾，在腫瘤轉移相關的信號轉導過程中發揮關鍵作用。我們的前期研究使用CelluSpot™的絲氨酸/蘇氨酸激酶肽微陣列分析，比較了兩種我們新建立的肝癌細胞系——原發肝癌細胞系和與之匹配的轉移肝癌細胞系（稱為 PLC/PRF/5-PT 和PLC/PRF/5-LM）——的磷酸化譜，兩種細胞系均來源於一種母代細胞系，但兩者的轉移潛力不同。我們發現，相較於原發肝癌細胞系（PLC/PRF/5-PT），轉移肝癌細胞系（PLC/PRF/5-LM）的NPM在蘇氨酸234/237的磷酸化（MPM-Thr234/237）水平上升。運用Western blot方法，在另一對轉移肝細胞癌細胞系中也發現了類似現象，轉移程度高的細胞系（MHCC-97H）比轉移程度低的細胞系（MHCC-97L）的MPM-Thr234/ 237磷酸化水平更高。以上兩種現象促使我們去探究NPM磷酸化在介導肝癌轉移過程中的作用。我們的前期研究已經證實了NPM與一個新的腫瘤轉移基因——Rho激酶2（ROCK2）——的物理相互作用，既往研究顯示ROCK2能夠協調胞漿中的細胞骨架事件從而導致肝癌浸潤。目前，我們有初步證據顯示Thr234/237磷酸化的缺陷能夠減少細胞浸潤以及與ROCK2的親和力，並伴隨ROCK2蛋白表達的下降。既然NPM的磷酸化對於實現NPM的調節功能是如此關鍵，那麼我們可以假設NPM的磷酸化對ROCK2介導的肝癌轉移也產生了影響作用。在本研究中，我們旨在評估p-NPM-Thr234/237在肝癌中的臨床意義，描述了肝癌中p-NPM-Thr234/237的生物學特性以及它的功能的內在機制。本研究獲得的新發現可能揭示了NPM磷酸化在肝癌進展中的地位，展示了一個新的針對肝癌轉移的分子治療標靶，以及促進我們對肝癌轉移的理解。

771111.label: Realisation of objectives
771111.value: (1) Immunostaining has been performed in 30 cases of primary HCC, metastatic HCC and their non-tumor samples to evaluate the expression changes of p-NPMThr234/237 and NPM in human HCCs. We found a stepwise increase in the expression of MPM-Thr234/237 from normal, primary HCC to metastatic HCCs. P-NPM-Thr234/237 was found to be preferentially expressed in metastatic HCCs when compared with primary HCC (p<0.05). By analyzing more clinical samples, we found the expression of p-NPM-Thr234/237 in primary HCC is not significant in terms of abundance and frequency, while intense and widespread expression was found in metastatic HCC. Due to this reason, we have not evaluated the prognostic value of p-NPMThr234/237 in primary HCC patients. We also found that p-NPMThr234/237 to be preferentially expressed in metastatic HCC cell lines. This objective has been completed successfully and all parts have been achieved satisfactorily except the evaluation of prognostic significance (2) To further characterize the functional role of p-NPM-Thr234/237 in HCC, we have constructed phosphor defective mutant Flag-NPM (234/237A) and cloned into lentiviral-based vector. We have overexpressed Flag-NPM (234/237A), wild-type NPM and control vector into Hep3B and Huh-7 cells. This plan is exactly the same as I wrote for the proposal and successfully accomplished. Using these clones, we have successfully evaluated the effect of NPM phosphorylation at T234/237 using proliferation, invasion and migration assays as written in the proposal. In addition, we have examined the in vivo metastatic role of p-NPM-Thr234/237 using the transfectants derived from Hep3B cells. This objective has been completely achieved. (3) We found that wild-type NPM was found to physically interact with a novel metastatic gene, Rho kinase II (ROCKII) by immunopreciptitation. But the binding activity has been diminished in phosphor defective mutant HA-NPM mutant. In addition, we found that p-NPM-Thr234/237 affected the expression of MLC-2 as what we have proposed. However, we couldn't find difference in expression of ROCKII upon alternation of phosphorylation of NPM at Thr234/237. We have tried to overcome this problem by purchasing another brand of ROCKII antibody (Cell Signal). However, we also could not detect any changes in ROCKII expression. However, due to limitation of time, we didn’t evaluate the effect of p-NPMThr234/237 on transcriptional activity of ROCKII. In view of this, we have not performed any rescue experiment to overexpress ROCKII in phosphor defective mutant Flag-NPM mutant. Due to the limitation described above, we have achieved 60% of the objective proposed in the proposal.

771111.label: Major findings and research outcome
771111.value: 1. Identification of p-NPM-Thr234/237 critical in HCC metastasis. We analyzed CelluSpot™ kinase peptide array to compare the phosphorylation profiles of our newly established pair of corresponding primary and metastatic HCC cell lines (namely PLC/PRF/5-PT and PLC/PRF/5-LM and found phosphorylation of Nucleophosmin (NPM) at threonines 234/237 (p-NPM-Thr234/237) was elevated in the metastatic cell line (PLC/PRF/5-LM) compared to the primary counterpart (PLC/PRF/5-PT). IHC staining showed that both p-NPMThr234/237 and NPM were found to be over-expressed in human HCC samples. We found a stepwise increase in the expression of MPM-Thr234/237 from normal, primary HCC to metastatic HCCs. P-NPM-Thr234/237 was found to be preferentially expressed in metastatic HCCs when compared with primary HCC (p<0.05). 2. Functional characterization of p-NPM-Thr234/237 in HCC. For functional characterization of p-NPM-Thr234/237 in HCC, we have constructed phosphor defective mutant flag-NPM (234/237A) and cloned into lentiviral-based vector. We have overexpressed flag-NPM (234/237A), wild-type NPM and control vector into Hep3B and Huh-7 cells. Compared with vector control cells, HCC cells transfected with WT-NPM exhibited enhanced cell proliferation, invasion and migration, while this enhancing effect was abolished when phosphorylation of NPM at 234/237 is defective. To confirm the metastatic role of p-NPM-Thr234/237 in HCC metastasis, we have inoculated Hep3B cells transfected with EV, WT-NPM, and Flag-NPM (234/237A) orthotopically to the liver of NOD/SCID mice. Consistent to the in vitro finding, we have found increased intra-hepatic and lung metastases in WT-NPM transfectant, while this effect is abolished when phosphorylation of NPM at 234/237 is defective. 3. CDK1 is crucial in p-NPM-Thr234/237 mediated HCC metastasis. Based on the CelluSpot™ Serine/Threonine kinase peptide array, phosphorylation of NPM at Thr234/237 is mediated by cyclin dependent kinase 1 (CDK1). To further confirm the role of CDK1 in p-NPM-Thr234/237 mediated metastasis, we have knocked down CDK1 expression in BEL7402 and SMMC. Knockdown of CDK1 in both BEL7402 and SMMC not also inhibited phosphorylation of CDK1 at Thr234/237, but also suppressed HCC cell proliferation, migration and invasion. 4. Molecular mechanism of p-NPM-Thr234/237 in HCC metastasis. We reported that wild-type NPM physically interact with ROCKII by immunopreciptitation, while the binding affinity is decreased in phosphor defective mutant Flag-NPM mutant. Accompanied with this observation, the downstream effector of ROCKII, MLC2 and p-MLC2 (Ser19) were found to be consistently decreased upon ablation of phosphorylation of NPM at Thr234/237. Based on this result, it suggests that phosphorylation of NPM at Thr234/237 affects the binding of NPM to ROCKII, which subsequently decrease its transcriptional activity.

771111.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
771111.value: In this proposal, we found that phosphorylation of NPM at Thr234/237 is crucial in HCC cell proliferation and metastasis, which is mediated by CDK1. Consistently, knockdown of CDK1 suppressed NPM-Thr234/237 mediated cell proliferation and metastasis. We will first publish this data and submit to Oncotarget. Since CDK1 is a kinase, which is potentially a druggable target for treatment of HCC. We may collaborate with biopharma to investigate the use of small molecule inhibitor against CDK1 in treatment of HCC. Using this data, we may apply the Innovative Technology Fund from Hong Kong government.

771111.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
771111.value: Liver Cancer (HCC) is the second leading fatal cancer in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong. Patients with this cancer have poor prognosis because it is often presented at advanced stage. The advanced disease stage is very much due to presence of frequent metastases. Metastasis is a complicated process involving activation of multiple kinase cascades but the molecular mechanism of metastasis in HCC is unclear. Using peptide array analysis, we found that phosphorylation of NPM at Threonine234/237(MPM-Thr234/237) is critical event in tumor spread of HCC. In HCC clinical samples, we found a stepwise increase in the expression of MPM-Thr234/237 from normal, primary HCC to HCC with spread to other organs. Using HCC cell lines, ablation of the phosphorylation event of NPM at Threonine234/237 markedly suppressed the proliferation and invasiveness of HCC cells, suggests that role of MPM-Thr234/237 in HCC progression. Mechanistically, NPM-Thr234/237 increased the expression of MLC2, a protein critical movement of cells. Our characterization of the role of p-NPM-Thr234/237 in HCC is original and novel. Our work will reveal the role of p-NPM-Thr234/237 in HCC metastasis. Clinicopathological data obtained in this study potentially be useful clinically to predict tumor metastasis and open up new avenues in cancer treatment.

771611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
771611.value: 背景：急性粒细胞白血病是一种异质性疾病，已公认是起源于一小群复制静止期的白血病生发细胞，该细胞群可以归避化疗药物的毒性从而产生不断扩增的粒系原始细胞，因此针对白血病生发细胞的特异靶向治疗便成为彻底根治白血病的紧迫策略。sox基因家族是一组参与胚胎发育不同过程的转录因子，它们与肿瘤生成有关，但其病理遗传通路仍未彻底明确。在最初的实验中，我们发现sox7基因在急性粒细胞白血病细胞株和原代细胞中均没有表达，但是在正常原始细胞和急性淋巴细胞白血病细胞中均有很高的表达。sox7启动子含有高度甲基化的CpG岛，而在用5’-氮杂胞苷后处理急性粒细胞白血病细胞株后可以诱导sox7重新表达，提示sox7的表达在表观遗传学水平得以抑制，sox7可能是急性粒细胞白血病中的肿瘤抑制因子。 目的：在探讨sox7在急性粒细胞白血病中的病理遗产学功能时，我们需要回答三个问题：第一，sox7在急性粒细胞白血病中是如何调控的？第二，sox7沉默对白血病产生是否重要？第三，联系sox7沉默和白血病生成的机制是什么？ 方法和计划：在完成对急性粒细胞白血病细胞株中sox7启动子CpG岛高度甲基化研究后，我们会进一步对原代病人标本进行该方面的研究。通过用5’-氮杂胞苷处理急性粒细胞白血病细胞株和原代急性粒细胞白血病细胞，我们将进一步证实之前对于sox7表达的相关研究结果。对于DNA甲基化和sox7表达的相关变化，我们将通过对白血病病人初诊和治疗后完全缓解的标本的研究进一步明确。为了评价sox7在正常造血和血液肿瘤中的功能，我们将会检测sox7在造血干细胞，定向髓系和淋系祖细胞中的表达。在正常造血过程中，从造血干细胞向髓系分化的不同阶段sox7表达的变化也会通过体内和体外实验来进行监测。另外，我们也将通过慢病毒转染技术，将sox7导入急性粒细胞白血病的细胞株和原代细胞中，对产生的效果通过生物化学，克隆产生和NOD/SCID小鼠移植实验进行监测。要明确sox7静默和白血病生成的关系机制，我们将借助TOPFLASH报告质粒研究sox7和β-catenin信息通路的关系。最后通过基因芯片技术检测sox7过度表达后全基因组基因的相关变化。 意义：该研究方案将对sox7在急性粒细胞白血病中的病理遗传功能和调控机制提供全新的解析。

771611.label: Realisation of objectives
771611.value: Objective 1: How is sox7 regulated in AML? We have identified 2 cytosine guanine dinucleotide (CpG) islands densely clustered around the SOX7 transcription/translation start site. Bisulfite sequencing has demonstrated CpG island hypermethylation in NB4, KG1, ML2, K562, and THP-1 cell lines and primary AML samples. The results were confirmed by methylation specific-PCR. DNA hypomethylating agent 5-Adc induced SOX7 expression at both transcripts and protein levels. Temporally, expression of SOX7 in KG1 correlated with DNA demethylation, providing a mechanistic link between DNA methylation and SOX7 gene silencing. Objective 2: How does sox7 silencing relate to leukemogenesis? SOX7 was preferentially expression in cord blood (UCB) CD34+CD38- (enriched with primitive hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells) compared with CD34+CD38+ population (less enriched) and in CD34-CD19+ (B-lymphoid) compared with CD34-CD33+ cells (myeloid). It was down-regulated in colonies and engrafting myeloid cells in NOD/SCID mouse transplantation. SOX7 knockdown in CD34+ UCB cells by siRNA reduced cell growth; induced cell-cycle arrest and reduced clonogenic activities and the engrafting myeloid populations. SOX7 expression in K562 cells reduced cellular proliferation, induced cell cycle arrest but had no effect on apoptosis. It also reduced clonogenic activity but differentiation was not affected. DNA hypomethylating agent 5-AdC significantly reduced leukemia cell proliferation and clonogenic activity, associated with demethylation of SOX7 promoter. Objective 3: What are the mechanisms linking sox7 silencing and leukemogenesis? We nucleofected K562 cells with β-catenin together with GFP-SOX7, or GFP-SOX7Δ (deletion of SOX7 β-catenin binding site) and demonstrated defective β-catenin binding of SOX7Δ. Differential binding of SOX7 and SOX7Δ to β-catenin was also seen in THP-1 cells in which β-catenin was expressed endogenously. SOX7 but not SOX7Δ expression significantly reduced the nonphosphorylated (active) form of β-catenin and downstream signaling, providing a mechanistic basis for the reduced TOPFlash activity upon SOX7 overexpression in AML. GFP-SOX7 and GFP plasmids lentivirally transduced into K562, ML2, and NB4 cell lines were shown to induce upregulation of 15 genes (including SOX7) including SOX5 and SOX6, suggesting that transcriptional transactivation is associated with SOX7 expression. Sprouty 3, a negative modulator of receptor tyrosine kinase signaling, was significantly upregulated, providing an important lead for studying the tumor suppressor function of SOX7. Overall, the experiments performed so far have satisfactorily addressed the three main objectives proposed in the original proposal.

771611.label: Major findings and research outcome
771611.value: In this proposal, we have revealed a hitherto undescribed tumor suppressor function of SOX7 and the underlying mechanisms with particular reference to its link with β-catenin/Wnt pathway. The information has shed important and novel insights to the pathogenesis of AML and related myeloid malignancies. Furthermore, the proposal has provided a research topic for training of a Ph.D. student (Dr. Wan Haixia, HKU Student ID 2008941561. Title of Thesis: Function of SOX7 in normal hematopoiesis and in acute lymphoblastic leukemia) who has successfully completed her study in April, 2013. In addition, results of the proposal were published in the following publication: Man CH, Fung TK, Wan H, Cher CY, Fan A, Ng N, Ho C, Wan TS, Tanaka T, So CW, Kwong YL, Leung AY. Suppression of SOX7 by DNA methylation and its tumor suppressor function in acute myeloid leukemia. Blood 2015;125(25):3928-36.

771611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
771611.value: The observation of a potent tumor suppressor function of SOX7 may open up a new paradigm for the design of future therapeutic strategy in AML. Specifically, 1. Future clinical trials on DNA hypomethylating agents in AML should consider incorporating SOX7 expression as a potential biomarkers to evaluate treatment outcome; 2. Methods to deliver SOX7 protein into AML cells by the use of nanoparticles are being evaluated. Furthermore, our initial screening of SOX genes in myeloid malignancies has generated important information about the expression profile of other SOX genes. Such information will provide us a solid foundation to further investigate their potential pathogenetic role in AML.

771611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
771611.value: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a group of heterogeneous diseases whose treatment outcome is generally unsatisfactory. Discovery of novel leukemogenic pathways common to most AML cases will be of important therapeutic implication. In this study, we have revealed a hitherto unknown tumor suppressor function of sox7 in the pathogenesis of AML. Observations arising from this proposal have generated novel information about the expression and pathogenetic role of sox7 in AML and during normal myeloid differentiation from hematopoietic stem cells. Importantly, the results have given mechanistic insight to the link between sox7 and beta-catenin/Wnt pathway. SOX7 should be considered as an important biomarker in future clinical trials on hypomethylating agents in AML. Furthermore, the possibility of delivering SOX7 protein into AML cells using nanoparticles is being considered.

773611.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
773611.value: 在植物中，黃酮是一大類具有重要生理活性的黃酮類代謝產物。而且，持續食用含有顯著水平的黃酮或其它黃酮類化合物的食品與心血管疾病和癌症風險的降低緊密相關。黃酮衍生化合物異牡荊黃素(isovitexin)和麥黃酮(tricin)是在稻殼和麩皮中廣泛報道的健康成份。這些化合物也積累在營養組織中。異牡荊黃素是一種黃酮C-苷，而麥黃酮則主要以O-苷的形式存在於禾穀類植物中。長期以來，人們一直推測黃酮C-苷與O-苷黃酮類化合物的生物合成起源是不同的。最近，我們已證明植物中一個新的P450酶，CYP93G2，提供2-羥基黃酮作為C-糖基化的底物。這項研究有效地證明水稻中黃酮C-□的代謝途徑研究還存在不足。然而，黃酮O-苷（比如麥黃酮）的生物合成途徑在很大程度上仍然不太明確。所以本計劃研究的重點為黃酮O-苷的生物合成途徑。黃酮3’，5’羥化酶（F3’5’H），黃酮合成酶（FNS）和黃酮O-甲基轉移酶（OMT）是從黃烷酮形成麥黃酮苷元的預測途徑上的關鍵酶。作為典型的單子葉系統，水稻中大量的DNA序列信息使我們能夠識別與F3’5’H，FNS和OMT同源的基因編碼。這些基因中的一部分發現在水稻幼苗中有表達，並且生成大量的黃酮衍生物。在本研究中，將測定重組蛋白酶的活性，分析轉基因和突變型植物的代謝產物，以確定它們的生化功能與麥黃酮生物合成的相關性。預期的實驗結果將促進我們對單子葉植物中黃酮C-苷和O-苷的不同代謝途徑的認知。此外，水稻的可食用組織中（如胚乳）通常不含有這些對健康有益的植物化學物質。完整的了解水稻中黃酮生物合成的分子生物學知識，將對如何在可食用組織中富集這些物質的代謝工程提供深刻的見解。

773611.label: Realisation of objectives
773611.value: (1) In vitro enzyme activity assays The different putative rice flavonoid enzymes were expressed in E. coli or yeast (P450 enzymes) for in vitro enzyme activity assays. Three FNSI homologs (Os10g39140, Os04g49194, and Os03g03034) were demonstrated to have flavone synthase (FNS) activities, converting naringenin/eriodictyol to apigenin/luteolin. Two FNSII homologs which are P450 proteins were also tested: CYP93G1, but not CYP93F1, showed FNS activities. The flavonoid 3’5’-hydroxylase (F3’5’H) homolog (CYP75A11) in rice did not show any F3’5’H activities. Instead, a F3’H-like protein (CYP75B4) was found to have specific 5’-hydroxylation activity on chrysoeriol (3’-O-methylated flavone), while showing only 3’-hydroxylation activity on other flavonoids. Four OMT homologs were tested: only ROMT-9 (Os08g06100), but not Os04g09654, Os04g09604, or Os04g01470, showed OMT activities on the B ring of different flavonoids. A chalcone synthase (CHS)-like protein (OsPKS1; Os10g34360) with unknown catalytic functions was also investigated. CHS is the key branch enzyme for the biosynthesis of all flavonoids including flavones. The enzyme did not show CHS activities but accepted fatty acyl-CoAs to make tetraketide pyrones which are precursors of pollen wall polymer (sporopollenin). (2) Metabolite analysis of Arabidopsis plants over-expressing rice flavonoid enzymes For the rice enzymes with demonstrated in vitro activities, Arabidopsis O/E lines were generated for metabolite analysis. CYP75B4 restored the accumulation of 3’-hydroxylated flavonoids in F3’H mutant plants while ROMT-9 restored the accumulation of B-ring O-methylated flavonoids in OMT mutant plants. Results also indicated that none of the rice FNSI enzymes are functional in planta. Instead, CYP93G1 O/E plants accumulate flavones (apigenin, luteolin, chrysoeriol) which are not present naturally in Arabidopsis. Co-expression of CYP93G1 and CYP75B4 resulted in tricin production, demonstrating the role of CYP75B4 in the 5’-modification of flavones in planta. (3) Metabolite/functional analysis of rice T-DNA insertion lines. T-DNA insertion lines were obtained for the enzymes with demonstrated in vitro activities. Rice and other grasses accumulate large amounts of flavones in vegetative tissues. All the three FNSI mutant lines did not show any changes in flavone profiles. By contrast, both CYP93G1 and CYP75B5 mutant lines are completely devoid of tricin accumulation, further establishing their essential roles in tricin biosynthesis. On the other hand, the ROMT-9 mutant showed 50% reduction in tricin levels, suggesting that there are other OMT enzymes involved in tricin biosynthesis. The OsPKS1 mutant showed normal vegetative development but produced irregularly and lightly stained pollen. Its seed formation was reduced by 50% compared to wild-type plants.

773611.label: Major findings and research outcome
773611.value: The major objective of this project is to elucidate the biosynthetic steps for tricin in rice. Flavones are constitutively accumulated as C-glycosides and O-linked conjugates in vegetative tissues of cereals and other grasses. It has long been presumed that these two types of flavone derivatives have different biosynthetic origins. Previously, we reported that CYP93G2 functions as a flavanone 2-hydroxylase that provides 2-hydroxyflavanones for C-glycosylation, followed by the formation of the flavone nucleus. Tricin is a 3’,5’-dimethoxylated flavone exclusively found as O-linked conjugates. The flavone nucleus was proposed to form before the O-linked modification but the detailed enzymatic steps were unknown. Here, we demonstrated that CYP93G1, the closest homolog of CYP93G2 in rice, is a FNSII that converts flavanones to flavones and leads to flavone accumulation in transgenic Arabidopsis. Metabolite profiling of a CYP93G2 insertion mutant demonstrated the depletion of tricin O-linked conjugates. Our finding essentially established that CYP93G1 is a key branch point enzyme channeling flavanones to the biosynthesis of tricin O-linked conjugates. Previously, F3’5’H belonging to the CYP75A subfamily were thought to generate tricetin from apigenin for 3’,5’-O-methylation to form tricin. However, we demonstrated that CYP75B4 is a unique flavonoid B-ring hydroxylase indispensable for tricin biosynthesis. CYP75B4 catalyzes the 5’-hydroxylation of chrysoeriol to form selgin which is modified by an OMT (e.g. ROMT9) to form tricin. CYP75B4 is tricin deficient while co-expression of CYP93G1 and CYP75B4 in Arabidopsis resulted in tricin production. Based on our work, the reaction steps leading to tricin biosynthesis are then reconstructed as naringenin → apigenin → luteolin → chrysoeriol → selgin → tricin. The homologous sequences of CYP93G2, CYP93G1 and CYP75B4 are highly conserved in Poaceae and they may constitute a lineage-specific pathway specifically recruited for flavone biosynthesis in monocot. During the early stage of this project, we included a CHS-like (OsPKS1) gene in our analytical pipeline for flavonoid investigations. Interestingly, we found that it was actually an anther-specific polyketide synthase required for normal pollen development. OsPKS1 and homologous sequences are highly conserved in both dicot and monocot. They are involved in the biosynthetic pathway that generates monomers for polymerization of pollen wall (sporopollenin) which is essential for male fertility in flowering plants. This project provided training for a PhD student (Lam Pui Ying) and two postdoctoral fellows (Wang Yanbing and Zhu Fuyuan). Results were published in two papers in Plant Physiology (CYP93G1 and CYP75B4) and one paper in Physiologia Plantarum (OsPKS1) and were presented at two international conferences.

773611.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
773611.value: Recruitment of lineage-specific pathways has resulted in structural diversity of flavonoids among land plants. Our work using rice as a monocot model has provided a framework for future molecular and phylogenetic investigation of the biosynthetic pathways of different flavone-derived metabolites which are prevalent in many monocot species today. In this regard, two undergraduate students are now working on the catalytic functions of the CYP93G1, CYP93G2, and CYP75B4 homologs in different cereal crops including sorghum and maize as their final year project. Several studies have demonstrated the incorporation of tricin into cell wall lignin in a few monocot species. Recently, tricin was suggested to serve as a nucleation or polymer initiation site during lignification. Therefore, it is plausible that the CYP93G1 and CYP75B4 mutations affect the formation and structure lignin in rice. We have recently initiated a collaborative project with Dr. Yuki Tobimatsu (Kyoto University) to analyze lignin content and composition of the tricin-deficient mutants generated from this project. Our PhD student Lam Pui Ying will be spending 6 months in Dr. Tobimatsu’s laboratory to work on the lignin analysis.

773611.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
773611.value: Flavones are a major class of flavonoids with a wide range of physiological functions in plants. On the other hand, flavones as dietary constituents or supplements have become increasingly popular due to their health-beneficial effects, such as cancer prevention, antioxidation, antiviral activities, and reduced risks of cardiovascular diseases. In rice and other cereals, flavones are constitutively accumulated in vegetative tissues, grain bran, and husk, but not in endosperm which is the preferred and commonly consumed tissue. This work has successfully discovered two enzymes (CYP93G1 and CYP75B4) that are involved in two key reaction steps leading to tricin (a prevalent form of flavone in vegetative tissues) formation. They can be utilized as molecular targets for metabolic engineering of crops that do not produce the health-beneficial flavones in edible tissues. Our results also suggested that tricin biosynthesis may represent a phylogenetically unique metabolic pathway recruited by monocots since their occurrence. Furthermore, a rice enzyme (OsPKS1) originally thought to be involved in flavonoid biosynthesis was found to be required for formation of pollen wall which is essential for pollen function. OsPKS1 may be utilized for manipulating male sterility in economically important plants. Male sterility is a valuable trait useful for hybrid seed production and other agricultural applications.

773711.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
773711.value: Dental root caries (decay on tooth root surface) is common among older adults in Hong Kong and world-wide, which can lead to pain and loss of teeth, and affect general health. However, no established prevention or treatment method is available. The main objectives of this study are to compare the effectiveness of three methods in preventing new root surface caries and in arresting (remineralizing and hardening) early/shallow caries lesions. These are: a) giving oral hygiene instruction (OHI) and provision of fluoridated toothpaste; b) giving OHI, provision of fluoridated toothpaste and annual applications of silver diamine fluoride (SDF) solution; and c) giving OHI, provision of fluoridated toothpaste and annual applications of SDF solution followed by application of potassium iodide solution. The other objective is to assess whether application of potassium iodide solution immediately after application of SDF on early caries lesions will affect the colour of the arrested root surface caries lesions by making them whiter in appearance and hence improving the appearance. This study is a randomized clinical trial lasting for 30 months. A total of 300 subjects will be recruited from social centres for elders located in different districts in Hong Kong. Baseline clinical examination will be conducted by a single calibrated examiner in the social centres using an intra-oral LED light, mouth mirrors and probes. Subjects will be randomly allocated into the three study groups and receive interventions accordingly. Follow-up examinations at 6-month intervals will be carried out to assess the clinical outcomes, i.e. whether new root caries has developed and whether the active root caries found at baseline have become arrested (remineralized and hardened) or not. Photographs of the arrested lesions will be taken to assess their colour. Results of this study will provide the much needed evidence to guide the dental professionals in Hong Kong and worldwide in deciding on the most appropriate intervention for the prevention and treatment of this common dental disease of the older adults. In the long term, pain from dental origin and unnecessary loss of teeth in the older adults can be prevented and their oral health-related quality of life can be much improved. 牙齒根齲（發生於牙齒根面的蛀牙）在香港乃至世界的老年人群中是常見的口腔問題。它可以導致疼痛和牙齒喪失，進而影響全身健康。 然而，目前尚無確實的預防和治療牙齒根齲的方法。本研究的目的是比較以下三種方法在預防新發牙根齲以及在靜止早期/淺根齲發展（再礦化及硬化）方面的效果： 1）指導如何保持口腔衛生， 並送予氟化牙膏； 2）指導如何保持口腔衛生，送予氟化牙膏，並每年塗氟化氨銀溶液一次； 3）指導如何保持口腔衛生，送予氟化牙膏，每年塗氟化氨銀溶液一次，並於塗氟化氨銀溶液後即刻塗上碘化鉀溶液。 本研究的另外一個目的是評估在氟化氨銀溶液應用後再立刻塗上碘化鉀溶液會否減輕靜止早期牙根齲的著色，進而改善其外觀。 本研究是為期30個月的隨機臨床試驗。研究對象為家居長者，將會從香港不同地區的社區長者中心中招收，而被邀請參加的長者人數將合共有300名。長者同意參加後，將會於社區長者中心內，由一名經過標準一致性培訓的檢查者，使用口內LED光源，口鏡和探針，為其進行口腔檢查（基線檢查）。基線檢查後，參加的長者將被隨機分入三個研究組（分別採用以上三種方法之一）並接受相應的干預措施。隨訪檢查將會每6個月進行一次以評估臨床結果，從而跟進參加者是否有新發根齲出現，以及原有的活動根齲是否被靜止（再礦化及硬化）。靜止齲損將會被拍照記錄以評估其顏色。 本研究之結果將會為香港以及世界的牙科專業人士提供非常必要的臨床依據，以幫助他們選擇最為合適的干預措施來預防和治療老年人群中常見的牙齒根齲。從長遠計，老年患者中的牙源性疼痛和不必要的牙齒喪失將因此得到有效預防，而且他們的口腔健康相關生活質量也會得到極大提高。

773711.label: Realisation of objectives
773711.value: A randomized clinical trial was conducted among 323 elders in Hong Kong by the investigators. The study elders were randomly allocated into 3 intervention groups as follows: Gp1 (placebo control) – annual application of soda water; Gp2 – annual application of SDF solution; Gp3 – annual application of SDF solution immediately followed by potassium iodide (KI) solution. They were followed for 30 months and at the completion of this study 257 (79.6%) elders were reviewed. The collected data were analysed and results were generated to address all the study objectives fully. For objective 1 (100% addressed) - annual application of SDF or SDF/KI solution is more effective than giving oral hygiene instructions (OHI) in preventing root caries among elders. For objective 2 (100% addressed) - annual application of SDF or SDF/KI solution is more effective than giving oral hygiene instructions (OHI) in arresting root caries among elders. For objective 3 (100% addressed) - application of KI after SDF solution application has no effects on the effectiveness of SDF nor the colour of the arrested dental caries lesions. For objective 4 (100% addressed) - the null hypothesis is rejected. For objective 5 (100% addressed) - the null hypothesis is rejected. For objective 6 (100% addressed) - the null hypothesis is not rejected.
